title: [Moonglae Inn, North Lobby]
description: The north end of the spacious lobby is flanked by the front desk on one side and a wide spiral staircase on the other.  Between them, a lunar mobile spins slowly against a sky of black spidersilk stitched with gleaming white starstones.  A tall, dignified elf stands behind the front desk, ready to attend to your every need.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Upper Cloister]
description: A covered walkway paved with dark blue slate circles a skylit atrium in the center of the building.  A low greystone wall bolstered by a row of graceful black marble pillars ensures that inattentive guests will not step out into the empty space.  A large pane of stained glass framed in dark oak hangs between the pillars across from a heavy, black ash door on the opposite wall.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Iron Bridge]
description: A wrought-iron statue of a drake spreads its wings out wide, its neck extended towards the heavens.  A torch burns in the drake's mouth.  At the south end of the bridge a series of steps lead up to a hill.  To the north, the bridge ends at another hilltop.

A wrought-iron statue of a drake spreads its wings out wide, its neck extended towards the heavens.  At the south end of the bridge a series of steps lead up to a hill.  To the north, the bridge ends at another hilltop.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Bridges]
description: Two bridges fan out from this hilltop.  The iron bridge to the northeast curves slightly to reach a hill to the north while the cobblestone bridge to the southwest is as straight as an arrow.  Some iron steps lead to the iron bridge.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]
description: A rock wall, chinked with earth, wraps around the hillside to the west.  The night brings mysterious shadows with it.  A few stones have pushed out from the wall and now serve as hand and footholds.
A rock wall, chinked with earth, wraps around the hillside to the west.  A few stones have pushed out from the wall and now serve as hand and footholds.

title: [Whistler's Pass, Hills]
description: A wall of rock, barely as tall as the average giantman, surrounds the eastern side of the hill.  Earth chinking fills the space between the stones.  A few stones jut from the barrier, serving as hand and footholds for climbers.  Moonlight splashes across the stone walls.

A wall of rock, barely as tall as the average giantman, surrounds the eastern side of the hill.  Earth chinking fills the space between the stones.  A few stones jut from the barrier, serving as hand and footholds for climbers.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Cliff Face]
description: Fine showers of dirt and gravel periodically fall from this crumbling cliff face and pile up in shifting mounds at its base.  With insulting ease a whiptail lizard skitters straight across the rock wall.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Cliff Face]
description: Almost any movement sends dirt and pebbles tumbling down the vertiginous slope, and one section has already been torn away by a recent rockslide.  Digging into the loose gravel, next to a pale green lichen-covered boulder, is a hairy-legged beetle.  A hopefully stable protrusion is visible just below the trail.

title: [Solhaven, Bayside Road]
description: You can barely hear the roar of the Cairnfang falling into Solhaven Bay from here.  The Bay stretches out before you, sunlight glinting on the deep blue waters.  Dwarves, elves, half-elves, and humans push southward, headed into the city.

You can barely hear the roar of the Cairnfang falling into Solhaven Bay from here.  The Bay stretches out before you, moonlight glinting on the deep blue waters.  Dwarves, elves, half-elves, and humans push southward, headed into the city.

title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: A row of stone cottages lines the street, some washed in greens and blues.  A street peddler stands nearby, animatedly haggling with a dwarven woman over his wares.  Passersby simply walk around the pair, ignoring their animated discussion.

A row of stone cottages lines the street, some washed in greens and blues.  Clusters of gaudy jewels gleam beneath the garish awning of a street peddler's stall.  Nearby, a series of flagstone steps descend toward Bayside Road.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Garden]
description: Greenery around a charming manor provides a backdrop for a colorful array of flowers taking shelter under a grove of assorted fruit trees.  Burbling brightly, a multi-tiered riverstone fountain with crystal clear water cascading down its surface is surrounded by three carved benches, and a path of round, grey stones meanders up a small hill to the steps of a gazebo, then down to a stunningly azure pond.  Serving as the ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of regal, vibrantly plumed peacocks struts amongst the verdure.

Bathed in soft moonlight, a large riverstone manor is surrounded by verdant greenery and a fragrant array of flowers and fruit trees. Moonbeams bounce off of a burbling stone fountain surrounded by three carved benches, and a path of round, grey stones meanders up a small hill to the gazebo steps, then down to a dark azure pond. Occupying the ever-moving focal center of the garden, a muster of regal peacocks struts amongst the verdure, their colors eye-catching beneath the stars.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Gazebo]
description: Ivory marble inlaid with splinters of green and gold extends to the high, domed roof, contributing to an uncluttered, open cathedral feel.  Hanging from the rounded roof, a multitude of pots overflow with flowery growth, the tendrils draping down to mingle with morning glory vines twining up the gazebo's supporting colonnade.  Surrounded by verdant life and soft fragrance, several wicker chairs accommodate striking views of the entire garden and the pond below.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Cliff Face]
description: The steep cliff which rises above the trail here is primarily a pinkish granite with cubic fracture patterns, traced with a web of glistening white quartz veins.  Black lichen grows in patches over the lower portion.  At the base of the cliff is a small pile of rocks.

title: [Gorget Trails, West Cliff Face]
description: A small tree once grew right below this path, the only evidence now a twisted and weathered root still embedded in a tiny niche.  The imprint of a cloven hoof in the dusty ground attests to an agile mountain goat population.

title: [Wehnimer's, West Ring Rd.]
description: The road bends to conform to the inside curve of the southern and western walls of the high modwir log palisades, which converge here.  A whiff of the scents of the marketplace rises from a narrow lane to the east.
The road is twisted and dark, broken up by black veins that snake along the street.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point, the moonlight gently illuminating the interior of the tower.

Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point.

title: [Wehnimer's, West Ring Rd.]
description: Traffic is almost nonexistent at night on this portion of West Ring Road.  Most of the people still out in the streets seem to be using the busier roads that lie to the north and south, leading to the square.  A few warehouses and smaller shops line the way here.

Traffic is light on this portion of West Ring Road.  Most people seem to be using the busier roads that lie to the north and south, leading to the square.  A few warehouses and smaller shops line the way here.
Glistening black veins run along the ground, tearing up the cobblestone road.  The stench of death and decay hang like a thick cloud.

title: [Moot Hall, Great Lobby]
description: This is the great lobby of the Moot Hall.  Hushed voices discussing urgent town matters echo off the high ceiling.  The walls are draped in rich tapestries framing niches that hold marble busts of local dignitaries.  Ahead of you is a double door, and to your left, a mahogany door bearing a silver plaque.

The great lobby is quite spacious, with an oak bannister wrapping around a staircase leading to the second story of Moot Hall.  The wall are draped in rich tapestries framing niches that hold marble busts of local dignitaries.  To the north is a double door, and to the west, a mahogany door bearing a silver plaque.  A carpeted pathway leads toward the Debt Collector's Office.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, out

title: [Moot Hall, Landing]
description: You are on the landing of the second story of the Moot Hall.  The dust on the bannister and the cobwebs in the corner of the room indicate this part of the building does not see many visitors, in spite of what the sign on the varnished modwir door here says.

Sunlight filters in through several windows throughout the landing of the second story of Moot Hall.  The bannisters are a polished oak that run the length of the upstairs, and sweep down the staircase leading to the lobby.  A sign is displayed on a varnished modwir door.

Moonlight filters in through several windows throughout the landing of the second story of Moot Hall.  The bannisters are a polished oak that run the length of the upstairs, and sweep down the staircase leading to the lobby.  A sign is displayed on a varnished modwir door.

Sunlight filters in through several windows throughout the landing of the second story of Moot Hall.  The bannisters are a polished oak that run the length of the upstairs, and sweep down the staircase leading to the lobby.  A sign is displayed on a varnished modwir door with a large vertebral bone-framed blackboard hanging next to it.

title: [Moot Hall, Upstairs Corridor]
description: This end of the hallway is quieter, its hardwood floor muffled by a large burgundy-colored rug.  Potted plants, well-watered but looking a bit starved for sun in their dark corners, stand on two elaborate brass tables on either side of a richly carved mahogany door at the end of the hall.

The end of the hallway is enclosed by large burgundy rugs.  Potted plants are displayed on brass stands resting between a polished maoral door and a richly carved mahogany door.  The dark corridor doesn't offer much in terms of natural lighting.

title: [Moot Hall, Rooftop]
description: Dark slate runs across the roof of Moot Hall, providing solid footing and an impressive view of the town square below.  To the west, the great oak tree in the center of town rises up, partially obscuring the western side of the bazaar.

title: [Aznell's Armory, Forge]
description: Bits and pieces of armor adorn the walls, leather on one, and metal on the facing wall.  Scraps of leather and metal are littered across the floor, thickest near the iron anvil where apprentices are working on a misshapen lump of metal.  The heat and the closeness of the forge press in around you.

title: [Aznell's Armory, Rooftop]
description: The southwest corner of the Town Square expands below the rooftop, as dark alleys snake in between wooden shops and buildings.  Guards can be seen in a ballista tower nearby, eyes scanning the horizon.

title: [Tykel's Arms, Backroom]
description: This is the quiet backroom of the weaponsmith's shop.  Here are stored prized pieces of exquisite armor and weapons, most either ancient heirlooms or crafted by famous armorers from throughout the land.

title: [Catacombs, Musty Basement]
description: Large crates, rusted tools, and broken weapons of every description fill most of the space in this dank cellar.  Cobwebs hang from the raftered ceiling, apparently undisturbed for ages.  On the far wall, you notice a rectangular depression.

title: [Hearthstone, Courtyard]
description: Before you stands a grand old manor, framed by huge willows to the east and west.  The elegant trees sway gently in the moonlight, dappling the cobblestone courtyard with ever-shifting patterns of light and dark.  Snippets of conversation drift away from the long porch stretching along the full width of the great old house, as several guests enjoy the hospitality and ambience of this fine hideaway.

Before you stands a grand old manor, framed by huge willows to the east and west.  The elegant trees sway gently, dappling the cobblestone courtyard with ever-shifting patterns of light and dark.  Snippets of conversation drift away from the long porch stretching along the full width of the great old house, as several guests enjoy the hospitality and ambience of this fine hideaway.

title: [Hearthstone, Front Porch]
description: Airy and open, the porch is enclosed by smooth, freshly painted white modwir up to a height of about four feet.  As you ponder the sky-blue color of the ceiling and a lacework of deep green ivy that crisscrosses the open space between posts, the hubbub of the world beyond quickly fades away.  Rocking chairs of various sizes are an inviting sight, and an elegant green marble arch provides a tantalizing view of the splendors inside the old manor.

title: [Coastal Cliffs]
description: The cliffs narrow and you catch a glimpse of the jagged, rocky wasteland that lies eighty or so feet below you.  A few small rocks tumble out over the edge,  and it is breathless moments later before you hear them smash against the boulders below.

The cliffs narrow and you catch a glimpse of the jagged, rocky wasteland that lies eighty or so feet below you.  A few small rocks tumble out over the edge, and it is breathless moments later before you hear them smash against the boulders below.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Shoreline]
description: The rocky shoreline along the bottom of the cliff makes entry into the bay too treacherous to consider.  Muddy water covers the few soft spots in the ground between the rocks.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overgrown Path]
description: The soft, melancholy keening of the Sirenflower rises and falls as the breeze whispers erratically through the trees, turning your thoughts momentarily introspective.

title: [Underground Ruin, Entrance Hall]
description: You are in the northern end of a huge entrance hall.  It goes on to the south beyound the reach of your eyesight.  Your feet kick up small clouds of dust as you make your way around.  The smooth walls are covered with the faint rememberings of murals depicting great sea battles.

You are in the northern end of a huge entrance hall.  It goes on to the south beyond the reach of your eyesight.  Your feet kick up small clouds of dust as you make your way around.  The smooth walls are covered with the faint rememberings of murals depicting great sea battles.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: A low ground fog drifts between the thick boles of trees, cloaking the trunks with silvery haze.  Little undergrowth has penetrated this part of the wood.  A few large boulders sit between the oaks, and as the fog eddies around them, they momentarily take on the appearance of living creatures lurking in the shadows.

A few large boulders sit between the oaks, and as the fog eddies around them, they momentarily take on the appearance of living creatures lurking in the gloom.

title: [Blighted Forest, Treetop]
description: High in the branches of the oak, the thick growth of limbs, intersecting and crossing, offers an easy passageway between the trees.  The boughs are wide and easily traversed.  Far below, some large boulders on the forest floor are occasionally visible through breaks in the dense foliage.

High in the branches of the oak, the thick growth of limbs, intersecting and crossing, offers an easy passageway between the trees.  The boughs are wide and easily traversed, and the moonlight is brighter here.  Far below, the shadowy forms of some large boulders on the forest floor are occasionally visible through breaks in the dense foliage.

title: [Blighted Forest]
description: The trail passes through a grove of trees with little undergrowth.  Nettles and rhododendrons cloaking other parts of the wood have all but deserted the area, leaving the stark, black tree trunks standing in an austere congregation, like sentries at watch.

title: [Blighted Forest, Treetop]
description: High in the branches of the oak, the thick growth of limbs, intersecting and crossing, offers an easy passageway between the trees.  The boughs are wide and easily traversed.  Far below, the forest floor is occasionally glimpsed through breaks in the dense foliage.

High in the branches of the oak, the thick growth of limbs, intersecting and crossing, offers an easy passageway between the trees.  The boughs are wide and easily traversed, and the moonlight is brighter here.  Far below, the forest floor is occasionally glimpsed through breaks in the dense foliage.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Tavern]
description: Three shallow steps lead down into a broad depression in the central hall of the inn.  Dominated by a cluster of circular tables and high-backed chairs, the tavern room is alive with the omnipresent sounds of murmuring voices, clanking tankards, and creaking furniture.  The sweet odors of honey mead and berry wine mingle in the air.  Toward the rear of the vast hall, a highly polished wooden staircase ascends to the second floor.

title: [Shimmarglin Inn, Landing]
description: Illuminated by twin glass orbs, a hanging tapestry covers one wall of the second floor landing.  A detailed nightscape sits forever frozen within its expertly woven fibers.  A dimly lit hallway heads off in opposite directions.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Rocky Trail]
description: Small rocks are scattered across the trail before it turns up the mountain.  A series of evergreens line the trail up to the foot of the mountain.  An onyx obelisk stands as a silent sentinel at the base of the mountain.  Moonbeams seem to focus on the obelisk.

Small rocks are scattered across the trail before it turns up the mountain.  A series of evergreens line the trail up to the foot of the mountain.  An onyx obelisk stands as a silent sentinel at the base of the mountain.

title: [The Falcon, Foredeck]
description: A bronze-beaked falcon figurehead juts from the prow of the vessel, its spread wings embracing the crimson-painted hull.  Wrought from verdigris bronze, a waist-high railing mimics vines twining around modwir saplings.  A carved redwood ship's wheel crowns a raised platform several paces behind the figurehead.
b.location: The Falcon, inside the seaside town of Solhaven

title: [Whistler's Pass]
description: Overhead, the edge of one of the high rock walls has crumbled, sending a large pile of boulders down into the pass.  Contrasting round and jagged edges protrude from the conglomeration of rock, effectively barring the pass from further movement to the south.  Strangely, a few shallow indentations have been cut into the rock, perhaps as an aid to those who might wish to climb them.

title: [Whistler's Pass]
description: A pile of large boulders, the remnants of a partial collapse of the canyon wall, seem to block further passage through the cleft in the mountainside.  Flecked with a few clusters of orange and pale green lichen, the boulders appear to have lain in this position for some time.  Oddly, some of the large stones have been etched with what appear to be shallow hand and footholds.

title: [Whistler's Pass]
description: Skull-sized stones and gravel litter the passage, making movement through the tight cleft especially difficult.  As travelers carefully pick their way across the shifting ground beneath their feet, the grating sound of stone grinding against stone echoes through the pass.  A pile of large boulders blocks movement to the south.

title: [Whistler's Pass]
description: High stone walls reach toward the dim lights of the starry sky, their smooth facades punctuated by small clusters of lichen and withered clumps of pale grass.  A pile of large boulders has fallen here, blocking further passage to the north.  Oddly, the towering stone walls do not appear to have crumbled or been damaged, cloaking the origin of the tumbled boulders in mystery.

High stone walls drape thick shadows across the narrow cleft, their smooth facades punctuated by small clusters of lichen and withered clumps of yellowed grass.  A pile of large boulders has fallen here, blocking further passage to the north.  Oddly, the towering stone walls do not appear to have crumbled or been damaged, cloaking the origin of the tumbled boulders in mystery.

title: [Khazar's Hold, Central]
description: A dwarven outpost is located on this shelf carved into the rock mountain face.  Ragged tents line the edges of the outpost along the cliff and rock face.  A ramshackle tavern that sits just to the north has a faded wooden sign hanging unsteadily above its door.  The wind whips around the sides of the mountain, kicking up dirt and adding quite a chill to the air.  Diverse groups of travelers wander past, most likely just passing through on their way to another town.

title: [Western DragonSpine, Cliff]
description: A rough precipice juts out from the mountainside, creating a ledge above.  Tufts of sturdy grasses grow out of dirt that has collected in the crevices of the rock.  The moonlight glows softly on the sea of mist in the valley below.

A rough precipice juts out from the mountainside, creating a ledge above.  Tufts of sturdy grasses grow out of dirt that has collected in the crevices of the rock.  A sea of white mist floats near the floor of the valley below, tendrils of the mist whirling and dissipating above the surface.

title: [Western DragonSpine, Slope]
description: The air is bitterly cold and dry.  The edges of the dull grey clouds above shimmer bright silver, reflecting the moonlight.  Grass taking root in patches of dirt rustles softly as the strong breeze constantly blows around the mountain.  The uneven rock face and small ledge are noticeably smoothed by the sand and dirt that ride the unrelenting wind.

The air is cold and dry.  Grass taking root in patches of dirt rustles softly as the strong breeze constantly blows around the mountain.  Clouds created by the high peaks of the mountain range drift slowly through the sky.  The uneven rock face and small ledge are noticeably smoothed by the sand and dirt that ride the unrelenting wind.

title: [Western DragonSpine, Slope]
description: The mist below glows white from the moonlight.  The stars are filtered out by the bright moons, but are still visible.  The dark ledge is smoothed somewhat, and traces of moss line the small indentions of the rock.  The stiff breeze adds a chill to the air.  A rocky crevice leads upwards, and the ledge expands towards the northwest.

A few small, puffy white clouds float in the air around the peaks of the mountain range above.  The deep blue sky shimmers beyond the mountains and clouds.  The stiff breeze adds a chill to the air.  A rocky crevice leads upwards, and the ledge expands towards the northwest.

title: [Western DragonSpine, Slope]
description: The silence on the ledge combined with the heavy mist isolates the area.  The only features are a light grey wall of fog to the west and the solid dark grey of the mountain to the east.  A nearly imperceptible breeze floats past occasionally, adding to the eerie atmosphere.  The ledge leads off to the northwest, and the cliff below looks scalable.

title: [Western DragonSpine, Slope]
description: This short, narrow ledge runs along the side of the massive mountain.  Deep fissures along the face of the mountain are jagged and sharp, untouched by any form of erosion.  A jagged cliff leads upward, bearing natural handholds created by the cracks and crevices in the rock.  The damp air hangs heavily throughout the area, creating a cool, raw atmosphere.

title: [River Tower East, Headquarters]
description: Papers are strewn over the desk that stands in the middle of the room.  On the wall behind the desk is a banner with the insignia of the guard regiment assigned to man the walls and watchtowers of Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [River Tower East, Barracks]
description: You enter a square room with cots pushed back against the walls and a trunk at the foot of each bed.  Everything in the room denotes order and readiness.  In times of emergency, the extra militia sleep here.  To the north a recessed alcove is partly obscured by spare uniforms hanging from hooks.

title: [River Tower East, Barracks]

title: [River Tower East, Roof]
description: A small, roofed structure provides some weather protection on the open top level of the guard tower.  The view north across the bay affords a valuable vantage point, looking out towards the island of Glaoveln, home port of the warlike Ice Krolvin.  To the west and south, the blue rivers and rocky slopes of the Lower Trollfang region provide a breathtaking vista.

title: [Tall Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point, the moonlight gently illuminating the interior of the tower.

title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: The tiny cottages here seem to have grown straight from the steep hillside.  From the top of the steps, you can see more of the Port stretching southward.  Farther in the distance, the dark stripe that is the Vornavis Canal slices the city in two.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Rocky Trail]
description: Here the weathered rocks provide many hand and footholds for easy climbing.  Cool patches of moss provide relief for sore hands.  The trail above grows steadily steeper as it winds its way up the mountain.  The soft hooting of an owl can be heard in the distance.

Here the weathered rocks provide many hand and footholds for easy climbing.  Cool patches of moss provide relief for sore hands.  The trail above grows steadily steeper as it winds its way up the mountain.

title: [The Black Rose, Foredeck]
description: A bronze-beaked falcon figurehead adorns the prow of the vessel, its spread metal wings cleaving to the crimson-painted hull.  Wrought from the same metal, a high railing takes the form of a knotted rope supported by sculpted figures of slender men and women spaced about the edges of the deck.  A polished redwood ship's wheel crowns a raised platform several paces behind the metal falcon.
b.location: The Black Rose, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Cairnfang Falls]
description: Clouds of mist rise to the edge of the trail, the bottom of the falls being lost amid the rocks below.  Close to the cliff face the trail turns sharply west, beginning a series of switchbacks to reach the top of the cliff.

title: [Cairnfang Falls, Basin]
description: Lost in a world of roiling mist and slippery rock, pine-studded outcroppings ring a huge pool.  Moisture beads everywhere as water crashes onto jagged rocks at the cliff's base, and the thunder of it echoes deafeningly.

title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: Resembling a cobblestone footpath more than a street, Tumbledown Lane levels out for only a few feet.  The street dead ends at the door of a stone cottage sporting an incongruous onion-shaped dome, nestled close in the shadow of the Northwest Tower.  Behind the cottage, the metal track runs past, headed down the hillside.

title: [Tall Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below. title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: The tiny cottages here seem to have grown straight from the steep hillside.  From the top of the steps, you can see more of the Port stretching southward.  Farther in the distance, the dark stripe that is the Vornavis Canal slices the city in two.

title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: The cobbled street twists southward, snaking its way down the cliffside.  Several stone cottages line the street to one side, while on the other lie the roofs of the next.  Two well-dressed merchants, deep in conversation, stand in front of the largest cottage.

title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: The uneven, downward sloping cobblestones bring you into the looming shadow of Vornavis's Northwest Tower as you reach the top of the steps.  A single cottage, little more than a shack, sits nestled against the cliff wall.

title: [Solhaven, Tumbledown Lane]
description: Close to the bottom of the cliffs, the cobblestone street is somewhat level.  A tidy row of stone cottages faces the bay, moonlight glinting on their glaes window panes.  A well-dressed elven man walks by at a fast clip, his eyes glued to the pavement.

Close to the bottom of the cliffs, the cobblestone street is somewhat level.  A tidy row of stone cottages faces the bay, sunlight glinting on their glaes window panes.  A well-dressed elven man walks by at a fast clip, his eyes glued to the pavement.

title: [Solhaven, Conch Street]
description: Clapboard warehouses sit on either side of the cobblestone street.  Wagons stand in long lines, the drivers leaning against them.  Burly guards keep a wary eye on passersby.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Several steps down from street level, this passageway winds a twisting path that tunnels underneath city buildings.  Here, the cobblestones of the roads above are repeated, however they're less weathered and more cumbersome to navigate with sound footing.  Oil lamps glow permanently, day and night, due to the subterranean nature of the area.

title: [Solhaven, Wentletrap and Chiton]
description: Shops ring the intersection except for the southeast corner, where a worn set of steps leads up to a raised courtyard.  A limestone keep that looks like it might have been carved from the natural rock of the bay shore rises behind the courtyard's crisp-cornered boxwood hedges.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Warrior Guild Entryway]
description: The unadorned facade of a sturdy limestone building rises before you, its weathered surface broken only by several vertical slits in the ancient stone and a heavy mithril portcullis bearing an engraved brass plaque.  Well-groomed hedges fill the small flagstone courtyard with a peaceful scent of sunlit leaves, but the sounds of grunts and clashing weapons echoing from somewhere above dispel any sense of calm.

title: [Solhaven, North 'Haven Quay]
description: Lighters and barges tie up along the north side of the quay, loading supplies and cargo for the larger carracks and cogs moored further out in the bay.  The south side of the quay descends in a broad stretch of steps to the water, providing easy boarding for the passengers of the many punts, gigs and skiffs plying the bay between the shore and the anchored vessels.

title: [Solhaven, Niima's Steps]
[Solhaven, Stormdaughter's Steps]
description: Hooked onto a mooring ring, a gig and its crew sit with shipped oars, evidently waiting for the return of an officer or the arrival of a passenger.  Seemingly oblivious to the comings and goings of people, dozens of tiny, dark green crabs scavenge along the algae-coated steps between the tide marks.

title: [Solhaven, Eastbridge Lane]
[Solhaven, Eastbridge End]
description: The tapered top of a single yew tree peaks over the corner of the high stone wall surrounding the villa to the southeast, but no roof is visible beyond the wall, nor does the solid oak gate permit any glimpse of what lies within.  The rough stone wall forming the northeast corner of the intersection is not nearly as tall, and a copper-sheathed dome can be seen beyond it, gleaming in the starlight.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Kraken Manor, Courtyard]
description: Standing in the center of the walled courtyard is a masterfully crafted water fountain created in the image of a sea kraken.  Wrapped in the kraken's tentacles is a flawless crown-of-Charl shell, from which the water cascades into the base of the fountain.  Well-kept flowerbeds containing an assortment of exotic flowers have been bordered with a collection of ruby-lined nassa shells, along with yellow, pink, and blue coquina shells.  An opal-flecked walkway leads up to a set of double doors.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Ring]
description: The circling roadways from the north and south meet here on a level with the rooftops of buildings to the north, east and south.  A steep ramp reaches upward to the west, ending at a jagged opening in the tower's base where a gateway must once have stood long ago.  Paired torches bracket the tower's entrance and light the ramp's summit.

The steep incline of the circling roadways from the north and south meet here on a level with the rooftops of the buildings directly north, east and south.  Rising to the west is a ramp that leads through the opening at the tower's base.  Noticeable repair is evident where white limestones replace the old, darker stones around a fitted steel portcullis.  Paired torches, in polished brass brackets, flank the refurbished tower entrance and illuminate the ramp's summit.

The steep incline of the circling roadways from the north and south meet here, level with the rooftops of the buildings directly north, east, and south.  Rising to the west is a ramp that leads through the opening at the tower's base.  Noticeable repair is evident where white limestones replace the old, darker stones around a fitted steel portcullis.  Paired torches in polished brass brackets flank the refurbished tower entrance and illuminate the ramp's summit.

Paired torches in polished brass brackets flank the refurbished tower entrance.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: White limestone mixes with the tower's dark foundation from its base to its crown and is a marked sign of renovation to the ancient premises.  Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward towards four landings and is wrapped by dark ebonwood banisters.  Above the stairway, daylight trickles across the eight crenellated points, outlining new and old stone work, some of which glints with foreign metal.

White limestone mixes with the tower's dark foundation from its base to its crown and is a marked sign of renovation to the ancient premises.  Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward, its course illuminated by bracketed torches and interrupted by four landings.  Above the stairway, the roof of the tower has been removed to expose the night sky and all eight crenellated points have been repaired.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Several smashed crates litter the floor here, apparently broken after having fallen a great distance from the top of one of the stacks.  The contents of the broken containers have long been removed, but the refuse remains.  The boxes and crates part to allow passage to the west and south from here.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the east and south.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: The cliff here is composed of thin layers of blue and grey stone tilted sharply downward.  Ruddy iron oxide stains dapple the surface and darken a wide vertical fracture.  Broken shards of stone litter the base of the cliff, having tumbled from the treacherous rock faces.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: A layer of feldspar glittering with garnet fragments runs across this section of the cliff.  Fuzzy black moss grows in clumps along a shallow horizontal crevice.  Handholds are few, but a slight outcropping just above you looks promising.

title: [Old Farm House ]
[Old Farm House]
description: The painted plaster walls have long since turned to yellow.  Cobwebs abound in the rafters.  The smell of mold and decay is somewhat alleviated by a soft breeze coming through a broken window.  Some words, faded with age, have been scratched in the wall by the door.

title: [Old Farm House]
description: The plastered walls are cracked and yellowed with age.  The wide-planked floorboards creak under your feet.  One end of the steeply angled ceiling is thick with soot.  The air feels dank and the room smells of mold.

title: [Bottom of the Well]
description: The wind blowing over the top of the well creates an odd, eerie moaning sound.  The moonlight slants into the well, illuminating the rope so that it looks like a bright strand of spidersilk.  The air at the bottom is rank, smelling of mud and mold.  A narrow tunnel in the wall leads north under the lake.

The air at the bottom is rank, smelling of mud and mold.  A narrow tunnel in the wall leads north under the lake.

title: [Teorainn Valley, Lake Tanai]
description: A gently sloping hillock forms the banks of Lake Tanai.  The narrow lake shimmers in the moonlight.  A few wooden structures and a field of sunflowers are visible on the opposite bank.  The branches of a tall, ancient oak tree form a canopy over the area.  An old, deteriorated stone well stands nearby.

The branches of a tall, ancient oak tree form a canopy over the area.  An old, deteriorated stone well stands nearby.

title: [Teorainn Valley, Arboreal Haven]
description: This skeleton of a storm-battered treehouse no longer provides much shelter from the elements.  Only the flooring and sections of two walls remain relatively intact.  A small altar has been erected in one corner.  The branches sway gently in the breeze.  Through the thick, green leaves you can see the blue waters of Lake Tanai.

title: [Masked Hills, Hairline Ridge]
description: The trail continues at a cruel angle along the ridge.  The air is noticeably thinner here, causing your heart to struggle to supply your muscles with much-needed oxygen.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Crossroads]
description: This mostly level spot is a respite from the climb, but not from the wind that buffets you from all directions.  Packed brown dirt pocked with eruptions of grey marble make the trail tricky in spite of its gentle slope.

title: [Wraithenmist, Lakeside Trail]
description: The path disappears completely beneath the edge of the lake, wherever it once led apparently submerged in the black depths forever.  The thick fog grows ever more oppressive, making it difficult to breathe freely.

title: [Wraithenmist, Fishing Hut]
description: An abandoned hut lies near the water's edge.  Remnants of fishing nets, the rope in tattered and rotten shreds, hang from metal hooks imbedded in the hut's stone walls.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Trail]
description: The occasional call of a bird is the only sound that disturbs the eerie silence of the forest.  An oddly luminescent moss grows on the tree trunks, covering the bark in areas as large as the span of a hand.

title: [Wraithenmist, Narrow Trail]
description: An ancient tree lies across the path, the wood half-rotted and infested with insects.  Several small boulders, apparently overturned and moved aside at some time long past, lie alongside the path.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Plaza Southwest]
description: A stout marble tower dominates this corner of the plaza, standing nearly fifty feet high.  Members of various races wander about, some lingering on the marble benches flanking the plaza.  On the far western shore of the river, the ramshackle buildings of the poor quarter are covered by a constant haze.

title: [Ghorsa Isle, Tower]
description: The view from the tower is spectacular.  The city is spread out before you, huddled in a valley beneath the great mountain Stormbrow.  Far to the northeast, beyond the walls, the sky is lit with a dim, red glow.  To the northwest, you see only mist.  A white glaes statue of a dwarf stands tall on a podium, gazing over the town.
The view from the tower is spectacular.  The city is huddled in a valley beneath the great mountain Stormbrow.  A white glaes statue of a dwarf stands tall on a podium, gazing over the town.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: A pall of soot hangs in the air like a greasy black cloud.  The ramshackle housing is ill-kept, the windows boarded up or broken.  Dwarves clad in rags shuffle along without looking up.  From under a pile of rotting planks, a mangy cat stares out at you with dull red eyes.

A pall of soot hangs in the air like a greasy black cloud.  The ramshackle housing is ill-kept, the windows boarded up or broken.  Dwarves clad in rags shuffle along without looking up.  From the shadows under a pile of rotting planks, a mangy cat stares out at you with dull red eyes.

title: [Kharam-Dzu, Poor Quarter]
description: Clouds of ash choke the air, and the buildings here are covered with soot.  Broken windows, peeling paint and rotting wooden timbers all mark the general decay.  Shabbily-dressed dwarves filter through the creaking double doors of a seedy tavern.  To the southwest, a dilapidated pile of planks serves as a makeshift gate into Pig Puddle Lane.

Clouds of ash choke the air, and the buildings here are covered with soot.  Broken windows, peeling paint and rotting wooden timbers all mark the general decay.  Shabbily-dressed dwarves filter through the creaking double doors of a seedy tavern, tucked back into the shadows.  To the southwest, a dilapidated pile of planks serves as a makeshift gate into Pig Puddle Lane.

title: [The Company Store, Lobby]
description: Lanterns burn brightly here, compensating for the lack of windows.  Voices drift down the eastern hallway, as people wait their turn for the public lockers.  A group of dwarves cradling exotic weapons jostles past you toward the stairs.

title: [Company Store, Corridor]
description: From the open doors at the east and west ends of the corridor come quite audible and creatively worded outbursts.  You realize that the words are not directed at you, but beyond you, from one room to the next.

title: [Company Store, Pelts & Mandible]
[Company Store, Pelt & Mandible]
description: Pelts and skins from several creatures are tacked to the walls.  Several creatures have been stuffed and mounted.  Looking behind you, you see over the red archway a huge bone that looks like a giant rib.  It spans from the floor, over the archway and back to the floor again.  The counter before you is haphazardly covered with several hides, as the proprietor has yet to remove them from the counter.

Several creatures have been stuffed and mounted around the room, while the pelts and skins of others are tacked to the walls.  Spanning the red archway is a huge bone that looks like a giant rib.  The counter before you is haphazardly covered with several hides, apparently awaiting proper storage.  A rickety staircase leads down toward the source of some very powerful odors.

title: [Pelt & Mandible, Workroom]
description: The air in this room is heavy with the smell of chemicals.  Behind a stained counter stands a large vat, the obvious source of the majority of the odor.

title: [Mud Baths, Rock Basin]
description: An expansive rock basin sits in this partially walled structure, home to the local mudbaths.  Heat rises off the thick, dark, bubbling mud, the bursting air pockets splattering ooze in large arcs.  A set of steps on the east side leads down into the therapeutic liquid.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Mud Baths, Pool]
description: A continuous, circular stone wall surrounds this pool, which is filled with smooth, warm mud deep enough to sink a dwarf to the neck.  Beneath the mud, the wall slopes gently, ending below the pool's terraqueous floor.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: Mephitic vapors emanate from a collection of retorts and alembics which occupy most of the dark ash wood table in the center of the workshop, despite the flue carved in the raw stone ceiling high above.  A narrow channel directs lava from a cleft in the rocky floor to the east hallway.  The room glows from the ruddy illumination cast by the magma through the thin veil of translucent glaes walls.

title: [Wizard Guild, Steps]
description: The narrow channel feels as enclosed as a chimney and is almost as sooty.  The rock walls around you are uncomfortably warm to the touch, and the widely spaced torches shed little light on the seemingly never-ending steps.

title: [Cobblestone Road, Canyon]
description: The road follows the river into a canyon, which narrows to the south.  The craggy, reddish-brown rock towers hundreds of feet overhead.  At the southern end of the canyon, a walled town sits at the base of the peak.  The clang of a bell and the distant bustle of the crowd drift along the canyon.  A squat barge plies the river toward the town, its deck piled high with fresh-cut timber and dozing dwarves.

title: [Canyon, Stone Stairs]
description: A narrow set of stone stairs, carved into the reddish rock of the canyon, leads upwards.  A few shacks have been built along the stairs, precariously mounted on rock ledges and niches.  Small lizards sun themselves on the stairs, skittering away from passing feet.

title: [Fish Plant, Pickling Room]
description: This is the room where the fish would have been pickled.  Large vats fill the room, with catwalks hanging above them.  The air is pungent with the odor of decay and the smell of rotten pickling juices.  The odor fills the room, and you are almost too repulsed by it to seek out the source.

title: [Fish Plant, Pickling Room]
description: As you traverse the catwalk that hangs suspended over the vats, you are very careful not to break the planking under your feet.  You can now see inside most of the vats and what you see disgusts you.  Where you thought you would see pickled fish, you only see small dead creatures.  It would seem that some came to drink from the vats, falling in and drowning.  Or perhaps some effect of the now putrid fluid caused their almost instant death so that their bodies slipped into the thick fluids in the vats.

title: [Lava Flows, Barren Flats]
description: The layer of ash is much thinner here, the wind and rain having erased it completely in some places, leaving the land a barren nightmare of jumbled black rock and cinders.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Lake Chamber]
description: Molten lava bubbles and explodes at the center of the lake of liquid rock that fills this chamber.  Large enough to hold a couple of good-sized manor houses, the heat trapped in here begins to sear exposed flesh within seconds.  The level of the lake must have been higher in the past since a ledge of black basalt circles the room and extends into the lava pipe to the west.  Part way up the chamber's dome a patch of sky is visible through a gaping hole in the basalt.

Molten lava bubbles and explodes at the center of the lake of liquid rock that fills this chamber.  Large enough to hold a couple of good-sized manor houses, the heat trapped in here begins to sear exposed flesh within seconds.  The level of the lake must have been higher in the past since a ledge of black basalt circles the room and extends into the lava pipe to the west.  Part way up the chamber's dome a patch of night sky is visible through a gaping hole in the basalt.

title: [Lava Flows, Old Channel]
description: An old lava channel forms a ready path through the basalt outcroppings and boulders that the volcano has thrown this far.  To the north, a hillock rises out of the litter of stones, its shoulders strewn with rubble and its top a flat expanse.  A trail zigzags up the incline, punctuated with pockets of lava that decorate the hillock with their flickering red light.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Bluff]
description: A steep trail winds between stark formations of glaes, frozen into grotesqueries of shapes that populate the narrow butte like strange, contorted wanderers.  Hot spits of wind push drifting clouds of steam and smoke about, carrying an undertone of salty sea-air mixed with the sulfurous stench of lava.

A steep trail winds between stark formations of glaes, frozen into grotesqueries of shapes that populate the narrow butte like strange, contorted wanderers.  Hot spits of wind push drifting clouds of steam and smoke about, carrying an undertone of salty sea-air mixed with the sulfurous stench of lava.  To the south is spread a panoramic view of basalt, lava and, here and there, the ferocious beasts that thrive in such surroundings.

title: [Basalt Hillock, Precipice]
description: On the northwest, the trail skitters and dodges over the boulders choking a steep slope.  Below is a lower section of the plateau, dotted with lava pits and bordered by a sheer cliff wall on the east.  To the northwest, a huge stela of glaes towers high over the floor of the mesa.

On the northwest, the trail skitters and dodges over the boulders choking a steep slope.  Below is a lower section of the plateau, dotted with lava pits and bordered by a sheer cliff wall on the east.  To the northwest, a huge stela of glaes towers high over the floor of the mesa, casting an irregular shadow over the bubbling magma pits and rutted terrain.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Second Tier]
description: The flat tier mirrors its sister above, dotted with bubbling pools of liquid death, like some malevolent garden made by the god of brimstone and fire.  Stark basalt fingers jut out of the landscape, casting crooked shadows.  The odor of sulfur is near to overpowering, hemmed in by the cliff walls on the eastern side of the plateau.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Overlook]
description: The trail curves around the huge glaes formation, its path zigzagging around lava and rock.  At the edge of a steep embankment on the north, an offshoot of the trail weaves down the incline between a scrub of boulders and strange, stunted bushes with withered-looking, grey leaves.  A few of the shrubs are perched at the edge of small fissures full of lava, their gnarled roots submerged in the liquid rock.

title: [Basalt Plateau, Ravine's Edge]
description: A trail follows the bottom of a steep incline.  The jumble of rocks cloaking the slope above makes the track hazardous, and here and there, boulders fallen from above obstruct its progress.  On the narrow shelf's north shoulder, the ground falls into a deep ravine, its bottom lost in darkness.

A trail follows the bottom of a steep incline.  The jumble of rocks cloaking the slope above makes the track hazardous, and here and there, boulders fallen from above obstruct its progress.  On the narrow shelf's north shoulder, the ground falls into a deep ravine, its bottom lost in shadow.

title: [Lava Flows, Lava Pipe]
description: The molten lava drops through a fissure in the floor of this chamber, but the heat seems less intense here.  A narrow gap high in the west wall might be the reason, since part of a distant crater wall is visible through it.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Entrance]
description: Sparkles of charcoal grey ash slowly drift to the ground where they add to the several inches already resting there.  Wafts of steam and hot air, rising from a dark hole in the rock face, cause the ash to swirl and dance tirelessly while incessant vibrations from deep within the mountain send rocks skittering downward and make the footing unsure.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: The crawlway angles sharply here, making climbing treacherous.  Razor-sharp pieces of crystallized volcanic glass protrude from the ash-covered surface.  The walls of this pipe-like tunnel close in tightly around you, making passage slow going.  Smoky hot silt and soot swirl upward from below.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: Slanting sharply at a near-vertical pitch, the crawlway cuts deeper into the volcano.  This narrow tube seem to be widening ever so slightly through an opening below.  The soot smudged walls tremor around you as magma shifts from beyond the rock.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Ruined Cavern]
description: It would appear that a catastrophe once occurred in this foul smelling chamber.  The eastern wall has been caved in, burrowed through by something large enough to leave the floor strewn with glaesan boulders in its wake.  Despite the destruction, several wooden beams still rise up to support the ceiling above, and the iron scaffolding erected along the other walls looks unscathed.

title: [Abandoned Mine]
description: A rock lizard sits atop a shelf in the northern wall in the northern wall, its softly kindled eyes blinking in the gloomy dark.  Iron railings descend from a slope to the west, only to be buried under a blockade of rubble that nearly seals the eastern passage completely.

title: [Temple Burrow, Koar Street]
description: The well-traveled road is flanked by an orderly procession of street lamps, their bases carved with thunderbolts and bearded figures with severe countenances.  Priests in blue robes wander up and down a staircase carved from the side of the glacier.  It and the ice of the road are rough enough to easily traverse without falling.  A few small burrows are carved into the ice, round doors facing the street and painted with all of the hues of the dawn.

This area seems well-travelled.  Priests in blue robes wander up and down a staircase carved from the glacier, and the ice you walk on is rough enough to stand on without falling.  A few small cottages have been built from the ice, and one seems to have been encased in it, with holes drilled out for the door and windows.

title: [Temple Burrow, Koar and Lumnis]
description: The edge of the glacier offers a marvelous view of the walled town below, a mix of burrows in the ice and cold earth and shingled rooftops of aboveground dwellings.  The roads are slightly haphazard in layout, but they join eventually with four main streets sprouting from the town center.  Above towers the temple, carved from pure ice and radiant in the sunlight.  An ice ramp descends westward, while an ice staircase leads down to the east and some carved steps plunge to the northwest around an oddly shaped ice flow.

On the edge of the glacier, you have a marvelous view of the city to the south.  Your eyes follow the slightly haphazard streets around Icemule Trace until they meet the four roads and eventually the gates in the walls.  Above you towers the great temple, carved from the purest ice and shining with a nearly divine light in the sun.  A ramp of ice leads down to the west, while an ice staircase leads down to the east and a set of carved ice steps lead down to the northwest around an oddly shaped ice flow.
