title: [Temple Burrow, Lumnis Street]
description: Escorted by lamp posts whose bases are adorned with linked rings, the road delves between two rises in the glacier.  Carved ice steps wind up toward the temple, which crowns the southeastern rise, while a simple trail mounts the opposing slope.  From up the trail comes a vigorous splashing sound.  Shopkeepers do business from burrows that delve down into the ice, and several families have even cut dwellings out of the glacier.

You are situated between two hills in the glacier.  On the southeast hill is the Temple, accessible by a set of carved ice steps, while a simple trail leads up the side of the other hill.  A couple of ambitious shopkeepers do business from shops within the ice, and several families have made homes in the glacier.  From up the trail, a vigorous splashing can be heard.

title: [Icemule Trace, North Gate]
description: Several town guards watch the northern gate of the town, which is little more than a chasm hollowed out of the encroaching glacier.  Though armed, the guards seem less focused on watching for foes from the ice and more on discouraging the unwary or unprepared from braving the frigid depths.  The faint shadow of what once must have been the actual gates is visible through the ice, evidently devoured during the glacier's unrelenting advance.  Some stairs cut into the ice leading up to the city walls climb the natural wall created by the ice.

Several well-armed guards stand to either side of a hole in the glacier.  People wander in and out of the opening, which apparently serves as a gate to the town.  Within the ice you can see the faint shadow of what once must have been the actual gates.  However, the glacier has devoured it over time, and the resourceful halflings have taken advantage of the natural wall created by the ice.

Several well-armed guards stand to either side of a hole in the glacier.  People wander in and out of the opening, which apparantly serves as a gate to the town.  Within the ice you can see the faint shadow of what once must have been the actual gates.  However, the glacier has devoured it over time, and the resourceful halflings have taken advantage of the natural wall created by the ice.

title: [Icemule Defenses, North Wall]
description: This vantage point affords a view of the North Gate and the wide North Road running straight into the heart of Icemule Trace.  The few travelers at the near end of the road slip and slide over the ice-covered cobbles, while a few local citizens measure their strides for a more steady pace.

title: [The Nightowl Pub, Entry]
description: Upon entering the dimly lit room, you are startled by the row of round eyes staring at you from above.  As your vision adjusts to the darkness, you realize that you are merely being watched by the many owl statues lining a plate rail high on the wall.  It appears that each pair of eyes is formed by different gems, backlit by candles.

title: [The Nightowl Pub, Lounge]
description: Waitresses wearing feathered headdresses fashioned like the heads of owls work the room swiftly and quietly, trying not to interrupt the guests or the stage act.  Although the tables are set relatively close together, the darkness creates a feeling of intimacy.  After their number, the chorus glides off the stage and all but disappears behind a dark curtain.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Lager Road]
description: A twisting staircase with slender wrought iron rails spirals precariously up the back of the Nightowl Pub.  The stairs climb to a small grated ledge just below an open window on the second story of the ramshackle building.  Empty hogsheads, still smelling of the beer they once contained, are stacked beneath the staircase, as if to provide a splintery cushion for anyone who might fall.

A twisting staircase with slender, wrought-iron rails hangs precariously from the backside of the Nightowl Pub.  The top of the staircase ends just below an open window on the second story.  Empty barrels are stacked in the space beneath the staircase, providing a rather splintery cushion for anyone who might fall.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Nightowl Landing]
[Twisting Staircase, Landing]
description: The narrow landing is wrought from the same metal as the staircase, though its surface is grated to provide a glimpse of the street below.  Though thin, the railings seem sturdy enough to support the weight of most humanoids.  Whispers, giggles, and the occasional feather drift onto the landing from an open window at the back of the pub.

You pause at the narrow landing to catch your breath.  To your relief, the thin iron railings are much sturdier than they appeared to be at first glance.  Whispers, giggles, and the occasional feather drift onto the landing from an open window.

title: [Tartifacts Bakery]
description: Light pierces the windows and strikes dozens of cut glass display cases, sending rainbows of color dancing around the walls of this decadent shrine to the tart.  Young halflings run around, tripping over each other to polish the sparkling silver tables normally filled with chatting patrons.

Moonlight pierces the windows and strikes dozens of cut glass display cases, sending rainbows of color dancing around the walls of this decadent shrine to the tart.  Young halflings run around, tripping over each other to polish the sparkling silver tables normally filled with chatting patrons.

title: [Tartifacts, Balcony]
description: Silver tables and chairs line this balcony, resting on a floor covered with a fine layer of tart crumbs.  A group of dwarves sits at an end table, grumbling about the lack of good ale in Icemule Trace.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Dwarven Circle]
description: Bumblefinger's Pawnshop is perched on the south side of the road, the well-tended wooden building draped with several blue and green banners proclaiming its low prices and fine goods.  Several giantkin mill about outside, counting their coins.  Freshly painted some white stairs climb up to the pawnshop porch.

A giantman strolls merrily away from Bumblefinger's Pawnshop, counting his coins.  The pawnshop is perched on the south side of the road, housed in a well tended wooden building.  Freshly painted white stairs lead up to the pawnshop porch.

title: [Pawnshop, Porch]
description: Several tables line the porch, offering Bumblefinger's odds and ends to passing adventurers.  A sleepy-eyed halfling leans against the pawnshop door, keeping one eye trained on the tables at all times.

title: [Icemule Trace, South Gate]
description: Thick stone walls frame a wide, wooden gate.  A vaulted stone archway provides some cover from the weather, which is often inclement so close to the glaciers.  The packed earth pathway skirting the town's walls gives way to a cobbled street in the same dark grey stone as the lower half of the walls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Snowfield]
description: Snowdrifts rest against the exterior wall of Icemule Trace.  The snowfield spreads as far south as you can see.  Someone has created a statue of snow and ice that leans against the wall, its edges worn away by recent snowfalls.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tundra]
description: The constant, fierce wind has wreaked havoc with the few trees that line the bank of the frozen river.  With branches bent low, they look as though they are bowing to the river in homage.

title: [Icemule Trail, Icy River]
description: Moving cautiously over the ice-covered river, you scan the marsh that seems to extend forever past the northern bank.  You might be able to traverse that quagmire by stepping from hummock to hummock, but truly dry land seems scarce.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: Staring at the grotesque, frozen foot of some poor soul protruding from beneath the rockslide tells you this mountain has been forsaken by the gods and is no fit place for man nor beast.  You glance furtively upwards, ever fearful that the rocks above will tumble down upon you.

title: [Blue Glacier, Mountain Pass]
description: Ahead of you a mammoth rockslide has blocked the way.  You study the steep mountain slopes around you and wish, not for the first time, that you were part goat.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The horizon is painted with shifting color, strange flickers playing in the clouds like distant lightning tinted with a monumental paintbrush.  Underfoot, a small cliff is formed by a rock outcropping.  It narrows into a trail which leads up to the southeast.  Another narrow trail leads northwest from a ledge below, and beyond that, the mountainside extends down in a dizzying fall.

The horizon is painted with layers of clouds, waves of grey upon black roiling across the sky.  Underfoot, a small cliff is formed by a rock outcropping.  It narrows into a trail which leads up to the southeast.  Another narrow trail leads northwest from a ledge below, and beyond that, the mountainside extends down in a dizzying fall.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: A small ledge marks the end of a poor excuse for a trail, which winds down the mountainside to the northwest.  Snow flurries keep the way pristine with a slick coating.  Overhead, low clouds conceal everything beyond a close pocket of vision, however, another small ledge is visible within climbing distance.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Bitter gusts of wind drive clouds of loose snow up from an icy slope to the south.  The slope descends amidst jagged cliffs, at the bottom of which the faint image of a trail can be seen.  Overhead, large snowdrifts threaten to dislodge at the slightest opportunity.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Wind driven flurries of snow keep vision poor.  Further down the southern face an immense arch is barely visible through the snow.  A narrow trail follows the base of the cliff wall, starting at an icy slope then running towards the northeast.  The slope climbs upwards among the cliffs until it is lost in the clouds.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The great glacier grinds its way down the canyon, pulverizing rock and mountain alike.  An icy slope serves as the leading edge to the mighty frozen river inching its way towards the flats of the polar cap.  Deep tracks in the permafrost hint at creatures eking out an existence in this bitter climate.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The makeshift trail that leads back to the tundra comes to a halt at the bottom slope of a gigantic glacier, dwarfed only in size by the mountain itself.  Further up the glacier, the going gets even rougher, with piles of rock frozen in place to mark the way across the ice.  Deep rumbles shake the ground as the ice grinds its way down the steep grade.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Small steps hacked out of the side of the mountain lead down, providing meager protection from the howling gales on the slopes.  High above, cornices hang dangerously low, shuddering with each renewed gust of wind.  Packed ice and snow make assaults on the peak slow at best, fatal at worst.  Blocks of ice the size of buildings lie in heaps at the bottom of the western slope, a testament to the power of the titanic avalanches that ravage the mountain.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: An immense arch of ice battles to remain standing against the ravages of the wind.  Through the makeshift gateway, the open expanses of the frozen tundra provide little protection from the chilling temperatures.  The treacherous slopes of Mount Aenatumgana tower above the flats, the peak of the gigantic mountain invisible through the blowing sleet and snow.  Two sets of frozen steps, carved out of the mountainside, lead up to the precarious east and west approaches to the summit.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: An immense arch of ice battles to remain standing against the ravages of the wind.  Through the makeshift gateway, the open expanses of the frozen tundra provide little protection from the chilling temperatures.  The treacherous slopes of Mount Aenatumgana tower above the flats, the peak of the gigantic mountain invisible through the blowing sleet and snow.  Two sets of frozen steps, carved out of the mountainside, lead up to the precarious east and west approaches to the summit.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: At the northwestern edge of a small elevated plateau, winds swirl angrily in no particular direction.  A narrow path leads into the shadows northeast between jagged rock walls, and steps carved into the ice lead haphazardly down towards the arch to the southwest.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: Jagged cliffs seal off most of this end of the ravine.  A steep trail leads to the east at a sharp angle, climbing the wall that isolates the area.  The trail is extremely narrow and appears treacherous at best.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: About halfway up a steep slope, a small ledge stands exposed to the bitter elements, cleared of snow by the driving blasts of wind.  A trail to the west skirts the icy wall into a ravine below, and to the north a path winds its way up the rock-littered slope.  Both directions appear extremely dangerous.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: About halfway up a steep slope, a small ledge stands exposed to the bitter elements, cleared of snow by the driving blasts of wind.  A trail to the west skirts the icy wall into a ravine below, and to the north a path winds its way up the rock-littered slope.  Both directions appear extremely dangerous.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The slope levels out here at the base of a trail headed to the north.  To the south the slope grows considerably steeper, and a path treacherously winds its way down.  The weather shows no signs of letting up.

title: [Arctic Embankment]
description: The wind is a cruel master, reigning at the apex of the boulders with dangerous gusts spiked with needle-sharp ice and sleet.  A sheath of ice covers the stones, making a perilous catwalk of the embankment's top.  Wind screams its way over the jumble of rock and barrels against the mountains to the south in an endless onslaught.

title: [Northern Slopes, Arctic Plateau]
description: To the north, a band of broken stones borders the snowy plateau like a final break-water against the savage grip of the tundra stretching away to the northern horizon.  Snow and wind blast the rocks, leaving drifts in the lee of their southern faces.  Pine-covered mountains provide a backdrop to the south, misted with fog and snowy clouds that drift across the peaks like ghostly barges on a dark green sea.

title: [Northern Slopes, Arctic Plateau]
description: A flat plateau of snow stretches into the distance, bounded in the northern reaches by a snowy peak that shimmers in the light, looking as much cloud as mountain.  A cascade of boulders offers egress to a forested range of mountains, guarding the southern borders of the tundra.  Snow falls over the still landscape in intermittent flurries which sparkle when a persistent beam of light breaks through the assault of bitter storms.

A flat plateau of snow stretches into the distance, bounded in the northern reaches by a snowy peak that shimmers in the moonlight, looking as much cloud as mountain.  A cascade of boulders offers egress to a forested range of mountains, guarding the southern borders of the tundra.  Snow falls over the still landscape in intermittent flurries which sparkle when a persistent beam of light breaks through the assault of bitter storms.

title: [Northern Slopes, Arctic Track]
description: A jumble of snowy rock cascades across the trail, blocking further progress to the east.  The stones descend to an expanse of flat tundra that stretches away to the northeast in an almost featureless plain.  Clouds of snow cross the vast wilderness of ice in the distance, moving like great behemoths over the land in a silent dance.

title: [Pinefar Trading Post, Lawn]
description: The snow-covered lawn stretches up to a rambling log manor that blends into the surrounding forests with an uncanny grace.  The building looks inviting and cozy despite its sprawling size.  A front porch wraps around the entire facade of the building, and a number of stone chimneys stand guard on the roof, each spouting an aromatic plume of smoke.  Stone steps lead up to the porch, flanked by a pair of fanciful carved drakes.

title: [Pinefar Trading Post, Porch]
description: The porch is floored with wide, wooden planks, swept clean of snow and painted a wishful shade of green.  All down the length of it, rocking chairs sit in a row, silent in the winter hush.  This far north, the snow is a constant presence, transforming the row of pristine, green and white rockers into a wonderful winter folly.  Generous, albeit short, double doors lead into the building.

title: [Pinefar Trading Post, Greatroom]
description: Shining wood floors and a beamed ceiling distinguish the spacious room.  An impressive rock fireplace dominates the back wall, flanked by a wide staircase leading to an upper floor.  Before the hearth sits a tawny leather sofa with a variety of armchairs sitting in attendance around it.  Rugs scattered across the plank floor add tones of coral, blue and red to the warm ambience.  All along the walls, paintings compete with windows offering views of the snow-bound countryside.

Shining wood floors and a beamed ceiling distinguish the spacious room.  An impressive rock fireplace dominates the back wall, flanked by a wide staircase leading to an upper floor.  Before the hearth sits a tawny leather sofa with a variety of armchairs sitting in attendance around it.  Rugs scattered across the plank floor add tones of coral, blue and red to the warm ambience.  All along the walls, paintings compete with windows offering views of the moonlit, snow-bound countryside.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Pinefar, Second Floor Hallway]
description: Here at the top of the wide stairway, one has a good view of the expansive great room below.  The banisters sweeping down to the lower floor are intricately carved in a pine cone motif and polished to a high luster.  A long hallway stretches north, one wall occupied almost entirely by a large oak door.  The green length of the hallway is carpeted in a finely woven runner depicting a pattern of pine needles and cones.

title: [Northern Slopes, Snowy Drifts]
description: A fierce wind drives the heavy white snow forcefully into knee-deep drifts, eradicating any sign of passage. A forested slope rises in the snow-obscured distance.

title: [Northern Slopes, Timberline]
description: The timberline is thinly forested, being thicker further up the mountainous slope, but even the sparse tree cover helps decrease the brutal force of the wind. Snow piles in high drifts at the base of each tree and covers every branch.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: The thick tree coverage runs up to the edge of a steep cliff and provides welcome shelter from the harsh wind. Without those frigid gusts howling through the tree branches, the forest is remarkably peaceful. Several sets of tracks wind chaotically through the forest, and a few disappear up a fairly steep incline.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: A large pine tree stands in the middle of a small clearing. The lower branches of the massive tree are broken and split, and the trunk looks as if it's been repeatedly battered by something large and blunt. The snow around the base of the tree has been churned up, revealing dirt and pine needles underneath.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: This rocky, tree-covered ledge is clearly hazardous. Pebbles, snow, and loose ice slide down the slope with each powerful gust of chill wind. An icy incline leads to a large forested shelf above you.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: A steep, tree-covered slope leads up towards an icy ledge. The wind is strong, and ice and snow fall from above when the frigid gusts blow. The chittering of birds fills the air, sounding much like the chattering of teeth.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: Broken branches poke through the snow, surrounding a massive fallen pine tree. The wind blows through the forest, making pine needles quiver and shaking a light dusting of snow from them. Several trees on a well-forested incline sway gently with each rush of cold wind.

title: [Mountains, Quiet Forest]
description: A clearing can be seen to the west, and low, steady, rhythmic tones come from that direction. Several sets of fresh footprints can be found here, leading deeper into the forest in various directions, and a few of the trails appear to lead from a slippery incline.

title: [Northern Slopes, Quiet Forest]
description: The snow here is extremely churned up, and broken branches and pine needles cover the ground. The trees are scarred and damaged, and one pine tree has been splintered almost completely into bits. A path of arboreal wreckage leads up a once heavily forested incline.

title: [Mountains, Quiet Forest]
description: A mix of broken branches, fallen pine needles and the occasional pinecone are scattered down a steep incline.

title: [Mountains, Quiet Forest]
description: An immense boulder covered with snow and ice sits in the middle of a clearing. Smaller rocks lie in various positions around the boulder, casting irregular shadows on the fresh snow. The wind is almost non-existent, and the scent of fresh pine needles is overpowering.

title: [Atop an Immense Boulder]
description: Snow covers the top of this large rock, and large footprints mark much of the surface. A small, fist-sized hole sits almost in the middle of the boulder, and snow and ice have been cleared away from it. The snow at the edge of the top of the boulder looks as if it has been flattened by the passage of many climbers.

title: [Southern Slopes, Treeline]
description: Snow covers the large rocks and boulders that have found a perch along the mountainside.  Further below, majestic spruce, maple and aspen trees decorate the slopes, but not here.  This far up the mountain, only a few stunted scrub pines have managed to take root.

title: [Southern Slopes, Alpine Ridge]
description: A large rock formation hunkers in the snow at the end of the trail.  The formation is shaped like a natural stairway, its fractured surface forming steps that are piled high with snow.  Above here, the alpine forest begins to thin considerably.

title: [Abbey, Receiving Yard]
description: Rising sharply along the mountainside, the grounds are green and well-tended despite the stark banks of snow scattered here and there.  The hewn blocks of native granite that comprise the the abbey are dark with time and worn by the elements.  Huge stone urns are spaced along the walk, holding blossoming roses bushes that seem unfazed by the cold.  Nearby, broad stone steps lead to a wide, uncovered porch with a low balustrade.

title: [Abbey, Porch]
description: From its vantage atop a spiraling rise of stone steps, the porch provides a sweeping view of the bordering valley, which stretches in a sea of white and grey and green to the misty horizon.  The stonehold below is built into the mountainside, blocking views of the trail leading away from the abbey.  Polished parquet doors of spruce and maple are flung open like outstretched, welcoming arms.  The lintel above is intricately carved.

title: [Abbey, Porch]
description: Some broad stone steps curve downward from the porch toward a verdant garden of evergreens, the minty bite of resin rising from below on the breeze.  At the end of the low balustrade, a carved stone figure stands poised and proud.  Several garlands of rose are heaped at her feet.

title: [Abbey Evergreen Garden]
description: At the base of some broad stone steps, cultivated cousins of wild local trees form a small arbor.  The bite of pine resin is cool and clean on the frigid air, rising off of Olbin pine and Ossian spruce.  One side of the garden is bordered by the facade of abbey, while the other is framed by the edge of the cliff upon which the compound is built.

title: [Abbey, Great Hall]
description: Left open to the crisp air of day via vast maple doors, the great hall is a cavernous chamber lined with long wooden benches that march in neatly ordered rows beneath its gabled windows.  At its eastern end, two steps lead from the main floor to the dais.  Three lancet windows on the eastern wall halo the dais in light, crowned by a wheel-shaped window inset with rose-colored stained glass.  The small minstrels' gallery sits over the oak-paneled buttery screen that graces the western wall.

Left open to the chill of night via vast maple doors, the great hall is a cavernous chamber lined with long wooden benches that march in neatly ordered rows beneath its gabled windows.  At its eastern end, two steps lead from the main floor to the dais.  Three lancet windows on the eastern wall halo the dais in muted moonlight, crowned by a wheel-shaped window inset with rose-colored stained glass.  The small minstrels' gallery sits over the oak-paneled buttery screen that graces the western wall.

title: [Abbey, Grand Stair]
[Abbey Grand Stair]
description: Seven broad, stone steps lead upwards, bracketed by ornate wooden bannisters.  The balusters are carved into the spearheaded shapes of irises, while the newels are shaped like frogs upon lilypads.

title: [Abbey, Grand Stair Landing]
[Abbey Grand Stair Landing]
description: The broad landing of the grand stair is oval, with its wooden floor painted dark green.  A semi-circular railing surrounds the landing and continues up the final five steps to the upper gallery.

title: [Abbey, High Gallery]
[Abbey Gallery]
description: Silvery moonlight glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Bright-pigmented paintings depicting the surrounding lands in different seasons are spaced along the opposite wall.  One depicts the environs in high summer, the greenery verdant and the fields blossoming, with nary a hint of snow to be seen.

Pale sunlight glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Bright-pigmented paintings depicting the surrounding lands in different seasons are spaced along the opposite wall.  One depicts the environs in high summer, the greenery verdant and the fields blossoming, with nary a hint of snow to be seen.

Silver light glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Fading paintings, which depict the surrounding lands in the days before the permafrost, cover the opposite wall.

Silver moonlight glints off the diamond-shaped panes in the windows running along the southern wall of the long gallery.  Fading paintings, which depict the surrounding lands in the days before the permafrost, cover the opposite wall.

title: [Abbey, Dorter]
description: Small, spare cells line the walls, each guarded by a door with a slotted window.  Beyond, every cell is remarkably similar, housing a bed, nightstand, and writing desk.  Torches along the walls drive back the day's chill, but the dorter's entrance is open and doorless, waiting at the top of a narrow staircase.

Small, spare cells line the walls, each guarded by a door with a slotted window.  Beyond, every cell is remarkably similar, housing a bed, nightstand, and writing desk.  Torches along the walls drive back the bitter cold of night, but the dorter's entrance is open and doorless, waiting at the top of a narrow staircase.

title: [Abbey Cloistered Walk]
description: A narrow staircase climbs the stone walls of the abbey.  High hedges grow along the arcade, tidily tended.  They are verdant and green in a manner that seems inconsistent with the cold terrain.

title: [Abbey Chapel]
description: Ornate doors of heavy bronze muffle sounds from outside of the chapel, a long chamber with a low maple ceiling that has fanciful patterns of leaves and rosettes carved into its surface.  Framed on either side by pews of sturdy spruce, a walk proceeds to the east.  A thickly balustraded stair along the northern wall spirals up into a small loft.
To the right, a thickly balustraded stair leads upwards.  The low oak ceiling is carved into a fanciful pattern of leaves and rosettes.

title: [Abbey Choir Loft]
description: At the top of the stair, the thick beam balustrade, seamless as if hewn from a single tree, is supported by thick wooden columns carved with rose vines and snowflakes.  Three shallow risers stand beneath the traceried lancet window that runs the length of the loft.

The thick beam balustrade, hewn from a single tree, is supported by thick wooden columns carved with vines of roses.  Three shallow risers stand beneath the traceried lancet window that runs the length of the loft.

title: [Abbey Ossuary, Antechamber]
description: Thousands of wild rose petals carpet the cold stone floor, filling the chamber with a sweetly perfumed smell.  To either side of a heavy oaken panel leading out to the chapel, golden torch sconces support torches that bathe the antechamber in bright light.  Despite the roses' aroma, there is a creeping scent of death wafting up from a crumbling stone staircase leading down into stygian darkness.

Thousands of crushed, dried rose petals carpet the floor, blackened with age, their fragrance long since departed.  Golden torch sconces adorn the plain fitted stone walls, but no torches sit within them.  It is dark, yet quiet, lending a sense of serenity.

title: [Abbey, Ossuary]
description: The staircase narrows to a claustrophobic tunnel of greyish, fitted stone.  Sputtering torches throw dim, flickering light down the narrow corridor, giving a sense of life to the old slate flooring.  The dust-filled air is stale and heavy, smelling of rotting cloth and long-dry bone.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Parlor]
description: The bannisters are missing from the stairway leading upstairs from the parlor.  As elsewhere in this house, everything is either broken or crushed.  Tattered cloths droop from warped curtain rods over the arched windows.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Upper Hall]
description: Dark, watery stains discolor the ceiling and the walls.  Flakes of plaster form a gritty dust on the hardwood floor.  Long strands of dust hang in the corners of the ceiling and in the doorways.

title: [Abandoned Farm, Barn]
description: Snow blows in through the cracks and missing planks of the barn.  Low stone walls frame several empty stalls to the north while from the west comes a nauseating stench.  A rickety ladder leads upwards into the gloom.

title: [Abandoned Barn, Hayloft]
description: A rickety ladder leans up against the edge of the hayloft, providing the only means of escape.  Most of the roof is gone from this part of the barn and snow drifts fill the corners in a soft blanket over the jumble of broken farming implements left behind when this farm was abandoned.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Base]
description: The path leads you closer to the south side of the hill where large cave openings can be seen scattered along the base.  The closest opening is one of three along this side and has heavy gouges around the lower edges.  To the left of the opening is a staircase that has been carved into the side of the hill leading upwards to a wide ledge.

title: [Ice Plains, Hill Side]
description: The staircase leads onto a smooth pathway that has been excavated from the side of the hill.  A thin layer of snow covers the ground along the path but stops short of an opening hidden behind a drift of snow.  The entrance leads north into a tunnel that was not formed naturally.  As you get closer to the opening, a waft of warm air against your face reminds you how cold you are.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Entryway]
description: Lit only by a single iron-sconced torch east of the gated entrance, this ice-enclosed cavern is filled with an unwelcoming silence and a sense of foreboding.  To the northwest, countless stalagmites of crystalline ice jut wickedly upwards towards a suspended rope bridge far above the penitentiary floor.  Garbed in hooded black robes, a pair of grizzled halflings guard a thick imflass-chain ladder that leads upwards into the Icewall.

title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Ledge]
description: The guards at the top of an imflass-chain ladder stamp their feet in a vain attempt to fight off the biting cold.  A single torch set in an unadorned iron sconce provides only scarce light, causing shadows to flitter about the area.  Near the torch, a thick imflass door has been fixed securely into the ice and bears a prominent mithril plaque.  To the west, a suspended rope bridge crosses a narrow chasm.

title: [White Haven, Grand Courtyard]
description: A vast and peaceful courtyard surrounds the crystal tower bordered by a stone wall.  Engulfed by clinging ice-coated vines that create a large frozen mosaic on the wall are a white birch branch message board and a heavy slate blackboard.  Almost hidden by the vines, a staircase spirals upward against the central tower, while a massive white modwir-framed entryway stands as the obvious entrance, with a granite monument placed nearby.  An ice-covered pond dominates one corner of the courtyard.

A vast and peaceful courtyard surrounds the crystal tower, bordered by a stone wall.  Delicate vines coated with a fine layer of ice cling to the wall, creating a frozen mosaic.  Almost hidden by the vines, a staircase spirals upwards against the central tower, while a massive white modwir-framed entryway stands as the obvious entrance.

A vast and peaceful courtyard surrounds the crystal tower, bordered by a stone wall.  Delicate vines coated with a fine layer of ice cling to the wall, creating a frozen mosaic.  Almost hidden by the vines, a staircase spirals upwards against the central tower, while a massive white modwir-framed entryway stands as the obvious entrance.  An ice-covered pond dominates one corner of the courtyard.

title: [White Haven, Outside Landing]
description: A dark wood railing that is weathered from the intense northern climate surrounds the granite landing, preventing falls to the ground below.  A sturdy oak door carved with mystical runes looms before you.

title: [Silvermule Gaming Hall, Foyer]
description: The high-ceilinged foyer is paved with royal blue and white marble tiles flecked with silver.  A clerk smiles from behind a silver teller's cage and exchanges pleasantries with the guests.  Some topiary, trimmed carefully into the shapes of spades and hearts, stands on either side of the arched doorways leading east and west.

title: [Silvermule, Upper Hall]
description: Tall potted palms lean gracefully over the carved, white railings.  At the top of the landing hangs a large oil painting of the town.  Bright silver and blue tapestried carpet runs the length of the hall, softening the patrons' footsteps.  A massive chandelier sways from silver chains, hanging low in order to light not only the landing, but the entry on the floor below.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Main Room]
description: The walls and ceiling are paneled in dark cherry wood, which makes the room seem smaller than it really is.  Low-backed chairs upholstered with red leather seats are arranged beside a glowing brazier.  The sounds of clinking mugs and low voices provide the comforting sense that refreshments are near.

title: [Honeybeer Inn, Upper Hallway]
description: Several doorways open off the hallway, however, only two are currently used as guest rooms.  The chandelier hangs low enough that you must duck your head or risk being splattered with hot tallow should you bump into it.  A slightly worn tapestry carpet has been tacked down the center of the hallway.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Barley Lane]
description: The lane turns sharply north, its forward progress blocked by a low stone well.  Attached to a length of frayed rope, the well's bucket has been hauled out of its depths.  Its wood looks to have been dry for some time.  Voices of parties heading home or to nearby taverns echo off of the brick facades of the narrow buildings to either side of the road, but the stretch is quieter than most of the surrounding district.

Barley Lane turns sharply north here, its forward progress blocked by a community well.  This section of town is somewhat quieter, although occasionally, the voices of parties heading home or to a tavern echo off the narrow buildings.

title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
description: A precarious ledge juts out from the wall and a few broken stones of the well shaft's lining, icy to the touch, serve as a handhold.  The pale circle of the well's mouth above outlines a rusted winch.  A fraying rope dangles past you into the shadows below.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Amaranth Wey]
description: The crush of passersby makes this busy intersection difficult to navigate.  Above all, the towering gate looms, casting the entire area into deep shadow despite the brightness of day.  A group of guardsmen stands to one side, casually watching the crowd.

Few people wander through the area at this hour.  The towering gate looms above, blocking any view of the moons and stars and leaving the area only dimly lit by several ironwork torches placed along the wey.  A group of guardsmen stands to one side, casually watching the crowd.

title: [Amaranth Gate, Battlements]
description: Moonlight casts eerie shadows upon the walkway above the Amaranth Gate.  Crenellated parapets that rise and fall, give the impression of jagged teeth in the night and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

The view from atop the gate stretches as far as the eye can see.  The bridge below is silhouetted against the brilliant blue waters of the Mistydeep River.  Crenellated parapets guard the top of the walkway above the Amaranth Gate and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Amaranth Wey]
description: The crowded intersection of wey and var teems with people, each hurrying in his or her own direction.  A row of pennants of the Vaalor ruby and gold colors flutter atop the nearby city gate, bringing cheer to the otherwise austere limestone edifice.

The normally crowded intersection of wey and var is nearly deserted, the few who are abroad hurrying towards their destinations.  A row of pennants of the Vaalor ruby and gold colors flutter atop the nearby city gate, dark and shimmering in the pale light cast from the night sky.

The normally crowded intersection of wey and var is nearly deserted, the few who are abroad hurrying towards their destinations.  A row of pennants of the Vaalor crimson and gold colors flutter atop the nearby Vermilion Gate, dark and shimmering in the pale light cast from the night sky.  A crisp white pavilion stands to one side of the Gate, while a small square building stands on the other, their front walls creating a corridor through which the crowds pass.

title: [Vermilion Gate, Battlements]
description: The view from atop the gate encompasses the cemetary and the Neartofar Forest in the distance.  The bridge below is silhouetted against the brilliant blue waters of the Mistydeep River.  Crenellated parapets guard the top of the walkway above the Vermilion Gate and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

Moonlight casts eerie shadows upon the walkway above the Vermilion Gate.  Crenellated parapets that rise and fall, give the impression of jagged teeth in the night and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Rubicaene Wey]
description: The bustle of the airship docks occasionally ascends into a deafening roar, as shouting sailors climb ship riggings, and dock workers operate winches and nets to move cargo to and from the various vessels.  Foremen and ship captains alike yell orders to the workers, their voices carrying above the din.  A thick metal grate is set into the cobbled street.

title: [Catacombs, Entrance]
description: A vaulted ceiling allows dim rays of light to seep in through the cracks from the grate above.  Flickering shadows of various shapes and sizes play on the walls.  An odd assortment of paper, kegs and other trinkets litter the ground.  Shattered crates and barrels mar the surface of the floor, and almost hidden behind them lies the rusted top of an opened hatch.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Victory Wey]
description: A large stone-clad building sits back from the cobbled wey, its doors and windows thrown open.  The clanging sound of hammer on metal rings through the area as smiths do their part to keep the city well armed.  A small bronze plaque hangs upon the doorpost.  A stone walkway snakes around to the rear of the building.

A large stone-clad building sits back from the cobbled wey, its doors and windows thrown open.  The clanging sound of hammer on metal rings through the area as smiths do their part to keep the city well armed.  A small bronze plaque hangs upon the doorpost, illuminated by the red glow emanating from within the structure.  Ambient light from the windows casts shadows on a stone walkway that leads to the rear of the building.

title: [Victory Gate, Battlements]
description: The view from atop the gate encompasses the rolling grasslands and Yander's farm.  The bridge below is silhouetted against the brilliant blue waters of the Mistydeep River.  Crenellated parapets guard the top of the walkway above the Victory Gate and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

Moonlight casts eerie shadows upon the walkway above the Victory Gate.  Crenellated parapets that rise and fall, give the impression of jagged teeth in the night and offer a safe vantage point for archers and spellcasters alike.

title: [Thanatoph, Stone Valley]
description: The dying valley runs headlong into the desolation of Thanatoph.  Straddling the twin peaks, a stone structure cut into the northern face of the mountain looms above you.  Scaling the wall is impossible and the only way around the wall is a narrow winding trail to the northeast.

title: [Thanatoph, Highland Hills]
description: The trail winds further up into Thanatoph, narrowing to the point that you are forced to shimmy your way around.  Catching a glimpse below, you bear witness to the defoliation plaguing the valley as it moves towards the mountain.

title: [Stronghold, South Hall]
description: The passageway widens into an expansive chamber, with branches in various directions and the beginning of a wide, winding stairway.  To the north sits an alcove, its darker interior creating a gloomy maw at its entrance.  The southern hallway is likewise shadowy, however braziers can be glimpsed on the walls, promising the possibility of illumination.

title: [Stronghold, Lookout]
description: The stairwell bursts out upon the landing of a tower bounded by a high stone wall.  Open air blows briskly through the large openings between the walls and the beamed ceiling, carrying a chill on its shoulders and a shriek in its jaws.  A panoramic view spreads itself out against the horizon in all directions.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You stand below the top bank of the eastern shore of the Locksmehr River.  From here you have a good view of the many merchant barges and fishing boats that move along the river.  Some move towards the Landing to exchange their goods for silver, while others are working their way upstream to gather new cargo.

title: [Mine Road]
description: As you top the ridge of the bank of the Locksmehr River you see the remains of the northern mining road that leads northeastward into the hills near Darkstone Bay.  It is obvious that the road is in little use now.

title: [Wayside Inn, Dining Room]
description: This ramshackle hostel bears the signs of rough use by hard-bitten travellers and headstrong adventurers.  Several blade-scarred tables and low stools are lined up against the walls, while the central area is dominated by a large firepit around which is a low platform covered with a few ratty bearskins.  The clatter of clay tankards and the smell of humble victuals provide some small comfort to the steady stream of wayfarers who pause here to meet and greet one another.

title: [Wayside Inn, Garret]
description: Quiet laughter and subdued conversation punctuate the otherwise peaceful atmosphere of this little room tucked beneath the garret of the inn.  The smoke-blackened wooden beams meet at an angle, cradling a brass fixture with candles that bathe the room in a soothing glow.

title: [Silvergate, Private Lounge]
[Silvergate Inn, Private Lounge]
description: Leaded glass windows provide a glimpse of the sun-dappled back gardens.  Overstuffed burgundy damask sofas and chairs with matching footrests face a carved marble fireplace.  Exquisitely detailed tapestries adorn the ivory silk-covered walls, and an Inn News chalkboard hangs above a mahogany marble-topped bar spanning the west wall, near a wide carpeted staircase.  An antique cabinet stands opposite an ancient oak door, and a bubbling fountain can be seen through a dark stone arch.

The grey stone of the manor walls is softened by a silvery wool carpet and large tapestries depicting the histories of the peoples of this land.  Comfortable chairs and a sofa, flanked by end tables, are arranged to provide a quiet spot to sit and compare notes at the end of a long day's hunt.  In the far corner of the lounge you see a silver veined marble bar, its mahogany base gleaming in the light which filters through windows overlooking the wilderness beyond this haven.

Leaded glass windows provide a glimpse of the sun-dappled back gardens.  Overstuffed burgundy damask sofas and chairs with matching footrests face a carved marble fireplace.  Exquisitely detailed tapestries adorn the ivory silk-covered walls, and an Inn News board hangs above a mahogany marble-topped bar spanning the west wall, near a wide carpeted staircase.  An antique cabinet stands opposite an ancient oak door, and a bubbling fountain can be seen through a dark stone arch.

title: [Silvergate, 3rd Floor Hallway]
description: Thick carpeting muffles your footsteps and warms this room.  A small window in the western wall overlooks a courtyard far below and the forest beyond.  Simply furnished, there is a single table and a straight-backed chair resting at the window.  A wide carpeted staircase leads back to the lounge far below.

title: [Silvergate, Foyer]
description: Comfortable sofas fronted with low tables are arranged neatly around this welcoming lobby.  Well-placed sconces highlight the paintings and statues which decorate the walls.  Small groups of smiling people pass through, filling the lobby with their voices, while at the far end of the room a cheerful clerk stands behind a large modwir desk, busily attending to the Inn's guests.  To the southwest is a secure-looking ancient oak door.

A polished maoral table holding a bouquet of roses and jasmine rests near the tall arched doors leading to the courtyard.  Damask-covered sofas are arranged neatly around this welcoming lobby.  Silver sconces highlight paintings which decorate the walls, and chandeliers dance with light overhead.  The lobby bustles with life, while a cheerful clerk stands behind a large modwir desk, busily attending to the inn's guests.  To the southwest is an ancient oak door guarded by a footman.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, northwest

title: [Silvergate Inn, Art Studio]
description: Circular stone steps lead into a room with picture windows set in ivory-painted walls which flood the room with light.  One floor-to-ceiling window opens onto a balcony overlooking a garden.  A large platform holding a velvet-draped divan and a carved teak chair sits before a frame which holds rolled up canvas backdrops.  Shelves holding finished works line the walls and a tall cabinet filled with painting supplies behind glass doors is shoved to one side next to a sturdy worktable.

title: [Silvergate, Grand Hall]
description: Although large and open, this hallway manages to feel cozy.  Burgundy wool carpet covers the stone floors and a wide stone staircase with garland-trimmed bannisters which rises gracefully to the upper levels of this fine old manor house.  Carved oak display cases flank the foot of the stairs and fill most of the eastern wall.  Opposite the stairs, well-cushioned sofas and chairs are grouped around each of four large leaded glass windows.

Shadows dance across the onyx-tiled floor of this spacious room.  In the center of the room is a bed shrouded with a black and silver spidersilk veil suspended from the ceiling.  One long-stemmed blood red rose lies across the pillows.  A night stand of gleaming black onyx is carved in the shape of a wolf standing guard.  A silver-tipped scroll lays on a delicate mahogany writing desk, and a large mural on the west wall catches your eye.

Cut-crystal chandeliers brightly illuminate the hall, the light reflecting off tall leaded glass windows.  Plush cream damask sofas and chairs rest atop a crested rug.  Carved sideboards flank a magnificent fireplace under an oil painting of Silvergate Inn.  A sweeping grand staircase with lustrous mahogany banisters rises to the upper level, and elaborate bouquets of jasmine and golden roses artfully fill tall vases decorating the hall.  Liveried footmen and bellmen bustle about, attending to the guests.

Tall leaded glass windows allow light to stream in and reflect off the gold-veined marble floors.  Plush cream damask sofas and chairs rest atop a crested rug.  Carved sideboards flank a magnificent fireplace under an oil painting of Silvergate Inn.  A sweeping grand staircase with lustrous mahogany banisters rises to the upper level, and elaborate bouquets of jasmine and golden roses artfully fill tall vases decorating the hall.  Liveried footmen and bellmen bustle about, attending to the guests.

title: [Silvergate, 2nd Floor Hallway]
description: Plush, dark green carpeting underfoot complements the stained oak wainscot of this light and airy landing.  Along one wall you see a heavy oak sideboard.  Two crystal vases with arrangements of fresh cut flowers adorn each end of the sideboard and their reflections in a mirror above fill the room with their color.  The delicate scent of the flowers intermingles pleasantly with the smell of freshly polished woodwork.

title: [Hall of Justice, Clerk's Office]
description: A heavily carved modwir desk occupies the center of the office.  One wall is lined floor to ceiling with built-in wooden shelves, each one burdened with orderly stacks of files and thick sheaves of parchment.

title: [Ta'Vaalor, Hall of Justice]
description: A thick iron chandelier hangs from the wide-beamed ceiling, casting flickering light across the stone walls and ivory-veined black marble floors of the Hall.  Several plain ironwork sconces line a flight of steps leading upwards into the shadows.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A ladder of woven palm fronds hangs over the wide ledge and is the only way to gain entry to the pit.  It looks quite frayed and in terrible condition, with most of the fronds torn or tattered.  The giant red splatter stains on the floor below are not reassuring in the least.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Three huge cages dominate this room, two of which are empty.  The third, made of sturdy iron, imprisons a dangerous looking beast.  A smoke-spewing metal contraption rattles nearby, and although its purpose isn't clear, it's quite obviously doing something.

title: [Boreas Ridge, Zephyr Lane]
description: The elevation here offers a spectacular view of the hills below cast in a pale glow of available moonlight, with beautiful well-groomed trees towering over the vista.  Recessed paths lit by small lanterns lead to elaborate estates carved into the mountainside, some nearly obscured by bushes.

The elevation here offers a spectacular view of the hills below, with beautiful well-groomed trees towering over the vista.  Recessed paths lead to elaborate estates carved into the mountainside, some nearly obscured by bushes.

title: [Boreas Hills, Sundowner Way]
description: Slate stairs set into the mountain lead up to the ridge above, while an iron railing gives those venturing upwards something to hold onto.  Several thanot trees grow nearby, ivy winding their way around them and eventually up onto the railing.

Slate stairs set into the mountain lead up to the ridge above, while an iron railing gives those venturing upwards something to hold onto.  A few lamps have been hung from the railing to provide lighting for the stairs.  Several thanot trees grow nearby, ivy winding their way around them and eventually up onto the railing.

title: [Helden Hall, Great Hall]
description: Rushes are strewn across the floor of this enormous room with a lofty ceiling, and elaborate tapestries adorn the walls.  Opposite the entrance is a raised dais dominated by a massive table overlooking scores of smaller tables.  In the center of the Hall lies a large hearth providing warmth and light, and a few comfortable leather chairs are scattered about.  A display case rests against the east wall, flanked by trophies of conquered beasts.  Stairs lead up the north wall to a railed balcony.

title: [Helden Hall, 1st Floor Balcony]
description: The stairs continue up to the second floor, while this passage leads east and west.  Laughter and loud boasting float up from the Great Hall below you.

title: [Helden Hall, Viewing Chamber]
description: A wide walkway encircles the fighting pit.  Carved into the stone walls are seats for spectators to view the contests of bravery and honor below.  The stones of the walkway are worn smooth from years of stomping as the observers cheer for their favorite combatant.  The only decoration on the chamber's circular wall is a finely made tapestry.

title: [Helden Hall, Dark Cavern]
description: The lights from the crystals reach this room with a light touch, giving it a soft glow.  The roughly hewn walls extend in a circular fashion, creating a perfect complement for the huge set of heavy oak double doors that adorn the far wall at the base of the slope.  The echoes of cheering crowds seem to resonate within this room.  Next to the double doors and a little to the side, steep stone steps climb upwards.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You reach a rock filled crevice that used to be a narrow passage.  It looks as if a rockslide from above has decided to impede your progress.  It could take days to remove all the rocks and clear the passageway.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trail narrows as you pass between the two rock faces.  To the west, a pile of fallen rock impedes your passage.  To the east, you view a winding trail descending into a grassy valley meadow.

title: [Mine]
description: A rather large boulder lays on the floor near the eastern edge of the room and you can see a ledge above the room in the southern wall with a set of stone steps cut into the rock face there.

title: [Mine]
description: The ledge above the cavern is larger than appeared from the room below.  It continues to the east and appears to be covered with more of the pine branches that you saw at the entrance to the cavern.

title: [A Dark Shaft]
description: Piles of dirt and debris fill this end of the shaft.  An odd sound echoes in from somewhere above and as you look up to find its source, you see a mottled clay ramp, covered with thousands of tiny wood chips.

title: [Shadow Valley]
description: A thousand tiny particles of shattered wood cover a mottled clay ramp which descends into the ground before you.  Torn and broken earth indicates that the opening may have been caused by an explosive force.  Strangely, odd black mists twist and flow around the entryway, as if trying to conceal it.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley of Peace]
description: The floor of the valley is featureless and white.  Each step you take threatens to pin your leg in a jagged hole as your foot breaks through the hardened top layer of snow.  A scraggly stick poking out of the ground looks suspiciously like the top of a pine tree.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Valley Cave]
description: The thick snow walls of this cave muffle the sound of the crying wind and insulate this cozy space from the biting cold air of the valley above.  Its ceiling is supported by the lower branches of a tall pine tree whose trunk forms a column of grey in the center of the room.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Inner Trail]
description: Water gushes out of a large vertical crack in the rock face, cutting a gash in the trail and falling over the side into the valley below.  Thick, black ice has accumulated high up along the edges of the crack showing just how deep the water can get.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Wet Cave]
description: The crack leading into this cave is narrow and pointed at the bottom, but it widens toward the top to allow the entrance of even the largest of beasts.  A cold, black rivulet cuts a deep channel across the cave floor and tumbles out onto the trail outside.  Tree branches and a collection of other odds and ends, both from nature and civilization, have been woven clumsily into a huge nest that straddles the brackish water.

title: [Locksmith, Salesroom]
description: The walls of this shop are covered with keys and locks of all colors, shapes, and sizes, from large iron padlocks to bone-white skeleton keys.  A white-hot coal fire burns steadily under a pot of molten metal over which stoops the locksmith's apprentice.  Forms for keys and lock parts sit wedged in sand on a wood work table nearby.  To the north, a dimly lit doorway recedes into the shadows.

title: [Edwina's Lockpick Repair]
description: A small counter has been placed in front of a curtain that divides this small attic space into two.  Edwina, Larton's ex-wife, bustles about her shop constantly cleaning and eyeing prospective customers.

title: [Cysaegir, Citadel Drawbridge]
description: Massive stones, pale grey in color, and fitted together so well that the joins are nearly invisible, rest at the top of a brush covered hill.  Blaestonberry cling heartily to the tower-flanked gates with a vaulted archway in the center of the stone wall.  Vines struggle in vain to reach the pointed domes of the towers, which appear to be made of polished silver in the moonlight.  Running along one side of the wall rising up here is a narrow path traversing down into a deep gorge.

Massive stones, pale grey in color, and fitted together so well that the joins are nearly invisible, rest at the top of a low hill.  Blaestonberry cling heartily to the tower-flanked gates with a vaulted archway in the center of the stone wall.  Sunlight glitters on the pointed domes of the towers, making it appear as if the domes themselves are made of burnished gold.  Running along one side of the wall rising up here is a narrow path traversing down into a deep gorge.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: The sound of rushing water nearby fills the area with a gentle natural murmur.  Trees, shrubs, and lichen struggle among the crags for footing and their very survival.  Cut into the natural stone of the cliffside, a narrow path leads up the mountain while a steep trail leads further down the rock face.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: Hugging the tree's southern side, the platform stretches out eastward over the large supportive branches of the ancient forest.  A hemlock tree pokes through an intentional break in the planking and looks sturdy enough to climb down to get to ground level.

title: [Cysaegir, Disk Statue]
description: Thick vines of creeping clematis completely entwine the bole of a hemlock tree.  A curious looking relic rests beneath its spreading branches.  Revolving slowly on an invisible axis above a pedestal made of intricate stonework traceries is an oval-shaped disk of glass.  Relieving the darkness, alternating shades of purple, pink, and white light flash from within the depths of the disk.  The air and ground immediately surrounding the relic seems to shimmer and crackle with energy.

Thick vines of creeping clematis completely entwine the bole of a hemlock tree.  A curious looking relic rests beneath its spreading branches.  Revolving slowly on an invisible axis above a pedestal made of intricate stonework traceries is an oval-shaped disk of glass.  Paled under the sunlight, alternating shades of purple, pink, and white light flash from within the depths of the disk.  The air and ground immediately surrounding the relic seems to shimmer and crackle with energy.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: The platform follows the contour of a tanik tree to the south and butts up against its rough bark.  The north side has a stout wood-beamed railing to prevent a drop down to the forest floor.  The only break in the beams is for a rope ladder leading down to the ground.  Carved into the bark is a pair of initials surrounded by a crude heart.

title: [Cysaegir, Wishing Well]
description: Nestled beneath the peacefully spreading branches of several tanik trees is a charming, fel-gabled edifice.  Set in the elegant bay window, a lone candle burns and an inviting soft light spills forth from the opened window.  A wishing well, affixed with a polished plaque set in its center stands not far off from the building.  Trumpet-shaped purple blossoms of mournblooms snake along the lip of the wishing well and vines of creeping clematis drape down the sides.

Nestled beneath the peacefully spreading branches of several tanik trees is a charming, fel-gabled edifice.  Glimpsed from the open bay window, a set of ivory brocade drapes billow on a soft breeze.  A wishing well, affixed with a polished plaque set at its center stands not far off from the building.  Trumpet-shaped purple blossoms of mournblooms snake along the lip of the wishing well and vines of creeping clematis drape down the sides.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: This side of the tree platform ends here in an open, rounded area.  Set along the south side of the platform is a circular riser elevated to the level of the railing, providing a precarious perch for those wishing to take in the view at this height.  Tied off on one side of the railing are several lengths of rope that can be seen climbing up into higher tree branches overhead.

Perched high in the trees, the platform ends here in an open, rounded area.  Set along the south side of the platform is a circular riser elevated to the level of the railing, providing a precarious perch for those wishing to take in the view at this height.  Tied off on one side of the railing are several lengths of rope that can be seen climbing up into higher tree branches overhead.  A small wooden structure juts out from the decking suspended over the ground below by supports attached to the side of the trunk.

title: [Cysaegir, Treetop Platform]
description: The platform turns sharply here, around the trunk of an ancient tanik tree, and features reinforced railings along both sides.  Coming to a stop at a raised section, steps climb up a set of risers that lead to a bar where several lengths of rope have been tied off.  The other end of those hempen cables soar high into the towering treetop canopy.

title: [Cysaegir, Vista Knoll]
description: Cresting the top of the hill provides an ideal vantage point of the snow-capped mountains that tower in the distance and the town common spreading out below.  The wan glow of a moon peeks out from between two of the largest mountains, their perpetual misty clouds breaking apart to allow a thick beam of light.  Illuminated by the faint moonlight is a small clearing surrounded on three sides by thick ancient forest growth and a steep mountain slope in the remaining direction.

Cresting the top of the hill provides an ideal vantage point of the snow-capped mountains that tower in the distance and the town common spreading out below.  The glowing ball of the sun peeks out from the perpetual mists that surround two of the largest mountaintops.  Off to the side, a small clearing is host to some ancient ruins and abandoned buildings.

Cresting the top of the hill provides an ideal vantage point of the snow-capped mountains that tower in the distance and the town common spreading out below.  Illuminated by the faint moonlight is a small clearing surrounded on three sides by thick ancient forest growth and a steep mountain slope in the remaining direction.  A spiral staircase winds around one of the large trees growing along the edge of the woodland.

title: [Front Porch]
description: A three foot high railing encloses a wide, cedar porch which has aged to a warm red tone.  Several rocking chairs are arranged near a small wicker table.  Through the trees, in the distance, snow-capped mountains can be seen rising through a fog.  A spiral staircase, following the contour of the tree, descends back to the forest floor, while a heavy oak door provides access to a cottage built around the tree.  A tall window provides a glimpse of the interior of a cottage

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: A slight mist fills the air here and is accompanied by the rushing sound of the nearby waterfall.  The rough bark on the tree log cross-section steps provides sturdy footing for any that try to navigate the narrow, switchbacking mountain trail.  Trees, grass, and other lush flora glisten and thrive in the gentle dampness here, nearly obscuring an overgrown path that leads down to the bottom of the gorge.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: Lined on both sides with fallen trees, the steep path along the mountain seems well maintained and moderately easy to travel along.  Cross sections of logs, set into the dirt at the foot of this section of the trail, serve as crude steps to proceed down into the gorge.  A steep trail leading up lends no aid to those ascending the switchback.

title: [Cysaegir, Pond]
description: The lotus-shaped blossoms of water lilies dot the moon-streaked surface of the pond, and several stepping stones lead down into the water.  Towering over a square cottage and a matching riverstone bungalow is an old birch tree.  Pieces of its papery-thin bark litter the ground, and an assortment of red and blue trafel mushrooms grows at the base of its trunk.

The lotus-shaped blossoms of water lilies bounce and bob on the surface of the pond, and several stepping stones lead down into the water.  A family of frolicking geese creates a cacophony of sound as they playfully swim around the pond nipping at each other.  A lone duck swims the circumference of a barrel, which is next to the entrance of a square cottage made of riverstone.  Towering over the cottage is an old birch tree, pieces of its papery-thin bark litter the ground.

The lotus-shaped blossoms of water lilies dot the moon-streaked surface of the pond, and several stepping stones lead down into the water.  Towering over a square cottage made of riverstone is an old birch tree.  Pieces of its papery-thin bark litter the ground, and an assortment of red and blue trafel mushrooms grows at the base of its trunk.

title: [Cysaegir, Pond]
description: Low, drooping branches of a willow tree gently caress the surface of the warm, crystal clear water.  Wisps of steam rise up, prompted by the thermal vents along the bottom of the spring, and create a series of effervescent bubbles that glide along the surface.  Moss clings thickly to the tree, and every so often a strong breeze causes a flurry of its catkins to take flight.  Thriving swamp buttercups break the surface and lily pads float serenely around the circumference of the pond.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall]
description: Ivory inlaid doors line both sides of the hallway.  Most of the doors remain closed and locked while the rooms behind them are still undergoing construction.  Further down the hall, an opened doorway that leads to the citizenship office and a stairway leads to the upper floor.  A magnificent bouquet of delphinuris thrives in a faceted crystal vase sitting atop an ebonwood table that features fluted legs and gilded scrollwork.

title: [Rhyaesdid Hall, Second Floor]
description: On opposite ends of the corridor, covering the windows are wooden shutters carved in lacy patterns that allow a trickle of sunlight into the room.  A gilded mirror hangs above an ebonwood table laden with food and drinks.  Plush flowered carpeting runs the length of the hallway, and colorful, semi-circular doormats occupy the space at the foot of several locked doors.

On opposite ends of the corridor, covering the windows are wooden shutters carved in lacy patterns that allow a trickle of sunlight into the room.  A gilded mirror hangs above an ebonwood table laden with food and drinks.  Plush flowered carpeting runs the length of the hallway, and a colorful, semi-circular doormat occupies the space at the foot of an ebonwood door.

title: [Cysaegir, Pebble Pathway]
description: Shadowed by fiddlehead ferns, a pathway of soft white pebbles follows the gentle curve of a bubbling brook as it slips past clusters of glossy-leafed holly trees.  A quaint bungalow can be glimpsed over the edge of the ferns at one end of the pathway, while a large tanik tree stands at the other side across an arched footbridge.  Cross-hatched beams support platforms that are wrapped in railings and silken banners, which create a colorful dwelling.

title: [Cysaegir, Dwelling]
description: Traipsing across a bubbling brook is an arched footbridge painted a soft white that matches the pebbles of the meandering pathway that leads to a cluster of glossy-leafed holly trees.  Thick green moss creates an alluring carpet around the base of an ancient tanik that is surrounded by a complex platform system.  Wide steps separate the ground level from the first platform, which is obscured from sight by vibrantly colored silk banners.

title: [Cysaegir, Dwelling]
description: Traipsing across a bubbling brook is an arched footbridge painted a soft white that matches the pebbles of the meandering pathway that leads to a cluster of glossy-leafed holly trees.  Thick green moss creates an alluring carpet around the base of an ancient tanik that is surrounded by a complex platform system.  Wide steps separate the ground level from the first platform, which is obscured from sight by vibrantly colored silk banners.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Entry]
description: Clear lacquer preserves the golden hue of the oak used to create wide railings and the shelves beneath, which are fitted into the wide sides of the tanik tree at the edge of the circular platform.  Silken banners spread through the branches forming a colorful roof that shimmers when sunlight filters through the leafy canopy above.  Pillows lay in organized heaps among wicker baskets filled with vials of dye.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: Echoes bounce back and forth over the smooth stone walls of the cavern.  Cylindrical cones of calcite protrude from the ceiling in a haphazard manner.  Pointed spikes dot the surface of the stalactites, and every so often drops of water plummet to the ground, creating small puddles on the floor.  Irregular stone steps lead up to an oval-shaped hole in the wall.

title: [Cysaegir, Cave]
description: A dozen or so torches line the walls of the cave, which probably aids in keeping these walls dry.  Small square marble tiles decorate the surface of an open wood-framed doorway.  Along the back of the cave, broken crates and barrels are piled almost to the ceiling.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: Lined on both sides with fallen trees, the steep path along the mountain seems well maintained and moderately easy to travel along.  Cross sections of logs, set into the dirt at the foot of this section of the trail, serve as crude steps to proceed down into the gorge.  A steep trail leading up lends no aid to those ascending the switchback.

title: [Cysaegir, Gorge Switchback]
description: The sound of rushing water nearby fills the area with a gentle natural murmur.  Trees, shrubs, and lichen struggle among the crags for footing and their very survival.  Cut into the natural stone of the cliffside, a narrow path leads up the mountain while a steep trail leads further down the rock face.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Lobby]
description: Beautifully rendered watercolor and oil paintings adorn the silver-speckled marble walls.  Cushioned benches offer a grand view of the heavily trafficked foyer while a banistered oak stairway leads off to other attractions of the Naerine Hostelry.  Faint sounds of rushing water can be heard through a set of glaes-paned doors leading out to the bailey.

title: [Naerine Hostelry, Hall]
description: Velvet runners embroidered with a fanciful floral design span the length of the upstairs hall.  Terra cotta vases and kiln-fired urns burst with lush ornamental grasses and bountiful bouquets, flanking a sun-inset modwir door and a moon-inset tanik door.

title: [Reformatory, Antechamber]
description: A heavy, barred gateway at the edge of the immense and circular chamber leads to a walkway that reaches three cellblocks.  Thick hinges and iron straps reinforced by huge black iron locks adorn the gateway, prohibiting further passage toward the holding cells.  The rhythmic sound of marching boots echoes off the walls as sentries tread on a metal catwalk high overhead while patrolling the area from up above.

title: [Reformatory, Gallery]
description: Metal grating makes up the catwalk that encircles the guard station.  Overlooking the antechamber below, sentries armed with short-bows easily patrol the cellblocks from this strategic vantage point.  From behind thick, clear glass, other guards are plainly visible as they perform various duties, including the oftentimes tedious task of paperwork.  Rectangular slots run the perimeter of the glass.  The niches are just wide enough to allow arrows to be fired from behind the safety of the glass wall.

title: [Reformatory, Storage Room]
description: This snug little closet is cleanly swept and rodent free.  Labeled in a neat and precise hand, the efficiently organized shelves, cabinets, and barrels contain items that are required for the daily needs of the inmates and staff alike.  Leaning against the wall, and missing a rung or three, a ladder rests beneath a trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Reformatory, Roof]
description: The trapdoor leading back down to the storage room has been painted with a large bull's-eye in red paint.  Partially hidden behind a huge wall of trees and dimly illuminated by moonlight, the roof provides a perfect spot to rest and relax while contemplating life.  A dart board hangs above a copper urn.  Stored in a glass bowl on one side of a felt covered table are small red and blue tokens.  Brightly colored rocks hold down stacks of playing cards and, on the opposite side of the table, a leather-bound black book.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: Greyed and cracked, an ancient oak rises from the thick undergrowth, a plethora of broken branches, fallen leaves and other debris scattered about its base.  The old oak has collapsed in upon itself.  Long cracks run the length of its trunk, and the knobby ends of fractured branches protrude at odd angles.  A massive branch has fallen from some height and lodged itself in an opening, providing a steep but stable climb to the upper area of the tree.

title: [Great Oak, Collapsed Hall]
description: Sharp splinters and jagged shards of wood emerge from the once-smooth walls and floors of the hollow interior of the great oak.  The ceiling has completely collapsed, raining dead branches and leaves across the uneven floor.  The southern side of the chamber has fallen away, leaving a gaping hole to the outside.  An enormous branch, grey and dying like the other parts of this infected oak, has lodged itself in the opening, allowing access to the forest floor below.

title: [Calelith Villa, Courtyard]
description: Bright sunlight fills this area overgrown with shrubs and bushes.  The forest has begun to close in around a large dilapidated villa looming to the north, obscuring any signs of a road or path.
Bright moonlight fills this area overgrown with shrubs and bushes.  The forest has begun to close in around a large dilapidated villa looming to the north, obscuring any signs of a road or path.

title: [Calelith Villa, Portico]
description: Ivy surrounds the support columns and covers much of the portico floor.  The roof is sagging and a section to the west has fallen, the debris landing on what remains of a chair.  A large maoral door hangs on one hinge, its frame splintered.

title: [Calelith Villa, Foyer]
description: Shards of pottery litter the cracked and scratched marble floor and a shattered maoral table lies against the western wall.  Overhead, a tarnished brass chandelier hangs, its candles long since extinguished.

title: [Calelith Villa, Upper Hall]
description: Thick carpeting covers the floor, faded and frayed.  Splintered pieces of wood litter the hall, the remains of bedroom doors.

title: [Calelith Villa, Hall]
description: An oak door lies in the middle of the hall, its bent hinges still hanging on the western wall.  A rounded arch on the eastern wall leads to the villa's library.

title: [Calelith Villa, Wine Cellar]
description: The cellar is dark and musty, with the smell of wine still lingering in the air.  Dark stains cover the floor and several kegs sit with their spigots in the open position.  Large wine racks cover two walls.  Curiously, all the bottles are still in place but the corks have been removed.  Odd scratches are visible in the floor, beneath the dust.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: Atop the ridge is a magnificent view of the pool below and the forest to the south.  High above the spray of the falls, the air is crisp and clean.  To the west a stand of yews rises tall.  Rocks form a natural stair that appears to head down and behind the falls.

title: [Gyldemar Green, Waterfall]
description: A fine mist keeps the air cool and damp, while water glistens on the rock walls of this small cave behind the falls.  Water roils from the force of the falls where the cavern floor meets the pool.  Nature has left handholds and rock steps on both the eastern and western faces of the cave, making it possible to climb in and out of here without difficulty.  Gazing out at the falls, moonlight creates a crystalline curtain of water.
