title: [Gyldemar Forest, Clearing]
description: Swallows dip and wheel around a deep cleft in the cliff face, some of them bearing bits of grass and vines to be used for nests.  The wildflowers that carpet the clearing are in full bloom, their brilliant yellows and purples a welcome change from the starkness of the pale grey cliff face to the north.

Bats flutter around the night-blooming plants at the base of the cliff, drawn there by drifts of insects which swarm around the sweet-smelling blossoms.  Denser foliage to the south obscures the more distant trees, but seems passable if potentially treacherous at night.  A deep cleft in the cliff face is a blacker shadow against the dark grey stone.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Cliffside]
description: A series of steps carved in the native rock winds down the cliffside, each step worn so smooth at its center that they form more of a treacherously slippery ramp.  Jagged rocks line the deeply incised passage on either side.  The highest point of the cliffs is not too far away now.

A series of steps carved in the native rock winds down the cliffside, each step worn so smooth at its center that they form more of a treacherously slippery ramp.  Darkness does little to aid in the safety of the steps.  Jagged rocks line the deeply incised passage on either side.  The highest point of the cliffs is not too far away now.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Hot Springs]
description: Sunlight streams through the branches of the pine trees that surround the springs while short bushes fight for what sun they can gain in the shadow of the pines.  Lush grass creates a ring of green carpet around the pool.  A hollow log rests near a circle of flat stones that surround the hot springs.

Moonlight flows through the branches of the pines trees that surround the springs while short bushes fill the spaces between the pine.  Dark green grass creates a ring of dark carpet around the pool.  A hollow log rests near a circle of flat stones that surrounds the hot springs.

Moonlight flows through the branches of the trees that surround the springs while short bushes fill the spaces between the pines.  Lush grass carpets the area around a circle of flat stones that surrounds the steaming pool, one side of the formation creating steps that descend into the water.  A hollow log rests near a thick hedgerow that grows to either side of a scrollworked wrought-iron gate.

Sunlight streams through the branches of the trees that surround the springs while short bushes fight for what sun they can gain in the shadow of the pines.  Lush grass carpets the area around a circle of flat stones that surrounds the steaming pool, one side of the formation creating steps that descend into the water.  A hollow log rests near a thick hedgerow that grows to either side of a scrollworked wrought-iron gate.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Hot Springs]
description: Wisps of steam rise off the pool as the hot water comes in contact with the cool mountain air.  Centered in the pool is a flat rock, barely protruding above the surface.  The rock has become home to several dragonflies.  Shadows from the tree branches above dance across the water.

Wisps of steam rise from the pool as the hot water comes in contact with the cool night breeze.  Moonlight illuminates a flat rock centered in the pool which has become home to several dragonflies.  The midnight-black water mirrors the night sky, seemingly an extension of the heavens above.

title: [Observatory, Entry Hall]
description: The building's age becomes evident as you look around this expansive entry hall.  Tapestries hang from the tall ceiling and cover most of the walls, and rugs, once rich and vibrant but now faded, cover nearly the entire floor.  Strangely, there is no dust or clutter despite the absence of any housekeeping.  The chamber is vaguely shaped like a huge piece of pie, the far walls sloping inward to meet at one point, and the wall opposite them curving inward on either side.

title: [Observatory, Dome]
description: Footsteps echo loudly in the cavernous dome overhead.  There is a four-foot slit in the side of the dome, running from the top to nearly the bottom.  In the exact center of the room, a magnificent telescope fashioned from eahnor and coraesine points toward the opening.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine's Edge]
description: The level ground of the old riverbed suddenly disappears as the ground falls away to the east amid a jumble of boulders and fallen branches where a rushing waterfall must have once filled the still air with mist countless years ago.  A huge formation of piled rocks bounds the northern entrance to the ravine, and the more traversable ground of the forest rises in a shady hillside to the south.  High moors rise beyond the deep ravine, their geography shrouded in clouds of darkening mist.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The ravine ends abruptly in a wide, rocky area, the floor of the chasm smoothed by the pounding of falling water eons ago.  A few small trees and patches of weeds have taken root in the stony ground, amid piles of fallen rocks and a few bones of fallen adventurers, at the foot of the precipitous wall.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The walkway widens considerably for a stretch into an oval bulge.  No buildings can be found this far along, and the boardwalk opens to the surrounding marsh.  Railings border the walkway, and benches and tables line the edges of the planks, providing a place to rest and perhaps have a meal.  To the northeast, a muddy path rises out of the marsh and climbs a tall hill.

title: [Marshtown, Jag Hill]
description: The muddy path is treacherous and lined to either side by sharp-leafed plants that cut and slice at exposed skin.  Rolling mud and loose rocks make the climb very difficult, and the lack of any railing provides a frustrating ascent to the top of the hill.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Cliffs]
description: The rocks of the cliff face make further progress to the west or north impossible.  A rough path, strewn with sharp, protruding rocks from the cliff face, continues to the southeast.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: The sand on this stretch of beach is almost completely black, having come from the volcanic rocks of the cliff face to the east.  The cliff looms high above the beach and, while having many crags and crevices, does not offer enough handholds to be climbable.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A river delta lies to the north, flowing in falls from the cliff face, running west through the black sands, and emptying into the ocean. The flow of fresh water from the east is steady and could not be crossed but for the bridge erected across the delta.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: The source of the waterfalls to the west, a large, fresh water lagoon, lies to the east, contained by the cliff face.  Colorful birds dart in and out of the large bushes and ferns that surround the narrow beach of the lagoon.  To the west, some rickety stairs lead down the cliff face to the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, North Beach]
description: A river delta lies to the south, spanned by a weathered wooden bridge.  To the north, the beach is more cluttered with debris than to the south.  The looming cliff face to the east grows closer to the shore line to the north, giving the beach the illusion of disappearing into the distance.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lagoon]
description: The waters of the lagoon rush over the edge of the cliff face here, falling hundreds of feet to the beach far below.  Standing here on the edge of the cliff face, the black beach stretches out below for great distances to the north and south.  The falls form a small delta on the beach below, which is crossed by a weathered, old bridge.  A rickety set of wooden stairs leads down.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: The dunes grow very tall here, and must be climbed to navigate the beach.  The sands reach nearly to the height of the cliff to the east, and several areas of the cliff look climbable.  The waves of the beach continue to crash endlessly to the west.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: Bright moonlight flows in from the west, where the sounds of the crashing surf can be heard over the rushing winds and rustling leaves.  The woods here are lush, and thick underbrush covers the ground around the trees.  The cliff to the west can be climbed down to the beach.

Glaring sunlight flows in from the west, where the sounds of the crashing surf can be heard over the rushing winds and rustling leaves.  The woods here are lush, and thick underbrush covers the ground around the trees.  The cliff to the west can be climbed down to the beach.

title: [Vornavian Coast, South Beach]
description: A massive oak tree has toppled from the cliff to the east here, and is tall enough to allow a climb to the top of the cliffs.  The roots of the tree still cling to the cliffside, and rocks lie strewn about the tree on the beach, dislodged in the fall.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: A forest of oak and fir trees spreads out to the east from the top of the cliff line here.  The ocean roars against the beach below to the west, and the smell of the salt is carried in mists on the breeze blowing in from the west.  The roots of a massive oak tree that has toppled to the beach below still cling firmly to the cliff top.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: A sturdy companionway ladder leads down into the water, and upward to the upper deck.  As the ladder leads underwater to lower decks of the ship, the tide washing through the hull is so strong that further progress in that direction is impossible.

A sturdy companionway ladder leads down into the water, and upward to the upper deck.  As the soot-stained ladder leads underwater to lower decks of the ship, the tide washing through the hull is so strong that further progress in that direction is impossible.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Beached Hulk]
description: Here on deck, the weathered ship looks almost seaworthy, belying the massive holes in the hull.  The wooden timbers of the deck are bleached almost white from years of the relentless beating of the sun.  Still solid but worn smooth by years of weathering, the deck continues northeast to the bow.  A ladder leads down into the hold.

Here on deck, the weathered ship looks almost seaworthy, belying the massive holes in the hull.  The wooden timbers of the deck are bleached almost white from years of the relentless beating of the sun, and stand in stark contrast to the black scars of a recent fire about many of the holes in the deck.  Still solid but worn smooth by years of weathering, the deck continues northeast to the bow.  A blackened ladder leads down into the hold.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Many fallen trees nearly block the path here, slowing progress to a crawl.  The roots of the fallen trees stand tall above the fog off the path to either side.  Despite the felled trees, no moonlight penetrates this place.  A hill to the east looks to be climbable.

Many fallen trees nearly block the path here, slowing progress to a crawl.  The roots of the fallen trees stand tall above the fog off the path to either side.  Despite the felled trees, no sunlight penetrates this place.  A hill to the east looks to be climbable.

title: [Vornavian Coast, The Lake]
description: A large inland lake stretches out to the east, circled by a well-traveled dirt road.  The forest closes in on the path all around the lake, making a beautiful landscape for watching the sunrise.  A breeze from the west blows the trees gently, and dips down to make occasional ripples on the lake.  A hill slopes down into a foggy valley to the west.

title: [Captain's Rest, Entryway]
description: The walls are half paneled with modwir wood with whitewashed walls above.  Time darkened beams above support brass oil lanterns.  Just to the right of some well-worn oaken stairs is a large painting of a ship in a stormy sea.  From the common room to the east comes the clink of glasses and the sound of conversation.

title: [Captain's Rest, Landing]
description: The well-worn oaken stairs open out to a green carpeted hall leading to rooms to the east and west.  A spiral staircase continues up toward the roof.  The sound of conversation from the common room downstairs drifts up the stairs.

title: [Outlands Manor, Stable]
description: Smelling more of moldered hay and rotted wood than of horses, the dark interior of the stable provides a faded image of its past glory.  Outlines and nail holes mark the wood where metallic crests once adorned the now warped maoral stalls and the carved haon doorjamb.  An old modwir ladder leads up to the stable's hayloft above the empty stalls.

title: [Outlands Manor, Stable Loft]
description: An uneven layer of hay covers most of the loft, with pale splotches of mold forming a second, less wholesome layer.  Here and there the hay slopes downward into a soft-edged hole where the floor boards have rotted away beneath it, and elsewhere the hay is striped with accumulated pigeon droppings beneath the roof beams.  An old modwir ladder leans against the edge of the loft and provides an easy means of reaching the ground.

title: [Manor House, Kitchen]
description: As dirty and damp as this room is, with patches of yellow mold and cobwebs in the corners, the steel spit spanning the large fireplace and the butcher block counter make the original purpose of the room quite plain.  A rusted basin rests on a table between a boarded up window and a stairway set against the east wall that climbs to the second floor.  Beneath the stairway, stone steps descend to the manor's cellar.  A haon door stands just south of the fireplace in the kitchen's west wall.

title: [Manor House, Wine Cellar]
description: Splintered and broken, bottle racks line the walls, and the shattered pieces of what must have been dozens of bottles cover the floor.  In the center of the cellar is sprawled the face-down skeleton of a giantman, its spine and several of its ribs cleanly severed.  A set of stone steps lead upward along the east wall.

title: [Manor House, West Entryway]
description: Moonlight washes over the once-beautiful tiles that cover the floor of the entryway in front of the oak entry door, but the boards beneath have warped, causing the tiles to crack and buckle.  Hallways lead from here to the north and south wings of the house, and a third corridor with several doors off it runs due east.  Pieces of broken wood beneath the window by the entry door are all that remain of a small table and chair.  A curving stairway leads up to an overlooking landing on the second floor.

Once-beautiful tiles cover the floor of the entryway in front of the oak entry door, but the boards beneath have warped, causing the tiles to crack and buckle.  Hallways lead from here to the north and south wings of the house, and a third corridor with several rooms off it runs due east.  Pieces of broken wood beneath the window by the entry door are all that remain of a small table and chair.  A curving stairway leads up to an overlooking landing on the second floor.

title: [Manor House, Second Floor]
description: This landing overlooks the first floor foyer and the curving stairway that ascends from it.  From here, short corridors lead to the north, east and south.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Trampled ashes, scattered pieces of charred cot frames and burnt shreds of mattress ticking cover most of the floor in this chamber.  The layer of soot that covers the ceiling suggests that the contents of the room were piled in the center of it and then set ablaze.  A narrow stone stairway climbs to the second level of the tower along the room's east wall.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Brownish stains darken the stone floor in this chamber, although a distinct pattern is evident after more than a cursory glance.  Remnants of bloodstained canvas still sheath the broken frames of cots that lie crumpled against the walls, but most of the cloth appears to have been chewed away.  More recent than the stains, narrow cracks and an upward warping of the floor are evident in the center of the room and extend toward the stairway to the first floor along the east wall.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Littered with the bits and pieces of smashed bins and racks, boxes and casks -- this area at the foot of the stairway to the tower's third level appears to have been used for storing weapons and equipment as well as provisions.  Arrow slits pierce the north wall where the stone stairs allow, letting a small amount of moonlight into the otherwise dark room.

Littered with the bits and pieces of smashed bins and racks, boxes and casks -- this area at the foot of the stairway to the tower's third level appears to have been used for storing weapons and equipment as well as provisions.  Arrow slits pierce the north wall where the stone stairs allow, letting a small amount of sunlight into the otherwise dark room.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Unlike the lower floors of the tower, this level was built with no dividing walls connected to the outer shell, so archers can move easily around the tower's perimeter.  Also, counting reveals that each of the tower's walls visible from here are pierced by ten arrow slits.  A steel-sheathed trapdoor, hinged along the side of the opening where the stairway comes up from the second floor, can be closed to isolate this level from access below and to provide solid footing for the arrow slits above the stairs.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower]
description: Unwilling to disrupt the symmetrical spacing of the arrow slits along the tower's west wall just to provide access to the tower's roof, the builders constructed a narrow, freestanding set of steps that rise from near the wall of the inner chamber and end little more than a pace from the outer wall.  Empty quarrel bins and an empty barrel, of a size to hold cloth yard shafts, are lined up along the wall between the arrow slits.

title: [Outlands Manor, Tower Roof]
description: A battlemented rampart rings the slate-shingled pyramid of the tower's roof.  From here the dilapidated manor house stands a stone's throw to the south, and the diminutive ruins of the village cover the gentle slope of the hillside to the southwest.  The hills to the north grow into foothills before the snow-capped bulk of mountains farther north, while to the east lie the hills and river valleys of the borderlands.  South of here, the manor's hill descends into the rolling prairie common to the outlands.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, The Row]
description: A sprawling building built of rough-cut logs, chinked with mud, and roofed with red tiles stands half-buried beneath the ground here.  The peak of the roof rises to waist level, and a wide timber stairway set into the turf descends to an equally wide doorway.  A wooden sign depicting a cluster of barrels, crates, and grainsacks hangs above the door.

title: [Caravansary Chandler's Shop]
description: Freestanding shelves, stacked barrels and piles of dry goods all arranged in rows divide the shop into a half dozen aisles where caravaners, adventurers and guildsfolk browse.  A Dark Elven woman whose build resembles more that of an overgrown Halfling than any kind of Elf waits on customers at a counter along the back wall.

title: [Vornavis Caravansary, The Row]
description: A large skin-covered wagon stands here with a short set of wooden stairs leading up to its door.  It appears that the wagon has been here for some time, since morning-glories completely hide the wheels beneath a shroud of blossoms and greenery.

title: [Herbalist's Wagon]
description: Large, circular windows filled with a myriad of tiny, leaded panes flood this wagon with moonlight.  The potted plants, perched on anything resembling a flat surface, appear to thrive here.  Only a small space on the counter is kept clear for the transaction of business.

Large, circular windows filled with a myriad of tiny, leaded panes flood this wagon with sunlight.  The potted plants, perched on anything resembling a flat surface, appear to thrive here.  Only a small space on the counter is kept clear for the transaction of business.

title: [Mercantylers' Guild Hall]
description: A large, arched doorway framed in polished monir leads to the interior of the guildhall.  To one side a staircase with an ebony-and-brass banister leads up to the second floor.  An elegantly painted sign resembling a brilliant cut ruby the size of a melon hangs above the foot of the stairs.  A small notice is posted next to the stairs.

title: [Mercantylers' Hall, Landing]
description: The ebony-and-brass banister from the staircase changes to an ebon railing that follows the plaster walls of this small landing.  The railing ends at a plain ebon doorway adorned with a sign carved to resemble a faceted gem.  A small dark hallway leads to the south.

title: [Captain's Rest, Landing]
description: The well-worn oaken stairs open out to a green carpeted hall leading to rooms to the east and west.  A spiral staircase continues up toward the roof.  The sound of conversation from the common room downstairs drifts up the stairs.

title: [Captain's Rest, Garret]
description: Two small round windows streaked on the outside with dried salt shed dim light on a spiral staircase leading down into the Rest.  A small bird's nest sits up in the rafters.  A weathered haon door leads out to the Captain's Walk.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: Several small boxes have been turned on end here and placed around a slightly taller box.  This appears to be where some warehouse workers take their lunch, or maybe play an occasional game of cards.  The boxes have been pushed aside clearing paths east and south.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the south and east.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Main Hall]
description: Royal blue wall hangings and marble sheathed walls lend an air of elegance to the main hall of the Inn.  Black, white, and rose marble is placed in an elaborate pattern covering the floor.  Several vultite inlaid modwir tables are ranged around the edge of the room, each with a pair of heavy carved modwir chairs in attendance.  The centerpiece of the room is an immense crystal and candle chandelier, which sends sparks of soft light throughout the room.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Brass sconces on either wall light this red carpeted hall.  An incredibly ugly vase sits on a table along the north wall.  Upon the south wall is a hanging depicting the founding of Solhaven.  A wide marble staircase leads to the lower floor of the inn.

title: [Kahlyr's Precious Gems]
description: Everything in this small shop gleams softly in the candlelight flickering from a crystal chandelier hanging overhead.  A row of glaes-paned cases lines one wall, the first holding a collection of gems and the second displaying a diamond necklet.  A carved wooden counter rests opposite.  A carpeted stairway leads up to the second floor of the shop.

title: [Kahlyr's Precious Gems]
description: A pure white snowflake against a jet black background covers the floor within the semicircle formed by the three display cases in this upper chamber.  The central display case is flanked on the right and left by two glaes-paned display cases that enclose the room.  The tight woolen pile of the carpet absorbs the sound of footsteps and creates a sense of inherent luxury.  A carpeted stairway leads down to the first floor.

title: [Onion Dome Chamber]
description: The flaring curves of five vertical fel beams give this chamber its shape -- tapering to meet overhead in a sky-reaching point.  A myriad of horizontal fel boards has been expertly fitted to the beams and sanded to give the dome its smooth outer skin.  Radiating outward to each of the five beams, a spiderweb of brass wire is inlaid in the fel floorboards of the chamber.  At the center of the pattern, a polished blue sphere rests atop a rune-engraved brass column inlaid with a tiny plinite chip.

A myriad of horizontal fel boards has been expertly fitted to the beams and sanded to give the dome its smooth outer skin.  Radiating outward to each of the five beams, a spiderweb of brass wire is inlaid in the fel floorboards of the chamber.  At the center of the pattern, a polished blue sphere rests atop a rune-engraved brass column.

title: [Darbo Phoop's Arcane Outfitters]
description: A scattering of arcane symbols, worked in polished brass, are inlaid in the blue granite floor.  A few of the sigils even gleam from the stair treads and risers that circle upward to the floor above.  Opposite the stairway,  a midnight blue tapestry stitched with gold astrological diagrams forms a backdrop for a glaes-paned display case and a dark maoral counter.  Cracked plaster walls peek between the wall hangings.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Waterfall Quarry]
description: An underground river runs through this natural cavern, which has been enlarged and beautified by the stonecutters' work.  The water enters near the ceiling and cascades down a rippled ramp.  Reforming into a rushing stream, the water runs back and forth across the room in a series of channels cut deep into the stone until it crashes against a black marble wall, throwing up a tremendous mist.  The water collects in a large pool at the base of this wall.

title: [Mraent Cavern, Gneiss Tunnel]
description: Some wide stairs lead from the granite quarry above into a layer of gneiss.  Thick, wavy bands of color characterize this stone, which has been formed by the extreme pressure exerted on granite during the formation of the mountain range.

title: [Timmorain Road]
description: Massive oaks, maples and sycamores line the cobblestone road, and their branches cross overhead.  The sunlight filters through the leafy canopy to dapple the road with intermittent bright and dark patches.  A brisk wind rustles the trees' upper leaves, but nearer the road the foliage softens the gusts, turning them into a warm, gentle breeze.

Massive oaks, maples and sycamores line the cobblestone road, and their branches cross overhead.  The moonlight filters through the leafy canopy to dapple the road with intermittent bright and dark patches.  A brisk wind rustles the trees' upper leaves, but nearer the road the foliage softens the gusts, turning them into a cool, gentle breeze.

title: [Neartofar Forest]
description: A steep gully leads down from the road, its banks lined with gravel to prevent erosion during the sudden rainstorms that sometimes drench both forest and road.  At the foot of the gully, a trail leads off between some scrub oak trees and honeysuckle vines that have reclaimed some of the land cleared by the road builders.

title: [Glaise Cnoc, Cemetery]
description: The entrance to a crypt stands where four paths converge, creating a crossroads.  The entrance to the crypt is made of granite blocks and only the granite steps leading down are visible.  The crossroads in the path appear to mark the center of the old cemetery.

The entrance to a crypt stands where four paths converge, creating a crossroads.  The entrance to the crypt is made of granite blocks and only the granite steps leading down are visible in the darkness.  The crossroads in the path appear to mark the center of the old cemetery.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Catacomb, Entrance]
description: Flickering torches on the walls light the entrance of the catacombs.  Several chairs provide seating in what seems to serve as a waiting room.  Arches flank both sides of this room and a hallway extends to the north.

title: [Stone Turret, Ground Floor]
description: The cool, stony darkness of this circular room is pierced by a shaft of sunlight coming through the open doorway.  A thick carpet softens the footsteps of the well-heeled gentry who stop to chat with the staff seated at a long table before ascending a twisting stone staircase.

A dozen tiny lamps, flickering in the draft coming through the open doorway, light this stone-walled, circular room.  A thick carpet softens the footsteps of the well-heeled gentry who stop to chat with the staff seated at a long table before ascending a twisting stone staircase.

title: [Stone Turret, Waiting Room]
description: Dozens of comfortable leather chairs have been gathered into informal seating areas around this circular room, with nearby oil lamps casting a warm glow.  To one side of a twisting stone staircase leading down stands a curving brass and onyx counter.

title: [Catacombs, Chute]
description: In the center of the room sits a huge boulder.  In the far corner and missing several rungs, an old rickety ladder leans against the wall.  Only the portion that is eye-level is visible as the rest of it ascends upwards into total darkness.

In the center of the room sits a huge boulder.  Tattered and torn clothing rests among some white ashes and sticks, which protrude from beneath the rock.  Closer inspection reveals them to be a skeleton, which is turning to dust.  In the far corner and missing several rungs, an old rickety ladder leans against the wall.  Only the portion that is eye-level is visible as the rest of it ascends upwards into total darkness.

title: [Catacombs, Cavern]
description: A slight breeze stirs the silken-threads of a monstrous cobweb, which almost entirely hides the eastern wall.

A slight breeze stirs the silken-threads of a monstrous cobweb, which almost entirely hides the eastern wall.  From a niche directly above what serves as a dining table for the denizens, eerily red glowing eyes shine brightly.  Piles of shredded clothing, helmets and other items lie in the corner.

title: [Rambling Meadows, Hilltop]
description: A vacant and dust-strewn yard surrounds the burnt foundation of an old farmhouse, its earthen expanse quickly dwindling under the onslaught of rugged grass.  A few scorched wooden steps provide access to the open interior of the ruin.

A vacant and dust-strewn yard surrounds the burnt foundation of an old farmhouse, its earthen expanse quickly dwindling under the onslaught of rugged grass.  The outer walls and roof of the house have long since vanished, victims of the fire that gutted the structure or of the elements which have ravaged it in recent years.  A few scorched wooden steps provide access to the open interior of the ruin.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Rambling Meadows, Farmhouse]
description: Covered with a thin crust of dirt, the wooden foundation of the ruined farmhouse is cracked and splintered in numerous places, leaving dangerous holes scattered across the flooring.  A few partially standing interior walls and burnt timbers help to separate the remaining rooms in the house, while the entirely missing roof allows for an unobstructed view of the dark night sky.  Nearby, the remnants of a woven mat have been pressed into the cracked foundation, trapping the tattered material.

A few partially standing interior walls and burnt timbers help to separate the remaining rooms in the house, while the entirely missing roof allows for an unobstructed view of the hazy sky.  Nearby, the remnants of a woven mat have been pressed into the cracked foundation, trapping the tattered material.

title: [Labyrinth, The Forge]
description: The hall ends at an elaborately carved doorway that leads into a dark, open room.  A pair of stone pedestals rests on either side of the doorway, each supporting a bronzed soldier statue.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Labyrinth, The Dark Altar]
description: The tunnel opens into a large, open room.  Carpet remnants line the floor, stretching into separate tunnels as they split into different directions.  Bronze statues depicting large, cloaked priests rest between each path.

title: [Grey Wind Manor, Front Steps]
description: Tendrils of silver mist snake across the landscape in undulating waves, obscuring the ground.  Appearing out of the massive growth of the garden is a large manor, its windows warm with cool white light that shines through the shadows cast by the canopy of the trees that dwarf it.  There is an otherworldly quality to the light of the garden; with its lack of direct moon- or sunlight, one is left to question if it is even they which illuminate this green and mist-filled world.

Tendrils of silver mist snake across the landscape in undulating waves, obscuring the ground.  Appearing out of the massive growth of the garden is a large manor, painted the colors of an overcast sky, and permanently shadowed by the canopy of the trees that dwarf it.  There is an otherworldly quality to the light of the garden, with its lack of direct sunlight -- if it is even the sun that illuminates this green and mist-filled world.

title: [Grey Wind Manor, Porch]
description: Shadows drip from the eaves, and a light coating of mist covers the floorboards of the porch.  The manor sports no visible windows, just a massive set of double doors of engraved ebon oak.

title: [Wizard Guild, Study Room]
description: Set within the southwestern tower, the rounded walls of this spacious study are obscured by several tapestries.  The large banners depict images of wizards clad in grandiose garb casting several spells of a classical elemental nature.  The soft sounds of the tapestries fluttering and the occasional quiet shuffling sounds of a student's feet mingle with each other, creating a peaceful background for contemplation.  A few chairs and tables stand scattered throughout the room.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway SW]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door.  Spaced out along the walls are iron sconces that hold glowing torches that provides more than enough light to see by without any visible flame.  An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

The narrow stairs wind their way up the tower far higher than one would expect only to end at an iron-bound door at the top.  Light streams in from the narrow windows that ring the tower at evenly spaced intervals.

An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

title: [Wizard Guild, Private Room]
description: A brass candelabra and small fireplace light up the small comfortable room.  A few comfortable chairs and a small sofa are arranged to catch the warmth of the fire that dispels the night chill.  Except for quill and ink, there is only a brass lamp upon an otherwise immaculate desk.  The floor is covered with plush carpets and the walls with rich tapestries.

The small comfortable room has a few comfortable padded chairs and a small sofa arranged near a fireplace.  Except for quill and ink there is only a single large volume on an otherwise immaculate desk.  The floor is covered in plush carpets and the walls with rich tapestries.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway SE]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door. title: [Wizard Guild, Study Room]
description: Dark modwir tables gleam softly in the pale blue light cast by several small crystalline orbs set in the center of the tables.  A quiet thrumming sound is heard every few moments from the dark spheres as they occasionally dim and then glow stronger.  The subtle, rhythmically-shifting illumination provides a peaceful atmosphere for relaxing study.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway NW]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door.  Spaced out along the walls are bronze sconces that hold glowing torches that provides more than enough light to see by without any visible flame.  An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.
