title: [Wizard Guild, Study Room]
description: The first floor of the northeast tower is a spacious study, yet small for a single room in a tower of this size.  A large slab of black slate has been framed in oak and fastened to the wall and used to display symbols and runes.  A few well worn tables and chairs are scattered about the room and some steep stairs spiral high up into the tower.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stairway NE]
description: The narrow stairs wind their way up into the dark tower far higher than one would expect, only to dead end at the top with a door.  Spaced out along the walls are eonake sconces that hold glowing torches that provides more than enough light to see by without any visible flame.  An occasional cool night breeze sneaks through the few open narrow windows.

The narrow stairs wind their way up the tower far higher than one would expect only to end at a door at the top.  Light streams in from the narrow windows that ring the tower at evenly spaced intervals.

title: [Henty's Depot, Ceilings]
description: A massive ramp runs along side some stairs connecting the first and second floors of the building.  Stacks of sealed crates have been marked with red paint, gathering dust while awaiting transport up the ramp.  Beside an open window with a clear view of the street, a varnished maple stand holds a thick tome listing the store inventory.

title: [Henty's Depot, Warehouse]
description: A massive ramp leads down from a large opening adjacent to some stairs.  Numerous papers have been affixed to a nearby bulletin board labeled, "Inventory."  A series of pulleys and ropes line the ceiling of the passage, in order to securely move cargo between floors.

title: [Smokey Cave, Cavern]
description: The floor of this small cavern dips at the center to form a small basin.  The black grit that seems to cover everything has collected in the depression.  The thick collection of grit moves in waves when it is disturbed, almost as if it were a liquid.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: A faint, greenish light fills this cavern.  You notice that the light stems from the lichen-covered walls.  In spaces between the lichen, flow a few grainy rivulets.  The ground is covered with heaps of dark grit, which makes walking rather difficult.  A jagged crevice can be seen in the shadows.

title: [Blackened Cave, Cavern]
description: In the darkness you can barely make out an old tree trunk propped up against a ledge.  Someone has gone to great trouble to drag the trunk in here and hoist it against the ledge.  If safety awaits up there, it was bought with a lot of sweat.

title: [Blackened Cave, Ledge]
description: This ledge might not be very large, but a modicum of safety certainly outweighs any inconvenience.  There is evidence that someone has tried to enlarge the ledge by chipping at the walls.  Pieces of rock are strewn all about.  An old tree trunk leans against the lip of the ledge.

title: [Lysierian Hills, Forest Trail]
description: The trail here used to split in three directions, but a rockfall blocks what was the southeast path; there appears to be no way around it.  A large boulder standing just west of the fork in the trail looks somewhat like a large hand pointing a single finger at the southwest leg of the trail.

title: [Abandoned Trail]
description: Overgrown almost to the point of non-existence, a continuing gap between the trees to the southeast seems wide enough for wagons to have passed that way some years ago.  To the northwest a rockfall blocks what must have been the route in that direction.

title: [Gryphon Holding]
description: Marsh grasses and bracken almost hide a half dozen wooden gravemarkers on this slope of the hillock.  The stone tower looms at the top of the rise, but to the south the slope of the hillock appears less steep.

title: [Gryphon Holding]
description: The stone tower rises above the surrounding marsh, narrow window slits and a battlement about the gabled roof giving it an almost sinister appearance.  To the north, east, and west, the slope of the hillock descends sharply and is quickly lost beneath the reeds and cattails.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Great Hall]
description: This cathedral-sized room, the heart of the castle, extends up at least three-stories tall.  Two rows of stone piers march down its length, each with an elaborately carved capital.  The huge beams supporting the ceiling rest on the tops of the piers.  Doors are visible on the hall's southern expanse, but are curiously walled up with stone.  On the room's western wall, an impressive flight of stairs leads to other rooms in that wing.  At the opposite end, discrete stairs lead into the flanking tower.

This cathedral-sized room, the heart of the castle, extends up at least three-stories tall.  Two rows of stone piers march down its length, each with an elaborately carved capital.  The huge beams supporting the ceiling rest on the tops of the piers.  Doors are visible on the hall's southern expanse, but are curiously walled up with stone.  On the room's western wall, an impressive flight of stairs leads to other rooms in that wing.  At the opposite end, discreet stairs lead into the flanking tower.

title: [Anwyn Castle, East Tower]
description: This circular chamber is littered with the broken bones of its former furnishings.  No big surprise there.  One thing is distinctive though -- the stench here could knock an orc on its back.  That and the cold.  Every breath exhaled here frosts the air into a white fog.  No wind is stealing in to account for it, a fierce, dead cold that permeates the warmest garment.  A staircase winds up to the floor above.

title: [Tower Chamber]
description: Cold inhabits the chamber as if it were bred here.  Across the floor, debris and dust mark uninhabited time as well as a clock, sifting into the room's corners in gentle drifts.  The odor of decay hangs over the emptiness with its secretive nuances, speaking a subtle language universal to all lands.

title: [Turret]
description: The turret is dark and empty -- at first glance.  Then one after another, and then another winged shape swoops past your line of vision.  A look at the ceiling reveals the whole of it is covered by a vast complex of hornet nests.  Their papery convolutions curve around the roof's beams like a blanket, folding out here and there into incredible blossoms of living chambers.  Busy winged workers labor across the surface of the monstrous construction.  The staircase leading down looks exceedingly inviting.

title: [Tower Chamber]
description: This circular room was probably once living quarters.  Now however, it's in a shambles, with broken pieces of furnishings cluttering the floor.  The remains of heavy draperies -- now tattered -- hang from the towering windows, like shrouds hanging off of a graveyard mummy.  A cold wind blows through, making the strips flutter hopelessly in the half-light.  A hazardous-looking staircase winds up to the floor above.

title: [Turret]
description: A narrow staircase ends here in the tower's summit.  Large shapes, crates and boxes that miraculously survived time lurk against sloping walls that form an arch overhead.  Little sounds in the shadows give evidence of mice scurrying about.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Hall]
description: This hall is in a decrepit condition.  Large holes deface its exterior walls, granting a glimpse of one of the eastern towers.  The doorway leading to the inner yard is doorless and bereft of its ornamental carving.  The entrance to a residential chamber opens to the west, while a hall to the southwest grants entry into a corner tower.  To the northeast, the hall veers, making it difficult to tell what lies in that direction.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southwest, west

title: [Archer's Gallery]
description: This spare hallway, running along the castle's front, has no decoration -- only rough, stone walls broken by narrow windows, where bowmen once stood to shoot down at enemies.  Patches of moonlight dapple the rough flagstones of a floor that time has canted into a downward slant.  The passage opens onto a wall-walk at its east end.

This spare hallway, running along the castle's front, has no decoration -- only rough, stone walls broken by narrow windows, where bowmen once stood to shoot down at enemies.  Patches of light dapple the rough flagstones of a floor that time has canted into a downward slant.  The passage opens onto a wall-walk at its east end.

title: [Anwyn Castle, Hall]
description: The castle's buttery opens off of this hall's southern end.  To the north, the hall continues, where the main stair into Anwyn's Great Hall can be seen.  The windows here are tall and furnished with the facing window seats pervasive throughout the place.  A hall to the southeast grants entry into one of the octagonal corner towers, and some narrow stairs curve up out of sight.  A wooden doorway stands open to the inner yard, admitting a chilly breeze.

title: [Gatehouse Wall-walk]
description: This walk, crossing the battlements protecting the gate, gives a shielded vista of the castle yard.  It also offers an exceptional view of the surrounding countryside outside the castle environs.  The cold waters of Lough Ne'halin encompass the fortress's feet like a steel-gray carpet.  To the west, a dark forest approaches the lake's edge and stretches inviolately to the horizon.  On the wall's east end, narrow stairs lead down into the castle buildings.

title: [Dim Recess]
description: This small closet of a room is dank and redolent with the heavy odor of the spirit-saturated, wooden casks.  On the back wall, almost obscured by darkness, stone steps lead down into the guts of the ancient keep.

title: [Stone Ledge]
description: The treacherous stairs have widened into a landing, yielding an opportunity to ponder the strange, underground tower that extends into the darkness beyond the crumbling edge of the parapet.  The stairs are cut into the stone walls and have no rail to guard against falling.  They follow the round walls, spiraling down into the depths.

title: [Mountain Trail]
description: The trail runs northeast and southwest here.  A large pile of rocks and small boulders from an old avalanche forms a rocky slope to the southeast.  The slope levels off a little above the trail that you are on and looks to be an easy climb.

title: [Mountain Trail]
description: This spot is at the crest of an old rockslide, a few stray rocks still littering the ground.  It seems that they have been arranged into a definite pattern, though its meaning eludes you.  The rocky slope of the avalanche leads down to the northwest.  A trail leads upwards to a small plateau to the southeast.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Dark Tower]
description: Cobwebs of immense size hang from the rafters, and a musky smell wafts up from the rotting wood floor.  A charred glaes orb lies in a dark corner, emanating a sickly faint glow.  Entranced by its power, you still hesitate to touch it, feeling a definite evil presence.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Tower Cellar]
description: An eerie pall of silence falls over this dark chamber filled with an array of torturous devices.  Battered shackles dangle from loops on the walls, and dried patches of blood stain the packed dirt floor.  Behind an imposing iron table, you see a rough-edged hole carved into the wall.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Ledge]
description: At the base of a rocky ravine, this narrow ledge is eroded from the side of the mountain.  The wind blows fiercely down from above, threatening to sweep you along with it.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Overlook]
description: A chill runs down your spine as the clouds part to reveal Darkstone in all its evil glory.  Even from this distance, the foreboding sight brings a shudder deep in your bones and a sense of dread to your heart.  A path leads down to the valley below, but is barred by immovable rubble.

title: [Upper Dragonsclaw, Ledge]
description: The ledge melds back into the side of the mountain here.  Sparse clumps of weeds cling to the mountainside, nearly buried amongst the rubble left from a long dormant landslide.  Peering off through the clouds, you can barely make out the spires of a sinister-looking castle.

title: [Ocoma Vale]
description: A rugged trail leads away from the landslide in front of you, passing through a thicket of bushes and short pines.  Crossing the landslide appears treacherous, and several boulders teeter precariously on the mountainside above, seeming to taunt those who would dare the climb.

title: [Badlands, Ravine]
description: The ravine ends in a sheer wall of crumbling shale.  The slightest movement sends showers of rock cascading down to the floor of the ravine below.  A few tiny yellow flowers have sprung up on a ledge nearby, bringing some color to this otherwise dismal land.

The ravine ends in a sheer wall of crumbling shale.  The slightest movement sends showers of rock cascading down to the floor of the ravine below.  A few tiny flowers, pale yellow in the moonlight, have sprung up on a ledge nearby, bringing some color to this otherwise dismal land.

title: [Badlands, Hillock]
description: The hilltop, frequently blasted by cold winds and chill rain, is barren of all but the toughest shrubs.  A warren of canyons twists between the forlorn hills in every direction.  On the next hillock to the southeast, you spy a huge humanoid figure.  It slumps motionless, perhaps a fearsome giant contemplating the wastelands.

The hilltop, frequently blasted by cold winds and chill rain, is barren of all but the toughest shrubs.  A warren of canyons twists between the forlorn hills in every direction.  On the next hillock to the southeast, you spy a huge humanoid figure which blots out the stars.  It slumps motionless, perhaps a fearsome giant contemplating the wastelands.

title: [Badlands, Hillock]
description: Atop a lonely hill sits a massive granite figure.  The great stone colossus sits astride the tumbled rocks of the mount like a king enthroned.  His reign has been a tragic one, and both feet, as well as his left arm, have long since crumbled away.  He sternly surveys the lands to the south, no doubt contemplating how to regain the lost glory of his dominion.

Atop a lonely hill sits a massive granite figure, his brow limned in moonlight.  The great stone colossus sits astride the tumbled rocks of the mount like a king enthroned.  His reign has been a tragic one, and both feet, as well as his left arm, have long since crumbled away.  He sternly surveys the lands to the south, no doubt contemplating how to regain the lost glory of his dominion.

title: [Colossus, Knees]
description: The knees of the giant are fused into a single smooth mass, unlike the pitted shins of the stone legs below.  A pair of great stone thighs stretches over to the bulk of the torso.  The stone is deathly cold, even through booted feet.

title: [Colossus, Lap]
description: A great puffed chest looms above you.  To one side, the bicep of a vast stone arm bulges, the forearm forming a railing and a windbreak as it melds with the stone of the lap.  The other arm is lost at the shoulder.

title: [Colossus, Right Shoulder]
description: On the windward side, the shoulder, face, and head of the giant statue are worn smooth.  The almost obliterated features appear childlike in their smoothness, but a majestic beard sprawls across the great chest, a forest of hewn stalactites hanging down from a noble chin.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Entry]
description: A large rug woven in shades of light and dark green protects the floor in front of the door, looking comforting to tired feet.  Light from several candelabras plays over the golden grain of a polished wood desk, illuminating the neat stack of papers and ledgers necessary to keep an inn running smoothly.  The hall stretches north, flanked on the east by a curved wooden stair, and on the immediate west by a curtain of rich green brocade.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Bright brass candle holders line the walls.  They are filled with sweet-smelling beeswax candles, shedding light and a comforting warmth down the corridor.  A runner of forest green carpet covers the length of the hall's floor, leading the way to the guest room doors and a good night's sleep.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Pictures hang from the walls along this long corridor.  Portraits of important guests who once stayed in the inn, landscapes, and a wedding portrait of the proprietors while they still lived liven up the wood paneling between the guest room doors.  A simple wooden stair a little to the west marks the end of the hallway.

title: [Abandoned Inn, Attic]
description: Obvious effort has been expended to make this attic space respectable and neat.  No boxes or other storage containers clutter the corners, and the floor speaks of a recent soaping.  Brightly burning candles sit in polished sconces on either side of the door to the north.  Little crystals dangle from the holders, as if attempting to catch a casual observer's attention.

title: [Under Crypt, Tunnels]
description: This area looks like a ghoul's larder.  Bodies and parts of bodies lie buried in ice that was scraped off the walls and ceiling then covered with layers of the gruesome pink icicles.  Not a pretty sight.  In one corner of the room you see some roughly carved stairs leading upwards.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Under Crypt, Ice Room]
description: This room is dominated by a giant slab of ice.  There is a chill here that transcends the cold you felt elsewhere.  Piled in front of the ice slab are the remains of many a grisly sacrifice.  Bones and skulls lie piled at the base of the slab as though in homage to something.  Your curiosity piqued, you draw close to the slab.  Dimly within you can make out a richly robed figure.  On one side of the room are some roughly carved stairs.

title: [Dark Grotto, Huge Cavern]
description: A broad stair of gigantic proportion has been carved into the face of the north wall of the huge cavern.  The gargantuan stairway trails upward, out of sight, following the wall of the cavern to the east.  The unnatural flora of the cavern ends abruptly at the edge of the stone platform that forms the landing of the great stairway.  The huge cavern that stretches out to the south is an eerie, other-worldly vista, filled with tall spires of stone and growths of giant mushrooms and huge fans of lichen.

title: [Dark Grotto, Long Stairway]
description: The gargantuan stairway rises from the landing here, reaching up along the wall of the cavern farther than you can see.  The stair is a marvel, an engineering feat of unparalleled proportions.  The broad steps are more than twenty feet wide, some seven or eight feet deep, and about three feet high.

title: [Catacombs, Twisting Tunnels]
description: A cave-in some time in the distant past must have sealed off the western extension of the manmade tunnel here.  Pristinely clear water cascades in waves over the heap of rubble left in the wake of the collapse, forming a limpid pool at its base.  Overflow from the pool runs off eastward down the center of the floor along a time-worn channel.

title: [Catacombs, Muddy Bend]
description: Dirt and rock, held together by stout, ancient tree roots, are all that is left of the walls here.  An old cave-in reduced the original tunnel to a mass of jumbled rubble beneath you.  Mud and loose stones line the sides of the passage, and the earthen roof is just high enough for you to stand up.  A thin trickle of glassy water flows eastward and down the rubble pile, from a large chamber just to the north.

title: [Catacombs, Beneath a Well]
description: The columnar stone shaft of an old well punctures the vaulted ceiling above and extends about halfway to the ground.  Directly beneath is the glassy surface of a spring-fed lake of unsurpassed crystalline beauty.  Diffuse light refracts off the lake and casts multihued reflections on the walls, as though filtered through a thousand tiny prisms of Elven devising.  The scene is so enchanting, you almost forget the harsh, muffled sounds echoing down the well.

title: [Town Well]
description: The old well is made of flat stones built up around a circular opening.  A slate roof overhangs the opening, keeping the drinking water clear and refreshing.  Several skin water buckets, with long ropes attached, are scattered on the hard-packed earth surrounding the well.

title: [Sailor's Haven, Outside Rear]
description: A small patch of sand lies between the building and the cliff face.  Green and brown scrubby bushes have gained a foothold here and salt grass flourishes in rank tufts.  A badly corroded iron ladder clings to the wall and leads to the roof.

title: [Sailor's Haven, Roof]
description: The low flat roof is made from large slabs of locally quarried slate and is still sound after years of neglect.  The dark blue-grey surface crunches underfoot with an accumulation of salt crystals blown here by the wind.  A low railing still stands along the seaward edge of the roof.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Bones of animals and odd bits and pieces of litter are scattered about this area.  Leading up to a small opening in the hillside stands a crude ladder.

title: [Littered Ledge]
description: This narrow ledge is covered with garbage and trash of nearly every shape, size and description imaginable.  You recognize the craftsmanship of most of the known races of Elanthia in the broken shards of pottery, the rusting and useless weaponry and the faded scraps of cloth.  Extending to the floor of the valley below is a crude ladder while to the north can be seen the darkened entrance to a large cave.

title: [Cave, Ledge]
description: This narrow ledge is at least twenty feet above the floor of the high ceilinged room.  From here you have a good view of the room itself and the jumble of stones that provide access to the floor below.

title: [Cave, Vaulted Chamber]
description: A narrow ledge is perched high on the north wall of this vaulted chamber.  Several large rocks have been moved from other parts of the room and now rest in a jumble directly beneath the ledge.

title: [Watchtower, Foyer]
description: Crafted entirely of limestone, this vaulted room is adorned with pennants and banners depicting the allies of Solhaven as well as the H.E.R.T. coat of arms.  Deep blue rolton wool rugs stretch the expanse of the oak floor and provide a cushion for the room's centerpiece, a replica of the Sea Wolf.  Beneath the supports of a circular staircase are some wide double doors leading to the courtyard beyond, while a crest-adorned oak door leads to the streets.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Watchtower, Commons]
description: Various benches are set about the room, their expanses covered with repair and polish kits, while curved chairs sport neatly folded woolen blankets in a shade of royal blue.  Standing at opposite ends of the room are two nearly identical doors, differing only in the grain of wood of which each is fashioned.  Set at a safe distance from a downward spiraling staircase is a slender ladder bound to the smooth limestone wall, which leads to an ironbound trapdoor set into the ceiling.

title: [Museum of Weapons and Armor]
description: Heavy blue watered silk tapestries embroidered with a scattering of silver-threaded crescent moons and stars decorate the walls and block the windows.  Rectangular displays enclosed with glass holds a variety of edged weapons.  Along the back wall, an assortment of throwing weapons dangle from an old throwing net.  Several handblown glass lanterns are deliberately positioned on tall metal poles designed to provide sufficient lighting for viewing the various exhibits.

title: [Museum, Balcony]
description: Standing near the railing, the entire ground level of the showroom can be viewed from this vantage point of the gallery.  A wide curving staircase leads back down to the main floor.  Emanating from the iridescent, domed skylight above, pale moonlight creates a rainbow of cascading colors.  Streaks of colors rain down over an antique thanot wood cabinet containing a few brawling weapons set securely behind heavy, etched glass doors.

Standing near the railing, the entire ground level of the showroom can be viewed from this vantage point of the gallery.  A wide curving staircase leads back down to the main floor.  Emanating from the iridescent, domed skylight above, golden sunlight creates a rainbow of cascading colors.  Streaks of colors rain down over an antique thanot wood cabinet containing a few brawling weapons set securely behind heavy, etched glass doors.

title: [Museum of Weapons and Armor]
description: A bronze replica of a forge, complete with hammer, tongs, and a blacksmith, resides along the back wall.  Supported by metal brackets in the ceiling, an intricately designed, fringed banner drapes down above the forge, and billows softly from a barely palpable breeze.  Hanging on the three remaining walls from sturdy wooden pegs, shiny metal bolts, and some thick metal rivets is a vast assortment of shields, polearms, and two-handed weapons, and protected behind thin sheets of glaes.  Brass flowerpots flank the sides of a wide staircase.

title: [Museum, Balcony]
description: Interrupted by the staircase, a wrought iron railing runs the entire length on the upper level of the gallery.  The sullen glow of the moon creates a rainbow of cascading colors, as it peeks through the iridescent domed skylight above.  An amazing collection of masks and armets hang on metal pegs that protrude from the walls.

Interrupted by the staircase, a wrought iron railing runs the entire length on the upper level of the gallery.  The brilliant glare of the sun creates a rainbow of cascading colors, as it shines through the iridescent domed skylight above.  An amazing collection of masks and armets hang on metal pegs that protrude from the walls.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rockslide]
description: Small rocks skip down the wall, making a clattering noise for several moments before finding a place to rest.  The remaining wall appears highly unstable and the source for the majority of rubble that comprises the rockslide.  Not far above, the rim of the canyon is visible against the silvery night sky.  Sloping steeply and containing many loose and jagged rocks, the wall beyond this point appears to be an impossible climb.

Small rocks skip down the wall, making a clattering noise for several moments before finding a place to rest.  The remaining wall appears highly unstable and the source for the majority of rubble that comprises the rockslide.  Not far above, the rim of the canyon is visible against the blue sky.  Sloping steeply and containing many loose and jagged rocks, the wall beyond this point appears to be an extremely dangerous climb.

title: [Krag, Twin Canyon Rim]
description: The silvery sky illuminates the slope of The Krag as a chilling wind blows down the valley formed by the eastern slope of Sentoph Mountain and the western slope of The Krag.  Below, a steeply sloped wall leads to the top of a rockslide at the southern end of the Twin Canyons, while to the southeast a trail climbs towards Krag's Peak which towers several thousand feet away.  Across the canyon Sentoph's peak reaches nearly as high into the night sky.

Bright sunlight counters the cold mountain air blowing through the valley formed by the eastern slope of Sentoph Mountain and the western slope of The Krag.  Below, a steeply sloped wall leads to the top of a rockslide at the southern end of the Twin Canyons, while to the southeast a trail climbs towards Krag's Peak which towers several thousand feet away.  Across the canyon, Sentoph's peak reaches nearly as high into the sky.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You are just below the ridge line of Upper Trollfang.  There are tall trees all around and the trail ends at a sheer wall that does not appear to have any handholds.

title: [Ridge Line]
description: You are grasped by the stiff sea breeze that makes its way along the crest of the ridge you are standing upon.  Sea gulls dance on the sky's waves, their cries from above warn that you approach their hidden nests in the rocks.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Grove]
description: The grove opens up enough to let in small beams of moonlight.  Dust drifts slowly through the rays, adding a touch of the fantastical.  Slightly to the northeast lies a giant boulder lightly covered with orange and red lichen.

The grove opens up enough to let in small beams of light.  Dust drifts slowly through the rays, adding a touch of the fantastical.  Slightly to the northeast lies a giant boulder lightly covered with orange and red lichen.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Boulder]
description: Though mostly bare, the granite boulder is splotched with mottled orange and red lichen.  A natural hollow is centered on top of the rock, still damp from the remains of the last rainfall.

title: [Aillidh Brae, Vale]
description: An old rock slide has deposited its remains all across the valley floor.  Rocks of all sizes are strewn everywhere, making hiking quite difficult.  A crevice gapes like a jagged wound in the otherwise pristine hillside.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Crevice]
description: Loose rocks and soil make it hard to hike this crevice.  Small, thorny bushes cling desperately to the sandy soil, not making movement any easier at all.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ridge]
description: The mountain rises sharply to the east, affording some relief from the wind.  It looks like there's a small ledge a ways up the mountain, though only a mountain goat or a dwarf would enjoy the climb up to it.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ledge]
description: The ledge widens just enough to make it possible for a small group of adventurers to sit down and rest a bit.  The southern portion of the ledge is almost choked off by a couple of large rocks, but it is possible for the slim of waist to squeeze by them.

title: [Liath Bheinn, Ledge]
description: A small ledge is cut into the steep, west-facing mountainside.  The ledge is filled with rocks of all sizes, and more tumble down every so often.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Cliff]
description: Smooth granite makes getting a purchase difficult, though the climb up is decidedly easier than the steep mountainside that awaits below.  An eerie strain drifts down occasionally from the pass further up.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Outer Watch]
description: The meandering pathway runs up to a steep cliff thrice the height of man.  Loose rocks edging the cliff blur in the grey of dusky shadows.  A small crack can be discerned in the darkness.

title: [Dubh Brugh, Cavern]
description: A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of moonlight parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

A rough granite wall ends the cavern abruptly.  Small rivulets of water cascade down the wall, making its slippery surface glossy.  High above a ray of light parts the far darkness.  A dark hollow has been gouged out of the granite.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Peel Tower]
description: Rough granite walls encircle this large room.  Pieces of smashed furniture litter the floor, much of it covered in dust.  Occasional gusts of wind send minor whirlwinds twirling playfully through the area.  A narrow, curving stairway hugs the wall, leading to the floor above.  A broken doorway leads outside.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Peel Tower]
description: The top of the tower looks like it has been sheared off at an angle, leaving this area vulnerable to the often harsh climate.  A narrow, curving stairway hugs the wall, leading to the floor below.  Part of a large, oaken beam juts out from a small pile of rubble nearby.

title: [Clearing]
description: Pines ringing the clearing deepen the night's shadows, their boughs heavy with long, fragrant needles.  Although the trees stand back, seemingly respectful of the circle's perimeter, the invasive ferns have surrendered little ground.  They dance around the pines' feet, lacing among an embankment of boulders blanketing a rise that borders the clearing on one side.

title: [Crown of Boulders]
description: The large boulders jumbled about are mottled with delicate mosses.  Trillium grows here and there, offering tri-leafed stems crowned with snow-white blossoms.  Ferns resume their rampant play behind the edge of the granite outcrop, sprawling over and around the feet of a beautifully veined, black marble portal.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Erosion and time have formed a tall earthen cliff, the lake below still visible from this vantage.  Several crushed pieces of stone lie scattered about the ground, most no bigger than a pebble.

title: [Thanatoph Bowels, Cavern]
description: Unlike many of the earthen tunnels near this cavern that appear to be natural in origin, there is clear evidence that this well hidden area is man-made.  A pile of perfectly square stones has been neatly stacked along one wall, each of them placed with complete precision.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: The wind has scoured the rock clean on this side of the mountain.  Not a bush nor a tree nor a blade of grass mars the harsh nakedness of the stone.  The wind whips up small pockets of dust, depositing them in your eyes and ears and clothing.  Through the swirling dust, you glimpse a narrow trail cutting its way up the mountainside.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: Dust devils whirl about in the shrieking wind, whipping across the stones and through your clothing.  A treacherous path winds its way around the mountain and a steep trail heads up the mountainside, neither way looking particularly easy.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: A few greyish-brown shrubs cling to the cracks and crevices that pit the slope.  They must suck moisture from the fog that blankets this side of the mountain, since no spring or stream is in evidence.  A narrow ridge of stone winds its way up toward the mountaintop, losing itself in the grey mist within a few dozen yards.

title: [Upper Trollfang, Sentoph]
description: Up here on the peak of Sentoph, the crags soar like teeth into the sky.  A narrow, rocky ridge winds its way down the mountainside where it soon gets lost in the fog that covers the lower slopes.  Footing is uneven here, and you see no plant life anywhere.

title: [Temple, Hallway]
description: Stale air fills the hall.  The dust here is thick, breeding undisturbed by wind or being.  A narrow staircase, flanked by two empty torch sconces, leads up into darkness, while the hallway continues to the north.

title: [Temple, Dressing Area]
description: Glass from several shattered mirrors covers the floor, and it seems the bad luck from the broken looking glasses has spread throughout the room.  The polished wood vanities are scratched and dented, the silver hairbrushes tarnished and destroyed, and pieces of broken perfume bottles mix with the bits of mirror on the floor.  A narrow staircase descends to the ground floor, the candle sconces lighting it long gone.

title: [Temple, Closet]
description: Tattered bits of cloth litter the floor.  A twisted and mangled clothing rack lies discarded in the corner, and shelves have been half torn from their braces to hang precariously from the walls.  A rickety ladder leans in the corner, heading up through a trapdoor in the roof to what you presume is the attic.

title: [Temple, Attic]
description: The contents of several boxes have been scattered about the room.  Gold candlesticks, altarcloths, white robes, and other items litter the floor, thrown with obvious disregard to their symbolic worth.  A rickety ladder leads down through a trapdoor in the floor.

title: [Temple, Altar]
description: The old altar sits overlooking the sanctuary.  From here, the shadows seem deeper, the silence more ominous, as if the sonorous breathing of a majestic life had suddenly ceased, leaving you alone and afraid.  Set into the wall behind the altar is a massive glass window, not yet broken, although a creeping dark stain has spread over it, turning the colors an unwholesome red-black.  Some marble stairs lead down into darkness, providing an alternative to going back to the sanctuary itself.

title: [Temple, Crypt]
description: Not a breath of wind stirs the air here.  Faint light issues from the walls, the source unknown, illuminating rows of biers leading to the south.  Upon each bier rests a shrouded form, slim and delicate, a silver symbol clutched in dead hands upon each chest.  They seem to be priestesses of the order this temple is dedicated to, long passed on into time.  Some marble stairs lead upward from the crypt.

title: [A Guard Tower]
description: Large cut blocks of stone, mortared with a dry gray paste, climb high enough here to rise above the walls surrounding the town.  A wooden stair runs around the circumference of the tower and leads to an opening in the ceiling.  Daylight filters through the squat doorway leading out into the heart of the town.

Large cut blocks of stone, mortared with a dry gray paste, climb high enough here to rise above the walls surrounding the town.  A wooden stair runs around the circumference of the tower and leads to an opening in the ceiling.  Moonlight filters through the squat doorway leading out into the heart of the town.

title: [Observation Tower]
description: The stone walls are bare, save for a raised mural on the north facing wall, which depicts in great detail the surroundings of Wehnimer's Landing.  Resting on a dais mid-center of the tower, a hand-carved obsidian chair captures the eye.  Deep gouges mar the surface of one of the steps which leads up to the surface of the platform.

title: [Raging Thrak Inn, Front Desk]
description: A polished wooden desk sits to the side of the staircase, and bears the placard of the Thrak's proprietor.  At the top of the creaky wooden stairs are the establishment's guest rooms.

title: [Raging Thrak Inn, Hallway]
description: You can look down this hallway to the other end of the building.  Doorways lead right and left off it.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Garret]
description: A narrow passage winds through the attic among stacks of ancient crates and boxes.  An expansive but dusty window is set in the west end of the garret, looking out over the streets below, and an old velvet-upholstered sofa has been dragged out of storage for the residents to sit on and enjoy the view.

title: [Dragonsclaw Arms, Third Floor]
description: A small window provides a view of the nearby rooftops and the street below.  The slight breeze from the window causes the candle-flames to flicker, casting odd shadows on the painted walls. A narrow staircase leads up into the ceiling.

title: [Raging Thrak Inn, Hallway]
description: You can see more doors in either direction down the length of the hallway, but are prevented from continuing further north by a rope firmly tied across the hall.

title: [Raging Thrak Inn, Rooftop]
description: Dwarven loggers tirelessly haul crates of lumber along the cobblestone road below, moving along the street between the bathhouse and local bank.  The ancient oak tree of Town Square stretches up to the southeast.

title: [Temple, Monks' Room]
description: Several humble cots are arranged around this chamber, a dormitory for monks and clerics from outlying districts who come to visit town and its temple.  You see a rack hung with robes and bedrolls stowed atop it.  A stairway ascends to the southeast.

title: [Temple, Storeroom]
description: This seemingly abandoned storeroom is dusty and filled with cobwebs.  There appears to be nothing of material value here, yet a sense of power and otherworldliness fills the room.  Although there are no windows, all is suffused with a shimmering, shifting light.  A stairway leads down.

title: [West Bank, Dock Street]
description: The cobbled street extends along the riverbank, overlooking the continual traffic of merchant boats that pass to and fro.  Colorful sails and gaily painted cargo ships fill the river, and banners and flags in an equal variety of colors are hung from wooden poles along the road.  A set of weathered wooden stairs leads down to a bustling pier below.

title: [West Bank, Pier]
description: The wooden pier extends to the north, set on heavy stone pilings rooted in the riverbank.  Merchant barges are berthed along the pier, loading and unloading a variety of crates and barrels.  A group of gaily dressed workmen bustle around a large canvas tent, which seems to be in the process of being taken down or put up.

title: [Paupers, Dark Landing]
description: The air in this dark, cramped room is cool and musty.  Tattered cobwebs hang in the corners of the ceiling.  The narrow wooden stairs look rather rickety.

title: [Paupers, Spirits Cellar]
description: The smell of fermentation permeates this dusty sub-level of House Paupers.  Kegs of ale are stacked along the stone walls, forming a narrow aisle leading back to huge wine casks, some of which are as tall as a giantman.  Industrious spiders have constructed complex spiderwebs that hang from the rafters down to the casks of wine and kegs of ale.  Three glasses and several drained liquor bottles rest atop one of the kegs, suggesting a recent, spur-of-the-moment celebration.

title: [Rone Academy, Yard]
description: The grounds outside the Academy proper are filled with small groups of students clustered around instructors.  The buzz of animated discussion drifts through the air at all hours of the day.  An imposing set of marble steps rises up to the Academy entrance, polished smooth by the constant footsteps of journeymen and visitors.

title: [Academy, Front Porch]
description: A pair of towering dreamstone-studded doors appear at the top of the marble steps, engraved with the seal of Rone Academy.  Towering modwir trees shade the steps, making this a comfortable place to sit and relax.

title: [Frith's Inn, Loft]
description: Shards of shattered glass crackle as you make your way across this loft of the inn, which appears to have been plundered and left unrepaired.  A rope ladder dangles from the skylight above.  There is no longer anything here of value, only cobwebs, rain-warped floorboards and the odor of rotting wood.

title: [Frith's Inn, Rooftop]
description: You stumble across the debris-strewn rooftop.  A ledge skirting the building permits access to an open window in the wall rising to your left.  The tar feels tacky beneath your feet as you notice a broken skylight to your right.  A rope ladder is tied to one of the crossbars.

title: [Wine Shop, Lounge]
description: Large candles resting upon elegant brass stands illuminate this richly appointed chamber, the candlelight soft and inviting.  While the bookcase along one wall is not completely full, the numerous tomes arranged within provide ample variety for those interested in a bit of reading.

title: [Wine Shop, Cellar]
description: Floor-to-ceiling iron racks house row after row of wine bottles, the shelving covering nearly every inch of wall space.  Dim flickering light coming from a single dusty sconce dances off the glassy surfaces of the bottles, the kaleidoscope of reflections all warped in similar fashion.

title: [Dabbings Mews, Mews Lane]
description: Mews Lane ends at the foot of a flight of stone steps leading up to an imposing building, its front girthed by a generous porch stretching completely across it.  In its lee, the row houses reach their end, and an alley leads between them and the large edifice.  The path bordering Mews Lane turns the corner in back of the building, containing the Mews in its embrace.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Dabbings Mews, Front Porch]
description: Running the entire length of Tuckered Inn, the establishment's porch is given a generous view of Mews Lane by its higher elevation.  The avenue stretches north, its row of houses neat and their stoops spotless.  Halflings hurrying along in the chilly wind look small and huddled up against the air's inhospitable temperature.

title: [Mill Tower, Entry]
description: The floors are lightly dusted with flour that has overshot the holding bins.  A wheelbarrow is propped against the wall, having been emptied of its load of wheat, it now awaits the final product for the return trip home.

title: [Mill Tower, Second Floor]
description: Great gears and pulleys nearly fill the room.  A bewildering assortment of ropes and pulleys for hauling grain to the hoppers on the floor above is in one corner.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Oil lamps flicker in the unnatural breeze coming from the opening at the top of the steps.  Several leaves swirl down around the cobblestones, making dry skittering noises as they are moved further into the passageway.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Between twin rows of buildings sits an open courtyard blotted with an occasional fragrant midden.  Fresh air keeps the smell from permeating this narrow space.  Oil lamps outline a patch of lush grass neatly maintained with a trim of blue-grey riverstones.  Several well-placed benches create a small common area for socializing, or just for stargazing in a somewhat private setting.

Between twin rows of buildings sits an open courtyard blotted with an occasional fragrant midden.  Fresh air keeps the smell from permeating this narrow space.  Attempts have been made to make the area more appealing, as a patch of lush grass is neatly maintained with a trim of blue-grey riverstones.  Colorful flowers dot each corner of the park-like oblong, between which rest benches.  Laundry draped upon the ropes stretched between the buildings is barely noticeable, except when they flap loudly.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: A lone rat scampers close to a saucer of milk left out for stray cats near one of the building's closed back doors.  Oil lamps create gargantuan shadows along the walls surrounding this courtyard, as passersby come and go.  Several trumpet vines climb and intertwine along the walls, their brilliant flame-hued blossoms closed into tight buds for the night.

Several scrawny cats crowd around a saucer of milk left out for them near one of the building's closed back doors.  Birds take advantage of the laundry ropes strung overheard, using them as convenient perches, to the distraction of the gathering felines.  Several trumpet vines climb and intertwine along the walls, their showy dark green foliage contrasting with brilliant flame-hued blossoms.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: The scent of burning oil is thick in this section of the underground passageway, mainly from the constant illumination provided by the lamps that light the way.  Stone steps at either end lead up to courtyards set between the rows of buildings that line the streets above.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Wind whistles around the corner and down the steps, as it creeps in through the opening at street level.  A torn and dirty copy of the Elanthia Journal turns cartwheels over the cobblestones, making its way deeper into the cavern-like passageway.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Several people gather around a blazing firepit in the middle of the courtyard, telling stories and singing songs as they watch sparks dance towards the heavens.  Several windows are open and lit with a candle, adding to the festive atmosphere.  From one set of curtained panes comes the delicate notes of a sweet melody accompanied by an enchanting voice.

Bright and sunny, this large courtyard offers little in the way of shade, other than what appears naturally from the angle of the sun.  Trumpet vines snake along the building walls thickly, covering them with lush foliage and reddish-orange blossoms, while skirting clear of the many windows.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Faintly briney air serves to remind that the bay is close by, and enhances other smells noticeable.  The scent of cooking meats is redolent with the night breeze, thick with garlic and spices.  A lone bench sits next to a flight of stone steps leading down into a passageway, and offers a panoramic view of this sheltered hideaway and the night sky above.

At this end of the courtyard, someone has tried to create a small vegetable garden.  Leggy tomato plants wind around their supports, profuse with yellow blossoms, yet there is no fruit forthcoming.  Pumpkin vines sprawl along the ground, anemic with yellowed leaves.  A nearby bench sits next to a flight of stone steps leading down into a passageway, and offers a panoramic view of this sheltered hideaway.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Faded silk banners with their words long gone hang in frayed valances, draping from each oil  mounted on the passageway walls.  The end of one section hangs down limply, detached from the remainder and trailing in a rivulet of water meandering along the cobblestones.

Faded silk banners with their words long gone hang in frayed valances, draping from each oil lamp mounted on the passageway walls.  The end of one section hangs down limply, detached from the remainder and trailing in a rivulet of water meandering along the cobblestones.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: At the top of the steps, flanking pots of white and crimson geraniums stand like sentinels.  Birds roost just under the eaves of the arched opening, their straw nests fringed with bits of string and paper.  Echoing footsteps along the passageway cobblestones sound loudly, but it's hard to discern if they are coming closer or moving farther away.

title: [Solhaven, Spiral Passageway]
description: Wider than the other courtyards along this twisting passageway, due to the proximity of Vornavis' western wall, this sanctuary boasts a large grassy area for family gatherings or celebratory moments.  The buildings that ring the tiny park feature windows with shutters and awnings, many of them tossed open and illuminated with candlelight.

Wider than the other courtyards along this twisting passageway, due to the proximity of Vornavis' western wall, this sanctuary boasts a large grassy area for rest and for play.  Slightly better maintained, the buildings that ring the tiny park feature windows with shutters and awnings, a sure sign of prosperity.

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: This central area is cleaner than the surrounding tunnels.  Relatively fresh straw covers the ground and in one corner is a tiny mound of partly digested cloudberry seeds.  The walls are old and full of small holes and cracks -- with a bit of effort you might be able to climb them.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Infested Tunnels, Rat's Nest]
description: A natural ledge gives a clear view of a large chamber.  The ceiling is far above and the floor far below.  You might be able to make it down if you climbed over the edge.  But then who'd want to go down there?
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A thick rope of braided palm fronds knotted around a sturdy iron loop leads downward into the pit.  Parts of the rope look chewed on and frayed, but it still seems to be in serviceable condition.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Bolted into the wall are several thick iron chains, every last one shattered so badly that the links are torn wide open.  Scattered about the floor are a few ruined and warped steel manacles, clearly far too weak to hold whatever they may have imprisoned originally.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: A gleaming pole of silvery metal reaches from ceiling to floor and allows easy access into the room beneath.  It looks to be wedged quite securely into the stone above and below, and should be able to hold the weight of even the heaviest adventurer.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Placed with precision about the room are several tables bearing thick leather straps.  Each table is perfectly spotless.  If they have been used recently,  considerable care was taken to clean up any mess that was made.  The floor, however, is not nearly as pristine and is covered with splotches and stains.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: An elegant stairway crafted from handcarved chunks of pink coral leads downward into the sunken pit.  One of the stairs is badly cracked and chipped, but is easily enough skipped as the distance between each of the steps is quite small.

title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
description: Several large vats have been overturned and whatever was contained within them is now nothing more than a few stains on the floor.  One cauldron remains upright, however, and is issuing forth huge gouts of black smoke from its madly bubbling brew.

title: [Northern Caravansary, NW Corner]
description: A solid, log building has been built in the northwest corner of the palisade.  Split log steps lead up to the heavy, brass-bound door.  A brightly painted sign depicting a diamond the size of a melon hangs above the door.

title: [Stonebiter's Gemporium, Entry]
description: The log walls of this long, narrow entry, along with heavy doors at both ends and a kill-hole above the northern doorway, leave little doubt as to this room's purpose.  Split log steps are visible just outside the southern doorway.

title: [Northern Caravansary, NE Corner]
description: A squat log building has been built into the northeast corner of the palisade.  Split log steps lead down to the heavy, iron-banded door that is half below ground level.  A pair of burly dwarves stand to either side of the steps, suspiciously eyeing each person as they come and go.  A brightly painted sign depicting a golden pouch bulging with coins hangs above the door.

title: [Clenchfist Bros. Banking, Entry]
description: The log walls of this long, narrow entryway are unadorned and give the room a closed-in feeling.  Split log steps are visible just outside the southern doorway.

title: [Flynth Lake, Barn]
description: Here in the back of the barn, stalls for eight animals take up most of the area.  The enclosures are spacious and sturdy, and piles of hay fill a couple of them, spilling out onto the rough planks of the barn floor.  Freshly cut wood lies in a corner, ready to be split and stacked.

title: [Flynth Lake, Hayloft]
description: In this peaceful loft, great mounds of sweet-smelling hay are piled high, awaiting hungry oxen fresh off the trail.  It brings to mind idyllic thoughts of lazy afternoons spent lying in the hay, listening to the nicker of horses from below.  With a rustle of wings, a startled barn owl takes flight and soars to another, quieter part of the barn, where it settles down to its slumber once again.

title: [Cairnfang Falls, Basin]
description: Lost in a world of roiling mist and slippery rock, pine-studded outcroppings ring a huge pool.  Moisture beads everywhere as water crashes onto jagged rocks at the cliff's base, and the thunder of it echoes deafeningly.

title: [Cairnfang Falls, Hidden Pool]
description: Hidden from the basin by rock outcroppings and a curtain of young pines, this pool is a starlit backwater, ringed with sandstone ledges and a tiny beach of pale golden sand.
Hidden from the basin by rock outcroppings and a curtain of young pines, this pool is a sun-warmed backwater, ringed with sandstone ledges and a tiny beach of golden sand.

title: [Trading Post, Foyer]
description: The foyer is decorated with banners from nearby cities.  A large, pine desk sits in one corner of the room.  Near the entrance, a rickety podium, covered with a thick layer of dust, stands to greet visitors.  Chairs and tables, clearly not often used, are placed at intervals along the unadorned wooden walls.

title: [Trading Post, Upstairs Hallway]
description: A faded, fraying carpet pads the center of the floor in this hall.  Oil lamps hang at odd intervals on the walls, providing patchy, flickering light.

title: [Trading Post, Common Room]
description: Travelers and adventurers of all races and ages find rest in this large, open room.  A fire pit is located in the center of the room, providing warmth and light.  Barmaids serve food and drink from behind a long oak bar.

title: [Trading Post, Cellar]
description: This cellar serves as storage for the wines and ales sold in the common room.  Roots and dried goods are also stored in barrels and casks along the walls.  Bottles of wine sit in racks that form aisles throughout the room.

title: [Zul Logoth, Ametrine Tunnel]
description: A lone stalactite has been painted with swirls of deep amethyst and streaks of sunny yellow-gold.  Elaborate feats of dwarven masonry stand on display out in front of an expansive storefront.  Idle chatter between shopkeepers, patrons, and neighbors runs together with the heavy footsteps of passersby.  Growing in the shadowed nooks of the tunnel are small clumps of softly glowing blue-green moss.
a.location: the tunnels and caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Subterranean Siegecraft]
description: A blackened ironwork spiral staircase descends from a wood-paneled ceiling into this luxurious showroom.  Polished mahogany cases with glass windows stand sentinel around the walls, each well lit with brass sconces.  A rich woven carpet rests along a marble floor on which a small desk and chair sit in the center of the room.  Between two of the cases, a marble arch leads to another well-lit chamber of this basement boutique.

title: [Jail, Hallway]
description: Brightly lit by several torches set in iron sconces on the walls, the smoothly tunneled corridor allows no room for shadows to dwell.  Colorful iron doors mark the entry to each cell, each with a different native gem set into the doorway to make differentiation simple.  A set of low steps leads north and down to a lower level of the prison, while to the south, the entry can be glimpsed beyond the burly dwarven guard who stands watch.

title: [Jail, Passage]
description: Highly polished stone walls and floor reflect the dim torchlight here, making it seem more than it is.  Painted iron doors studded with gems indicate the entrances into two more prisoner cells.  A set of low steps leads up toward the exit of the prison, while some steep stairs lead lower into darkness.

title: [Wizard Guild, Antechamber]
description: Five tall, silver-flecked pillars support the domed ceiling, spaced evenly around the periphery of the antechamber.  A deep blue granite stele stands alone in the center of the floor in front of a winding stairway.

title: [Wizard Guild, First Stratum]
description: Twin, narrow stairs spiral steeply downward, providing access to the lower levels of the guild.  Through the circular opening in the floor, the other strata are clearly visible.  A pair of agate-inset doors lies within the northwest wall, facing some quartz-inset doors to the southeast.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: The air is stale and dry here.  Large amounts of debris seem to have settled here when the walls to the southeast crumbled.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Tunnel]
description: Piles of debris and rocks hamper passage to the northeast as the tunnel continues downward to the southwest.  Fossils pockmark the walls amid small cracks and crevices.

title: [Temple Steps]
description: The roots of cyclopean fel trees have forced some of the steps from their horizontal planes.  The great trees have grown over the smaller outbuildings of the temple complex, their trunks assuming fantastic shapes stolen from the stones they have covered.  Wide landings allow visitors to pause and admire the sight of the temple's conical towers reaching toward the stars.

Wide landings allow visitors to pause and admire the view of the temple's conical towers reaching to the sky.

title: [Temple Entrance]
description: A closer examination of the temple's walls reveals nature's dual role of destroyer and consoler.  Vines have torn apart some of the more delicate carvings, but moss has healed the breaches in the stonework.  Friezes of stylized flames and lotus flowers that span the length of the facade are almost hidden in the shadows, but the sandstone figure of a kneeling woman on the lintel above the entrance is plainly visible even in the faint moonlight.

Friezes of stylized flames and lotus flowers stretch the length of the facade, and the sandstone figure of a woman kneels on the lintel above the entrance of the temple.

title: [Temple, Bathing Chamber]
description: Water droplets condensing on the hollow-tiled ceiling above the central bath grow gravid in the steamy air and return to their source with a quiet splash.  Silver ewers and vials of scented oil are within easy reach of the communal bath, their tarnished surfaces reflecting the flickering candlelight dimly.  A large window on the western wall appears to serve the dual purpose of allowing bathers to admire the night skies and to put themselves on display.

A large window on the western wall appears to serve the dual purpose of allowing bathers to admire the lush forest outside and to put themselves on display.

title: [Temple, Bath]
description: The bath has apparently been built over a natural hot spring, its murky waters steaming hot but not quite to the point of discomfort.  The cloyingly strong smell of incense doesn't quite conceal the faint mineral tang in the air.

title: [Piaere's Boutique, Main Room]
description: A sprawling azure canopy, painted like the sky it obscures, shades this open-air platform enclosed by sturdy fel railing.  The massive trunk of a linden tree rises through the heart of this cozy boutique, and several of its thick branches have been converted into makeshift clothing racks.  A florid orange tree nearby scents the air with a heady fragrance, drawing iridescent hummingbirds to flit through the shop in search of sweet nectar.

title: [Piaere's Boutique]
description: Variegated leaves from the neighboring flora have been affixed and sealed upon the wooden floor in an orderly fashion, like the footsteps of nature.  Artfully arranged in three semi-circles, slender-legged tables and stands present beautifully crafted clothing and accessories.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: This small, open landing is supported at the center of a complex nexus of structural growths attached to the walls.  Looking over the edge you can see down through the hollow tree to the levels below, but the fog and mist obscure most details.  Above, a steep staircase climbs to another landing overhead with twin spiral stairs stretching farther up the inside of the tree wall.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: This spacious landing serves as a junction for twin, spiraling stairs leading up and some steep steps leading down into the misty darkness below.  The walls facing the interior of the tree here are porous with small, irregular holes allowing glimpses of the hollow area outside.  The omnipresent veins run through the floor and stairs in all sizes and configurations.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: This spacious landing serves as a junction for twin, spiraling stairs leading up and some steep steps leading down into the misty darkness below.  The walls facing the interior of the tree here are porous with small, irregular holes allowing glimpses of the hollow area outside.  The omnipresent veins run through the floor and stairs in all sizes and configurations.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The stairs continue here, circling for almost a quarter-circle along the inside of the tree trunk.  Far below you, mists shroud the bottom of the tower.  Woody growths crisscross the open area and to the east, far across the hollow interior, another spiral stair circles the tree in the opposite direction.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: This spacious landing serves as a junction for twin, spiraling stairs leading up and some steep steps leading down into the misty darkness below.  The walls facing the interior of the tree here are porous with small, irregular holes allowing glimpses of the hollow area outside.  The omnipresent veins run through the floor and stairs in all sizes and configurations.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Stair]
description: The tree towers up and up into the misty darkness, while the spiraling steps continue their climb up the side of the trunk.  High above, bats circle in and amongst the huge, woody branches and growths that run across the interior of the tree.  Mists rise from below, cloaking the bottom of the tower in a hazy shroud.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: Great arching branches come together in the center of the tree, forming a huge cathedral-like hall.  The walls stretching upwards from the landing are a deep, black hue so dark they appear liquid.  Great branch-like structures form a majestic colonnade down the periphery of the huge chamber.  The smooth, expansive floor is broken abruptly in the center of the room by the passage leading down.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: The walls of the great tree stretch up into a gloomy half-light, here and there punctured by stark beams of colored light.  Whether the rays come from openings to the outside, or are generated in some fashion isn't certain.  Underfoot, an outcropping of the tree's wall comprises the floor.  It extends out in a polished, veined semicircle as though the wood was as malleable as clay when the landing was formed.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Landing]
description: The incline stops at the foot of a suspended bridge that traverses the abyss of empty air with delicate stairs made of polished ebony.  Each stair hangs on silver wire no greater in diameter than a hair, and the steps are inlaid with tiny pieces of colored wood that form a pattern of runes around the risers.  A tapestry hangs on the wall opposite the stair, its vast dimensions dwarfing the delicate construction of the stair.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Observatory]
description: An expansive chamber stretches above the hanging platform serving as its base.  The ceiling is made of some sort of translucent material that more resembles air than a solid substance.  The sides of the tree dwindle into scrambled paths resembling veins tracing through the crystalline bubble.  Sunlight intrudes in great beams that shimmer on the strange, monumental construction, a machine that takes up most of the room within the sphere.

The sides of the tree dwindle into scrambled paths resembling veins tracing through the crystalline bubble.  Moonlight intrudes in great beams that shimmer on the strange, monumental construction, a machine that takes up most of the room within the sphere.

title: [Maaghara Tower, Observatory]
description: The catwalk encircling the lofty chamber seems dangerous, suspended on very thin wire supports attached to the transparent bubble overhead.  At the sphere's center, a colossal machine dominates everything, its gears, arms and pulleys so numerous, no self-evident logic can be determined by looking at them.  A flight of tenuous stairs, likewise suspended on thin wires, leads up to a higher vantage point.

title: [The Heavens Machine]
description: In the center of a translucent sphere sits a marvelous machine, huge beyond reckoning and more complex than the eye can take in.  Its complicated turns, twists and coils surround a narrow slab of rolaren at the precise heart of both the machine and the sphere.  A few dials can be seen on a dais beside the slab.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: The dark cliff rising overhead is bereft of handholds, save a narrow ridge of rock which slants across the face.  Dead branches and twigs are piled loosely at the base, tufts of white fur caught in the forks.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: The path cuts shelflike into the hillside, overlooking a precipitous dropoff.  One tilted layer of rock, clearly more resistant to erosion than the rest, stands out as a sharp ridge running down the cliff face.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: A layer of feldspar glittering with garnet fragments runs across this section of the cliff.  Fuzzy black moss grows in clumps along a shallow horizontal crevice.  Handholds are few, but a slight outcropping just above you looks promising.

title: [Gorget Trails, East Cliff Face]
description: Plunging straight down from the trail is a sheer cliff face with only a small outcropping providing purchase.  A sparsely foliated bush with small green berries grows from the only pocket of soil in the area.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Entry]
description: The entry hall of the inn is small and stuffy, smelling as if the place hasn't been aired out in years.  A ratty tapestry covers the wall opposite the front entrance, its fabric too moth-eaten to discern what the scene upon it may have once depicted.  Raucous noise comes from behind a swinging door in the south wall.

title: [The Feystone Inn, Upper Landing]
description: Shabby carpeting covers the wooden floorboards, but does nothing to disguise the creaking and groaning underfoot as the few patrons of this dubious establishment wander the hallway.  A battered brass chandelier hangs from the beams above, casting a dim sickly light across the hall.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A huge pile of fallen rocks, left by some long-ago landslide, blocks the entire width of the ravine to the east.  Scraggly bushes grow in the patches of soil that have built up in the sharp nooks and crannies, and the half-dried corpse of what looks like it was once a large dog lies shattered and impaled where it fell.

Scraggly bushes grow in the patches of soil that have built up in the sharp nooks and crannies, and the half-dried corpse of what looks like it was once a large dog lies shattered and impaled, its bones glinting in a shard of moonlight.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A lone tree protrudes from a ledge some distance above, its twisted form, grown from a fallen seed many years ago, casting an uneven shadow over the ravine.  A huge pile of fallen rocks blocks the ravine to the west, its sharp and unstable edges forming a treacherous obstacle.

A lone tree protrudes from a ledge some distance above, its twisted form, grown from a fallen seed many years ago, casting a ghostly shadow in the moonlight.  A huge pile of fallen rocks blocks the ravine to the west, its sharp and unstable edges forming a treacherous obstacle.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The eastern floor of the ravine climbs steeply upward, the nearly vertical slope slick with mud.  Heaps of fallen rock litter the ground amid patches of muck and trampled weeds in the ever-changing shadows of the precipitous ravine walls.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The floor of the ravine is soft and muddy here, the runoff of soil from the moors high above piled twenty feet deep under your feet.  Jagged shards of stone protrude from the dirt, along with a few shards of weatherworn bone.  A narrow ledge extends from the rock wall a few feet above the present level of the ground, and the ground descends a dangerously slippery slope to the west.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A patch of bright white wildflowers provide a spot of brightness in the shadow, having taken root in the thick, muddy soil that has fallen from the plains above and built into a thick layer over the years, seeming oddly out of place in the rocky desolation of the ravine.  The dirt drops off into a steep, slippery slope back to the rough stone floor of the chasm.
