The dirt drops off into a steep, slippery slope back to the rough stone floor of the chasm.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: A twenty-foot-high mound of earth blocks passage to the west, its steep borders slick with mud as if it had been washed down into the grotto by centuries of rain and drainage.  Thick patches of weeds grow in profusion around the dirt, but the bare ravine floor to the east is stony and desolate.

title: [Yegharren Valley, Ravine]
description: The long-buried bones of some unfortunate fallen adventurer protrude from a huge pile of jagged rocks left by the ancient landslide that buried the east end of the ravine in crumbled stone.  The walls rise steeply to both sides, revealing subtle grey patterns of striated rock.

title: [Ravine's End]
description: Piles of jagged rocks fill the end of the ravine, deposited by some long-ago landslide or explosion that has completely concealed whatever route the ancient stream that carved out the ravine took to disappear into the earth.  A steep ladder of crude stairs extends up the north wall, transformed by the rubble and muddy runoff from above into an unstable and treacherous climb.

title: [Ravine's End]
description: Piles of jagged rocks fill the end of the ravine, deposited by some long-ago landslide or explosion that has completely concealed whatever route the ancient stream that carved out the ravine took to disappear into the earth.  A steep ladder of crude stairs extends up the north wall, transformed by the rubble and muddy runoff from above into an unstable and treacherous climb.

title: [High Plains, Old Barrow Road]
description: A brisk, steady wind blows over the plain, swirling odd bits of grass and leaves across the ancient road and bending the rough patches of brambles and heather that dot the surrounding plain in an eternal slant.  Parallel lines of crumbled stone that once were walls stretch to the north, marking the edges of the rutted road.

A brisk, chill night wind blows over the plain, bending the dark patches of brambles and heather that dot the surrounding plain in an eternal slant.  Parallel lines of crumbled stone stretch to the north, marking the edges of the rutted road.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: Dirt pebbled with rounded stones form this pass that concludes at the bank of a lake to the north.  A short dock juts out from the rocky shoreline, studded with faded crimson and yellow mooring floats.  Though the grade of the climb to the forest towards the south is slight and gradual, the view from this distance is still remarkable.

title: [Fearling Pass, Ridge]
description: To the north, a large lake spans across the view, its dark expanse both eerie and still, while in the opposite direction, a treacherous path climbs up from meadow-like fields in the distance.  Directly below the ridge, a fetid bog sends her foggy tendrils slithering upward, where they wrap around the edges of a small shack.

title: [Fearling Pass, Rocky Trail]
description: Lakebed rocks become more prominent along this offshoot of the trail, as though more recently maintained.  The dark rich stones sport a mottled hue speared with alabaster veins.  The pass meanders east a short distance before a steep ledge cuts it off, descending into a deep gully and down to the edge of a morose-looking swamp.  Forbidding scents waft outward, festooning its banks like a decorative collar.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Marsh Edge]
description: An old wagon lies buried in the mud near the shore of a murky bog, dark green lichen already finding a home upon its timbers.  A light green carpet of minute plant life floats on the surface of the stagnant water, an occasional bubble parting the greenery as it expands outwards toward the shore.  At the edge of the marsh, stands of cattails mark the entrance to a shadowed archway beneath the burdened boughs of an ancient willow tree.

title: [Fethayl Bog, Corroded Statue]
description: Rising high above the swamp, a corroded green statue surveys the thick undergrowth below and blocks further passage to the north.  Multitudes of saw grasses and brilliant crimson flora wind along the thin, narrow ledge descending to the southwest.  A curtain of vines hangs over the precipice, the sinuous tangles creating a foreboding sound in the faintest of breezes.

title: [Fethayl Bog]
description: Tufts of wet moss spread along the trail, interspersed with stinking lumps of humid mud that strive to reach the surface.  The unsettling cry of a swamp lark occasionally breaks the incessant hum of the mosquitoes swarming around you.  A spongy trail leads to the south, heading deeper into the fetid swamp.  Gnarled lengths of twisted blood-vines dangle from the sheer rock wall that blocks passage to the north.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Thorn-covered vines have usurped the position of the grapes that once grew on the surrounding trellises, binding the wooden posts and rails in a weave of greenery as tight as a sailor's knot.  The path amongst the vines is blocked by a wall to the east, but continues on to the south and west.

title: [Wildflower Field, Pond]
description: A sparkling stream of water pouring from beneath a small white building to the east feeds into a small clear pond.  Roughly oval in shape, the pond is little more than a stone-lined depression in the ground, surrounded by grass and flowers, with a stacked stone wall to the north and west.

title: [Vineyard]
description: Vines trailing over the crumbled splinters of broken trellises have found a new source of support on the headless skeleton of a large bear.  Green leafy tendrils are twisted and entwined about the yellowed rib bones of the creature like yarn on a rug maker's loom.

title: [Wildflower Field]
description: A brick path weaves in and around several raised boxes that once enclosed plantings of invasive herbs.  Left untended by the restraining hands of a gardener, the plants have escaped the confines of the boxes and now spread unchecked across this portion of the field.

title: [Apple Orchard]
description: Scratches and strange marks mar the trunks of apple trees in the neglected orchard.  Though deep, the gouging is superficial to the old, large trees, which spread branches heavy and bent from lack of pruning.

title: [Wildflower Field, Pond]
description: A sparkling stream of water pouring from beneath a small white building to the east feeds into a small clear pond.  Roughly oval in shape, the pond is little more than a stone-lined depression in the ground, surrounded by grass and flowers, with a stacked stone wall to the north and west.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: Muddy soil, a steep slope, and razor sharp thorns render the climb to and from the top of this hill a real challenge.  The arduous climb is rewarded with a breathtaking view ... of yet more hawthorn.

title: [Briar Thicket]
description: The ladder reaches a wooden platform in the heart of the briar thicket.  Constructed of pine boards, now weathered and warped and eaten by worms, the platform offers little in the way of shelter or security.  A three-legged stool dangles from a thorny branch several feet above the platform, almost as if the hawthorn grabbed it as the thicket grew.  A series of handholds have been cleared of thorns to allow those with sufficient courage to climb even higher into the thicket.

title: [Lower Walkway North]
description: The marble walkway leads southwest and southeast underneath a thick walnut lattice apparently used by those moving about the second floor.  At the northern tip where the walkway comes to a point, a carved walnut door allows entrance to one of The Legendary Rest's sleeping rooms.  On the other side of the walkway, a honeysuckle hedge separates the walkway from the courtyard, though it is easy to see the courtyard's magnificent fountain from this vantage.

title: [Upper Walkway North]
description: The lattice walkway overlooks the courtyard below, with its huge fountain, flowering bushes and honeysuckle hedge.  The top of the fountain is approximately at the same height as the walkway's surface, so the fountain's piping, wheels, doors, and other intricacies are readily visible.  Directly to the north, a carved walnut door allows entrance to one of the Rest's sleeping rooms, and a polished stairway with plush, carpeted steps provides a descent to the level below.

title: [Lower Walkway South]
description: Thick beams shore up the sturdy walnut lattice directly overhead.  The lattice allows extra illumination and air to filter down from above while providing a sturdy walking surface for those moving about the second floor of the inn.  Directly to the north, a huge marble fountain burbles pleasantly in the center of a spacious courtyard, and thick honeysuckle vines shaped into a wide hedge perfume the air.  A carved walnut door, the entrance to a sleeping room, resides on the south wall.

title: [Upper Walkway South]
description: The top of the fountain in the courtyard reaches to just about the height of the second story walkway, and from the walkway most of the courtyard and all of the fountain are visible.  The walkway heads northeast and northwest to the doors of the eastern and western sleeping rooms, then converges back again to meet at the northernmost room.  Directly to the south is the carved walnut door of the southernmost sleeping room.  Although the walkway is covered, the Rest's courtyard is open to the sky.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: The ebonwood and mahogany parquet floor forms an unbroken pattern from one side of this grand entryway to the other.  A pair of tall, narrow windows frame the iron-hinged front door, spilling sunlight into the nearly empty room.  Set at a slight angle just by the entrance is a sparsely ornamented writing desk.

A pair of tall, narrow windows frame the iron-hinged front door, spilling moonlight into the nearly empty room.  Set at a slight angle just by the entrance is a sparsely ornamented writing desk.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Historical Society]
description: Heavy wood paneling topped with egg and dart molding lines the walls of this broad hallway.  A claw-footed roll top desk presides at one end, while at the other stands a gilded and enameled suit of platemail.  Snapdragons nod brightly in a porcelain vase underneath a round window.

title: [Malwith Inn, Entry]
description: Fine woodwork fills the grand entryway.  A large braided rug covers most of the wood floor.  Wood support beams along the ceiling are carved with various depictions of drakes in flight.  Lanterns hang from thick iron hooks attached to the beams.  To the north a grand desk can be seen.

title: [Malwith Inn, Landing]
description: A simple wood stairway leads up into the inn, while the landing is formed from large stones.  Steps of the same rock as the landing lead down into the inn's basement.  A lone lantern hangs above the landing, trying desperately to brighten the area.

title: [Malwith Inn, Front Desk]
description: A large desk surrounds a small office area.  Books, scrolls and other odds and ends litter a table behind the desk.  A grand staircase leads up to the second floor, its railings ending in stylized dragon claws.

title: [Malwith Inn, Upper Hallway]
description: Plush carpeting, blood red, fills the hallway from corner to corner.  The ceiling of the room arches high overhead.  Looking eastward, a number of doors can be seen on both sides of the hallway.  A carpeted staircase descends to the room below, mahogany handrails flanking both sides.

title: [Stockade, Cell Corridor]
[Bastille, Cell Corridor]
description: In an abrupt departure from the elegance of the public areas of the bastille visible through the iron doorway to the east, bare stone floors run the length of this hallway.  Bright torches are set in the walls between the cell doors, shedding light through the heavy bars.  Lightly blowing through the hallway, a faint breeze carries the aroma of sweat on its tail.

In an abrupt departure from the elegance of the public areas of the bastille, bare stone floors run the length of this hallway.  Bright torches are set in the walls between the cell doors, shedding light through the heavy bars.  Lightly blowing through the hallway, a faint breeze carries the aroma of sweat on its tail.

title: [Stockade, Storage Room]
[Bastille, Storage Room]
description: Flickering in the slight draft that flows by, torchlight stretches down to the earth, where the dirt floor quickly absorbs the bright invasion.  The small storage room is filled with boxes and crates stacked against its walls.  On the far wall, behind the stairway, a rusting door leads into a tiny cell.  An eerie series of sounds drifts in from further down the hallway, where darkness has taken over.

title: [Helgreth's Tavern, Taproom]
description: Boisterous laughter erupts often from the congregation of imbibing patrons seated at Helgreth's tables.  A scattering of flickering beeswax candles glimmer off the numerous brass fixtures and pristine inverted glassware suspended above the polished bar.  In their starched uniforms, off-duty military officers traverse the tumult of the taproom as they come and go from a plush sanguine velvet curtain marked by a heraldic Vaalorian buckler overhead.

title: [Helgreth's Tavern, Second Floor]
description: Most of the central area of this spacious room has been cordoned off, leaving a comfortable walkway around its perimeter, replete with padded leather benches and stools.  A trio of burnished chandeliers remain unlit as sunlight streams in through cut-glass windows from all four sides, illuminating the highly detailed, miniaturized terrain of the City-States laid out upon the floor.  A small alcove branches off from the main chamber to the north.  Several wooden cases line the walls, their glass fronts revealing tiny figures within.

title: [Theatre Andaire, Foyer]
description: Thick Loenthran carpets in rich shades of garnet, sapphire and amber cover the theatre's stone floors, effectively muffling the sound of footfalls.  The granite walls are hung with tapestries depicting mummers, bards and other players in various scenes both comedic and dramatic.  Wall sconces of delicately wrought iron hold glimmering amber glaesine spheres, each containing beeswax candles whose brightly burning wicks cast a golden glow across the room.

title: [Theatre Andaire]
description: The stage, its underpinnings carved of rich darkly stained maoral, sits recessed into the theatre's back wall.  Thick garnet-hued velvet curtains, trimmed with glimmering golden cords and tassels, hang across the wall, providing a lush backdrop to the stage.  Creatively shuttered glaesine lanterns hanging from the rafters above direct warm golden light at the stage while leaving the seating area in almost complete darkness.

title: [Bard Guild, Entry]
description: Slender oak columns frame this grand entry hall, whose pale granite walls rise the full two stories of the building.  The columns support a second floor gallery, reached by a sweeping staircase and bordered by a heavily carved balustrade from which are hung dozens of banners bearing crests of ancient elven families.  The east and west walls are pierced by tall, lancet-topped leaded glass windows, through which dappled sunlight pours into the hall.

Slender oak columns frame this grand entry hall, whose pale granite walls rise the full two stories of the building.  The columns support a second floor gallery, reached by a sweeping staircase and bordered by a heavily carved balustrade from which are hung dozens of banners bearing crests of ancient elven families.  A trio of gracefully wrought vaalorn chandeliers fills the hall with warm, steady light.

title: [Bard Guild, Gallery]
description: Encircling the the whole of the guildhall entry, this wide gallery is bounded by pale granite walls and a richly carved oak balustrade, which forms an elongated oval flowing up from a sweeping staircase.  Sunlight filtered through tall, lancet-topped leaded glass windows illumines four magnificent paintings, two flanking a pair of wide doors on the south side, and the other two placed symmetrically on the north side, framing a wide archway leading north.

Encircling the the whole of the guildhall entry, this wide gallery is bounded by pale granite walls and a richly carved oak balustrade, which forms an elongated oval flowing up from a sweeping staircase.  Candlelight from grand vaalorn chandeliers reflects from tall, lancet-topped leaded glass windows and illumines four magnificent paintings, two flanking a pair of wide doors on the south side, and the other two placed symmetrically on the north side, framing a wide archway leading north.

title: [Neartofar Road]
description: Raised above the level of the underbrush and banked to provide for drainage after storms, the road provides a safe and comfortable journey through the forest.  Constant maintenance keeps the road clear of leaves and twigs, and the acorns that pose an even more serious danger to the cobblestone pavement.  At either side of the road, small clumps of young oaks grow out of refuse piles left by the road-clearing crews.

title: [The Toadwort, Muddy Path]
description: Along this mud trail rests a deep, narrow creek.  Pale moonlight shows tiny footprints in the mud near the edge of the water.  A huge, frog-shaped, moss-covered boulder lies close to the border of the creek.  As the rushing current spirals downward, it passes over the boulder, causing water to splash onto the road.

Along this mud trail rests a deep, narrow creek.  A huge, frog-shaped, moss-covered boulder lies close to the edge of the water.  As the rushing current spirals downward, it passes over the boulder, causing water to splash onto the road.  Tiny footprints are visible in the mud near the edge of the creek.

title: [Calelith Villa, Barn]
description: The barn is large and open.  An old wooden plow sits along the northern wall.  The yoke used to pull it hangs from hooks on the wall above.  Assorted pitchforks, hoes and garden implements are neatly hanging from pegs on the wall.

title: [Calelith Villa, Hayloft]
description: The loft has a musty smell, most likely from what remains of the old hay.  Sunlight enters through the open loft doors, used for lifting hay into the loft.  An owl sits perched in the rafters overhead, his head swiveling at the slightest sound.

title: [River's Rest, Dilapidated Pier]
description: Not as worn as it first appears to be, this pier is actually a sturdy and pleasant platform.  From this vantage, the river is clearly visible to the north, the comings and goings at the drawbridge seen but not heard.  Visible in the deep waters are the reflections of thousands of stars from the evening sky, occasionally obscured by a passing cloud.  Rustling reeds and the sudden splash of a fish leaping from the water do little to disturb the peace.

Not as worn as it first appears to be, this pier is actually a sturdy and pleasant platform.  From this vantage, the river is clearly visible to the north, the comings and goings at the drawbridge seen but not heard.  Visible in the deep waters are the shadowy shapes of what one hopes are large fish and tiny crabs cling to the pilings, scurrying from view when the shadows of water fowl fall over them.  Rustling reeds and the sudden splash of a fish leaping from the water do little to disturb the peace.

title: [River's Rest, Dilapidated Pier]
description: This section of the pier is much closer to the water than that above, so close in fact that one might dip their feet in the river by sitting at the platform's edge.  Beneath the boards, the sound of water sloshing against the pilings can be heard, and silvery water striders can be seen skipping along the river's surface in the midst of the cattails and reeds.

title: [Small Clearing]
description: Moonlight filters in through the canopy high above you in this standing of trees.  Large half exposed roots weave a tight bramble that surrounds you.  A narrow but well worn path carefully winds its way through a huge tangle of roots.  Hanging down from the tree before you is a long spidersilk ladder which leads upward.

Light filters in through the canopy high above you in this standing of trees.  Large half exposed roots weave a tight bramble that surrounds you.  A narrow but well worn path carefully winds its way through a huge tangle of roots.  Hanging down from the tree before you is a long spidersilk ladder which leads upward.

title: [Fletcher Shop, Porch]
description: A swift breeze gently rustles the leaves of this large haon tree, partially obscuring your view of the town to the west.  The thick branches provide a natural support for the frame of the shop, while smaller branches form a railing which surrounds the porch.  Hanging off the edge of the porch is a spidersilk ladder which leads to the ground far below.

title: [Plaza of Stars]
description: A large plaza fronts the imposing facade of the Jastev Amphitheater, which is linked to its companion Bard Guild via a beautifully arched covered walkway.  The tile paving the plaza is laid in alternating bands of color, soft salmon contrasted with ivory, the tone and pattern matched in the walls of the buildings.  A statue stands in the plaza's center and a wide bank of stairs leads up to the amphitheater's entrance, at least a story higher than the plaza's floor.

title: [Bard Guild, Terrace]
description: A generous terrace stretches before the entrance to the Jastev Amphitheater.  From the elevated vantage point, the plaza below is striking with its alternating bands of color.  At the apex of the monumental arch leading into the theater, the lintel is carved with an image of a bearded man framed by a crossed pair of artist's brushes.

title: [Felinium's Fur Emporium]
description: The walls of this small shop appear to be covered with the furs and skins of all types of creatures.  Closer inspection reveals that many are still being prepared for use, although an occasional impeccably finished specimen is found.  Hunt souvenirs rest on a set of shelves tucked in one corner, where a cluster of roughly clad traders have gathered to examine them closely.

title: [Felinium's Fur, Workroom]
description: Heaps of straw are strewn across the stone floor, while piles of hides requiring more scraping to remove the fur and loose bits of flesh from the skins have been dumped into the corners of the workshop.  Off to the side of the stained counter, two enormous vats partially sunk into the ground contain limestone and bleach.  Various implements of the trade can be found on pegs circling the room and in crates and other containers.

title: [Watchtower, Main Floor]
description: The thick stucco walls of the watchtower keep the room cool.  Moonlight filters in through a number of cross-shaped arrow loops.  A commemorative shield is hung on the wall beside a rack of oak-hafted spears.  A wooden stairway leading up follows the curve of the wall.

The thick stucco walls of the watchtower keep the room cool.  Sunlight filters in through a number of cross-shaped arrow loops.  A commemorative shield is hung on the wall beside a rack of oak-hafted spears.  A wooden stairway leading up follows the curve of the wall.

title: [Watchtower, Second Floor]
description: This room is a jumble of wooden crates, rolled-up mattresses, bins of arrow shafts, and other supplies necessary for withstanding a siege.  Numerous arrow loops allow the light to stream in.  A wooden stairway leading down follows the curve of the wall.  At the top of the stairway is a rope, which hangs from a narrow trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Watchtower, Second Floor]
description: This room is a jumble of wooden crates, rolled-up mattresses, bins of arrow shafts, and other supplies necessary for withstanding a siege.  Numerous arrow loops allow the light to stream in.  A wooden stairway leading down follows the curve of the wall.  At the top of the stairway is a rope, which hangs from a narrow trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Watchtower, Rooftop]
description: In the moonlight you can see the entire southern approach to River's Rest...the wide river all the way from the Tempest Falls in the east to Maelstrom Bay in the west, the South River Road, the town drawbridge.  To the north and west, with the exception of the busy Merchant's Walk and the onion-shaped spire of a minaret, much of the town itself is hidden by the trees.  A length of rope tied to an iron stanchion drops down through a trapdoor in the floor.

From here you are able to see the entire southern approach to River's Rest...the wide river all the way from the Tempest Falls in the east to Maelstrom Bay in the west, the South River Road, the town drawbridge.  To the north and west, with the exception of the busy Merchant's Walk and the onion-shaped spire of a minaret, much of the town itself is hidden by the trees.  A length of rope tied to an iron stanchion drops down through a trapdoor in the floor.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Narrow Hall]
description: Many plaques and paintings adorn the walls here as light from ceiling windows reflect down on them.  An elegant oak staircase leads up to an open balcony of the upper floor.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Overlook]
description: A breath-taking view of the lower hallway makes you stop and admire the beauty of the intricately carved walls and plaques below.  An elegant painting hangs from the northern wall.

title: [Mislin Hall, Entry]
description: A rustic chandelier crafted from an old ship's wheel casts a ruddy glow across a polished maoral floor inlaid with a detailed pattern in knotted pale oak.  Weapon racks and full suits of armor guard archways leading off the entry foyer, and a plush green runner softens a grand staircase leading to the second floor.

title: [Mislin Hall, Hallway]
description: A narrow green runner follows the length of the hall from a maoral-framed slatted door and down the staircase to the main floor.  Faded paintings adorn the hallway, alternating with brass candle sconces and closed doors.

title: [Bluff, Maelstrom Bay]
description: Scrub grasses cling tenaciously to this rocky bluff.  A constant wind blows off the bay and across the hilltop, scouring the ground and exposing numerous large, flat boulders.

title: [Bluff, Narrow Precipice]
description: A strong wind whips around the side of the bluff, attempting to dislodge anything foolish enough to venture up to this precipice.  The way ends here as the trail ahead has apparently lost its battle to stay attached to the bluff.  A sheer drop to the bay hundreds of feet below cuts off further advance, and the sheer cliff face makes upward travel possible only if one has wings.  The only safe exit is back down the trail.

title: [Tempest Falls, Landing]
description: The steps pause at a landing of sorts behind the waterfall.  Only inches from the edge of the landing, the water falls rather noisily from above.  Any further progress up the steps is impossible, as the rushing water blocks your way.

title: [Tempest Falls, Above the Falls]
description: A thick damp mist envelopes the space immediately adjacent to the falls, rising from the roaring crash of the Tempest waters as they plummet below.  Little can be seen through the enshrouding mist, which only breaks apart occasionally to reveal a glimpse of the small town situated on the egg-shaped island below in the river.  The roar of the falls is almost deafening, and the rushing of the waters shake the earth underfoot.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A faint rumble can be heard here, perhaps the echoes of the river above, or some fearsome beast lying in wait, or a hungry halfling.  A hint of salt is in the air, which seems odd for a freshwater river tunnel.  A stairway carved of sandstone appears to lead further below the river here.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The stairs continue, carved out of the sandstone that makes up one wall of this chamber.  A small landing is present here, as it appears that the original carvers had to pick up the vein of sandstone on the other side of the chamber.  A chimney and ladder have been carved from the sandstone vein and a roaring noise can be heard from below as a steady cloud of mist rises up the chimney.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: The stairs continue, carved out of the sandstone that makes up one wall of this chamber.  A small landing is present here, as it appears that the original carvers had to pick up the vein of sandstone on the other side of the chamber.  A chimney and ladder have been carved from the sandstone vein and a roaring noise can be heard from below as a steady cloud of mist rises up the chimney.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A sizable stream enters this cavern from an opening near the ceiling in the southwest wall.  The water from the stream splashes into a rock-lined pool, dousing the walls with its spray as it hits.  The pool feeds through a grate placed underneath a set of carved stairs.  Where the grate goes is anyone's guess, as even the years of rushing water have left it intact and far too strong for even a giantman or dwarf to bend.  The stairs have been carved of sandstone and lead upwards.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A sizable stream enters this cavern from an opening near the ceiling in the southwest wall.  The water from the stream splashes into a rock-lined pool, dousing the walls with its spray as it hits.  The pool feeds through a grate placed underneath a set of carved stairs.  Where the grate goes is anyone's guess, as even the years of rushing water have left it intact and far too strong for even a giantman or dwarf to bend.  The stairs have been carved of sandstone and lead upwards.

title: [Sea Tunnels]
description: A deposit of some sort of ore in the walls here has prevented the rushing stream from eroding the walls of the tunnel and redirected its flow downwards and to the northeast.  The many years of splashing water have left the ore unaffected, except for being very clean.  You hear a roaring sound emanating from the northeast.

title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Aft]
description: The massive mainmast of the ship towers high above your head here.  High up the mast, near the top, is a small crow's nest.  Ratlines lead up from both sides of the ship to provide access to the crow's nest for the lookouts.  Forward from here, to the south, are the gangplank and cargo hatch.  Stairs lead up to the quarterdeck at the aft end.

title: [Krol Ship, Crow's Nest]
description: This is a small wooden basket suspended high above the deck on the mainmast.  Lookouts here have a commanding view of the surrounding seas, but even the slight motion of the ship riding at anchor is enough to make you feel ill at this tremendous height.

title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Aft]
description: The massive mainmast of the ship towers high above your head here.  High up the mast, near the top, is a small crow's nest.  Ratlines lead up from both sides of the ship to provide access to the crow's nest for the lookouts.  Forward from here, to the south, are the gangplank and cargo hatch.  Stairs lead up to the quarterdeck at the aft end.

title: [Krol Ship, Quarterdeck]
description: This is the command center of the ship, where the captain typically stands while the ship is at sea.  In the center of this deck is the ship's wheel from which the helmsmen steer the ship.  Some steps lead up to the poop deck, and another flight of stairs leads down to the main deck.

title: [Krol Ship, Anchor Chain]
description: You are holding on to the wet anchor chain with the greatest of care, fully aware of the water swirling under the ship, below you.  Although the bowsprit is not high above you, trying to climb up to it would be suicide.  A few feet above you, the chain disappears into the ship's hull through the hawse hole.  You may be able to squeeze through it.

title: [Under the Ship's Shadow]
description: The ship towers over the water, casting its shadow over the rocks as well as the shore.  The anchor chain trails down the side of the ship, and disappears into the depths of the river.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Tattered cobwebs hang from the ceiling and cover the dusty, brass oil lamp.  Painted on the wall beside a wide staircase are the words Staff Only.  A dented brass lantern hangs from the ceiling.  Tiny fungi grow in the cracks of the wide-planked floor.  A skeleton lies crumpled beside the staircase.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: A single large terra cotta pot, bathed in the rays from a dusty skylight, rests in the center of the hallway.  A faded, time-ravaged carpet covers the floor.  Arched doorways lead east and south.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Footprints mar the tiled floor of the hallway.  The words "Staff Only" are painted on the wall beside a narrow set of wooden stairs.  The lower stair railings have been indiscriminately hacked and chopped.

title: [Infirmary, Hallway]
description: Moonlight through a small, broken window set high on the wall illuminates the hallway.  Through the window you hear the blowing wind and the distant, plaintive cries of gulls.  Faint, krolvin-sized footprints lead away from some stairs.

A small, broken window set high on the wall illuminates the hallway.  Through the window you hear the blowing wind and the distant, plaintive cries of gulls.  Faint, krolvin-sized footprints lead away from some stairs.

title: [Aquarium Entrance]
description: You stand before a large brick enclosure that rises about twelve feet from the ground.  There doesn't appear to be a roof to the structure but a set of slate steps leads to the top.

title: [Zoo, Slate Path]
description: The tank below has a crack in its outer wall.  Water that flows in from the other tanks is lost through the crack leaving this one dry.  A variety of different sized skeletons of fish lie scattered about the tank.  The only living thing in the tank is a small tree, growing near the center, that gathers its nourishment from the water that flows through.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A cool draft drifts down a staircase.  Carved from the very granite of the walls, it appears to lead up to a second floor.  A rusty iron handrail held in place by two loose rivets provides the only support on the stairway.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: A cool draft blows down the spiral stone staircase in this corner of the hallway, sending the dust on the floor into intricate spirals in the air.

title: [Citadel, Hallway]
description: Spiraling upward, the black stone staircase is cut from the very stone of the wall of the Citadel.  Lining the hallway to the west is wood paneling covered in a thin layer of dust, occasionally gutted by the presence of dry rot and scarred by claw marks.

title: [Citadel, Battlement]
description: The floor in the corner of the battlement drops away into a spiraling stone staircase that vanishes below.  On either side of the staircase, the crenellated walls of the battlement run to the west and to the east, periodically marked by rusting flagpoles absent any streaming banners.

title: [Troll Lair, Long Hall]
description: The stench lessens as you continue along the passage, yet you are still surrounded by filth.  Rotting leaves and gamey-smelling skins litter the floor.  Dried blood stains the walls and floors, which are pitted and marked as if they had been hit with something heavy.  A large skin lies in the center of the hall.

title: [The Pit]
description: You are trapped in a very deep pit.  It really smells of rotted meat here.  If you dare to look about you, you'll see the moldy bones of others who did not escape.

title: [The Stone Eye, Den]
description: Overstuffed armchairs, upholstered in comfortable rolton cotton dyed in muted oranges and browns, are arranged in small groups around the room.  A large fireplace warms the air around you with its lively blaze.  A picture window allows an unobstructed view of the river below and the delta in the distance.  An arched doorway leads out to the veranda.  The silky, slow, susurrations of river water passing over rocks lend an atmosphere of peace to the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, southwest, down

title: [The Stone Eye, Top of the Eye]
description: Small ebonywood dining tables are situated such that every diner has a magnificent view of the countryside:  River's Rest, the river below and the Citadel of Elanith above.  Oaken frames supporting massive panes of glass make up the walls and ceiling of the circular dining area.  Bustling servants seem to be at your shoulder at your slightest whim to satisfy your every need.

title: [The Stone Eye, Stage]
description: Four rows of wooden benches sit astride a small aisle, allowing theatre-goers an unobstructed view of the small granite-floored stage.  Limelights are arranged around the base of the stage for use during productions.  Burgundy velvet curtains adorned with golden rope provide an accent to the colorful backdrop depicting a sunny day by a river.

title: [The Stone Eye, Basement]
description: Damp and dark, the room is constructed out of large blocks and thick oak timbers.  Lined up on one wall are a series of wooden crates stacked upon each other, while on the opposite wall are numerous iron-bound casks.  Water trickles from nearly invisible cracks in the walls, creating pools of water in several spots on the granite floor which reflect light from a handful torches set against the wall.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Quarterdeck]
description: Looking forward from the quarterdeck rail you can see the shattered mainmast lying across the main deck and the splintered starboard bulwark.  The masthead reaches down to the reef below.  A hatchway leads into the officer's quarters.  A short flight of steps leads up to the poopdeck and a narrow companionway ladder leads down to the main deck.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Poopdeck]
description: The deck slants to starboard.  The mizzenmast has been broken a few yards above the deck.  Although the mizzen masthead dangles dangerously above it is held aloft by the remains of the standing rigging, the shrouds and stays taut as bowstrings.  The wind blows through the ship's bell, an oddly-shaped bit of brass tubing, creating an eerie, sepulchral moan.  Steps lead down to the quarterdeck.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Quarterdeck]
description: Looking forward from the quarterdeck rail you can see the shattered mainmast lying across the main deck and the splintered starboard bulwark.  The masthead reaches down to the reef below.  A hatchway leads into the officer's quarters.  A short flight of steps leads up to the poopdeck and a narrow companionway ladder leads down to the main deck.

title: [Krolvin Carrack, Main Deck]
description: The starboard-slanting deck is littered with rigging and tackle.  The belaying pins in the portside pin-rail have all been ripped away.  Part of the broken mainyard lies in the bulwarks.  A narrow companionway ladder leads up to the quarterdeck.

title: [Marsh Keep, Courtyard]
description: Stone steps lead upward to the parapet of the outerwall along the perimeter of the courtyard.  A stone trough placed next to the steps is filled to the brim with tepid and foul-smelling rain water, and home to numerous insects which dart across the water's surface.  Set next to the trough is a rotting wooden bucket, set on its side and slowly collapsing inward on itself under the stress and decay of time.

title: [Marsh Keep, East Parapet]
description: Stone steps lead down to the courtyard below, beginning at the point where the parapet extends from the wall of the keep, and running south until turning west.  From between the crenellated granite walls of the parapet, the view of the surrounding fens and marshes goes on for some while, partially covered in patchwork blankets of fog before disappearing completely in a shroud of grey and white.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, South]
description: A dense jumble of collapsed walls and toppled pillars gives way to a scattering of stone blocks spread across an open plaza to the west.  A flight of wide stone steps leads up to the back of a building that is perched upon base of stone.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Asylum Square]
description: A high portico, still retaining a portion of its roof, extends out from the back of the building.  Vines twine up the supportive columns of the structure and out across the walls.  A brick walkway, badly overgrown with wild grass and moss, leads up to a gaping space in the wall of the building where once hung doors of more perishable material than the surviving bricks and stone.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Market Road]
description: To the northeast, the dark silhouette of a great and spacious building rises into sight.  With the foundation supporting it blocked from view, the shadowed edifice appears to float in brooding silence above the ruined city.  A few stone steps lead up to a high platform that spreads out to the north.

To the northeast, a great and spacious building rises into sight.  With the foundation supporting it blocked from view, the sparkling white edifice appears to float in brooding silence above the ruined city.  A few stone steps lead up to a high platform that spreads out to the north.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: The road to the north opens out into a wide plaza that encircles a huge tower of cut granite blocks.  Down a few steps to the south can be seen the collapsing remains of a residential section of the city.  The cracked pieces of what may have once been a green marble pedestal lie in a jumbled heap at the southwestern corner of the plaza.

title: [Dry Ring Pool]
description: A raised island sits in the middle of a sunken granite ring, and a granite stairway rises from the center of the ring to a room above.  From the marks all along the sunken ring, it appears that people descended the stairway from above in order to draw water from a sunken ring pool.  Once-colorful frescoes, now faded and cracked, adorn the walls above the outside edge of the pool.

title: [Basilica, Lower Level]
description: This room appears to have been cut directly out of the dark grey granite from which the outer pyramid was composed.  The room forms a six-pointed star that is slightly rounded at the tips.  At the eastern point of the star a marble staircase spirals out of sight to the floor above you, while at the western point a stairway drops to the floor below.

title: [Basilica, Lower Level]
description: This room appears to have been cut directly out of the dark grey granite from which the outer pyramid was composed.  The room forms a six-pointed star that is slightly rounded at the tips.  At the eastern point of the star a marble staircase spirals out of sight to the floor above you, while at the western point a stairway drops to the floor below.

title: [Basilica, East Apse]
description: This octagonal room appears to be some sort of council chamber, for centered within it is a large, circular table cut from red marble and surrounded by eight obsidian chairs.  The floor and walls, also of obsidian, are polished to a high sheen, and inlaid in the floor is a silver eight-pointed star.  A staircase, cut into the stone at the perimeter of the room, spirals out of sight to the floors above and below you.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Foothill]
description: A flight of cracked stone steps lead up the final slope of the hill, ending at the base of a large tower.  A faint breeze brings the sound of running water up from the river flowing past the base of the hill to the east.

A flight of cracked stone steps lead up the final slope of the hill, ending at the base of a large tower.  A faint breeze brings the sound of running water up from the river flowing past the base of the hill to the east.  Further on a pyramid, as tall as the hill and nearly as wide, lifts a sparkling white marble structure high above the city.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Observatory]
description: A grey tower thrusts itself up from the pinnacle of the hill like a finger pointing toward the stars.  Each block of granite making up the wall of the tower is carved with varying sizes of eight-pointed stars. Etched into the keystone of the arched entrance leading into the tower is the rounded orb of a full moon.  A flight of broken stone steps leads back down the side of the hill.

A grey tower thrusts itself up from the pinnacle of the hill like a finger pointing toward the sun.  Each block of granite making up the wall of the tower is carved with varying sizes of eight-pointed stars. Etched into the keystone of the arched entrance leading into the tower is a multi-rayed representation of the sky.  A flight of broken stone steps leads back down the side of the hill.

title: [Observatory, Lower Level]
description: Stone steps descending from the floor above continue to circle around the perimeter of this basement room, dropping down out of sight to another level below.  The air here is musty, smelling of damp earth and rock dust.  Smoke blackened marks on the stone walls indicate where torches must have once burned in this subterranean room.

title: [Forgotten Pool]
description: A spacious circular room chiseled directly out of the granite rock bed surrounds what may once have been a shallow pool.  The sides of the pool slope slowly down to the center of the room where they suddenly plunge into a dark hole perhaps six feet wide.  Circular stairs, cut into the walls of the room, rise to the Observatory above, following faded pictures inked into the granite.  A musty odor pervades the area, and there is a noticeable lack of air circulation.

title: [Aqueduct]
description: A layer of water only a foot deep covers the floor of what once was an aqueduct for the city above.  A tunnel runs off in six directions from this point to carry the water to the thirsty residents.  A hole leads upward, and a small amount of light filters down from the hole.  The main illumination, however, is provided by a light green glow from the water underneath.  The air is still and cool, and sounds echo easily off the cramped walls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: The long woody branches of a vine creep up the southern wall of the amphitheatre then descend across the tiered benches toward the ground below in a thick curtain of green.  A thick, sweet fragrance rises from the tubular orange blossoms clustered along the stems of the vine.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]

paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: Moisture has washed out portions of the substrate beneath the retaining wall of the amphitheatre, dotting the upper platform with potholes.  Dark stains caused by leached out minerals carried by streams of rain water ripple down over the cracked benches that slump in uneven rows toward the ground below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A pile of granite blocks rises to the north.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: A narrow path formed by the remains of a long stone bench picks its way between haphazard piles of crumbling granite blocks.  It would be possible, by climbing over the fallen stone, to descend to the grassy area to the south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]

paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]
description: Broken stone slabs sliding down a steep incline is all that remains of the tiered benches that once ran along the eastern side of a wide field.  A narrow platform along the edge of a retaining wall leads to the northwest and south.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheatre]

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Southeast]
description: The short jagged edges of a row of broken towers thrust skyward, like a line of upraised swords, along the edge of the path.  Running between each tower is a ragged line of dirt and stone, the last remnants of a low wall that once enclosed a large open square to the north.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, River Edge]
description: A narrow path leading between the edge of the river and a high wall to the south ends at the base of flight of granite stairs that rises up toward the top of the wall.  Spiky bulrush shoves its way between the broken slabs of the stone paving the surface of the path, working toward the wall with a relentless persistence that harbors no thought of failure.

title: [Basilica Platform, Second Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the west of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below. Another set of steps lead up to the third level of the pyramid.

To the west of the pyramid, a long straight road running between a series of massive statues leads to the city walls.  Wide stone steps drop down to the platform below. Another set of steps climb up to the third story of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, Third Level]
description: A building constructed of gleaming white marble is enthroned upon the pinnacle of the pyramid.  No vegetation climbs the pristine heights of the exterior walls. No dirt or signs of erosion mar the ornate carvings that surround the arched entrance leading into its massive hall. It is as if time has come to halt atop this lofty tower.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North Valley]
description: A massive oak tree grows across the rock-strewn path, branches spreading out in regal glory in all directions, acorns dispersed in profuse abundance about its base.  Scattered up the side of the hill are a few oak saplings, twisted and bent, like the unnourished offspring of a prolific, but uncaring despot.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Treetop]
description: A canopy of leaves blocking out most of the view of the sky and the ground below gives this treetop perch a feeling of privacy.  It is not exactly quiet here, but the sleepy trill of roosting birds and whisper of a breeze passing over verdant green foliage is pleasant and soothing.  The trunk of the oak descends to the ground below.

It is not exactly quiet here, but the bright song of birds and whisper of a breeze passing over verdant green foliage is pleasant and soothing.  The trunk of the oak descends to the ground below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, North]
description: An oak tree divides the animal trail running along the perimeter of the wall into two narrow paths that circle its trunk then merge once more on the other side.  A thick carpet of leaves and a sprinkling of acorns cover the ground beneath its branches.  Young saplings sprout near the edge of the path, but are nearly unnoticeable amongst the underbrush.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Northeast]
description: A huge, gnarled oak tree has forced its way over the crumbling remnants of the city wall.  It sits enthroned atop the mound of its fallen enemy with branches spread in exultant glory.  Oaken descendants cluster about it, like children at a grandsire's knee, creating a barrier as impenetrable as the conquered wall.

title: [Glaesen Star, Fo'c'sle Deck]
[Glaesen Star, Fo'csle Deck]
description: Topped by maroon glaes trim, the crenellated, oaken bulwarks that surround this deck create a fantastic blend of ship and castle.  Immediately aft of the foremast, the galley chimney rises through the middle of the steam grating: a cylinder of heat-discolored black iron surrounded by a gleaming symmetry of ebon glaes.  Aft of the grating stands the belfry, itself a testimony to the skill of the glaes-crafters' art.

title: [Upper Deck 'Midships]
description: Holystoned to the color of pale honey, the oak planking here in the waist of the vessel stretches from the base of the forecastle to the break of the aftcastle.  The expanse of deck is interrupted by the polished ashwood-and-glaes mass of the main capstan, the white glaes gratings of the two main cargo hatches, and the base of mast.  From here ladders lead up to the aftcastle deck, the fo'c'sle deck forward, and down to the maindeck below.

title: [Glaesen Star, Foremast Shrouds]
description: The triangular sweep of shrouds, laddered with ratlines, tapers from their base beyond the fo'csle bulwark, past the fore yard to end at the fore topcastle above.  Angled from the chain wales outboard along the hull to the formast above, the tilt of the shrouds, and the ratlines, make this a secure perch above the fo'csle deck.  From here you can climb down the shrouds to the fo'csle deck, or climb up the rigging to the topcastle.

title: [Locks and More, Salesroom]
description: A faded plum rug rests in the center of this room, glass cases holding various different kinds of lockpicks lining the walls around it.  Upon the carpet is an oak pedestal with a carving of a man kneeling and attempting to pick open a box.  Locks of all shapes and sizes hang upon the walls and a curved iron staircase leads upstairs.  The unadorned windows have been left open, allowing a fragrant breeze to waft through the area.

The unadorned windows have been left open, allowing the cool night air to enter the room.

title: [Locks and More, Workshop]
description: The ceiling slants downward from a peak overhead, mimicking the shape of the roof above.  Hooks have been placed on the lower part of the ceiling towards one side of the room, various tools used in the art of locksmithing and repairing lockpicks hanging from them.  Beneath them is a worn oak table that looks as though it might once have been a fine piece.  Windows up near the peak of the ceiling on either side of the room provide the only light, the lamps overhead unlit.

title: [Atrium, Entry]
description: Green-veined white marble tiles cover the floor, a few small potted palms resting atop it here and there.  Thick glass panes set into the roof overhead allow plenty of sunlight into the area, illuminating the many paintings hung on the white painted walls and emphasizing the sheer height of the room.  Hallways on either side of the room lead to the locker booths, while a spiral staircase leads to the balcony above.

title: [Atrium, Balcony]
description: Sunlight streams through the glass panes set into the roof overhead, providing ample light for an excellent view of the area below.  A white stone balustrade edges the balcony, a few small potted palms placed at regular intervals along it.  A marble arch opens into a long hallway.

title: [Firefly Villa, Approach]
description: Crushed shells follow a curving path as it winds its way through the foliage, their mother-of-pearl underbellies sparkling in the sunlight.  A series of low wooden steps leads to the inn's porch, which is draped in trailing exotic vines laden with brightly hued flowers that sway slightly in the seaborne breeze.

title: [Firefly Villa, Porch]
description: Wrapped by spindled banisters, the porch is crafted of golden linden and preserved beneath a varnish of clear lacquer.  A painted wooden sign sways slightly in the breeze and casts shadows upon a pair of low wooden steps, which spill out into a pathway of crushed seashells.  Warm sunlight reflects off of the painted glass windows of the double-wide doors that lead into the inn.

description: Crushed velvet carpets, thin and narrow, occupy the center of the floor where the northern and western corridors meet, their dark colors bleeding down the spiral stairs positioned within the curve of the white stucco wall. description: Polished paneling reflects the light the candles that are housed within wrought iron wall scones, their warm glow providing ample illumination throughout the small lobby.  Tall and wide, an alcove recessed into the northern wall housing a plethora of cubbies is guarded by a circular teak and cedar desk, while a set of spiraling stairs leads to the second level.

title: [Glaesen Star, Aftercastle Deck]
description: Running almost a third of the length of the ship, this castle deck wears the same crenellated bulwarks and maroon glaes trim as the fo'csle castle deck. The ship's wheel stands aft of the mizzen mast and forward of the bonaventure mast, where the helmsman can keep an eye on the ship's main sails and any shifts in the wind.  From here the aftcastle ladder leads down to the upper deck.

title: [Forward Maindeck Companionway]
description: A driftwood framed doorway pierces the forward bulkhead here with a mural covering the bulkhead to its right.  From here you can go aft.

title: [Aftcastle Companionway]
description: Black walnut wainscotting below silvery haon paneling lines this hallway.  The aftcastle door is at one end of this companionway, with the gold inlaid black walnut door of the Captain's cabin filling the other.  A heavily grained monir door in the starboard bulkhead bears the Master's plaque, while ashwood and oak doors in the port bulkhead are marked with the Pilot's and First Mate's plaques.

title: [Maindeck Aft Companionway]
description: The four glaes doors of the passengers' cabins open off of this short hallway.  The white and maroon glaes doors are set in the starboard bulkhead and the golden and black doors pierce the port bulkhead.  The ladder leading to the upperdeck is at the forward end of the hall.  From here you can go forward.

title: [Glaesen Star, Foremast Shrouds]
description: The triangular sweep of shrouds, laddered with ratlines, tapers from their base beyond the fo'csle bulwark, past the fore yard to end at the fore topcastle above.  Angled from the chain wales outboard along the hull to the formast above, the tilt of the shrouds, and the ratlines, make this a secure perch above the fo'csle deck.  From here you can climb down the shrouds to the fo'csle deck, or climb up the rigging to the topcastle.

title: [Glaesen Star, Fore Topcastle]
description: This tiny, battlemented platform is perched high above the fo'csle deck, where the lower mast ends and the topmast begins. A lubber's hole provides access to the rigging below.

title: [Glaesen Star, Mizzen Topcastle]
description: Perched high above the aftcastle castle deck, this tiny platform is battlemented like a miniature tower.  The lower mast ends here, but the topmast begins here and reaches higher.  A lubber's hole provides access to the rigging below.

title: [Glaesen Star, Mainmast Shrouds]
description: The triangular sweep of shrouds, laddered with ratlines, tapers from their base beyond the aftcastle bulwark, past the main yard to end at the main topcastle above.  Angled from the chain wales outboard along the hull to the main mast above, the tilt of the shrouds, and the ratlines, make this a secure perch above the aftcastle deck.  From here you can climb up the rigging to the topcastle, or down the shrouds to the aftcastle deck.

title: [Glaesen Star, Main Topcastle]
description: This battlemented platform sways high above the upper deck.  The lower mast ends here, and the main topmast rises to the crow's nest and the topgallant mast beyond. This is as high as passengers are allowed to climb.  A lubber's hole provides access to the rigging below.

title: [Old Manor, Dining Room]
description: Squeezing past a collapsed archway, you gaze upon an immense oak table stretching the length of the room.  Ornately carved dragons form the table legs, their claws giving the illusion of melding into the floor.  Eerily, the table is still highly polished and unscathed by the destruction around it, as if nary a flame had licked upon it.  You can't help but wonder why the impoverished residents of the area never carted it off.

title: [Old Manor, Bedroom]
description: Atop some battered stairs, you find the blackened remains of the master bedroom.  Scorched and looted of its past grandeur, all that remains is a carved window seat, covered with scraps of burnt grey velvet.  Gazing past the broken glass window frame, you look down upon the twisted ruins of a small garden.

title: [The Mother Lode, Lobby]
description: Cheerful arrangements of flowers brighten up the corners of this rustic Inn.  A small red couch faces the front desk, providing a spot for weary travellers to rest before seeing their room.

title: [The Mother Lode, Hallway]
description: Mining lanterns have been transformed into soft lighting fixtures on either side of the doors to the rooms.  Well-scrubbed oak tables stand at the ends of the hallway.  A lace doily and vase is on one table, while the other is bare.

title: [Brewery, Kitchen]
description: Sweltering heat radiates from huge copper vats which fill the room.  Suffocating waves of humidity wash over you with each breath you take.  Occasional whiffs of steam hiss, forced out between loosely-jointed pipes above your head, mussing your hair and singeing your ears.  A set of stout wooden steps disappears through the ceiling.

title: [Brewery, Store Room]
description: Casks, kegs, barrels and large crockery jugs crowd the room, stacked high among the eaves as far as you can see.  A few shards of light slant in from above, spotlighting sparks of dust as they knife to the floor.

title: [Marienna's Market, Foyer]
description: The tiny foyer opens up into a small shop, the surrounding smooth walls cut with arches leading into even smaller alcoves.  Half-curtains of sheer lace generously allow the moonlight to spill in from the front windows, while several invar sconces add illumination to brighten the darker corners.  A small flight of switch-backing stairs carved right into the rockface climbs up along one wall.

paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Marienna's Market, Loft]
description: The airy retreat features a small sleeping alcove, curtained with gauzy spidersilk, that looks out on a room painted realistically to resemble the canopy of a forest.  Overhead, a large round opening lets in the daylight, the rendered tree tops arching to meet the sky.  Off to the side, a cage filled with a couple of love birds dangles over a small rock-lined waterfall that functions as a bathing area.  A large window leads out to a tiny balcony.
