title: [Suniel's Pantry]
description: Shelves filled with provisions and lined with baskets and jars crowd this part of the hallway, passing through a small pantry.  A thick maoral door posted with a small birch bark sign framed with dried oak-leafed branches stands open, and reveals some steps that traverse downward.

title: [Suniel's Wine Cellar]
description: Directly in the center of the cellar is a wooden table with various refreshments artfully arranged across its smooth surface.  Invar sconces illuminate the filled wine racks that line the stone walls, showcasing their contents proudly.

title: [Golden Helm, Long Corridor]
description: The hallway appears brighter and wider than you expect, due to the high vaulted ceiling.  Three heavy wood wheels, heaped with candles of varying heights, are suspended from the ceiling by blackened iron chains.  A complete suit of mithril armor stands guard beside the steps.

title: [Golden Helm, Narrow Corridor]
description: A tapestry carpet in red and gold runs the length of the hall.  Several elaborate iron sconces hold thick beeswax candles.  Beneath the narrow window at the hall's end is a small maoral table with an exquisite floral arrangement placed neatly on it.

title: [Canyon, Siren's Path]
description: The trail ends in a set of stone stairs carved into the canyon wall, leading up to the ridge above.  A cluster of flowering cactus at the edge of the trail provides a home to several small green lizards which crawl among the spiny plants, searching for insects.

title: [Canyon, Dragon's Ridge]
description: A row of small houses are set along the east side of the red stone ridge, facing the view of the mist-shrouded sea far in the distance.  Piles of grey and red boulders line the edge of the canyon where it drops off to the moors below, and a set of stairs carved into the stone lead down to the south.

title: [Stormbrow Gallery, Lobby]
description: Sunlight filters in throught the gates, glittering off a wide staircase that leads upward, spiraling round and round beneath the enormous, glass dome ceiling.  The room is quite spacious, and though sparsely decorated, exudes a sense of elegance and respect.

The moonlight adds an ethereal glow to the torchlight in the room.  A wide staircase leads upward, spiraling round and round beneath the enormous, glass dome ceiling.  Even at night, the sparsely decorated room exudes a sense of elegance and respect.  A seemingly endless blue-black sky glitters with the hundreds of white starstones that dangle from the ceiling far overhead.

title: [Gallery, Above the Isle]
description: A circular balcony fashioned of brilliantly polished mithril surrounds the entire room.  Daylight streams through the domed ceiling above, though the vision below is far more ominous.  Ascending from far below is a model of the Eye of V'tull, its cone rising through the center of the balcony's ring.  Its edge is close, just on the other side of the balcony's rail.

A circular balcony fashioned of brilliantly polished mithril surrounds the entire room.  The domed ceiling above sparkles with the reflection of torchlight off the hundreds of white starstones that dangle from the blue-black canopy.  Ascending from far below is a model of the Eye of V'tull, its cone rising through the center of the balcony's ring.  Its edge is close, just on the other side of the balcony's rail.

title: [Hog's Pen]
description: This rugged tavern is a single great hall, windowless and choked with smoke from its blazing hearth and the long pipes favored by many of the local dwarves.  Tables and benches are scattered about, clumped here and there in bunches where a large group of miners or a logging team has staked a claim.  A row of barrels set on end near the fire and tended by a gruff bearded fellow seems to serve as a bar.  Around it, rain and ale have softened the dirt floor to mud.

title: [The Hog's Pen, Citizens Lounge]
description: In a stark contrast with the dirt and filth above, this plush lounge is filled with luxurious amenities.  Diagonal black and alizarin stripes line the walls, while an iridescent triton hide rug covers the floor in front of a a glossy obsidian fireplace.  Adorned with golden golvern studs, a leather-edged hammered glaes bar stretches from one side of the room to the other, displaying a massive aged oak cask, while a supple black leather couch rests in the corner, ready to provide rest to the weary traveler.

title: [Ruined Temple, Dais]
description: Gentle waves ebb and flow across the short dais, crashing into the carved staircase that leads to the floor above.  Several large metal pots, etched with intricate wavy designs, rest at the base of the staircase, rusted and worn where submerged.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A pair of bronze fire bowls rests near the base of the wall, one toppled and both beyond repair.  Streams of water form puddles that flow silently down to the depths below.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A spiral staircase climbs up to third floor of the temple, and is flanked on either side by a large stone statue carved to resemble a large water droplet.  The flooded water reaches to the statues' middles, where wavy patterns have been formed by years of erosion.  A single tapestry, soaked with moisture, hangs from the northwestern wall, and a rusted iron bar rests opposite it.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: From the submerged floor below, water laps gently, echoing through this roofless chamber.  An armless statue of a woman gazes upon a collapsed section of wall, soot marring her otherwise flawless ivory visage.  Bleached bones lay in the shadow of the statue.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Water streams down from the ceiling above in quickly paced drops, splattering before gaining momentum and running to the east through the grooves carved in the stone floor.  A short set of descending stairs, half submerged below the high water level, leads to the northeast, while to the south, a single pillar has collapsed, but does not impede travel in that direction.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A pair of rusted iron sconces flank the doorway that rests at the top of half-submerged ascending stairs.  The room is otherwise unadorned, and there is no evidence to suggest it ever was.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: The shattered remnants of a large clay vase rest on a shelf carved into the northern wall, the shards adorned with painted waves.  Some descending stairs rest at the base of an elaborately carved archway along the eastern wall, flanked by a pair of long extinguished fire pots.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Daylight streams in through a window along the northern wall, revealing dark scorch marks along the stone walls.  The floor is completely submerged below nearly a foot of water, and several large pieces of rotted wood float about haphazardly.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Tiny streams of water trickle through grooves carved into the floor, gathering to form puddles that pour over the staircase to the water below.  The walls are slick with moisture, and small drops of water occasionally fall from the ceiling above.  A toppled bronze fire cauldron rests near a marred stone sea serpent statue, both of which have been blackened and stained with smoke.

title: [Ruined Temple, Dais]
description: Gentle waves ebb and flow across the short dais, crashing into the carved staircase that leads to the floor above.  Several large metal pots, etched with intricate wavy designs, rest at the base of the staircase, rusted and worn where submerged.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A pair of large stone statues, carved to resemble large droplets of water, rests on either side of the spiral staircase that leads to the floor above.  The statues are partially submerged and have been bleached with natural wavy patterns formed by years of sea meeting rock.  Ruined tapestries cling to the walls, soaked with the moisture that has claimed dominance over the room.

title: [Ruined Temple, Third Floor]
description: Constant exposure to the brine of the sea has encrusted the bases of several pillars with salt.  Cracked pottery has been bleached and worn well from the elements, piled in a small area around a leaning marble column.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: Boulders the size of small huts are melted into the wall frozen for eternity, their slow arduous journey from the bowels of the earth now ended.  Steam escapes from around some of the boulders giving them the appearance of bleeding, as lighter elements are forced through the cracks in the wall with the great pressure of the steam.  To one side, a pile of rubble and rocks cast into a heap by the passage of magma takes on an eerie silhouette within the shroud of drifting smoke and fog.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Circle of Stone]
description: Huge boulders ring a small, circular area, with a cliff face to protect the far side.  The stones shield the spot from the oppressive heat, making it seem almost temperate compared to the raging fury on the other side of the barrier.  In stark contrast to the rough, blasted surroundings, a statue stands in the center of the clearing, formed of pale grey marble.  Its form is a model of strength and noble symmetry.

title: [The Edge]
description: The trail curves sharply to the northeast, circling jagged stone perimeters and sidling along gullied rents.  Loose shale creates a downward slide south of that, where large, irregularly configured knives of stone stick up out of the scree here and there as the decline disappears into the gloom.  A low hissing can be heard, the sound of steam escaping from unseen fissures elsewhere in the cavern.  It rises and falls in volume, like gusts of wind sighing around a closed window during a storm.

title: [McKyren's Road]
description: A steep slope ends at the edge of a raised path of stone slabs.  Each slab is irregularly shaped, yet fits perfectly into its neighboring tiles, and the surfaces are smooth and level.   This was obviously constructed, since the rock composing it is both a different type and color from the adjacent walls.   The color, a light pinkish red, is a luminous contrast to the gloom and grey stone surrounding it.

title: [Lobby]
description: This square room seems to have been carved out of solid rock, as evidenced by the smooth, hard walls.  A simple, deep brown rug covers the center of the floor.  A mural has been painted on one wall, covering it from floor to ceiling with a detailed image of the Eye of V'Tull.  Two granite benches sit against the adjacent walls, and a refreshment cart stands in the corner.  A sign hangs over a carved stone stairway, and a rounded arch is carved in the fourth wall, nearly hidden by deep blue curtains.

title: [Kharam Dzu, Departure Annex]
description: This room is sparse, having no seating or amenities.  Wall-mounted torches provide illumination for the room's only decoration, a portrait hanging on an otherwise bare wall.  A sign hangs near a carved stone stairway.

title: [Dargeur's Armors]
description: Leather and metal armor of all shapes and sizes covers the walls of this establishment.  Oil lamps hang from the ceiling, dangling on rusted chains.  A brawny half-elf leans upon the wooden counter, eyeing the customers from half-closed eyes.

title: [Dargeur's Armors, Upper Room]
description: Glancing around the interior of the room reveals several sturdy looking armor stands.  Various types of armor, from leather to plate, rest atop the stands for display.  Polished shields have been hung from the walls and seem to stand guard over the room.  Somewhere nearby the distinct sound of a hammer striking an anvil can be heard.

title: [Solhaven Arms]
description: Polished wooden cases line the room, containing a wide assortment of weapons.  Echoing through the shop is the sound of a hammer striking metal.  A stocky Dwarf stands nearby, smiling to herself.

title: [Solhaven Arms, Upper Room]
description: All manner of weapons have been neatly hung along the walls for display.  Deadly looking blades and maces gleam silently as they hang, and seem to beckon you towards adventure.  A polished fel counter sits in the center of the room, and is strewn with packages awaiting pickup.

title: [Solhaven Town Hall]
description: The Hall lobby is packed with people as merchants, fishermen, hunters and townsfolk alike mill about, doing their business.  A bust of the Baron of Vornavis occupies a nearby niche.  A wide staircase leading upwards is lined with gilt-framed portraits, and a brass plaque hangs upon the opposite wall.

title: [Solhaven, Upper Town Hall]
description: The bustle of the milling crowds below hardly troubles the quiet of the upper hall.  Sunlight streams in from a large window by the wide staircase leading downward, illuminating motes of dust.  Thick carpets of rich aquamarine and cerulean tones line the hallway, muffling the tread of the occasional prosperous merchant or adventurer who has business with the town officials.

The bustle of the milling crowds below hardly troubles the quiet of the upper hall.  Pewter sconces line the hall and a wide staircase, their highly polished surfaces reflecting and amplifying the flickering light of tall beeswax candles.  Thick carpets of rich aquamarine and cerulean tones line the hallway, muffling the tread of the occasional prosperous merchant or adventurer who has business with the town officials.

title: [Marienna's Market, Loft]
description: The airy retreat features a small sleeping alcove, curtained with gauzy spidersilk, that looks out on a room painted realistically to resemble the canopy of a forest.  Overhead, a large round opening lets in the daylight, the rendered tree tops arching to meet the sky.  Off to the side, a cage filled with a couple of love birds dangles over a small rock-lined waterfall that functions as a bathing area.  A large window leads out to a tiny balcony.

The airy retreat features a small sleeping alcove, curtained with gauzy spidersilk, that looks out on a room painted realistically to resemble the canopy of a forest.  Overhead, a large round opening reveals the starry night, the rendered tree tops arching to meet the sky.  Off to the side, a cage filled with a couple of love birds dangles over a small rock-lined waterfall that functions as a bathing area.  A large window leads out to a tiny balcony.

title: [Marienna's Market, Garden]
description: A thick round of grass-covered earth sits inside a wooden frame attached to an elaborate pulley and rope system, designed to roll into the opening like a plug.  The top of this hillock has been worked to create a small garden, the bordered flower beds edged with a variety of fragrant herbs.  A slight whiff of sulphur occasionally scents the air here, sending up a puff of steam from a partially hidden hot spring.

title: [Repository, Ceilings]
description: Artful renditions of miniature ceilings are displayed on velvet-topped glaesine counters, while clerks stand at attention, ready to assist the nearest eager customer.  The pale blue-grey granite floor comes to an abrupt halt at a sweeping staircase to the north.

title: [Repository, Sign Room]
description: The pale maple floor's wide planks extend in all directions and pale ivory walls allow available light to bounce about best.  Three golden easels each contain the room's catalog, while sample signage is hung high against the walls, above the arches leading to other shops.  A broad, semicircular staircase leads down, its oak banister lacquered to a high gloss.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Kitchen]
description: A wide variety of broken and shattered cooking utensils cover the floor, and they present a very sharp and dangerous obstacle to those attempting to pass.  An old table with legs made out of what look like the bones of a giant has been pushed up against one wall near a badly dented iron stove.

title: [Bonespear Tower, Storage Area]
description: There is the slight tinge of a putrid rotting odor hanging in the air of this storeroom, but enough time has passed so that the smell is no longer offensive.  The floor is covered by trash and debris that reaches over a foot deep in some spots, but all of it is nothing more than unrecognizeable junk.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Foyer]
description: Square-cut heavy stone blocks rise from the hard-packed dirt floor to the dark ceiling fashioned of thick modwir planks and is completely devoid of windows or furnishings.  Iron bracketed torches flicker sporadically in the arctic winds that managed to escape the security of the front door, their icy tendrils also setting a bronze brazier at the heart of the room to flickering.  A circular staircase hugs the wall, its peak disappearing above, and twin arches lead deeper into the tower.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Common Room]
description: Cozy and warm, the common room has a circle of overstuffed leather armchairs and low couches arranged around an enormous stone-worked fireplace.  Rising from an opening in the rough modwir floor, the circular staircase pauses at a landing built against the wall before continuing to ring the room until it reaches a trapdoor positioned in the ceiling.  A door in the western wall leads into the barracks while a wide arch heads into the kitchen.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Common Room]
description: Cozy and warm, the common room has a circle of overstuffed leather armchairs and low couches arranged around an enormous stone-worked fireplace.  Rising from an opening in the rough modwir floor, the circular staircase pauses at a landing built against the wall before continuing to ring the room until it reaches a trapdoor positioned in the ceiling.  A door in the western wall leads into the barracks while a wide arch heads into the kitchen.

title: [Sunfist Outpost, Watch Room]
description: Chill winds ripple in the glassless windows of the watch room from all directions, their icy tendrils biting into any exposed skin they can find.  A single lantern sways from the bronze chain it is anchored to, its flickering light casting strange shadows upon the thatched ceiling.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, The Green]
description: Thick undergrowth limits travel in most directions.  The deciduous canopy closes thickly overhead, blocking much of the moonlight from reaching this tight clearing.  Blinking yellow eyes appear here and there in the foliage, remain for a moment, and disappear.  A narrow path winds off to the west, while to the east the trees have tightened to form a shadowy green tunnel.  A hill rises to the north, and a switchback ascends the steep slope.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Hall]
description: Moonlight streams through the stained glass panels of the half-roof rising on both sides.  The center is missing, leaving the hall open to the sky.  Heavily polished walnut supports arch gracefully from the sides of this oval chamber to meet in pairs high overhead.  Tiers of silver and black benches march down and forward to confront a sterling silver dais backed by a huge canvas banner.  Torches mounted on long poles stretch out from the supports and over the benches, their flames flickering brightly.

Sunlight streams through the stained glass panels of the half-roof rising on both sides.  The center is missing, leaving the hall open to the sky.  Heavily polished walnut supports arch gracefully from the sides of this oval chamber to meet in pairs high overhead.  Tiers of silver and black benches march down and forward to confront a sterling silver dais backed by a huge canvas banner.  Torches mounted on long poles stretch out from the supports and over the benches, awaiting nighttime use.

title: [Guardians of Sunfist, Outpost]
description: Utilitarian in design, the foyer is tidy, well-kept, and illuminated by copper lanterns strung between several shuttered windows.  Twin sets of double doors face one another, one leading to the path beyond and the other leading into a courtyard that is open to the sky above while remaining protected by the walls of the building on all sides.  Garment hooks to the left of the entry are arranged beneath a set of wide plank stairs leading up to the watchtowers, and open door to the right leads into the office.

Utilitarian in design, the foyer is tidy, well-kept, and illuminated by the light streaming in through a variety of open-shuttered windows.  Twin sets of double doors face one another, one leading to the path beyond and the other leading into a courtyard that is open to the sky above while remaining protected by the walls of the building on all sides.  Garment hooks are arranged beneath stairs leading up to the watchtowers, and an open door to the right leads into the main office.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Outpost, Watch Tower West]
description: Framed on three of four sides by wide open windows, the tower is bare of all furnishings and connected to the rest of the building by a thin corridor leading east and wide plank stairs leading down.  Each window provides a vantage point for a different area around the building and has shutters wrapped around them that can be pulled tight for protective shielding.  A thin pipe collects water from the roof and deposits it into a copper-banded oak barrel at the center of the room.

title: [Hearthstone, Balcony]
description: Lining the edge of this balcony, which overlooks the main lobby below, a polished oak railing glows in the soft moonlight emanating through windows high on the southern wall of the lobby.  Rich burgundy carpet underfoot softens the echo of voices drifting on the air.  To the east a fieldstone staircase curves down out of view, an alcove tucked into the wall at the top step.

Lining the edge of this balcony, which overlooks the main lobby below, a polished oak railing gleams in the warm sunlight streaming through windows high on the southern wall of the lobby.  Rich burgundy carpet underfoot softens the echo of voices drifting on the air.  To the east a fieldstone staircase curves down out of view, an alcove tucked into the wall at the top step.

title: [Hearthstone, Foyer]
description: Dark flagstone floors extend in a gleaming river of darkness beneath thick, handwoven crimson rugs in this spacious foyer.  To the north, banners of purple, blue, green, and yellow flutter from a balcony railing some fifty feet overhead.  A granite archway sweeps along the length of the western wall, and a magnificent fieldstone staircase curves upward to the east.

title: [Imaera's Grove, Passage]
description: A broad faewood rises into the enveloping canopy, nesting a modwir-paneled edifice in the midst of its branches.  Extending from the trunk, a spiral of steps wreathes the length of the tree, ending before an arched side entrance.  Columns of warm ginger-gold light stream through the leaves, casting a shifting dappled effect on the peaked roof of the temple.

A broad faewood rises into the enveloping canopy, nesting a modwir-paneled edifice in the midst of its branches.  Extending from the trunk, a spiral of steps wreathes the length of the tree, ending before an arched side entrance.  Dark silver shadows are projected from the leaves silhouetted against the moonlight, casting a shifting dappled effect on the peaked roof of the temple.

title: [Imaera's Temple, Sanctuary]
description: Elongated modwir panels are secured into a spacious semi-circular room that fans around one half of the outside tree.  Three glass-paned windows look out over the grove, illuminating the walls with tessellated bronze and copper light.  Raw silk cushions sit before an ornate faewood carving fitted against the entirety of the back wall, conforming seamlessly to the living tree trunk behind it.

Elongated modwir panels are secured into a spacious semi-circular room that fans around one half of the outside tree.  Three glass-paned windows look out over the grove, illuminating the walls with a pale lunar glow.  Raw silk cushions sit before an ornate faewood carving fitted against the entirety of the back wall, conforming seamlessly to the living tree trunk behind it.

title: [Temple of Koar, Grand Narthex]
description: Sparkling from above, a multi-tiered chandelier of brass-swirled crystal orbs imbues the narthex with sunny brilliance.  Panels of white birch gleam in the pale stone walls, each incised with the outline of a golden crown.  Across from a mosaic-tiled high golden archway, a velvet-draped marble stairway as wide as a city street rises toward a sprawling indoor plaza.

title: [Temple of Koar, Radiant Stair]
description: Moonlight streams through the darkened windows, spitting sullen amber shards across the snowy velvet runner cushioning the stairs.  Bolstering the feeble light are a series of white crystal globes spaced at intervals to either side of the street-wide stairway.

Long shafts of daylight, lent warmth and amber hue by the huge stained glass windows set in both bordering walls, infuse the stairway with blinding brilliance.  Beneath the streaming radiance and the additional glow provided by white crystal globes to either side of the street-wide stairway, the snowy velvet runner cushioning the stairs reveals a wealth of prismatic hues.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Infirmary]
description: The ramp scaling the tower comes to its end, framing a cozy infirmary.  Lined with downy beds, the careful organization of the room provides ample space to maneuver.  Across from a black steel stairwell leading up to a gap in the tower rooftop, a carved riverstone fireplace has been placed to lend heat to the cold stones encompassing the chamber.

The ramp scaling the tower comes to its end, framing a cozy infirmary.  Lined with downy beds, the careful organization of the room provides ample space to maneuver.  Across from a black steel stairwell leading up to a gap in the tower rooftop, a carved riverstone fireplace and a fired clay basket of sticks have been placed to lend heat to the cold stones encompassing the chamber.

title: [Fasthr's Lance, Crown]
description: Raised high above the green hillock that Fasthr's Lance occupies, the crenellated tower rooftop facilitates a panoramic view of Solhaven and Cairnfang Bay.  Incised shield patterns mark the top of each crenellation.  Striking yet higher, a dark ora lance hoisting a black ensign stitched with a snow-white shield proclaims the tower's allegiance.

title: [The Great Hall of Dreadnaught]
description: The domed cathedral ceiling of this great hall is crafted from the finest stained glass.  Just below the canopy, a frieze depicting significant events in Elanthian history rings the upper palisade.  A massive glass griffin sculpture stands in the center, its outstretched wings nearly touching each wall.  An elaborate red carpet connects the entrance of the sculpture with some swinging ebonwood doors and an archway.

title: [Hallway]
description: Lush deep red carpet stretches the length of the hall's floor, and portraits of the House's founders line the granite walls.  A small engraved plaque is hung at eye level for all to see.  Nestled in the center of the hall, an ebonwood balcony overlooks the Hall of Dreadnaught and its dominating griffin sculpture.  At the far end of the hall, a winding staircase leading to a heavy black iron door gives access to the tower, while a spiral stairway leads down to the ground floor.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Hall of Light]
description: Iron torches, lining the length of the domed hall, bathe the room with a soft, warm glow.  The white marble floor is covered with plush woven rugs and aged silk tapestries hang from golden cords on the rear wall.  Erected in the center of the room, on a slighty raised platform, a golden statue of an intricate luminescent globe rests upon mithril supports.

title: [Lumnis' Temple, Pool of Thought]
description: Parallel rows of benches face a large pool edged in white stone.  The pool's design is graceful and pleasing to the eye.  Marble steps surround it, offering different views of its eloquent nuances.  On the armrest of each bench is carved a sphere, the deft carvings accented in gold leaf.  Overhead, on the high, arched ceiling, the image of an ebon drake spreads its wings.  At each corner of the chamber rests a globe astride a carved marble column.

title: [Galieca's Teas and Coffees]
description: Crafted from white oak, the paneled walls of the shop contrast with darker wood trim that accents the room.  Rich blue gauzy curtains frame the glaesine windows, filtering the sunlight to a pale glow.  The walls are lined with shelves filled with packets and canisters of tea and coffee, while a rhimar-lined glass case built into the front of the counter holds various flavorings and treats.   Mugs, teacups, and silverware are tucked in a padded crate resting on the floor next to a narrow stairway.

title: [Galieca's Brewer's Retreat]
description: A thick wool rug covers the wooden floor, a carved table resting in the center.  Several cushioned chairs are set about the intimate gathering space with a large sofa taking up much of the room.  A small wicker basket is tucked to one side of a cast iron stove that occupies a shadowed corner of the room.  Curtained with blue silk, a picture window looks out over the var below.

title: [Solhaven Inn, Upstairs Hall]
description: Brass sconces on either wall light this red carpeted hall.  An incredibly ugly vase sits on a table along the north wall.  Upon the south wall is a hanging depicting the founding of Solhaven.  A wide marble staircase leads to the lower floor of the inn.

title: [A Concealed Room]
description: Crates, boxes and pieces of dusty, broken furniture are stacked along the walls of this seemingly forgotten storage room.  A simple desk and chair sit next to a narrow door.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Meeting Room]
description: This expansive chamber features a heavy oak bench that runs along each of the greystone walls.  On the wall opposite the archway leading from the cloister is a black granite speaker's rostrum.  The ceiling is crossed with sturdy ironwood beams from which hang a number of banners designating the guilds and professions that operate within the city.

title: [Moonglae Inn, Rooftop Park]
description: A pleasant little park area has been constructed on the roof of the inn, high above the bustling city streets.  A shallow, curbed planter in the center of the park is home to a thick, green lawn and a pleasant foresty odor rises from the dwarf pine trees growing in grey-blue granite planters spaced along its edge.  Two benches have been positioned to look out over the low greystone wall to the south, offering a lovely view of the sapphire-tiled roof of the bank and the rest of the city beyond.

A pleasant little park area has been constructed on the roof of the inn, high above the moonlit streets.  A shallow, curbed planter in the center of the park is home to a dew-covered lawn and a pleasant foresty odor rises from the dwarf pine trees growing in dark granite planters spaced along its edge.  Two benches have been positioned to look out over the greystone wall to the south, offering a view of the sapphire-tiled roof of the bank, which glows softly in the silvery starlight.

title: [Solhaven, Celebration Barge]
description: The Celebration Hall stands before you, its wide red-carpeted steps leading up to a pair of ornately embossed golden doors.  Rising beyond the red tiled roof of the foyer, the mithril-latticed crystal dome of the main hall glows with light from the myriad of candles within.  Tucked close in the shadow of the Celebration Hall, an ivy-covered arch pierces a neatly trimmed hedge.

The Celebration Hall stands before you, its wide red-carpeted steps leading up to a pair of ornately embossed golden doors.  Rising beyond the red tiled roof of the foyer, the mithril-latticed crystal dome of the main hall sparkling in the sunlight.  Tucked close in the shadow of the Celebration Hall, an ivy-covered arch pierces a neatly trimmed hedge.

title: [Celebration Hall, Grand Foyer]
description: Rich golden brocade covers the walls, its ivy and rose pattern drawing the eye upward to where an elaborate mural, depicting scenes from various points in Solhaven's history, covers the ceiling.  The red velvet carpet continues its journey from the steps straight towards a graceful archway, its length lined by small limestone columns, each clearly intended to hold a small statue or bust, but all currently still empty.

title: [Tyramia Hollow, Rocky Steps]
description: A steep flight of stone steps has been chiseled out of the bluff's rough face.  Carved handrails line each side of the steps' course, making the precipitous assent less hazardous.  Dogwood trees can be seen growing throughout the surrounding forest, their white flowers vivid in the forest canopy's shadows.

A steep flight of stone steps has been chiseled out of the bluff's rough face.  Carved handrails line each side of the steps' course, making the precipitous assent less hazardous.  Dogwood trees can be seen growing throughout the surrounding forest, their white flowers vivid in the forest canopy's greenish haze.

title: [Tyramia Hollow, Rocky Steps]
description: As the hillside gains altitude, the air is noticeably cooler, buffeted by constant breezes.  The terrain is much rockier than below in the valley, shot with stone outcrops and strewn with a carpet of pine needles.  Dwellings perch on the edge of the bluff and snuggle in between the huge boles of pine trees.  An immense white birch occupies a prime cliff-side vantage point to the north, its papery bark littering the ground around it.

title: [Solhaven, Abalone Street]
description: The crowd bustles with activity, shoppers entering and leaving a modest storefront where a large wooden boot hangs above the door.  A set of stairs to the right of the building lead up to a landing where a bright blue canvas slipper adorns the open door.  You are struck by the incongruence of all these races living together peacefully.  You can barely hear the sounds of the Market Square, carried inland on the ocean breeze.

title: [Solhaven, Slipper Shop Landing]
description: An open doorway dressed up with blue silk drapes lets into the building above the Cobbler's Shop, the oversized slipper nailed to the door proclaiming it as a related business.  Sheltered by the overhanging roofs of both buildings, the landing is a quiet refuge from the noise and crowds of the street below.

title: [Library, Collected Lore]
description: Three walls of this room are occupied by massive floor-to-ceiling bookshelves of gleaming mahogany.  In the middle of the room, a tall podium holds a large catalog.  The area is lit by a massive glass globe filled with darting fireflies, perhaps in an attempt to protect the library's precious contents from fire.  Sunlight falls in slanting rays from the passage created by a spiraling wrought iron staircase.

The area is lit by a massive glass globe filled with darting fireflies, perhaps in an attempt to protect the library's precious contents from fire.  Moonlight falls in slanting rays from the passage created by a spiraling wrought iron staircase.

title: [Library, Reading Tower]
description: The bare stone walls of this tall tower room rise to meet a massive dome of crystal clear glass.  Sunlight floods the area, leaving no corner untouched.  Centrally placed is a large black oak table surrounded by some long padded benches, suitable for reading as a group.  Flanking a large potted plant is a cream-colored suede chair and a soft blue chair.  A wrought iron staircase leads back down to the Collections room.

The bare stone walls of this tall tower room rise to meet a massive dome of crystal clear glass.  Centrally placed is a large black oak table surrounded by some long padded benches, suitable for reading as a group.  Flanking a large potted plant is a cream-colored suede chair and a soft blue chair.  The stars sparkle so clearly it is as though the dome does not separate this room from the night outside.  A wrought iron staircase leads back down to the Collections room.

title: [Malwith Inn, Casu's Coffee]
description: Warmly lit, the shop is littered with wood scraps, most hidden under thick drifts of sawdust.  A wood stove fills one corner, its metal black as night.  A tool bench is filled with a wide assortment of saws, hammers and other tools.  A shelf, fitted with small bins, holds nails and other fasteners.

Warmly lit, the shop is cozy and smells of fresh coffee.  Several mugs sit atop a wood stove, that fills one corner, its metal black as night.  A mistwood counter is filled with a wide assortment of flavorings and accessories.  A shelf, fitted with small bins, holds several packets of coffee.

title: [Malwith Inn, Casu's Cafe]
description: Thick crimson rugs cover the dark wood floors of the cafe.  Nestled in a corner, a wooden basket and a small refuse can sit beside a dark cast iron stove.  Several leather couches and chairs create a comfortable sitting area around a low table in the center of the room.

title: [Cavernfast, Grotto]
description: A squat cavern is ringed with carved granite beasts, which consist of a wolf, a lion, and a bear, that sit between the mouths of tunnels leading away into the underground gloom like silent sentries.  The fantastic statues are exquisite examples of stone cutting, each one displaying a lifelike demeanor.  Almost below a level of hearing, the low susurrus of rushing water provides an undercurrent of sound in accompaniment to flickering mithril braziers along the stone walls.

title: [Cavernfast, Hot Springs]
description: The ceiling arches high over a set of three interlocking circular pools.  Light shines up from beneath the pools' churning water, sending sparkling reflections off a mosaic of crystal embedded in the stone above.  The aqua water shimmers in the light, as if trying to outdo the crystals, and glistening droplets lofted by the water's agitation dance in the air above like tiny sprites.

title: [Ravelin, Riverside Dock]
description: Thick rope supported between each wooden piling creates a railing for this small river dock.  Several wooden barrels are stacked underneath a large fish-shaped sign hanging from a weathered thanot shop.  A small wooden ladder secured to the edge of the platform leads down to a boat mooring.  Fishermen move about carrying boxes of supplies and baskets of fresh fish from the day's catch.

title: [Riverside, Boat Dock]
description: Below the dock, a smaller raft-like platform floats on the river, while many large barrels keep the mooring afloat with several thick hemp ropes tying it firmly in place.  White froth churned up by the moving river dances about the edge, occasionally disturbed by small fish swimming underneath.  A few crates and barrels are stacked ready to be loaded on to one of the small fishing dories secured to the landing.

title: [Jidrael's General Shop, Entry]
description: Golden linden floorboards stretch from the arched modwir entry to the thanot panel walls, which are interrupted by double-wide windows thrown open to admit the cool river breeze.  Frosted globes are suspended from vaalin chains throughout the shop, illuminating the wares displayed in baskets, cupboards, and tables.  A long rope dangles a sign in front of a set of stairs opposite a divided door that leads outside.

title: [Jidrael's General Shop, Bedroom]
description: Sparsely furnished, the small room houses a riverstone hearth in the far corner that is flanked by glass-fronted cupboards.  The curtained four-post bed occupies the far wall beside a golden linden nightstand and a faenor-banded leather footlocker.  Beneath a frosted globe chandelier, set at the center of the room, is a small, round table with two armchairs draped with cashmere blankets.

title: [Kreldor's Locksmithy, Workroom]
description: Candle fixtures wrought of faenor hang from the high fel beamed ceiling illuminating a long birchwood counter.  Placed against the back wall is a worktable scattered with various tools, vials, and wedges for opening locked containers.  Two large windows flank a narrow ladder that leads up to a loft area.  A lush verdant fern in a large ceramic pot is placed in the far corner, its leaves falling over onto the patterned floor.

title: [Kreldor's Locksmithy, Loft]
description: Partially opened boxes and crates of supplies lie about a large workbench that dominates the small loft.  The surface is cluttered with various molds, tools, and implements for fixing small items.  A brazier with banked coals sits to the side under a domed window.  Covered with a worn homespun blanket, a small cot is set up in the far corner of the room.  At the end of the bed is a large iron-bound trunk with a sturdy padlock.

title: [Temple of Eonak, Landing]
description: This simple granite platform extends out from the south wall, supported by several granite arches anchored into the wall.  A winding stair spirals down to the floor of the sanctuary sixteen feet below, and a grey marble opening allows exit into a tunnel in the wall.  From this overhead vantage many aspects of the temple, such as the ledge, the fire ring, the fire sea, the ceiling, the anvil, and the battle axe, show aspects not apparent when viewed from the temple's floor.

title: [Temple of Eonak, West Sanctuary]
description: Towering columns chiseled from the granite rock itself leap upward to support a crystal-encrusted ceiling forty or more feet overhead.  Thick, sienna velvet carpeting extends from north wall to south wall in this cavernous sanctuary, and benches placed in rows march toward the altar that stands at least a hundred feet to the east.  All around, fire billows brightly along a ledge twelve feet up, the licking flames displaying no effect on the russet, woven mithril curtains that adorn the walls.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Museum]
description: Weapons of various types and origins are mounted on the walls to the north, west and east in this magnificent museum.  Shields bearing coats of arms and personal crests from places near and far are on display.  A glaes-bound display case dominates the center of the room.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Dyers]
description: This room is dank and damp, and smells of mold and chemicals.  Many vats containing dyes of different colors are crammed into the small space, with barely enough room to maneuver between them.  The ceiling is damp and sports brilliantly colored mosses.  The floor includes a network of trenches that drain any spilled dyes into a single vat in the rear of the room.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Museum]
description: Weapons of various types and origins are mounted on the walls to the north, west and east in this magnificent museum.  Shields bearing coats of arms and personal crests from places near and far are on display.  A glaes-bound display case dominates the center of the room.

title: [Girvahk's Shop, Upstairs Hall]
description: A worn red carpet covers a narrow strip of the hallway's hardwood floor from end to end.  The exposed floor shines as if polished daily, and no cracks or crevices appear anywhere in the length of the hallway.  A low, narrow table placed between two doors on the left and opposite the center door on the right sports a vase of fresh flowers.

title: [Bastille, Keeper's Office]
[Stockade, Keeper's Office]
description: Sharply contrasting with the grey stone walls, lush burgundy carpeting runs from wall to wall.  An elaborate desk stands opposite the heavy oak doors that separate this haven from the prison proper.  Bright with color, a collection of wall hangings decorates the office, placed just below small beveled glaes windows set high up on the walls.  Only a light drizzle of candlelight filters down from a chandelier meant to brighten the second-level loft, which is set above the northern end of the office.

title: [Bastille, Keeper's Sky Parlor]
[Stockade, Keeper's Sky Parlor]
description: A banister of dark oak lines the southern edge of this carpeted loft, allowing only a glimpse of the keeper's office below.  Providing the loft with a sweeping view of Ta'Vaalor, three large windows take up the entire northern wall.  The two adjacent walls display shelves that overflow with books.  Glinting in candlelight shed from an ornate chandelier, a solid gold plaque has been set into the carpet at the head of the stairs.

title: [Silverwood Garden]
description: A carpet of tussocky green grass is surrounded by tall cypress trees.  Moonlight filters in through the branches, and an octagonal white gazebo sits in the center of the area.  Surrounding the gazebo is a flourishing multicolored flowerbed boasting dozens of floral varieties.  Rather apart from the trees that encircle the space, a stately mahogany stands alone next to a bench and a burbling grey marble fountain.

A carpet of tussocky green grass is surrounded by tall cypress trees.  Sunlight filters in through the branches, and an octagonal white gazebo sits in the center of the area.  Surrounding the gazebo is a flourishing multicolored flowerbed boasting dozens of floral varieties.  Rather apart from the trees that encircle the space, a stately mahogany stands alone next to a bench and a burbling grey marble fountain.

title: [Silverwood Garden, Treehouse]
description: A wide platform, free of railings or restraints, has been erected among the strong branches of this tree.  A few soft sage linen cushions are tossed casually about the smooth surface, and layers of vibrant green leaves smattered with tiny white flowers provide the only walls.  Rays of moonlight slip through the twisting limbs, causing patterns of light to dance across the area with the slightest breeze.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: The floor of the warehouse creaks and groans underfoot.  A thin layer of dust coats everything, and packing straw collects in almost every corner, nook, and crack.  The boxes and crates part to allow passage to the east and north from here.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the north and east.

title: [Warehouse, First Floor]
description: The floor of the warehouse creaks and groans underfoot.  A thin layer of dust coats everything, and packing straw collects in almost every corner, nook, and crack.  The boxes and crates part to allow passage to the north and west from here.

title: [Warehouse, Second Floor Hall]
description: Tight and cramped, the second floor of the warehouse is new construction.  Underfoot, unfinished wooden floors sport frequent bent nails, and whitewashed panels of unsanded pine make up the walls.  Narrow, low hallways lead off to the north and west.

title: [Grand Dais, Altar of Crowns]
description: Illuminated by a circular shaft of sunlight blazing through a skylight above, the high altar is a tapered block of golvern draped by snow-pure silk.  Interlocking circles and arcs of gold inlay cleave the marble floor, spreading from the altar like ripples across a pond.

Pooling moonlight trickles through a skylight above, its feeble radiance catching on the edges of the high altar.  The tapered block of golvern is draped in snow-pure silk.  Interlocking circles and arcs of gold inlay cleave the marble floor, spreading from the altar like ripples across a pond.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Font of Purity]
description: The watchful eyes of a heroic crowned figure stare down from above, casting their gaze upon a tiered fountain fashioned in the shape of a rearing dragon.  Beyond the statue, a golden stairway marches up a steep incline to the dais.  Incised crowns adorn the ashen marble tiles of the floor.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Highwalk]
description: Sheltered from the radiance of the clerestory windows by an overhang of carved marble, the highwalk rises over the rear portion of the prayer plaza.  Banners of forest green silk unfurl from the overhang, each embroidered with the stylized image of a graceful white swan.

Sheltered from the moonlit radiance of the clerestory windows by an overhang of carved marble, the highwalk rises over the rear portion of the prayer plaza.  Banners of forest green silk unfurl from the overhang, each embroidered with the stylized image of a graceful white swan.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, West Stairwell]
description: Walls of textured stone encircle the pale marble stairwell at the center of the room, which climbs into a gap in the ceiling.  Glowing steadily, a phosphorescent orb crowning a wrought brass sconce lends soft light to the chamber.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Great Hall]
description: The great hall of the temple vaults about your head.  The soft shuffle of feet whisper gentle prayers to the gods. Here and there decorative niches hold sculptures depicting great mages and prophets.  To the north you glimpse the heart of the temple, the main worshiping chamber, and above you an ornate double stairway curves upward to a balcony overlook.  Beneath the stairs the hall slopes up, curving around the central chamber.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Balcony]
description: The air is thicker up here, hazy with incense and smoke.  The movement of worshipers below in the great hall meld with the spiraling mosaic pattern on the floor.  From this vantage you can see the monks performing acts of devotion in the main chamber of the temple, and the occasional visitor approaching the altar to leave a few silvers in donation.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Chamber]
description: These dim chambers serve as the private offices of the temple's monks.  Dark gray robes hang limply from tarnished brass hooks fixed to the wall.  A small urn burns some relaxing incense in the far corner.  The only luxuries are a hard wooden bench running the distance of the far wall, and a simple wooden table.  Near the back of the chamber sits a small wooden staircase.

Lurking beyond a brass crested arch, the dim chamber serves as a sanctum for the monks of the temple.  Violet-hemmed grey robes hang limply from a series of tarnished brass hooks affixed to the western wall.  Within a small crystal urn in the far corner, some grey-green wormwood incense incense burns and fills the air with its cloying scent.  Near the back of the chamber sits a small wooden staircase.

title: [Chamber of Prophecy]
description: Eerie stillness lingers on the air, heavy as the scent of wormwood incense drifting up from the chamber below.  Walls and a floor composed of highly polished brass reflect the dim luminescence washing off of a perfect silver sphere, its myriad reflections causing strange and dizzying tricks of the light.  The orb stands atop an ornately wrought brass bracket at the center of the chamber.

title: [Sanctuary of Journey]
description: Towering columns stand sentry, surrounding a large rotunda.  On an entablature above, a sculpted frieze displays a journey of trials, sorrows and victories.  Steeply angled gold-flecked blue marble steps, in the center of the room, lead to a massive free-standing altar at the summit.

title: [Altar of Illumination]
description: Resting on a tiered platform covered in relief work, an impressive altar of mountain-quarried stone stands in the middle of the chamber.  Blue granite spheres sit on each of the main compass points.  Within each banded globe is a flame, constant and resolute.  A vast, carved scroll floats above the altar, offering no clue as to the source of its suspension.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, East Stairwell]
description: Gently lit by a phosphorescent orb set into the ceiling, the small chamber centers around a gilt-trimmed pale marble stairwell.  Walls of textured marble encircle the room, broken only by an ora-bound honey oak door.

title: [Anodheles Plaza, Highwalk]
description: Stones in alternating patterns of ivory and snow white marble form a walkway held aloft by crystalline pillars and protected by a banister of twisted gold.  Bas-relief carvings of ornate crowns adorn the rear wall of the temple, which curves to follow the path of the highwalk.  Below, the plaza is a sea of bright stone punctuated by metallic-hued carpets and evenly spaced cushions in alternating hues.

title: [Watchtower, Commons]
description: Various benches are set about the room, their expanses covered with repair and polish kits, while curved chairs sport neatly folded woolen blankets in a shade of royal blue.  Standing at opposite ends of the room are two nearly identical doors, differing only in the grain of wood of which each is fashioned.  Set at a safe distance from a downward spiraling staircase is a slender ladder bound to the smooth limestone wall, which leads to an ironbound trapdoor set into the ceiling.

title: [Watchtower, Beacon]
description: Enormous windows take up each of the four cardinal points in this plain limestone room.  A small pot-bellied stove stands opposite a small round table and a pair of weathered chairs.  Dangling from the oaken rafters is a pair of tiny courier pigeon carriages, their denizens cooing softly in their sleep.

Enormous windows take up each of the four cardinal points in this plain limestone room.  A small pot-bellied stove stands opposite a small round table and a pair of weathered chairs.  Dangling from the oaken rafters is a pair of tiny courier pigeon carriages, their denizens cooing softly each to the other.

title: [Royal Court, The Palace]
description: The weathered remnants of a once prosperous gambling hall lie in ruin amidst this forsaken lot.  Stubborn weeds sprout pervasively from gaps in the distant crumbling stone wall.  Debris from the surrounding area has been amassed into a makeshift mountain of refuse.  A large faded sign hangs precariously from a single rusted chain before the gigantic heap, serving as either a welcome or a warning.

title: [Top of the Heap]
description: The summit of this mountain of debris offers a fantastic vantage point to view the entire Royal Court.  While bird droppings cover most of the miscellaneous scraps and rubble here, they are especially concentrated around a rather large and grubby nest.

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Entry]
description: Dull dark mahogany panels the entryway of the establishment, the wood probably once rich but now dusty and unpolished.  Plain egg-and-dart wainscotting adds some definition and design to the otherwise boring walls, splintering in several spots where it remains intact.  A flight of crooked wooden stairs leads up to a small landing, and double-width lintelled doors brace the hallway on each side.  Paralleling the staircase is a narrow corridor leading toward the kitchen.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [The Wage and Dagger, Landing]
description: The small, square hallway offers barely enough space to turn around in, and as a result, the boards here are well worn.  The wooden railing bows out slightly, probably from the frequency of hand traffic and people leaning their weight against the wooden slats while trying to get into their rooms.  A haon door is set on one side of the stairway landing and an ebonwood door is on the other side.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: An impressive chandelier made of spun glass hangs from the ceiling, highlighting a long winding staircase leading up to the second floor.  Plush red carpeting with dark oak runners line the mahogany paneled hallway as it stretches north.  Faint laughter and the sounds of off-key singing can be heard from the commons down the southeastern corridor.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: Here, at the top of the staircase, one has a commanding view of the area below.  The banisters sweeping down to the lower floor are intricately carved in a leaping fish motif and polished to a high luster.  A mahogany paneled hallway stretches off to the north, while the west wall across from the staircase is almost completely occupied by a large oak door.

title: [The Krawling Kraken]
description: The hall stretches north, carpeted in richly hued crimson along the floor and set with evenly spaced, engraved wall sconces made from polished brass.  Lighting from the candles illuminates the long winding staircase leading up to the second floor.  Smells of richly cooked food waft through the area each time a passing patron walks in from the dinning room.

title: [The Krawling Kraken, Upstairs]
description: A large oak door marks this hall's southern end and is situated next to a long, winding staircase that leads down to the lower level.  Polished mahogany paneling covers the western wall and the floor is covered in a fine, plush red carpet that muffles the sound of passing patrons.

title: [Ebondrift, Lower Clock Tower]
description: Unvarnished paneling of coastal pine covers the interior walls, bas-relief carved sea creatures curving up from its surface.  At random points, raised ebonwood designs -- images of objects or animals or plants sacred to specific dark gods -- have been added.  Filling one side of the room is a granite pool fed by a slanted wooden sluice.  Movement of the seawater in the sluice turns a large fel wheel, which in turn connects to a series of metal rods rising upward through a wide circular hole in the roof.

title: [Ebondrift, Upper Clock Tower]
description: This room is fashioned as something of a circular deck, with a wide hole cleaving out much of the middle of the floor and leaving walking space only nearer the walls.  Through the open portion of the floor, metal rods rise and fall in constant motion, pushing several huge gears.  Those gears in turn power other rods and smaller gears, some connecting to the causeways which slide animated figures out onto the display platform of the tower, some powering the actual workings of the timepiece.

title: [Ebondrift, Upper Clock Tower]
description: This room is fashioned as something of a circular deck, with a wide hole cleaving out much of the middle of the floor and leaving walking space only nearer the walls.  Through the open portion of the floor, metal rods rise and fall in constant motion, pushing several huge gears.  Those gears in turn power other rods and smaller gears, some connecting to the causeways which slide animated figures out onto the display platform of the tower, some powering the actual workings of the timepiece.

title: [Ebondrift, Clock Tower Steeple]
description: A series of two-dozen cast-iron bells, in sizes ranging from halfling height to giant height, fill this steeple chamber, leaving little room for walking.  Metal rods, pushing up through fitted openings in the floor, are attached to these bells.  The ceiling tapers up toward the tower's uppermost spire point, its interior painted a glossy black and embellished in silver-leaf with images of the stars of the Elanthian constellations, the mariner's directional guide since first he ventured out upon the seas.

title: [Venquinor House, Dining Room]
description: The low wooden eaves of the roof reflect wetly from the polished surface of a blond oak dining table carved from a massive single slab of wood at the center of the chamber.  Climbing through a high arch in the northern wall, some rounded riverstone steps ascend to the second level of the manor.  Mosaic tiles dance over the surface of the arch in interlocking patterns of opal and emerald tesserae.

title: [Venquinor House, Upper Hall]
description: Situated at the top of some rounded riverstone steps, the hallway is long and lushly carpeted.  Its northern wall is dominated by a muraled alcove, the vivid greens and shadowy blues of which provide a contrasting backdrop to a wide-mouthed dark jade jug.  At the hallway's end stands a pair of stained glass doors, the semi-translucent crystal panes adequately concealing the chamber beyond.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Foyer]
[Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Lobby]
description: White marble columns, set halfway into the walls, serve as both decoration and structural support for the high ceiling.  Set between them are some colorful velvet settees that offer respite for weary patrons.  The cool marble floor is interrupted by a pale gold carpet that leads up an expansive staircase.  In the center of the western wall is a green marble arch, while the eastern wall sports a white marble arch.  Across the room from a gold marble arch, a large platinum plaque and a rectangular white sign are displayed beside the oaken double doors that lead outside.

You are in the grand entry hall of the Wehnimer's Museum.  This building houses much ancient and historical lore, artifacts and antiquities.  The museum complex consists of galleries bedecked in fine works of art, wings devoted to historical artifacts, a library of rare manuscripts, a wing devoted to the natural history of Elanthia, and a Hall of Magic and Technology.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Lobby]
description: Surrounded by darkly paneled walls, this second-floor lobby mimics the opulence of the one below with its expansive marble floor and intricately painted ceiling.  Hallways lead to the east and west, while a neatly printed sign directing visitors to their destinations rests near an expansive staircase.  Across from the landing, a mahogany arch with a bas-relief floral design leads to the north.

Surrounded by darkly paneled walls, this second-floor lobby mimics the opulence of the one below with its expansive marble floor and intricately painted ceiling.  Hallways lead to the east and west, while a neatly printed sign directing visitors to their destinations rests near an expansive staircase.  Across from the landing, a mahogany arch with a bas-relief floral design leads to the north, while behind the stairs a black marble arch leads to a sunlit alcove.

title: [Griffin's Roost]
description: Two layers of metal fencing separate the trail from the edge of a steep cliff.  Extremely tall, thin posts topped with glowing glass orbs are strategically placed along the barrier, each radiating a nearly translucent web-work of faint red lines.  A long winding staircase leading up into a tall stone tower is flanked by handrails painted in bright yellow.

In the distance, beyond the trail, a mammoth nest can be seen, built in the crux of two flat stones that are braced to lean against each other.  A pair of adult griffins fly back and forth to the spot, attending to the structure itself and occasionally disappearing within.

title: [Griffin's Roost, Tower]
description: Offering a panoramic view of the surrounding habitats, the granite tower is protected from the elements by a rippling blue canvas sail.  To the north, the enclosure is filled with a small forest that descends into a red-walled canyon, while a series of constructed sandstone cliffs stretches upward in the distance.  Perched atop a nearby column of rock, a lone griffin stands sentinel, keeping a watchful eye on both the staircase to the west and the steps to the east.

The high-reaching granite tower offers a magnificent view of the surrounding habitat, a series of constructed sandstone cliffs at the center of a red-walled canyon.  Perched atop a nearby column of rock, a lone griffin stands sentinel, keeping a watchful eye on its territory.

title: [Griffin's Roost, Tower]
