title: [Griffin's Roost]
description: Surrounded by railings and high walls of protective glass, the enclosure provides a view of a veritable of a small forest with a faux cliff.  In the distance, a mammoth nest is visible upon an outcropping and is built within the crux of two flat stones that are braced against each other.  Adult griffins fly back and forth from the spot, attending to the structure itself and occasionally disappearing within.  Near at hand, a set of winding steps surrounded by smaston bushes lead into a tall stone tower.

In the distance, beyond the trail, a mammoth nest can be seen, built in the crux of two flat stones that are braced to lean against each other.  A pair of adult griffins fly back and forth to the spot, attending to the structure itself and occasionally disappearing within.

title: [Moonshine Manor, Foyer]
description: Stained oak walls rise from the edges of a mirror-finished black marble floor up to the vaulted ceiling, their smooth expanses decorated with intricate tapestries.  Chandeliers dangle from above to accent the lighting offered by the deep bay windows, while the garbled sounds of revelry trickle into the foyer from a candlelit hallway.  A cheerful halfling host greets everyone that enters the polished ebony double doors, and servants scurry past on their way to the kitchen hidden under a spiral staircase.

title: [Moonshine Manor, 'Shiner Lounge]
description: Plush leather seats and small side tables are arranged in a broad half circle on the edge of an expansive dance floor, positioned for a clear view of the trio of halflings playing music upon a raised platform at its far end.  A golden brocade curtain hangs on a stained oak wall to the west and flaps gently as the occasional breeze forces it aside, revealing a balcony beyond.  The shelves of a voluminous library are easily discerned through a narrow ebony archway to the north.

title: [Wehnimer's Hall of Magic]
description: This hall houses many curious and esoteric devices that appear to control much power.  Some are famous items of lore and legend, while others hint at origins and powers you dare not even guess at.  A narrow, spiral staircase leads up to a book-lined gallery on the second floor.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Study]
description: This gallery overlooks the Hall of Magic and Technology.  Robed scholars, wizened researchers and curious browsers clamber noiselessly up and down step stools to retrieve and reshelve the thick, dusty volumes that line the walls from floor to ceiling.  A few lecterns are placed around the circular library. At the far end, a tall, grey, bespectacled figure, obviously the head librarian, peers down at you, ready to pounce at the slightest noise.

title: [Museum Member's Suite]
[Museum, Member Lounge]
description: This reception area is restricted to use by members, patrons, donors and the elite of Wehnimer's Landing, to gather and entertain like-minded culture mavens.  The marble floors and walls are highly polished, reflecting the limpid light that filters through the stained glass skylight overhead.

In the middle of the ceiling, a large crystal chandelier descends to illuminate the inlaid wooden dance floor in the center of the room.  Various stained glass skylights dot the ceiling in an artfully haphazard fashion, each one a different scene of upper class society.  Along the northern wood-paneled wall, a long cloth-covered table is laden with refreshments.  Against the opposite wall, several plush velvet settees rest on the green marbled flooring that runs the edge of the room, offset from an intricately patterned silk curtain in the corner.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Rooftop]
description: The view from the rooftop extends all the way to the walls of Wehnimer's Landing and beyond.  Exposed to the elements, this wind blown edifice juts up into the sky opposite the observatory tower on the eastern side of the museum.  Protected from errant footfalls by metal rims, various stained glass skylights are set into the rough stone floor.  An unobtrusive drainpipe is attached to the side of the building, leading rainwater away from the roof.

title: [Rainbow Tent, Entry]
description: Heavy iron brackets secure some sturdy wooden stemples that lead down a nearly bottomless hole in the center of the room.  Several brightly colored footprints and splatter marks painted upon the wooden floor lead from the stemples to the tent entry, with one footprint bearing seven differently hued toe marks.

title: [Rainbow Cavern, Orders]
description: Massive stalactites and stalagmites create a pathway to a rickety wooden counter, behind which stands a sulking dwarven merchant.  A sizable iron sconce illuminates some bright green moss covering the stone walls of the cavern, and an unidentifiable, quite putrid odor threatens the nostrils of unsuspecting victims.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Meadow's Edge]
description: An imposing double row of poplars line a moonlit lane that materializes out of grassy meadows like the beginning of a sweeping line of charcoal in an artist's sketch.  Just at the lane's birth stands a statue.  Depicting a doe, the sculpture lifts its head as though just surprised at something carried on the breeze, the animal's elegant form limed in the soft moonlight.

An imposing double row of poplars line a subtle lane that materializes out of grassy meadows like the beginning of a sweeping line of charcoal in an artist's sketch.  Just at the lane's birth stands a statue.  Depicting a doe, the sculpture lifts its head as though just surprised at something carried on the breeze, the animal's eyes large and imminently expressive.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Wooded Bluff]
description: Rough weathered fieldstone steps pursue a curving path down the shadowy slope of a bluff.  Dense stands of deciduous trees gather atop the bluff, as though standing guard against the intrusion of the moonlit meadow below.  Lichens clinging to the rough surface of the trees' bark glow in the murk, as though trying to illuminate the foliage of large rhododendrons and ferns crowding at the foot of the trees.

Rough weathered fieldstone steps pursue a curving path down the slope of a bluff.  Dense stands of deciduous trees gather atop the bluff, as though standing guard against the intrusion of the meadow below.  The rich tones of their lichen and moss-covered bark complement the healthy green foliage of large rhododendrons and ferns crowding their foot.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Fieldstone Steps]
description: The trail ends at the foot of a tall course of weathered fieldstone steps, which winds up the bluff accompanied by large hostas and ferns.  High above, a dense company of trees crowns the head of the precipice, bolstered by an impassable jumble of huge boulders and tangled blackberry thickets stretching down the incline.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Flowering Bluff]
description: The head of the bluff is rampant with flowers, a heady mixture of fragrant rhododendron blossoms, snow-white trillium, purple violets, and the delicate ruby bells of bleeding hearts trembling on their arched fronds.  Overhead, the wide boughs of the trees block all but a subtle beam of the moons, creating an otherworldly, ghostly light within the copse.

The head of the bluff is rampant with flowers, a heady mixture of showy rhododendron blossoms, snow-white trillium, purple violets, and the delicate ruby bells of bleeding hearts trembling on their arched fronds.  Overhead, the wide boughs of the trees shelter the delicate blooms from midday sun and offer an otherworldly, green-tinged light within the copse.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Rough-Hewn Steps]
description: At the foot of a bluff traversed by rough-hewn fieldstone steps, the path ends.  A stand of aspens gather to the northwest, their silvery leaves fluttering in a light breeze playing in the moonlight.  At the top of the steps, a shadowy fringe of pines seems to look down on the oaks, ashes, and aspens with a disdainful air, while huge ferns and hostas guard the stair with their imposing fronds.

At the foot of a bluff traversed by rough-hewn fieldstone steps, the path ends.  A stand of aspens gather to the northwest, their silvery leaves fluttering in a light breeze that seems to bathe the hillside in a constant caress.  At the top of the steps, a fringe of pines seems to look down on the oaks, ashes, and aspens with a disdainful air, while huge ferns and hostas guard the stair with their imposing fronds.

title: [Halcyon Hills, Piney Overlook]
description: The bluff's elevation provides a spectacular panoramic view of the moonlit countryside.  Meadowlands stretch away to the east, and the indigo water of a lake mirrors the moons in wavering reflections.  A thick stand of pines scents the air with their pleasant aroma, and, underfoot, the ground is covered with a russet coat of their fallen needles.  The faint outline of a structure can dimly be seen through the trees to the northeast.

The bluff's elevation provides a spectacular panoramic view of the surrounding countryside.  Meadowlands stretch away to the east, and the deep blue water of a lake caresses its shoreline to the south.  A thick stand of pines scents the air with their pleasant aroma, and, underfoot, the ground is covered with a russet coat of their fallen needles.  A structure of fieldstone can be glimpsed through the trees to the northeast.

title: [Peaceful Meadow, Oak Tree]
description: Standing alone in the center of this peaceful meadow is a gigantic oak tree.  Wildflowers have grown haphazardly throughout the grass creating an array of colors that spreads across the entire meadow.  Off in the distance a small group of tawny deer can be seen grazing, with an enormous buck keeping watch.

title: [Oak Tree, Large Branch]
description: A small platform with an opening cut in the center has been built on this hefty tree branch.  A twisted rope ladder leads down the opening, back to the meadow.  High above is a ragged hole in the tree with a gnarled rope hanging down.

title: [Tiny Cottage, Bedroom]
description: A red and blue quilt covers the thick mattress of an oversized feather bed that fills the far end of the room.  Tucked between the bed and the wall is a nightstand of whitewashed pine.  White linen hangings with blue embroidered edges decorate the windows, and a rag rug covers the smoothly sanded floor beams.  A loosely woven curtain separates this space from the outer room and a ladder ascends up to an opening in the ceiling.

title: [Tiny Cottage, Attic]
description: The walls of the attic room slant upward, following the peaked line of the cottage roof.  Most of the floor space in the room is taken up with stacked storage crates.  A wooden ladder descends down through an opening into the bedroom below.

title: [Helden Hall, Stables]
description: Slanting beams of sunlight create pools of golden light upon hay-strewn floors, and every sound seems to echo within the cavernous stables.  Rows of stalls sturdy enough to hold even the most ambitious warhorse line either side of the stables.  Small motes of hay seem to turn to gold as they float through the sunbeams on their way down from the loft above.

title: [Helden Hall, Hay Loft]
description: This large hay loft hugs the rafters of the huge barn, creating a cozy and peaceful haven.  The piles of sweet-smelling hay might tempt the house members to lie down and relax after a hard day working the forge or swordfighting.  Sunlight shines through the hay loft doors, glinting off of the metal hooks and pitchforks hanging from the walls.  The faint neighing of a warhorse below reminds you of the work remaining to be done.

title: [Northeast Tower, Roof]
description: The crenelated walls of the tower do very little to keep the arctic winds from tearing through your clothing.  On each of the four corners, a crossed mammoth-tusk flag flutters madly in the breeze.  Off to the east, the stars glitter behind Mount Aenatumgana in the distance, while to the south the lights of Icemule Trace beckon with the promise of warm hearths and hearts.

The crenelated walls of the tower do very little to keep the arctic winds from tearing through your clothing.  On each of the four corners, a crossed mammoth-tusk flag flutters madly in the breeze.  To the east the sun gleams off Mount Aenatumgana, while to the north the glacier gleams like an uncut blue-white diamond.

title: [Northeast Tower, Barracks]
description: Beds of various size lie in precise ranks in this orderly barracks.  Small triangular pennants bearing the symbols of the various Arkati and lesser spirits decorate the room, and a large banner bearing the word "Faith" adorns one wall beside an opening in the ceiling that leads to the roof.  Near the stairway leading down is an oversize cabinet for the storage of herbs, bandages, and other implements of the healing arts.

title: [Northwest Tower, Roof]
description: The flags of the city militia flutter from the four corners of the square tower, proclaiming to a great distance the manning of the city defenses.  To the north lies a great expanse of glacial ice, while to the west the snowy plains are cut by walls and trenches.  In the opposite direction, the city of Icemule Trace gleams like platinum dust in the moonlight.

The flags of the city militia flutter from the four corners of the square tower, proclaiming to a great distance the manning of the city defenses.  To the north lies a great expanse of glacial ice, while to the west the snowy plains are cut by walls and trenches.  In the opposite direction, the city of Icemule Trace gleams like a frost opal in the sun.

title: [Northwest Tower, Barracks]
description: This is a place of rest and relaxation, but still a place governed by martial order.  Row after row of bunk beds fill the center of the room, while a few cabinets for the storage of herbs and bandages line the walls.  Next to a hole in the ceiling hangs an enormous banner stitched with the simple word, "Courage."

title: [Southwest Tower, Roof]
description: This tower commands a view of the South Gate trail, but few if any pass through its shadowy maw.  To the north and east, the city of Icemule Trace is lit by the warmth of candle and hearth fire, but surrounded by the cold darkness of the city walls.  From somewhere below the tower comes the rhythmical pulse of the windmill blades as they turn in time with the ubiquitous glacial winds.

This tower commands a view of the trail as it leaves the South Gate, passes the Behlayr and Ice Forest neighborhoods, and then heads toward Wehnimer's Landing.  To the north and east, the tower provides an excellent view of the city walls and of the city of Icemule Trace.  Directly below the tower, the blades of the windmill turn in lazy rhythm in time with the ubiquitous glacial winds.

title: [Southwest Tower, Barracks]
description: A small hole in the ceiling provides access to the roof, but the main purpose of this room is for rest and comfort.  Row after row of beds in descending order of length and width fills the room, leaving only a small space near the stairs for an herb and bandage cabinet.  Adorning one wall is a large banner that simply reads, "Honor."

title: [Southeast Tower, Roof]
description: Commerce Burrow sleeps under a shroud of darkness, resting up for the next business day.  The wilds to the east teem with creatures that pose a threat to the welfare of the citizens of the city, and it is well that adventurers pass through the East Gate to meet the danger even in the dead of night.

From this prodigious height, the bustle of Commerce Burrow is truly impressive, even if the height of those doing the bustling seems much reduced by the perspective.  The wilds to the east teem with creatures that pose a threat to the welfare of the citizens of the city, and it is well that adventurers pass through the East Gate to meet the danger.  Below, the sturdy walls run in precise lines toward corner towers at the north and west.

title: [Southeast Tower, Barracks]
description: The cold stone walls of this upper room are broken only by a simple banner bearing the word "Glory," which ripples in the frigid wind coursing through the hole leading through the ceiling to the roof.  A legion of beds stand at attention in the barracks, ready to give comfort to the weary and the wounded.  At the head of the stairway is a large cabinet designed to hold bandages and herbs for the cure of the wounded.

title: [Our Colorful Place, Dye Room]
description: A gold enameled trunk sits in the corner of the dye room opposite a number of boxes set along the ground.  Each wall in the room is painted with a different primary color, from a fiery red to a deep midnight blue.  The pristine white runner leading to the counter is in stark contrast to the other colors in the room.

title: [Our Colorful Place, Backroom]
description: A sturdy wooden desk sits at the side of this room covered with stacks of ledgers and other papers, giving away the backroom's purpose as an office.  A small portrait of the owner's family is set upon the wall, and an enormous bronze horse monopolizes the room's back wall.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: The wide ledge ends in a steep cliff that drops off into a desolate vista of uninhabitable rocky shore stretching off to the west.  A path winds down to the shore to the north, and a set of narrow stone steps has been carved into the rock, providing a precarious ascent to an outcropping of rock above.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Overhang]
description: This huge outcropping of stone hangs out over the precarious ledges below.  A few gnarled trees have found enough dirt to take root near the dark mouth of a cave set into the cliff, from which emanates a somewhat acrid odor and a faint sound of fluttering wings.

title: [Hidden Tunnel]
description: You find yourself in a small roughly hewn stone room.  Moss and lichen carpet the walls and floor, giving the area a musty scent.  In the south corner of the room you see some moss covered stairs heading down into the gloom, the sound of dripping water echoing up to you.  A rusty iron ladder leads up through the ceiling into darkness.

title: [Castle Varunar, Keep]
description: You are in a small circular stone landing.  Dripping copper colored stains adorn the walls looking as if someone had thrown buckets of blood on them.  A cut-stone spiral staircase wraps around the circular walls leading further up into what must be the castle keep.  A rusty iron ladder leads down a passage cut into the floor.

A cut-stone spiral staircase wraps around the circular walls leading further up into what must be the castle keep.  A rusty iron ladder leads down a passage cut into the floor.

title: [Hidden Tunnel]

In the south corner of the room you see some moss covered stairs heading down into the gloom, the sound of dripping water echoing up to you.  A rusty iron ladder leads up through the ceiling into darkness.

title: [Castle Dungeons, Guard Room]
description: You find yourself in what used to be a guardroom.  Empty ale tankards and empty plates still lie on a heavy oak table.  Rusted iron rings holding corroded lumps that were once keys hang from various pegs in the north wall.  A set of moss-covered stairs lead up into the gloom.

title: [Onoir, Great Hall]
description: Moonlight filters through the iridescent panes of six stained-glass windows spaced evenly along the cylindrical walls of this commodious hall.  Rows of low wooden benches flank a sturdy podium mounted upon a solid marble dais, facing a mosaic-tiled section of floor that portrays a gallant knight in full battle regalia.  Carved wooden lions grasp black and red crosshatched banners overhead, while flickering torches in wall-sconces drive back the shadows from a trio of archways leading to other areas of the castle.

Light cascades through the iridescent panes of six stained-glass windows spaced evenly along the cylindrical walls of this commodious hall.  Rows of low wooden benches flank a sturdy podium mounted upon a solid marble dais, facing a mosaic-tiled section of floor that portrays a gallant knight in full battle regalia.  Carved wooden lions grasp black and red crosshatched banners between unlit torches vigilantly waiting in their sconces over a trio of archways leading to other areas of the castle.

title: [Onoir, Brother Sartarius Chapel]
description: Moonlight streams in through the clear crystal ceiling, casting long shadows across the rosewood floor towards the pulpit centered at the front of the room, the platform set before several pews.  Silver sconces frame tapestries across the chapel walls, the light sparkling across them like stars in the evening sky.  Soft murmurs of prayer and singing echo throughout the chamber, the sounds reverberating against a rosewood table by the onyx staircase, the table half-cast in shadow.

title: [Onoir, Granite Cavern]
description: Simple torches cast light upon the roughly hewn white granite walls, revealing numerous scorch marks and a patch of soot that stands out in one corner, oddly resembling a large, humanoid silhouette.  Ash has collected in the deeper depressions of the floor and lies in small piles on a set of granite steps leading up to the garden.  Clear of all dust and debris, a large wooden bucket rests idly beneath a crack in the wall.

title: [Onoir, Garden of Faith]
description: A small brook winds its way through this tranquil garden, its babbling chorus enhanced where it empties into a clear pond.  A miniature dock reaches out into the water, while climbing vines and ivies ramble over rock walls.  Central to the garden is a simple shrine, an unadorned block of black marble, residing on a moonlit court of polished flagstones.  An offering of wildflowers sits at the base of the block, and tall willows shade a long stone bench nearby.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Orchard]
description: Grey cobblestones meander beneath well-tended orange and peach trees.  Lining the path, brilliantly colored flowers perfume the night air with heavy scents.  Crickets chirp from their hiding places, and moths flutter aimlessly about.  Wooden steps climb to an enclosed porch attached to a two-story villa.

Grey cobblestones meander beneath well-tended orange and peach trees.  Lining the path, brilliantly colored flowers perfume the air with heavy scents.  Birds sing in the branches above, and tiny butterflies flit from blossom to blossom with careless abandon.  Wooden steps climb to an enclosed porch attached to a two-story villa.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Porch]
description: A sturdy railing surrounding the porch supports some trailing vines that grow along its length.  Windchimes dangle from the wooden roof that shades the veranda.  A rope swing hangs from the ceiling, swaying gently with a passing breeze.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Landing]
description: Three portholes look out over the orchard and send trickles of moonlight down the staircase.  A framed display of knots hangs on the wall next to an old brass lantern.  The floorboards are buckled and warped, though braided throw rugs cover the worst patches.

Three portholes look out over the orchard and flood the staircase with sunlight.  A framed display of knots hangs on the wall next to an old brass lantern.  The floorboards are buckled and warped, though braided throw rugs cover the worst patches.

title: [River's Rest Hall, Foyer]
description: A wooden staircase rises to the second floor, its railing painted a pristine white.  Ivy vines have been trained to follow the balustrade, providing a verdant contrast to the paleness of the banister.  To the north, a hallway leads further into the building.

title: [Dark Tower, Great Hall]
description: The hall is circular, its polished dark walls stretching nearly thirty spans overhead.  Long tapestries hang from the walls, interspersed with iron braziers.  In the floor's center, inlaid into the grey granite tile, is a slit-pupiled eye rendered in vivid gold marble.  Around the room's circumference stand brass censers, from which smoke from exotic-smelling incense languidly curls upward.  A winding staircase disappears through the ceiling, and a black onyx door leads outside.
a.location: the Dark Tower, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Dark Tower, Study]
description: Bookshelves, rising high overhead, are filled with tomes in all sizes and colors of leather bindings.  Moonlight streaming through tall, narrow windows casts thin bands of silvery light on a carved modwir desk and its matching chair.  Nestled among the stacks is an immense hearth wrought of rough local stone, and stretching between a winding staircase and an ironwood door is a modwir credenza.

b.location: the Dark Tower, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Orders]
description: Though most of the floor is covered in compacted dirt, some areas have been worn away by the wind and reveal splintering planks underneath.  Standing on one side of the room and supported by several wrapped bamboo stalks is a long counter with a wooden top.  A clerk stands behind the counter, casually watching the customers come and go.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Basement]
description: Though stairs have been built to access the cottage upstairs, the rest of the basement resembles an untouched cavern.  Moss grows along the rock walls and climbs from floor to ceiling in unfettered majesty, the deep green and rust colors painting a natural picture along the perimeter.  Barrels, driftwood, rocks, and crates have been laid out upon the floor, serving as makeshift shelving that sits unevenly on the wet and musty floor.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Orders]
description: Though most of the floor is covered in compacted dirt, some areas have been worn away by the wind and reveal splintering planks underneath.  Standing on one side of the room and supported by several wrapped bamboo stalks is a long counter with a wooden top.  A clerk stands behind the counter, casually watching the customers come and go.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Attic]
description: A stiff breeze rattles the bamboo walls of this cramped room, creating a slight whistling noise as the room sways.  There isn't much decoration in this room except for a centrally located table and a long shelf that has many vials sitting atop it.

title: [Beacon Hall, Common Room]
description: Several coats of arms hang from the dark modwir walls in this softly lit room.  The south wall displays captured banners and armaments from a variety of military campaigns.  A large fieldstone fireplace dominates the north wall.  A massive oaken table sits surrounded by a horde of oak chairs in the center of the room beneath a black wrought iron chandelier.  Despite the presence of war paraphernalia, a sense of peace pervades the room.

title: [Beacon Hall, Story Room]
description: This expansive room is carpeted from wall to wall with soft lamb's wool that has been dyed a rich burgundy.  A large hearth in the rear lends a faint but warm light to the area.  A large, comfortable chair resting on an exquisite, hand-woven throw rug faces the hearth.  Soft pillows of every size are scattered about the floor.  The walls of this room are not adorned with any portraits, but the walls themselves are expertly painted murals.

title: [Beacon Hall, Staircase]
description: This long, cramped, wooden staircase connects the kitchen with the rooms above.  The servants use it to transport meals, dishes, linens and other assorted odds and ends between the two floors so as not to be seen on the main staircase.  The construction is rather shoddy, and several of the boards creak loudly with the passing of footsteps.

title: [Beacon Hall, Lofty Room]
description: A vaulted ceiling rises high above this large, unfurnished room.  A number of crates and barrels, most still sealed, are stacked about the room.  They bear labels indicating their contents to be books, scrolls, maps, and assorted scholarly paraphernalia, obviously intended for the Archive library but not yet unpacked.  The few open containers give off a satisfying smell of leather and parchment, and literary riches can be glimpsed within.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Attic]
description: This small room smells very musty, and its builder did not have enough sense to equip it with any windows.  He did, however, decide to build some handy shelves along the perimeter to hold the many vials of dye spotted throughout the room.  The eastern wall of the room is made from natural slate rock and seems to be untouched by modern tools except for a solid staircase that emerges from its corner.

title: [Bamboo Cottage, Basement]
description: The most prominent thing about this room is the long staircase that winds upward towards the sky.  Each step is crafted from the natural rock of the cavern, and no two steps are entirely even.  The rock walls are much eroded, and water trickles around several small cubbies created from years of water damage.  Several vials, conveniently filled with multi-colored dyes, are neatly placed within the cubbies.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: The hall is panelled with dark wood and hung with heavy tapestries that dull the sounds of footsteps.  Illuminated only by the glow from the torches to the south, the passage continues north into darkness.  A draft of cool air occasionally wafts in from a narrow stairway that leads up through an opening in one wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Upstairs Hallway]
description: The narrow hall is dimly lit by torches set into brass sconces on the walls, and carpeted with a thick woven rug that muffles your footsteps.  Several portraits are set in rich wooden frames and mounted on the walls.  Their eyes seem to follow you as you move, in what is probably just a strange trick of the light.

title: [Firefly Villa, Tree]
description: Arched in four directions, the redwood tree is hollow and polished to a lustrous warm, reddish glow.  Tiny orbs set into the distant ceiling provide ample light for any that wish to traverse the stairway, while sconces set on the right side of each entry provide illumination for the pathways that lead through the vibrant gardens that ring the inn.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Firefly Villa, Tree]
description: Arched in four directions, the redwood tree is hollow and polished to a lustrous warm, reddish glow.  Tiny orbs set into the high ceiling provide ample light for any that wish to traverse the stairway, while sconces set on the right side of each entry provide illumination for the catwalks that lead to the various balconies that ring the inn.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Spilling into the room from the northeastern corner is a resplendent staircase that culminates in mahogany-inlaid newel posts crafted of white birch.  Nearby, a frosted ebon glass door leads to the gentlemen's bathing facility, its polished surface beaded with sweat.

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Rich plum carpeting converges upon the landing from the western and southern hallway sections, though they terminate just before reaching the landing.  A spiraling staircase is flanked by mahogany-inlaid newel posts crafted of white birch, while opposite stands an enormous polished copper mirror.

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Polished alabaster descends from the winding stairs at this corner of the corridor and mimics the frothy flow of waves spilling forth upon the smooth teak flooring.  Decorative mother-of-pearl balusters are evenly spaced to match each of the wave-shaped steps as they ascend to the landing above, while near at hand they culminate in a pair of banisters fashioned into the semblance of fishermen casting their nets.

title: [Firefly Villa, Landing]
description: Polished alabaster rises from the winding stairs at this corner of the corridor and mimics the frothy flow of waves cresting upon the plum carpet.  Decorative mother-of-pearl balusters are evenly spaced to match the wave-shaped steps as they descend to the landing below, while near at hand they culminate in a pair of banisters fashioned into the semblance of paired mermaids holding urns above their heads.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: A chill draft blows up from the narrow stairwell at the end of the hallway.  A lone torch set in a brass sconce near the stairs illuminates the bare stone of the walls, which are uncovered by insulating tapestries here.

title: [Rogue Guild, Basement]
description: The heavy wooden boards of the floor are worn smooth by centuries of passing feet and scored by the marks of thousands of objects being dragged in and out of storage over the years.  The rough, unadorned stone walls form an irregularly-shaped chamber that extends to the east and south, and a heavy trapdoor is set into the floor near the western wall.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Akaelos']
description: The curving marble walls of the expansive, circular chamber enclose a dozen immaculately-kept worktables at which an equal number of meticulously-groomed halfling and human draftsmen labor at their inks and papers.  A tall dark elf, his waist-length black hair intricately braided and his gem-clasped robes shifting in the light from the glaes skylight above, moves about the tables, whispering instructions to the draftsmen.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Nazgir's]
description: The walls of this spacious workshop are set with panels of fine woods ranging from pale haon to richly toned ebonwoods, inset with a variety of patterns in jade and ivory to illustrate the skill of their craftsmen.  The elegantly clad dwarven artisan moves from table to table, a constant grumbling emanating from his squat, dark figure as he issues instructions to apprentices engaged in carving finely-made doors.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Kelsene's]
description: The whitewashed brick walls of the tidy office are arranged with numerous small paintings of a variety of modest buildings of wood and stone.  A smiling half-elven woman, her dark hair swept up in a neat snood, oversees the room from a spacious modwir desk, arranging neat stacks of parchments and sketches as she hums quietly to herself.  A narrow stairway leads down.

title: [Misty Isle Exteriors, Dunner's]
description: A small barred window near the ceiling illuminates the room with a smattering of light.  The stone walls of the basement are stacked with all manner of wood and metal panels, along with bins holding a fascinating variety of metal bits and hardware.  A middle-aged, bespectacled dwarf glances over the inventory, pushing his felt cap back on his head as he scratches his greying beard and rummages through the papers in his hand.

title: [Isle Designs, Entry]
description: Sun bleached driftwood walls frame the entry of this sandstone shop.  The warped plank flooring is covered with tracked-in sand and various mementos from the Isle line the thin shelves along the walls.  From the ceiling drape layers of dried seaweed, giving the room a faint ocean scent.

title: [Isle Designs, Permit Office]
description: A large white pine desk stretches across the center of the office, covered with scattered papers and pots of ink.  A rug-covered plank floor leads to a towering oak bookshelf behind the desk, which is littered with parchments and volumes, as well as a curious collection of bottled starfishes.  On the far wall is a framed blueprint of Four Winds Isle covered in tiny, red X's.

title: [Rogue Guild, Courtyard]
description: A rusted metal ladder is fastened to the stone wall of the building, leading to the roof above.  Several old crates are arranged in a circle on the stony ground as if they have been used for seating, and a few scraggly bushes have taken root in the soil next to the wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Rooftop]
description: Smells of cooking and other less appetizing things waft up from the street below.  The deserted rooftop is swept clean but for a few wooden crates arranged near the stone rampart that overlooks the street.

title: [Isle Designs, Signs]
description: A large ceramic bowl of tropical fruit stands on an iron table on the far side of the room, attracting a host of buzzing insects to the area.  From the direction of the table wafts the scents of coconut and lime, drifting across the room on a subtle breeze.  Propped up against the whitewashed plank walls are collections of signs and notices, surrounded by cans of colorful paints and oils.  Several craftsmen sit along a workbench on the eastern wall, diligently at work with hammers and paintbrushes.

title: [Isle Designs, Lookout Tower]
description: Cut out openings along the walls allow for the ocean breeze to spill into the room, bringing with it the scents of saltwater and tropical blooms.  Several carved benches and observation lenses have been placed next to the openings, affording a stunning view of the island and sea below.  Set into the floor, sandstone bricks have been placed meticulously, creating a swirling seashell pattern.

title: [Municipal Building, Lobby]
description: Dusty, grey stone tiles surround a slightly tarnished silver pick-and-shovel seal inlaid on the floor.  A handful of green-speckled yellow giant toadstools gather dust along the walls, set into polished brass pots.  Dwarves of all shapes and sizes go about their business in one of the building's numerous offices.  A prominent faux-oak door resides in the north wall, while some stone steps rise to the east.

title: [Muncipal Building, Second Floor]
description: Sparsely furnished, the entire second floor consists of a small landing lit by a pair of giant luminescent toadstools.  A single padded chair sits up against the wall next to a grey steel door, offering a seat to anyone waiting to see the Clan Leader of Zul Logoth.

title: [Muncipal Building, Second Floor]
description: Sparsely furnished, the entire second floor consists of a small landing lit by a pair of giant luminescent toadstools.  A single padded chair sits up against the wall next to a grey steel door, offering a seat to anyone waiting to see the Clan Leader of Zul Logoth.

title: [Municipal Building, Rooftop]
description: Sturdy wooden planks extend out to cover the rectangular roof of the Municipal Building below.  The cavern ceiling overhead is close enough to touch, while down below dwarves are seen coming and going, some entering and exiting the building on official business.  A strong ironwood beam structure suspends a large invar bell next to a long invar horn cradled in a similar supporting frame.  A ladder leads through a trapdoor back down into the building below.

title: [Jail, Passage]
description: Highly polished stone walls and floor reflect the dim torchlight here, making it seem more than it is.  Painted iron doors studded with gems indicate the entrances into two more prisoner cells.  A set of low steps leads up toward the exit of the prison, while some steep stairs lead lower into darkness.

title: [Jail, Passageway]
description: The passageway ends at three extravagant-looking doors.  In the north wall, a gilded crimson door bears a plaque that reads, "Warden's Office," while to the east is a heavy silver door and to the west a heavy golden door.  The latter two doors are obviously cell entrances, evidenced by the heavy locks securing them from the outside.  Some steep stairs lead up to the higher parts of the prison and eventually to the exit.

title: [Ta'Illistim, Caear Courtyard]
description: The illuminated domes of Ta'Illistim Keep rise overhead, each one tiled and sparkling with an abundance of mosaic decoration.  Before the keep, the var widens to a half-moon shaped courtyard, which in turn is bordered by the edge of the city green.

The domes of Ta'Illistim Keep rise overhead, each one tiled and sparkling with an abundance of mosaic decoration.  Before the keep, the var widens to a half-moon shaped courtyard, which in turn is bordered by the edge of the city green.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Cobalt Salon]
description: High above, the vaulted ceiling is a domed expanse of brilliant blue, a mosaic crafted from a multitude of tiny glaes squares.  The tilework continues down the walls, stopping halfway to meet smoothed silvered stonework.  An immense ogee arch is flanked by two smaller doors.  Daylight streams through the well of an alabaster staircase.

High above, the vaulted ceiling is a domed expanse of brilliant blue, a mosaic of millions upon millions of pieces of tiny glaes squares.  The tilework continues down the walls, stopping halfway to meet smoothed silvered stonework.  An immense ogee arch is flanked by two smaller doors.  Starlight streams through the well of a stone staircase.

The tilework continues down the walls, stopping halfway to meet smoothed silvered stonework.  An immense ogee arch is flanked by two smaller doors.  Starlight streams through the well of a stone ramp.

The tilework continues down the walls, stopping halfway to meet smoothed silvered stonework.  An immense ogee arch is flanked by two smaller doors.  Daylight streams through the well of a stone staircase.

title: [Guild Hall, Main Hallway E]
description: This part of the hallway is narrower than the main hall, and the regularly spaced columns discontinue.  Massive flagstones of somber colors floor the hallway.  At intervals along the heavy stone walls are ancient suits of armor interspersed with paintings of famous battles along with portraits of mighty Warriors of renown from many nations and times.  A wide staircase leads up, while narrow stone steps lead into the basement.

title: [Guild Hall, Basement]
description: You stand at the bottom of a narrow stairwell, in the dank, musty and dark basement of the Guild Hall.  A doorway leads west, though the door itself seems to have been removed from its hinges.

title: [Guild Hall, Main Hallway E]
description: This part of the hallway is narrower than the main hall, and the regularly spaced columns discontinue.  Massive flagstones of somber colors floor the hallway.  At intervals along the heavy stone walls are ancient suits of armor interspersed with paintings of famous battles along with portraits of mighty Warriors of renown from many nations and times.  A wide staircase leads up, while narrow stone steps lead into the basement.

title: [Guild Hall, Second Floor]
description: A cast-iron chandelier sways slightly above you; two of the five candles are missing and the other three are wickless, disfigured globs of melted wax.  Swathes of cobwebs cover the chandelier, spotted here and there with dried insect carcasses.  A set of stairs lead to the floor below.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Quiet Bluff]
description: Stout cedar poles support grassy thatching to shade this bluff.  A short cedar fence wraps around three sides of the bluff, keeping the unwary or perhaps the inebriated from falling to the rocks below.  Maelstrom Bay stretches out to the west, and the thick dark forest confronts the Bay's waters to the north and south.  Reclining chairs are strewn haphazardly about the bluff, and a small table accompanies each chair.  A windowless redwood building sits nearby, and a steep ramp ascends to the northeast.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This well constructed redwood platform rises over one hundred feet into the air, considerably higher than most of the surrounding forest.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off reflected light from below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  The soft breeze causes the platform to sway somewhat.

title: [Illistim Warrior Guild, Foyer]
description: A grand, double staircase leads up to the administrative offices of the Warrior Guild of Ta'Illistim.  Mica-flecked blue granite floors lead to fine, maoral-paneled walls, each bedecked with a suit of armor.  To the east, the guild's distinctive task offices are plainly visible through a wide marble arch and easily accesible to all guild members.

title: [Warrior Guild, Second Floor]
description: The carpeted staircase with its impressive marble balustrade leads up to an ample hallway, its ornate gilded lamps and ceiling rosettes completing a grand initial view of the upper floor.

title: [Reformatory, Office]
description: Specifically aligned, three chairs rest in front of a lightly carved desk.  Arranged side by side on the desktop, miniature portraits of a child and a woman in her middle years are on display in ivory frames.  In the far corner, standing roughly three feet high, a plainly made wooden horse bears the burden of holding a brass-riveted saddle.  Smaller wood sculptures of a wolf, a caribou, and a snow leopard carved in amazing detail surround the horse in a semi-circle.

title: [Reformatory, Tribunal Chamber]
description: Brass sconces flank the doorway and are mounted along the walls at regular intervals providing adequate light in the chamber.  Perched atop a dais three steps high, and polished to a mirror finish, rests a massive ebonwood bench that is lightly carved with vines.  Most of the back wall is comprised of a bookcase crammed with thick, leather-bound tomes pertaining to the law.  A featureless metal door stands almost hidden behind the bookshelf.  Gold runners cover the floor between symmetrically arranged padded chairs.

title: [Piaere's Boutique]
description: Variegated leaves from the neighboring flora have been affixed and sealed upon the wooden floor in an orderly fashion, like the footsteps of nature.  Artfully arranged in three semi-circles, slender-legged tables and stands present beautifully crafted clothing and accessories.

title: [Piaere's Boutique, Atelier]
description: Elevated just above the main boutique floor, this spacious atelier beholds the beauty of its arboreal environment.  Partially finished designs inspired by the stunning backdrop are suspended from a network of cords high above.  A stand of posed mannequins have been clothed in completed outfits beside a crowded sewing table.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Workroom]
description: Short worktables are arranged in rows around the edge of the platform, allowing the center to be kept wide and open for foot traffic as costumers and workers travel between the steps leading to the dyeing room and the colorful bannered corridor that leads into the main shop.  Mannequins fitted with beautiful wings of silver wire and gaily painted gossamer silk are draped in layers of fabric.

title: [Fluttering Myriad, Dyeing Room]
description: Oak barrels stand in a neat row against the edge of the platform, well away from the steps that lead deeper into the shop.  Above the barrels, a clever pulley system is operated by a tiny wheel secured into the rough bark of the ancient tanik tree and attached to ropes that dangle over the platform's edge.  Colorful banners, each splattered with various colors of wayward dye splotches, form a taught roofing system that protects from the elements while allowing the outside air to easily pass through.

title: [Cobbler's Cobby, Storage Room]
description: Bound by thick cords, spotted leopard pelts lay in a heap outside of an overturned coffer.  On a countertop in the rear of the room, clear jars are filled with an assortment of various-sized brass studs.  Displayed on the opposite end of the counter are shiny buckles that can be used to adorn almost any style boots or shoes.

title: [The Cobbler's Cobby, Workroom]
description: The stench of noxious liquids wafts through the area.  In the far reaches of the workroom, a tanning pit overflows with pieces of bark and hides.  Containers filled with various types of liquid are within easy reach of the vat resting in the opposite corner.  Thick cords encircle the danger zones to keep someone from accidentally falling inside.  Several scrapers lay beside piles of skins with a great deal of fur remaining on them.  Flies buzz loudly above a heap of decaying flesh stuffed in a barrel.

title: [Guild Hall, West Hallway]
description: Scenes of battle in a gilded frieze stretch along the walls, each pair of combatants cleverly arranged so that some protrusion--a spear, a raised fist--touches the ceiling.  Below the frieze and evenly spaced apart, pairs of weapons crossed over burnished shields hang on the white marble walls.

title: [Guild Hall, Dark Chamber]
description: The walls in this dark and gloomy room are painted black.  A dim light flickers from a tank full of squirming, serpentine bodies in one corner.  Against one wall is a set of shelves acting as an apothecary: several bottles of various shapes and sizes are lined up neatly there.  Sawdust is scattered on the floor, forming a thick carpet.  Something smells odd here.

title: [Warrior Guild, Lounge]
description: Groups of low sturdy chairs cluster around a circular firepit ringed with native riverstone.  One whitewashed wall is decked with banners of various Houses and orders, while the wall behind the bar bears beautifully preserved hunting trophies.  The bar itself is only a few long planks atop barrels, but serves its purpose well enough.  Citrus-scented candles burn near the windows to chase away vagrant mosquitoes seeking their own liquid refreshments.

title: [Warrior Guild, Basement]
description: Wine-casks, ale barrels, and sacks of flour fill the corners of the room to the rafters.  Although the narrow chamber is packed to capacity, there is order to the stored goods and all is clearly labeled.  A large bin near the door holds fresh locally grown apples.

title: [Willow Hall, Great Room]
description: The huge, columned room functions as the meeting room of Willow Hall.  Linden, haon and modwir squares form the floor, skillfully laid so the multi-hued woods blend together.  The walls are richly carved with woodland scenes, and the columns are tree trunks left untouched.  Rows of benches face a raised dais with a podium and a few chairs.  Through a fieldstone arch flanked by two stained-glass windows, one can glimpse a moonlit garden.

The huge, columned room functions as the meeting room of Willow Hall.  Linden, haon and modwir squares form the floor, skillfully laid so the multi-hued woods blend together.  The walls are richly carved with woodland scenes, and the columns are tree trunks left untouched.  Rows of benches face a raised dais with a podium and a few chairs.  Through a fieldstone arch flanked by two stained-glass windows, one can glimpse a garden.

title: [Willow Hall, Roof Garden]
description: On the flat roof of the Great Room is a garden, ingeniously crafted to resemble a natural meadow.  A light breeze ripples the long grass, causing moon shadows to flicker across their rippling surface.  Higher stories of the hall border the southern edge of the expanse, and a row of bungalows can be seen lining the eastern section.  Bright lights shining from the buildings' windows cast shadows behind a trio of malachite benches holding court in the surrounding sea of grass.

On the flat roof of the Great Room is a garden, ingeniously crafted to resemble a natural meadow.  A light breeze ripples the long grass, intermittently hiding patches of wild flowers.  Higher stories of the hall border the southern edge of the expanse, and a row of bungalows can be seen lining the eastern section.  A curling ribbon of fragrant smoke lifts from the roof of the west wing, wafting past a trio of malachite benches holding court in the surrounding sea of grass.

title: [Narcis Hold, Gloaming Walk]
description: Set at intervals down the length of the stone hallway are a trio of recessed alcoves, each boasting a smoking censer atop a pedestal of whorled glaes.  Three of the niches are home to well-preserved tapestries.  Shafts of radiance spill through slits on the western wall, blazing bright through the wisps of incense smoke.  Near the end of the walk, a series of stone steps spirals up into the ceiling.

title: [Narcis Hold, Terrace]
description: A lattice-worked mistwood awning expands over the terrace entry, the crisscrossing slats entwined by a thicket of climbing vines that twist into a canopy of deep green foliage.  Lace-like ivory blossoms cling to the reedy limbs of five persimmon trees surrounding a silvery marble refectory table centered on the pale stone floor.  On alternating sides of a narrow path, angular glass lanterns and azalea bushes lead to a tranquil pond nestled in a bed of rain lilies.

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Barroom]
description: Mismatched barstools showing signs of disrepair face a stained and badly damaged bar, which stands at the back of the taproom.  Hanging on a peg behind the bar is a loaded heavy crossbow, and a quiver filled with bolts leans against the wall.  Soot streaks blacken the walls where torches that provide some illumination to the room are chained.  A narrow staircase leads to the second floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, out

title: [Volstrun's Whetter, Hallway]
description: Standing off to one side of the hallway is a tarnished brass spittoon that is tucked partially beneath an oval-shaped table.  Lining the corridor are brass, steel, and copper-inlaid doors with tiny ribbons hanging from their doorknobs.  Some creaky stairs lead back down to the barroom.

title: [Hairless Rolton Tavern, Taproom]
description: Sunlight enters through the brocade curtains with diamond cutouts, creating a series of identical dimmed patterns on the polished dark-stained floor.  Roltons in whimsical poses are carved into the wood panel that covers the barroom, illuminated by brass lanterns, which are scattered throughout the room.  Hanging above the wall behind a semi-circular bar, with half-moon barstools surrounding it, is a stuffed caribou head with honey-colored glass eyes.  Carved with leaves and vines, a spiral staircase leads up to the second floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, out

title: [Hairless Rolton Tavern, Hallway]
description: Standing on opposite corners of the corridor on plush emerald green carpeting are identical brass flowerpots with intricate designs etched into their surface.  Gilded scrollwork decorates the long table set in the middle of the hall.  Three doors with swirled royal blue, crimson, and mulberry motifs line the hallway.  The spiral staircase leads back down to the taproom.

title: [Treehouse, Gathering Room]
description: A potbelly stove occupies one corner of this cozy room, casting a warm glow on the rough hewn oak walls.  Some colorful rugs are strewn across the sanded floor.  Wide benches, rocking chairs, and soft cushions crowd this room, offering rest and conversation, while large glass windows provide clear views in all directions.  Various herbs and flowers have been hung from the ceiling to dry, creating a rich, woodsy aroma through the room.  A small ladder, leading to a large skylight above, leans against the wall next to a round maoral door

title: [Treehouse, Roof]
description: A large brass telescope is mounted in the center of the rooftop overlook.  Enclosed in a sturdy oaken railing, a cushioned bench circles the area.

title: [Western Harbor, Docks]
description: Pilings rise on either side of the dock's platform and act as anchors to the railings that shield travelers from the open water on either side.  The southern railings are draped with fishing nets that block the view of the rocky shore immediately below, while the northern ones are left open to provide an unobstructed view of the open harbor.  Several steps lead down from the main dock and through an arch to the pier beyond.

title: [Western Harbor, Pier One]
description: New planks mingle with older ones upon the pier, their addition creating a stripped pattern across the smooth platform as it juts a short distance out into the sea.  A series of oak steps leads to the main dock on one side of the pier, while on the opposite side is a small canvas-sided awning sheltering a bench.  Fishing boats are moored to the edge of the dock, their arrangement neat and tidy with an equidistant spacing between each.

title: [Western Harbor, Docks]
description: Protected on opposite sides by railings, the platform of the dock shows recent signs of repairs.  Newer planks mix with the discolored older ones in an alternating pattern that is erratic and unpredictable.  A set of steps leads through a small arch and down to the pier below.

title: [Western Harbor, Pier Two]
description: Separated from the main dock by a pair of steps, the pier is slightly lower and stretches out into the waters of the harbor.  Mushroom-headed moorings line both sides of the platform, which is constructed of oil-treated oak, while blown glass globes are strung in a straight line from the tall pilings.

title: [Scuttlebug Tavern]
description: Rough oak planks spread from the entry at one end of the room to the dinghy-shaped bar that is surrounded by stools at the other, their slender surfaces riddled with large and small knots.  High above, a chandelier housing dozens of candles provides ample illumination for each of the various tables that are scattered throughout, while also illuminating the various signs that hang from the rafters.  A rickety staircase leads to the upstairs and connects with a balcony that encircles half of the tavern.

title: [Scuttlebug Tavern, Hallway]
description: Plain and unadorned, the western wall of the hallway has a pair of doors set into its smooth facing, one of knotty oak and the other of driftwood.  Directly opposite the entries is a railing that overlooks the common room below, which culminates in a rickety knotty pine staircase leading down.

title: [Citadel, Stairwell]
description: Moonlight filters in through an arrow slit in the wall, shedding light on a stone spiral staircase that descends into darkness below.  An old wooden chair sits at the top of the stairwell, its seat rotted through, next to glass bottle knocked over on its side.

title: [Citadel, Dungeon Landing]
description: Smooth black stone walls run north from a spiral staircase that winds upward and out of sight.  Several chairs and tables lie stacked to either side of the hallway, forcing a narrow passage between them.  Behind the makeshift barricade, skeletons in timeworn uniforms and rusting armor lie sprawled across the ground in a mess of broken and discarded weapons.

title: [Infirmary]
description: Sunlight intrudes easily between the warped boards and roof slates of this shack to illuminate various medical items, a good thing because the windows are so grimy as to be almost opaque.  A mannequin leans against a corner with nearly its whole figure swathed in bandages.  Against the far wall an assortment of cabinets hold medicinal ingredients of various shapes, sizes and potencies.  Several cots in remarkably clean condition occupy spaces here and there, and a ladder drops into depths unseen.

A mannequin leans against a corner with nearly its whole figure swathed in bandages.  Against the far wall an assortment of cabinets hold medicinal ingredients of various shapes, sizes and potencies.  Several cots in remarkably clean condition occupy spaces here and there, and a ladder drops into depths unseen.

title: [Meeting Cavern]
description: A huge salt cavern stretches deep underground.  Shadows cast by a hundred wall-mounted torches play across the off-white walls.  Rows of gleaming white stone benches with padded silver cushions cascade down to a spacious marble dais over which a huge banner hangs.  Plush emerald carpet covers the floor between the rows of benches.  Despite the many torches, the air is cool and dry in here.  An iron ladder affixed to the east wall leads up through a hole in the cavern's roof.

title: [Empath Guild, Alchemy Lobby]
description: The intricate marquetry of wood from the foyer continues in the spacious lobby, including a narrow pattern of lilies created from white ash set into dark maple that wraps around the walls of the circular room.  Five wood-framed arches lead off from the room to separate patios, allowing a slight breeze to flow through the room carrying with it the scent of honeysuckle.  In the center of the room rests a cushioned bench wrapped around a dark wood pedestal.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Empath Guild, Storage Room]
description: Four torches set into stands in the four corners of the room illuminate the narrow rectangular chamber and its dirt floor.  A strong smell of mildew fills the room and several mushrooms sprout downwards from the ceiling.  The room is empty but for a large wood closet and dust bin.

title: [Alley]
description: A pair of dogs feast on an unidentifiable lump of something, growling viciously anytime anybody gets close.  What sounds like an argument is bellowing forth from several of the buildings, confined mostly to yelling and screaming.  An occasional flowerpot sails across the sky, usually missing its mark and shattering against a wall.
A dwarf looms in the shadows, picking her teeth with a small dagger.  She is garbed in expensive elven-crafted clothing, but wears no jewelry.  Her eyes are wary, but her posture relaxed.

title: [Rooftop]
description: The roof is mostly level, although weather has taken its toll on some portions.  The building provides a good vantage of the alleyway below.  A few sparse clouds float aimlessly overhead, partially blocking out the harsh sun of the day.

The roof is mostly level, although weather has taken its toll on some portions.  The building provides a good vantage of the alleyway below.  A few sparse clouds float aimlessly overhead, partially blocking out the evening stars.

title: [Warehouse]
description: A staircase leads down, the steps cracked but probably sturdy enough to use.  A small rat sits atop one of the steps, an odd glimmer in its eyes.  It doesn't seem startled by your presence.

title: [Warehouse]
description: Doors have been removed from the smaller rooms surrounding the perimeter of this floor.  Training dummies peer out from several of the rooms, odd expressions painted upon their faces.

title: [Grand Entry]
description: A grand entry and marble tiled floor beckons you deeper into the building to explore the luxuries contained therein.  Double doors lead to the courtyard, and a sweeping staircase leads up to the second level.  Cream colored, gold-veined marble composes the top of a spindle-legged occasional table that stands near the entryway.

title: [Hall]
description: A polished wooden staircase curves downward from this wide landing, the checkered pattern of the marble tiles below visible at its base.  A pair of statues reside on thick pedestals on either side of the staircase, one an elegant crystal unicorn, the other an intricately carved wooden dragon.  Facing each other and striking similarly aggressive poses, the statues appear to be passing judgment on all those who ascend the stairs.

title: [Hallway]
description: A staircase leading down to the cellar is flanked on either side by oaken pedestals topped with decorative statuary.  Framed portraits and landscapes done in a variety of styles line the outer wall.  While each piece of art is aesthetically pleasing in its own right, the ensemble as viewed together seems somewhat mismatched.

A staircase leading down to the cellar is flanked on either side by oaken pedestals topped with decorative statuary.  Framed portraits and landscapes done in a variety of styles line the outer wall.  While each piece of art is aesthetically pleasing in its own right, the ensemble as viewed together seems somewhat mismatched.  A small crystal oil lamp hangs from a hook at the top of the stairs, illuminating the descent.

title: [Cellar]
description: Several elegant silver sconces filled with scented oil illuminate this generously sized cellar.  Alcoves lead off in all directions, most serving as some type of storage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west

title: [Rogue Guild, Lower Hall]
description: Deep, azure glaes has been crafted to resemble the flowing cascades of a waterfall in miniature.  The artful sculpture resides within a small nook hung with phosphorescent moss that casts a mysterious glow upon the volcanic glass.  A dark stairway stands in the corner of the hall.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
description: Stark and unadorned, the corridor turns a sharp corner into the adjacent hall.  The nearest source of light lies many yards to the north and northwest, leaving much of the area swathed in shadows.  Small seams run down and across the surrounding polished black marble, marking the edges of each perfectly cut block.  A dark stairway is visible just beyond a large, arched alcove built into the eastern wall.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Hall]
description: Smooth marble walls speckled with mica that glimmers slightly in the ambient light form a sharp curve in this section of the hallway.  Situated in the corner are several heavy pots filled with lichen and toadstools, creating a tiny subterranean garden that is luminescent in varying shades of blue and green.  A shadowed alcove harbors the small landing to a dark, descending stairway.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lower Hall]
description: A portion of the ceiling has been replaced by thick sheets of clear glaes that allow a glimpse into the surrounding rock laden with raw rubies.  The bright illumination provided by giant, glowing toadstools highlights the deep, sanguine hue of the gemstones.  Beyond a simple, polished granite archway is a dark stairway leading to the floor above.

title: [Rogue Guild, Lower Hall]
description: Several tiny crystal charms dangle from the speckled cap of a nearby luminescent toadstool, glimmering in the soft white light.  A trio of onyx orbs have been suspended above the small landing to a wide black marble stairway.  The distant sounds of training can be heard originating from the grand, descending passage.

title: [Rogue Guild, Descent]
description: Sloping downward in two different directions, the passageway walls are draped in fuzzy blue-green moss, lighting the way with their luminescence.  A massive, rusted iron safe with its door pried open sits in the corner and currently is home to some tiny, glowing toadstools.  A clamor can be heard from beyond the tunnel to the west.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry Hall]
description: This once elegant foyer retains the vestiges of its former beauty.  A deep crimson rug lies across the darkened rosewood planks, softening visitors' footfalls.  Dark-red velvet curtains hang from dust-covered windows, preventing passersby from looking in.  The front door has been nailed shut, rendering it useless as an exit.  A wide staircase curves up to the railing at the second floor landing.

title: [Rogue Guild, Narrow Hall]
description: A rosewood railing runs along this portion of the hall allowing a view of the foyer below.  The soft, woven rug makes all footsteps silent.

title: [Rogue Guild, Ballroom]
description: The marble floors of the former ballroom are covered with training mats.  Heavy velvet curtains and shuttered windows exclude any light from the outside, but the tinkling glass chandelier provides ample light for the members to work at their tasks.

title: [Rogue Guild, Conservatory]
description: Neglect has turned this once well-tended conservatory into a jungle.  Birds, finding their way in through the broken windows, flutter in the flora while guild members train on mats laid on the gravel paths below.

title: [Rogue Guild, Conservatory]
description: Tangled vines and overgrown shrubs provide a home for the stray birds and small mammals that have made their way through the broken glass into the conservatory.  The singing and chattering provide background noise for the members training on the mats laid out on the gravel paths below.  A large fig tree has broken its way through the ceiling.

title: [Conservatory Roof]
description: Iron strips provide a grid for walking between the panes of glass that form the conservatory roof.  In one area, the strips have been bent and twisted where a tree has forced its way into the sunshine.  From the street below you can hear the muffled sound of voices and the distant hurly burly of commerce.

title: [Rogue Guild, Warehouse]
description: This small warehouse has been piled to the rafters with a variety of barrels and crates that look to contain an endless variety of goods from many ports -- everything from spices to bolts of cloth to fine brandies to scrap metal and dried oats seems to be stored here.  An open area has been cleared to the west.

title: [Rogue Guild, Storage Cellar]
description: The low roof and winding tunnels of the cellar give the impression that it was probably an ancient halfling residence, burrowed long ago.  The curved walls are stacked with crates of glassware and foodstuffs, and a mouthwatering aroma of stewing meat, spices and garlic emanates from the wooden arch to the east.

title: [Inn, Cubbyhole]
description: This narrow area is lined with unfinished cedar.  Motes of dust drift down an air shaft.  An agile person might be able to shinny up the air shaft.

title: [Inn, Rooftop]
description: You stand at the very edge of the roof at the back of the inn.  Red glazed, barrel tiles make the footing risky.  Moonlight glints off the spire of a minaret to the northwest.  A breeze carries the slightly tangy smell of the distant bay.  To the east, entirely surrounded by thick brambles, is a dingy, stucco building that appears long abandoned.  For the stalwart, a rope bridge leads over the brambles to the roof of the abandoned building.  A narrow air shaft leads down.

title: [Rogue Guild, Rooftop]
description: Although the roof tiles look disordered and broken a meticulous inspection shows them to be carefully arranged to give the appearance of deterioration.  The roof overlooks a grassy courtyard in which figures can be seen engaged in rigorous guild exercises.  A rope ladder leads down.  A rope bridge offers a route to the roof of the River's Rest Inn.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry Hall]
description: Glazed ceramic tiles with an ornate indigo design cover the lower third of the sand-colored walls in this hallway.  Larger tiles rim the peaked arches that lead to the east and west.  On the wall, in a humble oak frame, is an ancient map.  A sturdy door leads south.

title: [Wizard Guild, Foyer]
description: Upward-sweeping arches of stone, impossibly slender yet seemingly ageless, rise overhead to meet around a slender shaft.  Between the stonework, panels of stained and clear glass allow starlight to stream into this roughly triangular room.  The outlines of the three towers of the guildhall are clearly visible, as well.

title: [Wizard Guild, Shaft Base]
description: You stand atop a platform of flame-cut granite fashioned into a perfect circle and positioned beneath a shaft, matching in shape and stone, extending far overhead.  Several guild wizards pass through the foyer below in quiet conversation.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: Musty old tomes and ancient writings compete with newer works and essays for space on the shelves of this library.  Ten shelves rise from floor to ceiling in each dark walnut bookcase, and ladders provide access to the higher shelves.  The crimson carpet carries the feel of extra padding, totally muffling the passing footsteps.  Brass candelabra grace each walnut desk, illuminating private places for study and contemplation, while a stern-looking librarian presides over this repository of knowledge.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This sturdy pine platform rises fifty feet into the air, considerably higher than most of the surrounding terrain.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off reflected light from below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  A gusty sea breeze causes the platform to sway somewhat precariously.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Vaults]
description: Long, narrow passageways lead away from the stone-walled cavity, each one passing beneath the graceful bend of a glaes-tiled arch.  Winding its way upwards in a tight spiral is a silver staircase, its steep path enclosed within a cage of equally argent metalwork.

title: [Ta'Illistim Keep, Hallway]
description: An elaborate labradorite-topped mistwood railing surrounds the well of a spiraling silver staircase, which descends from the center of the room into some lower, deeper chamber.  Alabaster tile set in a circular pattern covers the floor, each piece accented with natural silver striations.  The deep sapphire draping of an ornate archway contrasts with the surrounding stone.

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coast]
description: Surrendering to the descent of the terrain, rock-strewn soil tumbles and scatters along the natural rock steps leading to the powdery sand of the beach.  Dense shadows cling to the outskirts of the dark jungle looming to the north, and the ever-present resonations of nocturnal creatures occupying the labyrinth battle against the lapping sounds of the ocean along the shore.  Moonlight glitters off the endless span of blue water greeting the coastline, rippling with the rhythmic approach and retreat of the tide.

Surrendering to the descent of the terrain, rock-strewn soil tumbles and scatters along the natural rock steps leading to the powdery sand of the beach.  Clusters of vegetation embrace the outskirts of the exotic jungle looming to the north, and the ever-present resonations of the inhabitants of the dense labyrinth battle against the lapping sounds of the ocean along the shore.  An endless span of blue water greets the coastline, rippling with the rhythmic approach and retreat of the tide.
a.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Small Clearing]
description: The trees have been cleared out here to create space for a large bamboo changing hut.  A trio of flickering torches positioned near the hut cast light upon the lettered sign propped up against it and provide some illumination for the narrow footpath worn into the soil in the direction of the nearby lagoon.

The trees have been cleared out here to create space for a large bamboo changing hut with a brightly lettered sign propped up before it.  A trio of unlit torches rest beside the hut, while a narrow footpath is worn into the soil in the direction of the nearby lagoon.
b.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Waterfall]
description: Dense shadows complicate travel along the path edging a rocky plateau.  Moonlight reflects upon the mist cascading down from the top of the falls, casting prismatic glimmers in a striking contrast to the oppressive darkness of the jungle at night.  Slick with condensation, the outcropping levels out to accommodate exploration, while the path provides a way to the next level of the waterfall.

Ascending terrain complicates travel along the dense path edging a rocky plateau.  Mist cascading down from the top of the falls resembles miniature crystals sparkling with the reflection of the lush hues of the jungle.  Slick and gleaming with condensation, the surface of the outcropping levels out to accommodate exploration, while the path provides a way to the next level of the waterfall.
a.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Waterfall]
description: The natural beauty of the multilevel waterfall is striking from the vantage point of this topmost plateau.  Winding in from the northwest, the crystalline water of the river cascades down over the ledge to pool up and overflow from the next level, then empties into the mist-shrouded lagoon at the bottom.  Travel is only possible on the western side of the water, as the terrain thins considerably on the eastern side where it surrenders to the coastal cliffs that plunge sharply to the beach.

Fed by the river winding in from the northwest, the multilevel waterfall shimmers with muted shafts of moonlight that enhances its natural beauty.  The dark water spills forth in a cascade over this plateau to pool up on the next, then empties into a shadowy lagoon below with splashes of water that rise up in misty plumes.  Deep shadows accentuate the darkness of the jungle on the western shore, while the other is open to the night sky as the terrain surrenders to the coastal cliffs.

Fed by the river winding in from the northwest, the multi-level waterfall shimmers with muted shafts of moonlight that enhances its natural beauty.  The dark water spills forth in a cascade over this plateau to pool up on the next, then empties into a shadowy lagoon below with splashes of water that rise up in misty plumes.  Deep shadows accentuate the darkness of the jungle on the western shore, while the other is open to the night sky as the terrain surrenders to the coastal cliffs.
