b.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coastal Cliffs]
description: Flanked by thick foliage to the east and the deep cerulean sea to the west, the rocky cliff begins to narrow as it meets the sandy beach.  Rising from the ocean, the thunderous sound of crashing waves create a rhythmic beat accompanied by the thrum of nocturnal creatures.  Perched upon one of the slender, bent trees, a trio of seagulls sleep quietly, their heads tucked carefully beneath their wings.  Carved by the elements, thin slabs of sandstone sidestep down the rocks in a slippery passage to the beach below.
a.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Tidal Pool]
description: Crisp sea spray explodes into the air as rhythmic ocean waves meet large boulders dotting the small, shadowy expanse of beach.  Rushing up the sand, the salty water races to refresh densely packed pools gathered in the many nooks and crannies almost obscured by the night shadows near the base of the cliffs.  Moonlight glistens on the green algae and yellowing seaweed covering much of the slick steps climbing haphazardly up the cliff-face.

Crisp sea spray explodes into the air as rhythmic ocean waves meet large boulders dotting this small expanse of beach.  Rushing up the sand, the salty water races to refresh densely packed pools gathered in the many nooks and crannies found near the base of the cliffs.  Green algae and yellowing seaweed covers much of the exposed stone.  Climbing haphazardly up the cliff-face, slick steps have been eroded into the dense rock by years of exposure to the wind and sea.
b.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coast]
description: Shadows dance across the steeply sloped, golden sand dunes that develop then become compacted as the beach transitions into rugged cliffs to the northwest.  Shafts of hazy moonlight break through the large trees that edge the sand to the north, the vegetation slowly changing to bare scrub as it nears the rocky coastal terrain.  Piles of driftwood, cast aside by the fickle ocean, lay randomly about the dark, seaweed-strewn shore.

Steeply sloped, golden sand dunes develop then become compacted as the beach transitions into rugged cliffs to the northwest.  Large trees edge the sand to the north, the leafy vegetation slowly changing to bare scrub as it reaches the rocky coastal terrain.  Rolling in the surf, a pile of seaweed serves as a trap for any of the stray logs used as the sea's playthings.  Piles of driftwood, cast aside by the fickle ocean, lay strewn about the shore.
a.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Wilds]
description: The brilliant hues of hundreds of flowers are muted in the shadows of night, the closed blossoms lining thick liana vines wrapped around massive trees.  Delicate moonflowers, pale and glistening with mist in the dappled moonlight, compete for resources with scrubby dandelions.  Sprouting up amongst ferns and decaying logs, tall patches of blue, white, and purple larkspur sway in the cool night breeze.  Towards the south the jungle begins to thin along a rocky decline, and the faint sounds of waves can be heard.
b.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coast]
description: Shadows stretching across the landscape enhance the foreboding backdrop of the jungle against the natural beauty of the coastline.  Foam crests upon the wet sand, and shallow gullies are left in the wake of the ocean as it ebbs from the shore, only to refill with murky water when the tide comes back in.  A salty breeze permeates the cool night air, and moonlight reflects from the dark surface of the ocean as it laps at the beach.

The constant presence of the jungle serves as a dark and foreboding backdrop to the beauty of the coastline.  Foam crests upon the wet sand, and shallow gullies are left in the wake of ocean water as it ebbs from the shore, only to fill with water when the tide comes back in.  Decaying driftwood clutters the beach randomly, with spindly seaweed tendrils clinging to the water-swollen debris.  A salty ocean breeze permeates the air, while the cries of seagulls join the lapping sounds of the water.
a.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Mooring Dock, Shoreline]
description: A series of wooden steps leads down to the shoreline of the island, each plank covered in slick spray and crusts of salt from the water.  Several posts jut forth from the walkway here to tie off boats, flickering lanterns casting illumination upon them and the glassy water cradling them in its current.
b.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Coast]
description: The shadows of night provide a dark background to the expanse of sand surrendering to the ocean's grasp as its foamy waves rush forth and retreat rhythmically on the shoreline.  A flock of pelicans rest upon a large boulder, their bodies still but for the occasional shift of feet as they huddle together in the moonlight.  Collections of seaweed cling to the debris cluttering the beach, and moonlight reflects from the dark surface of the ocean as the sound of waves crashing filters in on the evening breeze.

The vibrant plants and trees of the jungle provide an exotic background to the expanse of sand surrendering to the ocean's grasp as its foamy waves rush forth and retreat rhythmically on the shoreline.  A flock of pelicans gather upon a large boulder, only moving from their resting place to dive into the water and retrieve fish in their large gullets before returning to their perch.  Collections of seaweed cling to the debris cluttering the beach, and the cry of seagulls accompanies the crash of waves.
a.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [Saewehna Jungle, Wilds]
description: Moonlight highlights the labyrinth of plants and trees punctuated by masses of vines hanging from the dense canopy.  Exotic, nocturnal flowers dot several of the malachite tendrils as they weave their way through the shadows in the vegetation, and the nighttime calls of various creatures are joined by the muted sounds of the ocean.  The gradual change in the terrain is clear as travel further south is restricted to a steeply descending path.
b.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

title: [The Pitchfork Pub]
description: The spacious interior of this renovated barn bears a bustling tavern and kitchen.  A tanik plank ladder climbs up the back wall of the barn, leading upwards to the loft.  Mounted on the wall above the battered haon bar is a three-pronged matte steel pitchfork.  The hard-packed earthen floor is covered with a thin layer of straw.  A rectangular haon notice hangs from one of the posts of the building.
a.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [The Pitchfork Pub, Loft]
description: A tall wrought iron railing runs along the edge of the loft.  Some bales of golden hay are arranged in a circle around the middle of the balconied loft.  Glass-paned lanterns hang from the beams overhead and provide a gentle illumination in the loft.  At the back wall, a tanik plank ladder leads back down into the tavern.
b.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Beezer's Barn, Main Floor]
description: The smell of fresh hay permeates the area, the source of which lies in the hayloft at the top of a narrow wooden ladder.  Here on the main floor, several stalls house a variety of farm animals brought in for the night.  Moonlight filters through the window above the double barn doors, illuminating the room with a silvery glow.  Hanging oil lanterns light up a rusted metal shelf along one wall that holds a variety of farm tools.  In the back, a small wooden door leads deeper into the barn.

The smell of fresh hay permeates the area, the source of which lies in the hayloft at the top of a narrow wooden ladder.  Here on the main floor, several stalls lay barren, their occupants put out to pasture.  Sun let in from the window above the double barn doors illuminates a large swath of the hay strewn wooden floorboards, and motes of dust dance delicately in the ray of light.  A rusted metal shelf along one wall holds a variety of farm tools.  In the back, a small wooden door leads deeper into the barn.
a.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Beezer's Barn, Hayloft]
description: Huge piles of hay lie scattered all over the dirty wood floor of this loft.  A hook and pulley system high overhead serves to bring bales of hay to the main floor.   Coils of rope and several other tools hang from pegs on the far wall.  Two oil lanterns on either side of the open window light up the room, while the sound of chirping crickets drifts in from outside.  A clear space on the floor right near the wooden ladder is set up with a low three-legged stool and a large woven mat.

Huge piles of hay lie scattered all over the dirty wood floor of this loft.  A hook and pulley system high overhead serves to bring bales of hay to the main floor.   Coils of rope and several other tools hang from pegs on the far wall.  An open window lets in the warm breeze from outside stirring the heavy scent of fresh hay that suffocates the air.  A clear space on the floor right near a narrow wooden ladder is set up with a low three-legged stool and a large woven mat.
b.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: Numerous rows of corn stretch onwards, forming a pathway to the north.  Dried corn husks litter the fertile dirt underfoot.  The neck of a dark green glass bottle pokes out from between two stalks of corn.
a.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Maze]
description: A small oak-hafted steel sickle gleams wickedly from its position discarded on the ground in the vermillion corn husks beside a pyramid of stacked crates and a wooden ladder.  It is obviously a well cared for farm implement, but someone seems to have left it lying here for someone to possibly injure themselves on.
b.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Grawood Farmstead, Town]
description: Square wooden planters filled to overflowing with pansies in a variety of colors stand beside a set of thick modwir steps leading to the general store.  A pair of rocking chairs sit on the store's porch, while garlands of greenery and flowers are draped from the edge of the roof.
a.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [General Store, Porch]
description: Warped and faded to grey, the raised decking is uneven and rickety.  A sagging awning shields the storefront from foul weather, though several patches attest to past inadequacies.  At the back of the porch, the store wall is set with a single door bracketed by two large windows.  Neatly lettered signs cover much of the wall's surface, often masking holes or gaps in the boards.  A wooden swing, suspended by iron chains, hangs at one end of the porch, while a cluster of rocking chairs sits at the opposite end.
b.location: Grawood Farmstead outside of River's Rest

title: [Cleric Guild, Training Foyer]
description: Intricate marquetry of naturally hued woods, incorporating palest pine, purple-grey haon, vivid red cedar, and dusky ebonwood, forms the walls of this grandly proportioned foyer.  Assorted training rooms and their attendant equipment can be glimpsed further inside the training annex.  The dry, herbal scents of cedar and sandalwood fill the air, the aroma more intense near the lamps set along each wall.

title: [Cleric Guild, Study Hall]
description: Resembling an octopus in shape, the study hall has eight narrow tunnels branching off in a variety of directions and two large globes anchored into the stucco ceiling offering cheerful illumination.  Five of the tunnels are curtained for privacy, while the remaining three remain open for public use.  A braided rug rests underneath a carved soapstone table that has a mosaic-inlay of colorful tiles and is surrounded by comfortable linden chairs topped with deep blue cushions.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Charcuterie Weyr]
description: Two glass-paned cases square off, facing each other across the shop.  Their contents not withstanding, the room is almost entirely white -- whitewashed stone walls, a white tiled floor and a white marble-topped bar set in a recessed space along the back wall combine in a cool, clean aesthetic.

title: [Charcuterie Weyr, Lounge]
description: A marble slab tops the stand-up bar, behind which is a wall of racked bottles.  The space is separated from the rest of the shop by a set of three short steps, which lead down into the half-moon shaped cutout.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Garden]
[Maezneris Villa, Garden]
description: Dwarf evergreens lend their shade to the delicate twists and turns of the garden.  Large boulders draped with pink-budded fetterbushes stand out amid white-striped lily turf and crimson monkey grass along the northern edges of the pebble path, while a narrow streambed trickles into a koi pond lined with tufts of dwarf bamboo.  Splashes of color generated by the flowering presence of azaleas and crimson ginger blossoms create interest near some smooth round stones.

Dwarf evergreens lend their shade to the delicate twists and turns of the garden.  Large boulders draped with pink-budded fetterbushes stand out amid white-striped lily turf and crimson monkey grass along the northern edges of the pebble path, while a narrow streambed trickles into a koi pond lined with tufts of dwarf bamboo.  Flanking a series of smooth stone steps, bright azaleas and crimson ginger blossoms bloom on one side, while a stone-lined bed of colorful flowers dominates the other.  Resting on the edge of one pale step is a small earthenware bowl.

title: [Meazernis Villa, Patio]
description: Lacquered bamboo dyed a warm red hue spreads across the simple patio to create an even floor, while matching poles are laced together on two sides to form narrow privacy walls.  High above, a lattice of woven bamboos creates an open roof that houses hundreds of tiny silver lace vines that create a natural canopy of verdant and white hues.  Painted screens of delicate rice paper frame a glass-paned white birch door that leads into the villa, while smooth round stones lead into the garden beyond.

High above, a lattice of woven bamboos creates an open roof that houses hundreds of tiny silver lace vines that create a natural canopy of verdant and white hues.  Painted screens of delicate rice paper frame a glass-paned white birch door that leads into the villa, while smooth stone steps lead into the garden beyond.

title: [Pagination, The Stacks]
description: The building is cylindrical and two stories, with a mistwood staircase spiraling upwards in the center of the room.  Matching railings rim the second floor, which overlooks the shelves and cases built into the curving lower wall.  The single arched doorway is framed by two octagonal windows, each of which is paned in sapphire glass.

title: [Pagination, Reading Room]
description: Beneath a domed ceiling of mosaic glaes tiles, the upper floor of the shop is given way to a ring-shaped reading room of blue velvet settees and overstuffed ivory leather chairs.  In the middle of the room, a mistwood staircase spirals downwards to the ground level, with matching carved mistwood railings blocking any inadvertent drop-offs.

title: [Krolvin Warship, Bottom Deck]
description: Crammed with banded barrels and crates that are stacked up to the planking overhead, this small area reeks with the odor of rot and waste.  The sound of waves slapping against the outer hull drowns out all other noises.
a.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Moist air laden with a mixture of rust, rot, and salt fills this section of the companionway.  A wide brush slathered with pitch lies on the floor next to a bucket of glossy black tar.  The ends of tar-soaked strips of oakum protrude from the hull where they have been crammed between planks, while even more gaps remain to be caulked.
b.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship, Second Deck]
description: Warped planks give this section of the deck an uneven cant that is echoed in the fitted wooden boards of the bulkheads.  Tacked to the forward bulkhead by seven iron spikes is an enormous spotted walrus skin.  In one corner of the compartment, a large knot in the wood has been burrowed out by claw and fang to create a small rodent nest.
a.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Krolvin Warship]
description: Faded green paint peels from the wooden housing protecting the rough, square-shaped hatch that leads below deck, by way of some wooden stairs.  Tepid water forms a small puddle in the hatch cover, which lies discarded against the hemp stays of the main mast.
b.location: somewhere on the Great Western Sea

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Lower Landing]
description: Torches set in simple iron sconces cast their flickering light across this small chamber.  Although its construction of heavy timbers and stone appears solid, its builders wasted no effort on ornamentation.  The top of a domed cistern is visible in one corner, its granite top pierced by a narrow opening.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Upper Landing]
description: The scents of freshly dug earth and ozone mingle unpleasantly in this cramped room.  The low ceiling is supported by roughly hewn planks supported by adze-cut posts, which also serve to brace the earthen walls.  The solid granite floors appear to be the natural bedrock, pierced by a staircase winding downward.  In stark contrast to the rough surroundings, a gleaming eahnor archway is set in one wall, flanked by a pair of stone panels.

title: [Empath Guild, Training Hall]
description: Wide blue-washed sandstone floors stretch down the hallway, covered down the middle with a light acantha green carpet.  A carved apple wood staircase curves upwards, and vertical matching apple wood moldings occur along the walls at regular intervals with limestone-potted sweetferns at the base of each.  A slender doorway pierces the wall opposite the staircase, while a large vine-limned archway leads east to a foyer.

title: [Empath Guild, Upper Hall]
description: Canted ceilings of green-tinged glaesine sheets rise high overhead, held in place with verdigris copper mullions, and a few intrepid vines wind across the outer panes, having clambered up from the cloister columns below.  Luminous moonlight drifts through the vines and ceiling, highlighting a pale acantha green limestone floor with blue-washed linen carpets.  An apple wood staircase curves downward, and an array of shadowy viridian ferns clusters along the walls, almost obscuring a narrow door.

Canted ceilings of green-tinged glaesine sheets rise high overhead, held in place with verdigris copper mullions, and a few intrepid vines wind across the outer panes, having clambered up from the cloister columns below.  Sunlight streams in from the ceiling, highlighting a pale acantha green limestone floor with blue-washed linen carpets.  An apple wood staircase curves downward, and clustered along the walls, an array of viridian ferns drinks in the sun, their lushness almost obscuring a narrow door.

title: [Sorcerer's Isle, Forest]
description: Coppery beech trees and bough-spreading white oaks block out nearly all moonlight, making an eery landscape of shadow upon darkness cut with blades of silver.  Barely visible, a crooked path winds around the trunks in a north-south direction, while a narrow ravine leads down to an old creekbed.

Coppery beech trees bearing patches of lush moss, thriving parasitically on the rough grey bark, grow in small groups apart from the taller, bough-spreading white oaks.  Some of the dark green foliage bear spiny orange-red pods, hedgehog galls, temporary home for young wasps.  A crooked path winds around the trunks in a north-south direction, while a narrow ravine leads down to an old creekbed.

title: [Sorcerer's Isle, Swale]
description: Spongy and slightly squishy, the grass-blanketed depression that was once an old creek bed still holds a bit more moisture than surrounding land.  Purple loosestrife and blue-violet pickerel rush have sprung up in spots, amid flowering cattails and bullrush.  Crickets seem to favor the location with their cacaphony.

title: [Cavern]
description: The sound of dripping water echoes off of the rough walls of the cave.  Large torches burn wildly, causing shadows to dance across the uneven stone surfaces.  A few steps lead up to an old altar that stands against one wall.  In the other direction, the light fades away into a deep, dark cavern.  Small mirrors are scattered along the wall of a large shaft that leads upward into blackness, and one large mirror is suspended just above the rock floor directly underneath the shaft.

title: [Cavern, Altar]
description: An old, dusty altar is set in the center of this small raised area.  The wall behind the altar is bare except for a row of five rickety levers connected to a thick rope that leads upward.  Each lever has been painted a different color: yellow, blue, brown, red, and green.  The torch light flickers ominously across the walls and pillars that brace the heavy stone ceiling.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Library]
description: This center of knowledge also seems to serve as the center of traffic for the Guild.  Smooth, cool limestone flooring leads off to the north, northwest, northeast and west, while a ramp leads steeply upward to the south.  This windowless room holds thousands of manuscripts on magic, history, geography, and a myriad of other subjects.  Easy chairs scattered about provide places to rest and read, each accompanied by a standing brass lamp.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This sturdy burled oak platform rises fifty feet into the air, considerably higher than most surrounding Solhaven buildings.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off light from the city below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  The soft warm breeze causes the platform to sway a bit.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Foyer]
description: Thick white polar bear fur covers the floor leading off to the east and west.  The snarling heads of arctic wolverines adorn the ironwood walls, and long slabs of mammoth tusk ivory form floorboards and headboards along each wall section.  Two freestanding candelabras carry ten candles each to illuminate the room.  In one corner a winding staircase leads downward, and frigid air intrudes through a pair of double doors.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Cavern]
description: Sharp stalactites hang menacingly from above in this enormous basalt cavern, and twisted nooks and recesses in the walls form mysterious dark passages.  Large pipes extend from floor to ceiling in four areas of the cavern.  A raised white marble dais occupies the north wall beneath a huge banner, and torches burn brightly along the smoother portions of the surrounding walls.  Covered by white polar bear fur, the floor supports rows of benches in tiers rising from the dais to the back of the cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Meeting Cavern]
description: Sharp stalactites hang menacingly from above in this enormous basalt cavern, and twisted nooks and recesses in the walls form mysterious dark passages.  Large pipes extend from floor to ceiling in four areas of the cavern.  A raised white marble dais occupies the north wall beneath a huge banner, and torches burn brightly along the smoother portions of the surrounding walls.  Covered by white polar bear fur, the floor supports rows of benches in tiers rising from the dais to the back of the cavern.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Den]
description: Dark walnut paneling and open beam construction make this room seem more spacious than it really is.  White polar bear furs and brown grizzly hides cover the floor, presenting comfortable places where one can just flop down and rest.  Trophy heads from tigers, pumas, and other fierce local beasts adorn the walls, appearing very much alive in the flickering firelight.  Two massive mammoth tusks leap out from the wall above a huge white sandstone fireplace that provides the room's only illumination.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Landing]
description: A trio of giant luminescent toadstools resides upon the landing, casting each third of the area in a slightly different hued light.  Thin veins of crystal weave across the stone walls, creating fanciful patterns against the darker rock.  The floor is punctuated by a few stout stalagmites around the perimeter.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Tunnel Nexus]
description: Slivers of azurite crystal have been inlaid into a dizzying spiral pattern upon the cold stone floor.  The slightly arched ceiling has been carved with a swirling design that faintly resembles flowing runes.  Against the western wall, a set of onyx-inlaid doors are flanked by two recessed alcoves that house stairways leading to the lower level.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Relaxation Room]
description: Overstuffed chairs and sofas rest on plush silver carpeting in this elegant resting room.  Several large paintings illuminated softly by nearby lanterns hang on the walls.  A fire burns merrily in the spacious fireplace, its mottled grey granite a soft contrast to the surrounding dark brown walnut paneling.  A refreshment cart in the corner offers several tasty and refreshing selections.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Planetarium]
description: This sturdy ironwood platform rises fifty feet into the air, considerably higher than most of the surrounding terrain.  The platform has been painted black to absorb as much ambient light as possible, and the sides of the platform are walled to a height of four feet to shut off reflected light from below.  Under a nearby overhang, several charts depict the nighttime constellations along with descriptions of the most popular ones.  The soft warm breeze causes the platform to sway a bit.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Portside]
description: A brisk breeze blows across the port rail, carrying with it the smells of the bay.  A couple of burly halflings elbow -- or some might say 'knee' -- by, muttering something that sounds like "don't much like tha cut 'a his sail, tha bloomin'..."  They soon pass out of hearing and disappear down the companionway to the 'tween deck.  Next to the rail, narrow stairs lead up to the poop deck, where sailors are busy checking lines and swabbing the deck dry.

title: [Spitfire, Poopdeck Portside]
description: The tall mizzenmast's sails are furled, and a couple of halflings are busy in the rigging, checking for wear.  From the mast, a spanker boom traverses the poopdeck's promenade and juts out over the stern rail.  The spanker boom is secured over the beautiful ship's wheel, a masterpiece of polished wood.  Chatter can be heard from the saloon skylight, located just aft of the coach house.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Portside]
description: The forward deckhouse sits just behind the foremast, two lifeboats lashed topside-down on its roof.  Raucous laughter can occasionally be heard from the crew's quarters inside the deckhouse, mixing with the melody played by a group of minstrels strolling the wharf below the Spitfire's rail.  Sitting forward of the mast, a forehatch gives access to cargo areas below deck.  A narrow flight of stairs leads up to the forecastle deck, and there is a narrow door leading into the forward deckhouse.

title: [Spitfire, Forecastle Portside]
description: The forecastle deck offers a splendid view of the buildings lining the wharf, a jumble of different facades sporting all manners of color and tone.  Brightly painted signs hang from the fronts of some, emblazoned with fanciful images and names.  Lines stretch from the rail to groups of pilings along the edge of the wharf, holding the Spitfire securely at dock.  A polished flight of stairs leads down to the main deck.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Starboard]
description: "Ahoy t' deck!" comes a call from the rigging high above where a crow's nest can be seen perched among the yards of the mainmast.  The breeze blowing in from the open sea carries off the rest of the garbled message.  A group of thickly muscled sailors works intently, polishing railing and checking tack for wear.  One, a particularly robust halfling, oversees their efforts, barking orders in her loud, raspy voice.

title: [Spitfire, Poopdeck Starboard]
description: Open sea stretches into the distance from the mouth of the bay.  The aroma of hemp from the backstays competes with the smell of tar from the rigging and the ocean's brine.  Just 'fore the poopdeck is the quarter boat, hanging from its arched white support arms.  Off the starboard rail, a small fishing boat tacks toward open sea, leaving the echo of a sea chantey drifting across the waves.  There is a group of halflings lounging on a raised platform in front of the ship's wheel.

title: [Spitfire, Quarter Boat]
description: The longboat is constructed of polished white planks traversed with butter-yellow oak ribs.  Diffused light permeates the canvas tarp covering the boat -- and you -- creating a cozy enclosure, albeit a low-ceilinged one.  A rope ladder drapes over the edge of the boat.  The halfling sitting here appears to be quite at home.  He bends over a small object, totally engrossed, while his hands work over it so rapidly it's hard to follow their progress.  His busy eyebrows dance in league with his flying fingers.

title: [Darkstone Bay, Shipside]
description: In one direction, the view is completely obscured by the wooden planks of a large ship, the Spitfire, which is anchored alongside the dock area of the bay.  A rope ladder hangs down from one of the covered stowaway boats that is cinched to the side of the ship.  In every other direction, chilly, dark blue water spreads out all around you, and small waves send you bobbing along the surface.  Across the bay, several buildings are visible in the distance, and further out, the open sea is a balmy blue.

title: [Spitfire, Main Deck Starboard]
description: The main deck narrows just aft of the tall foremast, where the deckhouse begins.  Barrels are stacked and secured against the rise of the forecastle deck.  A slatted door leads into the deckhouse, and from the squeaks, squeals and halfling giggles coming from inside, it's a good bet the door leads into crews' quarters.

title: [Spitfire, Forecastle Starboard]
description: The deck of the forecastle displays an intricate pattern of inlaid woods.  Deep mahogany contrasts with lighter-hued maoral wood and pine, crafted into an image of a mariner's compass.  Off the starboard rail, a shapely sloop tacks toward the mouth of the bay, needing no help in the brisk breeze.  The cries of seabirds overhead mingle with the bright melody of the minstrels strolling the wharf.

title: [Swords 'n Boards]
description: Cramped quarters only allow for sparse furniture.  A narrow wooden table stands near a solid black wooden door, its surface covered with small weaponry.  Near the back, a rickety ladder leads through a rectangular hole in the ceiling.  Partially falling apart with rot, a long water-damaged rack encompasses one full wall and houses shields of various sizes and styles.

title: [Swords 'n Boards, Crawl Space]
description: Not quite a room, the ceiling is barely high enough for a man to stoop and not hit his head.  The crawl space stretches off to the west where the ceiling lowers and the end is lost in the dim and dusty air.  The only light filters up from a rectangular hole in the floor.  The layer of dust on the floor around the hole has been disturbed, rendering some areas cleaner than the rest.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Hot Stuff]
description: Black sand outlines a winding path leading to a bizarre sight.  All other nearby furnishings are dwarfed by a giant fake volcano standing in the middle of this area of the hold.  A tall pile of obsidian marks the only navigable ascent up the clearly manmade structure.

title: [Tropic Treasure, Hot Sauce]
description: High above the floor, the top of the strange volcano is riddled with various vents, though the gaping volcano mouth is the most prominent and disturbing feature of this structure.  The air is thick with the pungency of hot peppers, and occasional bursts of smoke diffuse the spicy scent everywhere.  Steep, though passable with effort, the side of the volcano is the only apparent path.

title: [Methais's Home, Living Room]
description: A large bearskin rug covers most of the floor, with polished haon flooring showing between it and the cherrywood wainscoting.  A pair of relaxing-looking overstuffed chairs and an ottoman face a big ol' comfy couch with a pillow at either end.  A spiral staircase leads upstairs from the southeast corner of the room, and on the other side of the front door a wide window looks out onto the intersection of Nerite Lane and Eastbridge, lit by the glow of the streetlamps.

title: [Methais's Home, Hallway]
description: Matching the decor of the living room, cherrywood wainscoting below ivory plaster walls gives this narrow hallway an elegant look.  A polished haon door is set into the center of the hallway's south wall, while a felwood door stands opposite to the north.  The hallway ends well beyond these two at a multi-paned white door, where squares of sky are visible above the door's gathered curtain.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: Sunlight filters in through a thick, frosted window set high on the wall.  To the north is a carefully engineered tunnel.  A knotted rope leads up through a hole in the ceiling.

title: [al'Khalili Coffeeshop, Alcove]
description: This tiny, undecorated alcove is concealed behind a partition.  The aroma of strong coffee fills the area.

title: [Moot Hall, Chamber of Justice]
description: Two high-backed, elaborately carved chairs face the imposing, burnished oak bench where members of the official Town Council convene to decide matters of solemn importance.  A narrow stairway leads up to a low balcony that surrounds the chamber, providing ample seating for interested visitors to observe the proceedings.

title: [Moot Hall, Observation Balcony]
description: Several rows of hardwood benches line the balcony, each row a bit higher than the previous one in order to provide a view of the proceedings below from every seat.  A polished oak railing forms the front barrier of the viewing area, and a narrow stairway leads down.

title: [Willow Hall, Garden]
description: Wildflowers of every color abound, their rich aroma filling the air.  A willow tree stands proudly in the center of the beds, its leafy garlands caressing the ground and swaying gently in the breeze.  To the west is a crystal blue pond, and beyond that sit two wooden benches and a table, providing an inviting spot to sit and relax in the warm sun.  A small cottage sits back in the southwest corner with a gazebo opposite it.

title: [Willow Hall, Veranda]
description: Wide fieldstone steps lead past a terra-cotta strawberry pot onto a veranda sheltered by latticework intertwined with ivy vines.  Patterns of shadows chase across the floor as sunlight filters through the emerald leaves.  A myriad of colorful flowers, planted in window boxes and hanging baskets, exude a fragrant perfume, born on a gentle breeze that rustles through the ivy and sets a wind chime tinkling.  A pot of blooming violets sits on a table placed next to a generous woven grapevine swing.

title: [Willow Hall, Willow Tree]
description: The bole of the monstrous willow is surrounded with a wealth of hanging garlands.  They obscure the existence of a small enclave at the base of the tree near some louvered swinging doors, both curtained off by the tiny silver-backed leaves.  Constantly shifting spots of sunlight filtering through the boughs are hypnotic.  High up in the branch system, a circular construction is barely visible encircling the willow's trunk.

The bole of the monstrous willow is surrounded with a wealth of hanging garlands.  They obscure the existence of a small, shadowy enclave at the base of the tree near some louvered swinging doors, both curtained off by the tiny silver-backed leaves.  Soft moonlight filters through the boughs, leaving the silhouette of the branches as stark, black lines.  High up in the tree top, a circular construction is barely visible in the night's cloak of darkness.

High up in the tree top, a circular construction is barely visible in the night's cloak of darkness.

title: [Willow Hall, Tree House]
description: The tree house is a simple, round wooden platform.  Interlaced willow branches form a wall about four feet high around the perimeter, concealing its dwellers from anyone below.  From above, soft moonlight bathes the aerie with its benevolent illumination.  Several benches sitting in a scattered array create an inviting rendezvous destination for a small group informally inclined.  To one side, a polished brass telescope is mounted on a pedestal.

The tree house is a simple, round wooden platform.  Interlaced willow branches form a wall about four feet high around the perimeter, concealing its dwellers from anyone below.  From above, warm sunlight bathes the planks of the floor with a dappled pattern.  Several benches sitting in a scattered array create an inviting rendezvous destination for a small group informally inclined.  To one side, a polished brass telescope is mounted on a pedestal.

title: [The Crystal Lotus, Entry]
description: Wide open windows flank the entrance and provide an excellent view of the street, which is lined with tropical blossoms.  Polished golden linden floors spread across the room towards the white walls that are hung with a variety of pictures, each depicting a different flower in full bloom.  A glass-front cabinet stands as guardian before a wall-hugging wooden staircase that leads to the second level.

title: [The Crystal Lotus, Kitchen]
description: Cabinets and counters decorate the northern wall around a small window framed by gauzy blue curtains.  Beneath the frameless structure, a small blue sea glass wash basin is set into the countertop, which also houses a teak drying rack.  In the center of the room, a round wooden table topped with white linen has some curve-backed teak chairs around it.  Hugging one wall, a wooden staircase leads into the shop below.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Pier One]
description: Bright violet canopies striped with grey are anchored to the tall pilings of the pier and sporadically bounce in the slight breeze that occasionally rises from off of the harbor.  Strung along the length of the fabric, tiny orbs glitter in the bright light of the day and reflect the light into rainbow swirls upon the whitewashed wood of the pier.  Descending towards a dock, a pair of smooth wooden steps slips through an arch hung with an elegant painted sign and is flanked by smooth wooden railings.

Strung along the length of the fabric, tiny orbs flicker and provide soft illumination for the pier.  Descending towards a dock, a pair of smooth wooden steps slips through an arch hung with an elegant painted sign and is flanked by smooth wooden railings.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Boat Rental]
description: Surrounded by polished railings, the small dock is comprised of whitewashed floorboards and is occupied by a lanky and tanned sailor.  Benches provide a convenient place to rest, while colorful umbrellas stand open and offer protection against the heat of the day.  Ascending to the pier, a pair of smooth wooden steps slips through an arch and is anchored in place by large black iron nails.

Benches provide a convenient place to rest, while glass lanterns dispel the dark of the night.  Ascending to the pier, a pair of smooth wooden steps slips through an arch and is anchored in place by large black iron nails.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Beyond a corbelled marble arch, a spiralling stairway rises to the upper levels of the hall.  Flowering vines complete with dainty curled tendrils have been painted along the walls, framing the archway.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: Evenly spaced windows line the inner wall, offering a bird's eye view of the hall's lush courtyard.  Pale olive green and ivory tiles form a simple checkered pattern along the floor, curving southward in both directions.

Evenly spaced windows line the inner wall, offering a bird's eye view of the hall's darkened courtyard.  Pale olive green and ivory tiles form a simple checkered pattern along the floor, curving southward in both directions.

title: [Empath Guild]
description: A single winding stairway with rose-carved alabaster banisters rises to the peak of the hall's highest tower.  A velvety blue sapphire runner spills like a waterfall down the steps, pooling to a crescent-shaped landing.

title: [Guildmaster's Office]
description: A splendid ring of windows around this spire affords a panoramic view of the hall, inner courtyard, and bustling var below.  This cozy aerie has been decorated with a neatly kept desk and distinctly elven furnishings.  Spaced intermittently around the desk are fanciful crystal sculptures, sparkling in the sunlight.

A splendid ring of windows around this spire affords a panoramic view of the torchlit hall, inner courtyard, and quiet var below.  This cozy aerie has been decorated with a neatly kept desk and distinctly elven furnishings.  Spaced intermittently around the desk are fanciful crystal sculptures, glistening in the moonlight.

title: [Mist Harbor, Vineyard]
description: Cream-hued limestone walls glimmer in the golden sunlight, the new mortar that surrounds them dark against their incandescent coloring.  A carved limestone staircase rises from the crushed cinnamon bark path that winds its way to the north east and provide egress to the top of the guild.

Cream-hued limestone walls glimmer in the silvery moonlight, the new mortar that surrounds them dark against their incandescent coloring.  A carved limestone staircase rises from the crushed cinnamon bark path that winds its way to the north east and provide egress to the top of the guild.

title: [Cleric's Guild, Shrine]
description: Large and round, the shrine is built at the top of a tower and surrounded by an alternating pattern of limestone pillars and arching windows.  Rising from the heart of the room is the sculpted image of a blooming tree that houses a resplendent statue of Jaston.  Encircling the arboreal structure is a low altar that is pockmarked with bird's nests.  Dozens of birds have made this place their home, their soft song filling the air.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Foyer]
description: Full-length windows fill the spaces between the pairs of stately pale white marble columns deeply veined with ebon that flank the oversized cherrywood double doors.  Across from the entry, an elaborately carved door sits off to one side of a wide staircase leading to a carpeted landing above, then further up and out of sight.  The sound of splashing water in a small marble fountain echoes across the foyer.

title: [Ebonstone Manor, Second Floor]
description: At the top of a wide staircase, a smartly dressed steward stands to one side of a corridor lined with ivory paper-covered walls and ebonswood wainscoting.  Ornate silver sconces hang on each side of a polished ebonwood door and a white monir door.  A narrow, cushioned bench rests beneath a glass lunette window dominating the far wall.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Small Park]
description: The cobblestone path widens, becoming a large rectangular common area.  Wrought iron benches have been placed along the perimeter of the platform and flanked with tall ceramic vases of flowers.  At the center of the commons is a large rose garden filled with hues ranging from white to pale lavender.  A pair of short stone steps leads down to the east toward a small reflection pool.

Arranged for a rewarding view of the rose garden, wrought iron benches occupy various corners of the garden, with one resting beneath a tall lamppost that dangles a large glaesine orb.  Silvery moonlight glitters off of the white cobblestones set in the path, as well as a pair of short stone steps that leads to a wishing well.  Cedar chips scattered upon the ground prevent the massive amounts of roses from becoming cloying, while a light breeze brings forth the faint scent of the nearby ocean.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Wishing Well]
description: Periwinkle violets wink in the golden sunlight as they mingle with the verdant ivy that encircles the stone base of the wishing well, their petals glistening with moisture.  Though the roof is missing, the arms rise from the plump body and still hold aloft a pulley that suspends a hemp-tied bucket over the glittering waters at its base.

Though the roof is missing, the arms rise from the plump body and still hold aloft a pulley that suspends a hemp-tied bucket over the glittering waters at its base.

title: [Great Hall, White Chapel]
description: Deep cobalt blue tiles stretch across the floor, their glossy expanses decorated with white trilliums that provide a delicate accent to the white walls and high ceiling.  Twin alcoves flank the altar, one trimmed in carved wildlife and the other in verdant ivy bands.  An enormous stained glass window in the shape of an inverted diamond occupies the back wall, its image that of a young couple gazing up at the sun as they kneel in prayer.

title: [Groom's Waiting Room]
description: Silver and ebon-veined marble tiles spread across the floor towards walls that are painted with scenes of the wild hunt.  Standing before a wide open window is a full-length mirror, while a glass-covered wrought iron table nearby houses a set of playing tiles.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a set of polished linden stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble fauna-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Great Hall, Ebon Chapel]
description: Golden tiles mix with ebon as they stretch across the floor to meet with the linden walls that are accented with ebonwood columns that spiral upward to a sanguine dome ceiling.  Wrought iron wall sconces ring the upper reaches of each carved support and are fitted with dark green, white, and pale yellow tallows, which spread golden illumination through the area.  An enormous stained glass window is the focal point beyond the ebon marble altar and is framed by twin alcoves, one lined in gold and the other lined in silver.

title: [Bride's Waiting Room]
description: White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the light seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows that they frame and is accompanied by the spill of golden sunlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the cool seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows and is accompanied by a spill of silvery moonlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Albatross, Gambler's Rest]
description: Darkly paneled walls are adorned with silver dice and gold playing cards, while alabaster floors are visible beneath runners of plush, royal blue carpeting.  A cherrywood bar runs the length of the room, amply stocked with shelves of various alcoholic beverages and accouterments.  An open arch to the southwest leads to the prow of the riverboat, and a wrought iron spiral staircase climbs up to the next level.

title: [Silvers Aweigh Spirits]
description: Sunlight filters through the heavy, leaded crystal windows that span floor to ceiling on the port and starboard sides.  A gold-accented, circular mahogany bar sits in the center of the dark green marble floor, and a silver and gold buffet table is pushed against one wall.  A heavy tapestry partially blocks the hallway toward the prow, and a door leads to the aft.

title: [Silvers Aweigh Spirits]
description: Sunlight filters through the heavy, leaded crystal windows that span floor to ceiling on the port and starboard sides.  A gold-accented, circular mahogany bar sits in the center of the dark green marble floor, and a silver and gold buffet table is pushed against one wall.  A heavy tapestry partially blocks the hallway toward the prow, and a door leads to the aft.

title: [Albatross, Captain's Taproom]
description: Leaded crystal windows line the fore and starboard walls, and a lacquered rosewood bar stands at a diagonal in one corner, its gilted carvings sparkling in the daylight.  A pair of crystal doors leads to a small starboard balcony, and there is an arch in the portside wall.  Darkly hued chestnut marble covers the floor, its alabaster and gold veins forming an albatross at the center.

title: [Cavernhold, Guard Post]
description: This narrow ledge lies between a deep chasm to the west and a high wall that blocks further passage to the east.  Spanning the chasm is a narrow suspension bridge.

title: [Cavernhold, Lower Passage]
description: A maze of stalagmites makes travel in any direction other than northwest quite impossible.  Far above you can be seen a narrow suspension bridge that spans the high canyon walls that loom above you.

title: [Courtyard]
description: Red brick walls heavily covered in thick tendrils of dark green ivy block passage to the east and west.  To the north a shining silver portcullis intrudes on the expanse of wall, flanked by brightly burning sconces.  Here and there throughout the courtyard small trees stand in simple brick planters, and stone animals peer out shyly from behind them.  The courtyard extends a few yards to the south, dropping sharply away to present a view of the rest of the Guild.

title: [Hub]
description: Three stairways lead from this small plateau.  A short stairway leads straight up while a terraced stairway and a winding stairway snake downward.  To the north a retaining wall of heavy white quartz boulders holds back the upper level.  Honeysuckle cascades liberally over the boulders to fill the area with a sweet scent.  At ground level tall beds of snapdragons and gladioluses wave in the sea breeze that gusts in from the waters of the canal visible to the south.

title: [Hub]

To the north a retaining wall of heavy white quartz boulders holds back the upper level.  Honeysuckle cascades liberally over the boulders to fill the area with a sweet scent.  At ground level tall beds of snapdragons and gladioluses wave in the sea breeze that gusts in from the waters of the canal visible to the south.

title: [Relaxation Garden]
description: Climbing roses clamber up the northern wall of this expansive garden, their large, fragrant blooms reduced to whites, and greys in the moonlight.  Topiary animals frolic among hybrid tea roses, and sizeable rocks, their tops flattened to resemble stone end tables, sit beside metal rocking chairs accompanied by burning torches.  A winding stairway ascends steeply to the northeast, while a stone stairway drops away quickly to the southeast.  Flickering lights dance from a shaded nook.
