title: [Training Garden]
description: A long terrace snakes around the side of the cliff to the east.  Light grey ice plant cascades down the northern wall from above, clinging to the white limestone outcroppings.  To the south the ground drops steeply away, tumbling over the wall to the canal below.  Various stations have been set up to allow training in weaponry, martial arts, and bodybuilding, and several sets of sandbags rest under a tall gingko tree.  Far to the east, two figures stand as if awaiting someone.

title: [Relaxation Garden]
description: Climbing roses clamber up the northern wall of this expansive garden, their large, fragrant blooms reduced to whites, and greys in the moonlight.  Topiary animals frolic among hybrid tea roses, and sizeable rocks, their tops flattened to resemble stone end tables, sit beside metal rocking chairs accompanied by burning torches.  A winding stairway ascends steeply to the northeast, while a stone stairway drops away quickly to the southeast.  Flickering lights dance from a shaded nook.

title: [Potion Platform]
description: The small platform clings precariously to the side of the canal wall.  A stone stairway leads upward while a wooden stairway slips down into a recessed cavern below.  The wall, the stairways and the canal's waters underneath encompass the platform.  Long, winding orchid vines sporting dark flowers entwine around the platform's railing, and narrow workbenches support bottles, herbs, powders, and ointments piled haphazardly.

title: [Potion Platform]
description: The small platform clings precariously to the side of the canal wall.  A stone stairway leads upward while a wooden stairway slips down into a recessed cavern below.  The wall, the stairways and the canal's waters underneath encompass the platform.  Long, winding orchid vines sporting dark flowers entwine around the platform's railing, and narrow workbenches support bottles, herbs, powders, and ointments piled haphazardly.

title: [Meeting Cavern]
description: Slightly raised above the canal's waters outside, this deep limestone cavern extends several hundred feet back before tapering to a rounded point.  Rows of polished ironwood benches with emerald green seat cushions and backs line either side of the wide aisle that leads to the dais at the cavern's pointed end.  Torches mounted high on the wall above each bench serve to illuminate the silver carpeting, the white limestone dais, and the huge banner that hangs from the cavern's ceiling.

title: [Empath Guild, Corridor]
description: Carefully imbedded into the walls are tiny shards of local gemstones in a spiraling pattern that runs from floor to ceiling.  A pair of blue-toned luminescent toadstools flank the rails of a winding stone stairway.

title: [Empath Guild, Annex]
description: A trio of archways lead away from the half-moon annex, partially obscured by velvety curtains.  The grey marble floor has been inlaid with a repeating diamond design, alternating in color between shades of red and blue.

title: [Cleric Guild, Corridor]
description: Fine dwarven masonry is on display at this small juncture between floors of the guild.  A steep ramp descends below via a wide tunnel, its curved ceiling inlaid with a colorful mosaic of local gemstones.

title: [Cleric Guild, Shrine]
description: A harmonious blend of stone and metalwork sweeps across the shrine, present in the walls, domed ceiling, and supporting columns.  Each material's surface has been polished to a high gloss, resulting in the reflected light obscuring the borders between them.  An elaborate eostone altar stands across from a burnished invar gong, connected by a path of etched brass medallions inlaid into the smooth, pale limestone floor.

title: [Cleric Guild, Foyer]
description: Vaulted ceilings frame this wide gallery, set with skylights of polished glass.  An intricately woven carpet covers the white stone floor, a brilliantly plumed peacock staring up imperiously from the woven silk.  The foyer narrows on either side, bearing torch-lit hallways that lead further into the guild.

title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Teaching]
description: High vaulted windows line the walls of this large room, letting the light fall in muted tones on the sinuous contours of the teaching hall.  Wide steps hewn from silver-flecked marble provide both walkway and seating, leading down to a sunken dais in the center of the circle.  A thin ornamentally carved podium sits atop the dais, situated so that is easily viewed from anywhere within the circular hall.

title: [Foyer]
description: Expansive, rigidly perpendicular, and made of creamy white limestone, the entryway hints at quiet meditation and cool contemplation farther to the interior.  A double staircase, its steps centered between the three arches leading to the rest of the building, joins to itself in a landing rimmed with a golden baluster to the front.  Two wide, carved doors of white pine leading to the outside have been limned with golden paint to pick out the details.

title: [Landing]
description: Only wide enough for two or three people to pass each other uncomfortably, the landing gives a view of the magnificent foyer below.  A few small icons hang on the wall to each side of the door set in the middle of the wall.  Carpeting covers the floor, its plush pile dyed a pale eggshell color.

title: [Drakes Vanguard, Portico]
description: The hushed closeness of thick, cut-stone walls embrace the murky darkness of this windowless anteroom.  The few rays of moonlight penetrating from outside vaguely illuminate the floor's uneven paving stones and the ladder ascending to a small platform that projects from an otherwise featureless north wall.  The sharpened ends of a massive, iron-pronged deadfall suspend perilously overhead from a heavy chain affixed to a hewn oak beam supporting the roof.

title: [Drakes Vanguard, Great Hall]
description: Rough-hewn stone walls adorned by tapestries, sconces, and bas-reliefs enclose the spacious hall.  Carved oak posts support trusses overhead, each draped with a red and gold banner.  Arched, clerestory windows open to the sky with a thick, cut-glass, oriel window overlooking the waves rolling onto the rocky beach outside.  A blue stone mosaic and silver-veined quartz pedestal are at its center with colorful rugs, chairs, and sofas scattered across its stone-tiled floor.

title: [Drakes Vanguard, Library]
description: A hand-painted globe and an oak bookstand displaying a tome bracket the main doorway of this long, narrow room.  At the center are a heavy map table, reading tables, and a bin containing the books and maps to be returned to the shelves.  Wrought iron lamps illuminate the neatly rolled charts and leather-bound volumes on the shelves against the high-windowed walls.  A stone stairwell spanned by a spiked steel gate descends through the north wall.

title: [Drakes Vanguard, Landing]
description: The wind whips strongly across the trapezoidal-shaped granite fortification.  The roar of heavy surf crashing against the seawall surrounds you with its disquieting procession frequently accompanied by spray.  A narrow stone quay extends northward into the grip of the unfriendly sea, with a narrow stairwell climbing the fortress wall on the landward side.  Atop a raised platform at the center of the landing is a massive oak ballista.

title: [Stone Baths, Hearth]
description: The hearth room is dimly lit by brass lamps mounted along the dark mahogany walls.  A trio of deep blue cushioned chairs faces a grey sandstone fireplace in the corner, while a slate-topped bar runs the length of an entire wall.  A cluster of dark oak tables rests in the center of the room, not far from a brass archway.

title: [Stone Baths, Upstairs Hall]
description: Mahogany-hued carpeting runs the entire length of the hall, brightened by silvery moonlight streaming in through a large arched window.  A series of painted doors line each side of the walls, while at the end of the hallway a sturdy ladder leads up to a wooden hatch in the ceiling.

title: [Stone Baths, Upstairs Hall]
description: Mahogany-hued carpeting runs the entire length of the hall, brightened by silvery moonlight streaming in through a large arched window.  A series of painted doors line each side of the walls, while at the end of the hallway a sturdy ladder leads up to a wooden hatch in the ceiling.

title: [Stone Baths, Rooftop Garden]
description: Brass handrails rise up along the edges of the bathhouse's stone rooftop, enclosing a wide flat surface that is mostly dominated by vivid flowerbeds, brightened by the moon's silvery rays.  The view from the garden is expansive, revealing the shadowy streets of Wehnimer's Landing and the dark forests beyond the town.

Brass handrails rise up along the edges of the bathhouse's stone rooftop, enclosing a wide flat surface that is mostly dominated by vivid flowerbeds, made even brighter by the sun's warm light.  The view from the garden is expansive, revealing the bustling streets of Wehnimer's Landing, the lush green wilds, and Darkstone Bay beyond.

title: [Begetting Besiegers, Sky Arena]
description: High walls rise up to encase this open arena in a solid cover, muting the sounds of the town to a quiet muffle.  Sunlight from the open sky glints off the surface of tall flag poles, their banners stirring slightly with the breeze.  The arena itself is a circular stretch of scuffed dark slate, surrounded by a set of wide stone steps which lead up to an observation deck.

title: [Begetting Besiegers, Watch Deck]
description: A sturdy wooden observation deck stretches out in a half-circle providing ample room for spectators.  A carved ironwood railing provides some leaning comfort to onlookers while they view the arena below.  The tops of flagpoles rise up from the sides of the deck and stretch up into the open sky above.

title: [Cavernhold, Inside Pavilion]
description: This rugged structure appears to have been built specifically to house the only prominent feature in the room: a steeply spiralling staircase that cuts through the rock floor of the pavillion and leads down to a darkened chamber below.

title: [Cavernhold, Lower Passage]
description: The path divides into two levels here, the lower level dwindling to a crevice toward the south causing travellers from the north to clamber down into a shallow and stone filled trough.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Planetarium]
description: The black walls are circular, creating a dark cylindrical space.  Domed, the ceiling is riddled with tiny holes and lit from behind.  The light shining through the holes mimics the starlight on a cloudless night.  All the constellations well-known to the local area can be seen among the stars.  A narrow stone staircase leading up and a set of spiral stone stairs leading down rest against one curved wall, while four constellation tapestries hang an equidistance from each other on the rounded walls, their contents illuminated by the starlight from above.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Observatory]
description: All four walls are open to the surrounding area, and yet protected from the elements by the domed ceiling supported by carved columns that rise from a matching white marble railing.  A large brass-fitted telescope against one railing peers up into the heavens.  In the center of the room, a black cast iron brazier rests beside a basket of sticks.  Situated in a circle around the fireplace are several sofas, settees, and armchairs.  A low polished oak table sits between two chairs, its surface laden with refreshments.  A narrow stone staircase leads down.

title: [Sunken Mausoleam, Hallway]
[Sunken Mausoleum, Hallway]
description: Stagnant water pools at the back of the mausoleum on the opposite side of where the archway leads back to the entry.  The walls are a green tinge with patches of moss growing up the granite.  The slope in the floor comes to an end just before a short flight of steps leading further inside.

title: [Sunken Mausoleam, Dead End]
[Sunken Mausoleum, Dead End]
description: Along the walls, a group of ebonwood coffins has been plundered, leaving only some skeletal remains.  The circular room is a dead end, and the only exit is the flight of steps leading back toward the front.  A rusted iron plaque, its surface barely legible, is hammered into the granite wall.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Under the Banyan]
description: Diffuse starlight filters down through the canopy overhead, dappling the grassy hillock at its base in shadows.  An open space around the foot of the tree is festooned with flags and rimmed with blazing torches.  Beyond the ring, the ground slopes away and down, bisected by paths cut through the ground-cover and into the moist earth.  Here and there the roots of the looming banyan force the trails to twist sharply, their protrusions forming inescapable obstacles of skyward-reaching wood.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west

title: [Black Banyan, Trunk]
description: The airy, open chamber is multi-leveled, arising organically out of a wind-carved pocket within the monumental trunk of the tree.  A similar pocket leads out from the room, and several of the heavy boughs are wide enough to act as paths in their own rights.  A single burning lantern hangs from the ceiling, illuminating a staircase leading further up into the canopy and a spiraling ramp leading downwards towards the base of the tree.

title: [Black Banyan, Trunk]
description: The airy, open chamber is multi-leveled, arising organically out of a wind-carved pocket within the monumental trunk of the tree.  A similar pocket leads out from the room, and several of the heavy boughs are wide enough to act as paths in their own rights.  A single burning lantern hangs from the ceiling, illuminating a staircase leading further up into the canopy and a spiraling ramp leading downwards towards the base of the tree.

title: [Black Banyan, Crown]
description: At the crown, the topmost boughs of the banyan brush the sides of the platform, cradling it in a dense tangle of wildly growing branches.  Burning torches are affixed to the rope railing that marks off the edge of the drop, beyond which is the ground, far below.  A spiraling staircase in the center of the landing leads back down into the heart of the tree.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: Neither trees nor brush add greenery to this large mud-flat at the apex of multiple pathways.  Deep rivulets and gouges mark the path of rainfall where it journeys from the higher ground inland, down towards the open water.  Fastidiously moored in the intransigent mud, a dilapidated boat with a twisted rope drooping down from its interior provides both respite, and an invitation for yet more revelry.

title: [Dilapidated Party Boat]
description: Grand in its day, the party boat is in complete disrepair.  Most of the white paint has flaked away, and the exposed wood is mildewing.  A busted string of lights enclose the main area that once served as a dance floor.  The wooden floor sags and creaks even with the lightest of footsteps, providing a shaky barrier from the swamp underneath.  A thick, twisted rope provides both mooring and a means to venture back to the muddy road.

title: [Foxfire Manor, Yard]
description: Glass from a huge shattered window glistens from the wet grass of the yard.  The parts of the manor's back lawn that have not been drowned by the encroaching bog are lush with overgrown grass and flowering, black-trunked trees, the latter of which have grown into a grove around the ruins of a stone well.  Other trees, less cultured and more wild, grow in abundance to the north, fusing into a dense and foreboding wood.

title: [Fusion Sanctum, Locus]
description: Curtains as red as rose petals, darkened by the oppressive damp, swathe the walls of the circular chamber in a display of moldering majesty.  The velvet draperies cannot muffle the sounds of trickling water from without, or hide glimpses of a rope leading up out of the depths.  They do, however, funnel and enhance the haunting whispers rising from a basin of green liquid at the chamber's center. Silver patterns are etched into the granite floor, spreading outward from the pool in concentric spirals.

title: [A Pocket Full]
description: A red and gold woven rug extends from the small archway at the front of the room to the complementing tapestry hanging at the back, as if the rug travels seamlessly along the dusty plank floor and up to the ceiling.  On either side of the runner, shop wares are displayed on various surfaces.  A darkly stained pine table stands opposite from a low etched metal bin, each illuminated by flickering lanterns that adorn the walls above them.  Nearby, a row of brushed metal hooks displays some longer garments.

title: [A Pocket Full, Roof]
description: Short wooden railings encapsulate this small open space on the roof of the wagon, with a glass-encased lantern perched atop each corner.  Open to the air, this room is susceptible to the changing weather and errant breezes.  Several squares of once plush carpet, now matted and stained by unknown fluids, are scattered around the plank floor for use as seats.  At the back of the room, an open trapdoor in the floor contains a wooden ladder that leads down into the belly of the wagon.

title: [Feymist Inn Lobby]
[Feymist Inn, Lobby]
description: Large bouquets of swamp blossoms and wildflowers in crystal vases are set about the room, atop several polished oak stands.  The elegance of the furnishings are negated by the massive head of large gator, jaws fully agape, mounted above a two-way stone fireplace.  The bustle of dining patrons can be heard from a grouping of tables to the north while others mingle near a set of etched glass doors leading out to the porch.

title: [Feymist Inn, Upstairs Hallway]
description: Heavy creaking arises with even the lightest step upon the stairtreads and hallway planking, making a serrupticious rendevous in the adjoining inn rooms unlikely.  Bright copper sconces provide the only illumination, both day and night, in this windowless space.  Glass knobs reflect the dim, flickering light, inviting guests into each of four carved wooden doors.

Heavy creaking arises with even the lightest step upon the stairtreads and hallway planking, making a surreptitious rendezvous in the adjoining inn rooms unlikely.  Bright copper sconces provide the only illumination, both day and night, in this windowless space.  Glass knobs reflect the dim, flickering light, inviting guests into each of four carved wooden doors.

title: [Abandoned Church, Nave]
description: The interior of the church is overrun with moss and vegetation that has crept in through the entrance and the various rotted wood that mars the structure.  Upon the eastern side of the church, swamp water seeps in from the outside.  Old pews are used to display wares, which rest on grey linens.  A silk tapestry hangs from the rafters, displaying the Pantheon of Liabo.  A short flight of steps leads up to the pulpit.

title: [Abandoned Church, Pulpit]
description: Once able to overlook the entire church, sections of the roof have since collapsed and block the view.  Through the holes in the roof, the darkness from outside pours into the church.  Several old crates are scattered across the floor nearby a short flight of steps that lead back down to the nave.

Once able to overlook the entire church, sections of the roof have since collapsed and block the view.  Through the holes in the roof, the darkness from outside pours into the church.  Several old crates and boxes are scattered across the floor nearby a short flight of steps that lead back down to the nave.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Primal Stand]
description: Several black gum trees and bald cypresses lean to one side or another, their branches caressing the swampy water and the limestone shoreline.  Several of the trees are clearly very old, their massive trunks covered in knots, their branches shot through with char, while others are little more than saplings growing up amid the tall brush.

title: [The Believer]
description: Narrow in width, expansive in length, the tented area is situated atop the impressively flat roofs of two connected wagons.  Providing illumination, tiny flames dance within glass stars that are suspended between the pale blue fabric walls.  An assortment of garments is displayed on silver racks that hang from the dark blue ceiling.

title: [Abandoned Church, Chancel]
description: Unlike the rest of the church, the chancel is restored almost to its former glory.  Varnished wood paneling encloses the room, with religious relics displayed upon it.  A glossy stone floor leads up to a gold-inlaid ironwood lectern and branches off toward the east and west.  To the north of the chancel is an ornate crown-shaped altar carved from white oak, which creates a dominating presence in the church.  Behind the altar is a stained-glass mosaic of the Great Drakes, their forms barely visible due to the lack of moonlight.

title: [Abandoned Church, Undercroft]
description: Circular stone walls covered in mold and mildew enclose the undercroft, each bearing a carved ledge.  Upon the ledges, sarcophagi rest, though their lids are removed, and whatever rested within has been plundered.  Leading up to the chancel, a torch-lined granite stairwell is the only source of light.

title: [Erythro Island, Crater Rim]
description: A dip in the rim creates a rocky trail that leads down into the basin.  The earthen perimeter ends at a flight of polished stone stairs that lead up to a huge sandstone keep that looms high in the air, towering above the crater.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: A set of polished stairs leads up to a thick stone wall that encompasses a towering sandstone keep.   A thin layer of frost clings to the sides of the walls.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Half-formed cobwebs cling to the far corners of the tunnel ceiling, collecting more dust than bugs.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Guttin' Goods, Stock Room]
description: A number of featureless and weathered mannequins clutter two corners of the backroom, their bodies sporting an array of fishing attire and accessories.  A few empty ale mugs and some grimy dice rest on top of a stack of unmarked crates.

title: [Guttin' Goods]
description: Two circular windows provide an ample view of the dark wharf outside, with a handful of dockworkers laboring late into the evening.   Moonlight from the open doorway casts a sliver of silver light across the shop's floor, while dim lanterns supply a sufficient brightness to the area.  A scruffy half-krolvin shopkeeper leans upon a driftwood counter and seems to doze off more than once.  The weak scent of sea salt lingers in the shop.

Two circular windows provide an ample view of the wharf outside, with dockworkers loading and unloading a handful of ships in port.  Sunlight from the open doorway brightens the shop, light glinting off of an assortment of equipment lining a wide corner shelf.  A scruffy half-krolvin shopkeeper stands behind a driftwood counter, conversing with some customers browsing about.  The weak scent of sea salt lingers in the shop.

title: [Warcat Suite, Landing]
description: The wide stairwell leads up to a worn and flat landing, enclosed by burnished wood paneled walls.  The head of a stuffed warcat has been mounted above an arched modwir door, its face covered in striped black and grey fur and its mouth frozen into a feral snarl.  A small brindle fur rug rests just before the door, its material weathered and matted with dried mud.
b.location: Warcat Suite, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Warrior Guild, Limestone Shed]
description: A thin layer of rocky debris blankets the floor, but distinct boot tracks mark the most heavily used areas of the shed.  Musty odors and the scent of oil hang in the air.  Secured against the wall is an iron tool rack, fully equipped with implements needed by guild members.

title: [Warrior Guild, Dark Basement]
description: Flecks of mica glitter within the walls of black granite blocks, though shadows cover most of the area.  Only a single, small luminescent toadstool offers illumination in this slightly dank chamber.  Faintly visible, a set of stone shelves holds a variety of unmarked vials and bottles, while a large clear glaes tank flashes below.

title: [Warrior Guild, Coldhouse]
description: Drawing closer to a set of heavy rhimar-lined doors, the air grows more frigid to the point that a thin sheet of ice crystals have formed upon the silver marble floor.  A two-tiered rack holds all sizes of fur-lined gloves for guild members to use in this cold place.

title: [Warrior Guild, Ice Cellar]
description: A handful of hearty luminescent toadstools illuminate the darkness of this cellar, revealing the ice-slicked floor and frosted metal rails against the walls.  Glistening, semi-frozen moss hangs across a darkened archway that houses a wide staircase to the upper floor.  Occasionally, an attendant garbed in a heavy cloak wanders into the cellar to lay bundles of fresh towels on two stone racks.

title: [Solano Hall, Waterfall]
description: This cavern unfolds from the entry gate to rise high into the air, culminating with a curved stone ceiling.  A waterfall cascades down the cavern's center, splashing on a few plateaus before hitting a set of narrow stone steps and disappearing with them into a narrow fissure in the floor.  An ascending set of stairs carved into the rockface leads up beside the falls, and multihued toadstools in pots rest on the steps in even intervals.  Each toadstool reflects off small specks of mica in the walls, illuminating the cavern with a glittering rainbow.

title: [Solano Hall, Geode Landing]
description: The walls are devoid of mica, their rough dark grey surfaces illuminated by several large, glowing toadstools that sprout directly from the roughly hewn stone floor.  A huge geode, split in half and filled with clear lacquer, serves as a bench, and a stone shelf hangs on the wall within arm's reach.  A descending stone staircase allows passage down through a hole in the floor.  Carved directly into the rock, a round window peers out onto the cavern below, and a western passage leads toward the sound of rushing water.

title: [Solano Hall, Waterfall]
description: This cavern unfolds from the entry gate to rise high into the air, culminating with a curved stone ceiling.  A waterfall cascades down the cavern's center, splashing on a few plateaus before hitting a set of narrow stone steps and disappearing with them into a narrow fissure in the floor.  An ascending set of stairs carved into the rockface leads up beside the falls, and multihued toadstools in pots rest on the steps in even intervals.  Each toadstool reflects off small specks of mica in the walls, illuminating the cavern with a glittering rainbow.

title: [Solano Hall, Rainbow Landing]
description: A steep set of stone steps arrives from above, hugging the wall and curving to rest on the circular stone floor.  Although the walls shimmer with rainbow flecks, the main attraction is on the floor.  The center of the floor is perfectly flat and covered by a shimmering quartz mosaic.  The gems have been carefully cut and fitted so that, in the muted light, the mosaic appears almost as one solid gem, shifting from color to color.  A wooden black table laden with shiny trinkets sits beside a western passage.

title: [Seamist Hall, Front Lawn]
description: Meandering through a rolling lawn of thick green grass, a decorative stone path leads from a white steel gate up to a large riverstone manor.  Tall modwir trees grow throughout the grounds, shading the building beyond.  Thick heliotrope bushes dotted with beautiful purple blossoms flank some steps leading up to the front porch, and add bright color to the verdant surroundings.  Hanging from carved wooden poles, colorful unlit lanterns line the walkway, the bases of which are surrounded by rings of bright lilies.

title: [Seamist Hall, Front Porch]
description: Standing to either side of a pair of stained glass doors are two white marble urns filled with a variety of blooming flowers.  A richly woven mat runs the length of the pristine white floor, stopping just before some porch steps.  Several wind chimes hang from the porch, catching the smallest breeze, while the sunlight glitters off the contents of a small wooden table covered with gold silk.

title: [Etesian Villa, Foyer]
description: Clean rosewood floorboards meet crisply painted walls, the pale green ivy design complementing the wood accents around the room.  Oil lanterns dot the wall at even intervals, illuminating the area with a soft golden glow.  Flanking the entry door on one side is a polished rosewood bin sitting between two benches, while on the other side, a wide oak table holds a variety of objects that glitter in the light.  Stretching deeper into the cottage is a long dimly lit hallway, and a gold-fringed woven tapestry hangs on the wall beside a narrow set of stairs.

title: [Etesian Villa, Landing]
description: Carpeted by a muted burgundy woven rug, the small patch of solid ground here at the top of the stairs is bordered by a rosewood-paneled wall that boasts a curved ebonwood arch, a pale linden door, and a curved golden doorway.  Through the former, the mingling scents of tobacco and alcohol exude in an invisible cloud.  Flanking the doors are two ensconced gold oil lanterns that easily illuminate the small space.

title: [Seamist Hall, Back Lawn]
description: Meandering through the lawn and a meticulously manicured flower bed, the flagstone path moves about a grey marble reflecting pool filled with large goldfish.  Flowering bushes and bright blossoms grow about, their color reflecting off the stone.  Nestled in a secluded verdant nook, a colorful woven hammock hangs between two giant twin oak trees.  The lawn drops away at the western edge, where a set of stone steps lead down toward the beach.

title: [Seamist Hall, Beach]
description: Wave upon wave of crushing surf constantly batters the beach, which is more pebbles and stone than sand.  In the distance, barges, sailboats, and other seaworthy vessels float atop the water, near the piers to the north and south.  A set of stone steps leads away from the beach, toward an elegant estate.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Common Room]
description: Highly polished wood floors are covered with woven wool rugs, providing splashes of color in the large, chandelier-lit foyer.  A burled maple doorway resides in the eastern wall, and a sweeping grand staircase leads to the second floor.  In the opposite corner, a dimly lit hallway leads to the interior of the lodge.  Several burnished leather sofas and chairs, facing a low stone hearth, invite rest, while a a wide gold-chased table is placed between them.  Beside the entry doors a small golden depository sits against the darkly paneled wall.

title: [Zephyr Hall, Landing]
description: Dark red satinwood paneling covers the bottom half of the walls, while the top half is painted a pale cream hue.  Sconces of polished brass hang on the wall, and a hammered tin ceiling displays an elaborate scene of hunters cornering their quarry.  A long runner of animal hides pieced into a repeated compass rose pattern ends at each of the three doors opening off of the area, while the staircase is left bare for its craftsmanship to shine.

title: [Iceland Lobby]
description: Though the rink is enclosed in walls of pure ice, drakar torches emanate a subtle heat that keeps the area warm enough for comfort, but not hot enough to melt the ice.  The upward curving walls support a huge translucent dome-shaped roof through which the sky is clearly visible.  The sunlight beating down through the ice refracts and casts dappled shadows on the rink below.  Hugging the rink's wall beside the entrance is a carved felwood skate bin, while opposite, a winding staircase leads up.

The moonlight streaming down through the ice refracts and casts dappled shadows on the rink below.  Hugging the rink's wall beside the entrance is a carved felwood skate bin, while opposite, a winding staircase leads up.

title: [Iceland Mezzanine]
description: The balcony wraps around the entire structure and offers a full view of the rink below.  From here the skaters gliding in circles around the ice would look like toys on a fancy music box.  Lining the walls are several potbellied stoves that sit on brick platforms between cozy aqua blue sofas.  A descending staircase hugs the wall opposite the railing.

title: [Mistral Hall, Porch]
description: The front, rounded wall of the semi-circular room is crafted from fine fishing nets stretched taut within a driftwood frame that also houses the entry door.  Standing against the flat back wall is a weathered grey table, while a carved wooden sign hangs above.  A white archway leads to the other half of the bottom level, while a set of narrow stairs heads upward through a rectangular hole in the ceiling.  Water lapping against the pilings below provides a soft, rhythmic sound, and the sea breezes permeate this open room.

title: [Mistral Hall, Banquet Hall]
description: White driftwood walls climb to a generous height, surrounding this semi-circular room.  Several open porthole windows offer a view of the area below, and allow faint breezes into the hall.   In the center of the room, a long darkly stained table is surrounded by padded wooden chairs.  Several sphere-shaped, green paper lanterns dangle from the ceiling, their light casting a variety of verdant shadows on the floor.  An ascending spiral steps resides near the back wall, and a narrow staircase leads down.  A curved pale blue doorway offers entrance to the next room.

title: [Mistral Hall, Banquet Hall]
description: White driftwood walls climb to a generous height, surrounding this semi-circular room.  Several open porthole windows offer a view of the area below, and allow faint breezes into the hall.   In the center of the room, a long darkly stained table is surrounded by padded wooden chairs.  Several sphere-shaped, green paper lanterns dangle from the ceiling, their light casting a variety of verdant shadows on the floor.  An ascending spiral steps resides near the back wall, and a narrow staircase leads down.  A curved pale blue doorway offers entrance to the next room.

title: [Mistral Hall, Lounge]
description: Only comprised of half of this upper floor, the space is semi-circular, and a watercolor painting hangs a smidge off-center on the flat wall beside a narrow white archway that leads to the next room.  Curtains of beads flutter in the open windows along the curved wall, their faint clicking mixing with the sounds of the water below in a rhythmic harmony.  Several wicker sofas with plush cushions rest around a sky blue rug in the center of the floor, and a tall white bookshelf displays a few tomes and sea glass knick-knacks.  A set of spiral steps leads down.

title: [Mistral Hall, Conservatory]
description: The rounded exterior wall is made of the same fine netting that encloses the porch downstairs, allowing the salty breezes to permeate the semi-circular room.  A variety of plants take residence on a tiered wooden table that runs along the netted wall, allowing the fauna ample sunlight.  Two low padded benches rest against the interior wall, flanking a narrow white archway.  Standing beside a set of spiral stairs are two potted palms and a stone planter filled with colorful flowers, their faint scents adding a subtle tropical ambiance to the room, while a small sea glass fountain sits on the floor nearby.

title: [Mistral Hall, Office]
description: Light breezes waft in through an open window, occasionally ruffling papers on a dark driftwood desk that stands, along with its matching chair, beside the curved pale ivory wall.  Oak-framed paintings of local flora and fauna are scattered on the opposite wall, their contents depicted in vivid hues that add sporadic splashes of color to the off-white room.  A rounded oak arch in the flat wall offers entrance into the other half of this circular level of the lighthouse, while a set of spiral stairs leads down.

title: [Mistral Hall, Chapel]
description: Light and airy, this half-circle room has been converted into a small shrine.  Woven meditation mats are spread across the hardwood floor, offering a place for restful repose.  The curved, pale green painted wall sports an open window and thin, sheer ocean blue curtains that flutter in the occasional breeze.  A low oak and seashell altar stands beneath the window, opposite from both a rounded oak arch that leads to the next room and a narrow set of stairs that heads up through an opening in the ceiling.

title: [Mistral Hall, Upper Deck]
description: A low metal railing surrounds the circular topmost level of the lighthouse without obscuring the view of the surroundings.  In the center of the space, a large fire pit rests in an iron retaining bowl to prevent the signal fires from spreading to the weathered wooden planks of the deck.  A bundle of thick wooden sticks rests in a basket nearby, and several fire tending tools reside in an iron rack.  Sitting atop a low table near the railing is a small earthenware bowl, while a narrow set of stairs leads downward through a rectangular hole in the floor.

title: [Welkin Hall, Oriel Chamber]
description: This northern portion of the common room is separated from the main by several folded screens of dark oak and golden silk.  Resting against the wall is a long pine table, coupled with several high-backed padded chairs stained a dark chestnut hue.  Recesses with scalloped arches are set in even intervals within the walls, each sporting a black iron sconce, with tall candles exuding faint curls of smoke.  Tucked in one such recess is an oak door, while opposite, another reveals a stone staircase that blends with the wall.

title: [Welkin Hall, Landing]
description: Stone walls give way to dark oak panels on the upper half, amber-paned oil lanterns lighting the narrow landing with a soft, golden glow.  Two doors stand at opposite ends, each one intricately carved.  The deep golden linden door to the left bears the image of an erupting volcano inlaid with ruby, while the mahogany door to the right presents a hulking pyrothag outlined in black deathstone inlay.  Opposite the doors, a stone staircase leads down into the belly of the building.

title: [House Sovyn, Foyer]
description: This spacious foyer is enhanced by a large glass skylight which reflects colored lights about the room and among many of the plants.  Comfortable chairs near a pinewood bar invite you to relax before returning to your duties.  Against one wall, a small walnut counter sits beneath a blackboard, and a silver arch, a green arch, and a white arch lead out of the foyer.

title: [House Sovyn, 1st Floor Hallway]
description: A plush, sea blue carpet runs the length of this hallway.  The walls are done in a patterned paper that reminds you of sea foam.  Two giant seashells flank the staircases.

title: [House Sovyn, Foyer]
description: This spacious foyer is enhanced by a large glass skylight which reflects colored lights about the room and among many of the plants.  Comfortable chairs near a pinewood bar invite you to relax before returning to your duties.  Against one wall, a small walnut counter sits beneath a blackboard, and a silver arch, a green arch, and a white arch lead out of the foyer.

title: [House Sovyn, Hallway]
description: A plush, dark brown carpet runs the length of this hallway to a pair of statues which stand flanking the staircases.  The walls are paneled in oak and lightly stained so the grain is still visible.

title: [House Sovyn, 1st Floor Hallway]
description: A plush, sea blue carpet runs the length of this hallway.  The walls are done in a patterned paper that reminds you of sea foam.  Two giant seashells flank the staircases.

title: [House Sovyn, 2nd Floor Hallway]
description: Soft spring green carpet runs the length of this hallway.  The walls on either side are painted with scenes of inviting forests.  Miniature trees in gold pots flank the staircase.

title: [House Sovyn, Hallway]
description: A plush, dark brown carpet runs the length of this hallway to a pair of statues which stand flanking the staircases.  The walls are paneled in oak and lightly stained so the grain is still visible.

title: [House Sovyn, Hallway]
description: A vibrant red carpet lines this dim hallway.  The only light comes from two large brass braziers flanking the staircase.  Flickering shadows turn the silk patterned paper on the walls into shimmering pools of red.

title: [House Sovyn, Library]
description: Floor to ceiling bookshelves of highly polished rowan wood and stacked with ancient tomes line the walls of this room and the balcony above.  Well-lit window seats offer a comfortable place for reading one of the many volumes lining the shelves.  Upon a pedestal in one corner sits an enormous globe, while centered in the room is a massive linden wood table with matching chairs.

title: [House Sovyn, Library Balcony]
description: The atmosphere on this balcony is quiet and contemplative as people relax with their favorite novels.  The shelves are continued here as an extension of the numerous works held below.  Comfortable chairs are spread across the balcony so that you may read before climbing the stairs to the main library.

title: [House Sovyn, 2nd Floor Hallway]
description: Soft spring green carpet runs the length of this hallway.  The walls on either side are painted with scenes of inviting forests.  Miniature trees in gold pots flank the staircase.

title: [House Sovyn, Rooftop Garden]
description: A carefully cultivated carpet of rich grass grows, high on top of House Sovyn.  A multitude of different-sized flowers grows amidst low trees giving you the sense of being in the middle of a small forest.  Unobtrusive benches are placed around the garden allowing one to sit and relax.  Directly in the center of the roof several large stone pillars sit in a circle and a small covered stairway in the corner leads back down into the house.

A carefully cultivated carpet of rich grass grows, high on top of House Sovyn.  Brilliantly colored flowers grow amidst low trees giving you the sense of being in the middle of a small forest.  Unobtrusive benches are placed around the garden allowing one to sit and relax.  Directly in the center of the roof several large stone pillars sit in a circle and a small covered stairway in the corner leads back down into the house.

title: [House Sovyn, Hallway]
description: A vibrant red carpet lines this dim hallway.  The only light comes from two large brass braziers flanking the staircase.  Flickering shadows turn the silk patterned paper on the walls into shimmering pools of red.

title: [House Sovyn, Cavern]
description: This large subterranean cavern is lit only by torches set in sconces spaced evenly around the perimeter of the cave.  Natural crystals in the walls refract the flickering light creating beautiful rainbow patterns.  Water pours from an opening high above the ground, forming a waterfall, and splashes into a stream that winds its way between huge stalagmites that rise from the ground to meet large stalactites hanging from the ceiling way above you.  The light is too dim for you to see across the stream.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Changing Room]
description: Warm, humid air swirls about you.  Smooth obsidian benches have been carved from the walls, serving as shelves for a few neatly folded silken robes.  A large silver mirror hangs from the wall, coated with a light frosting of steam.  A smoked glaes door sits at the end of a short curving passageway, while a stairway leads downward, away from the portal.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Steam Cavern]
description: Wisps of steam curl about the cavern, rising from the natural hot springs in the center.  Benches carved from the walls hold towels and folded robes, and several pairs of soft sandals rest beneath them.  A few blue fire torches flicker from the walls, giving the room a gentle glow and illuminating the stairway upwards.

title: [Outpost, Courtyard]
description: Cobalt blue and buttercup yellow tiles mingle upon the round floor to create a sunburst mosaic that is outlined in grey mortar.  Directly opposite the entry is a circular golden linden staircase that disappears into a white stucco ceiling, which is hung with several hemp nets housing blown glass orbs.  An alternating pattern of open windows and oak-framed arches finishes the foyer.  One such arch leads to a small offset room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out

title: [Outpost, Landing]
description: Positioned beneath a domed ceiling, a circular golden linden staircase winds its circular path downward towards the lower levels.  Smooth walls, left plain and white, are interrupted only where arches provide egress.  The central arch emits a faint scent of tropical flowers.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Ruins]
description: Bright yellow sunlight sparkles across crushed, white seashells littering the area before a set of broad stone steps that lead through a pair of columns into an open entryway.  A slender footpath, covered with the same powdering of shells, works its way deeper into the jungle and affords a glimpse of some vegetation-choked buildings.  Two painted blue urns rest to either side of a carved sandstone bench under the shelter of a canopy of banana tree limbs.

Soft, silvery moonlight gleams across crushed, white seashells littering the area before a set of broad stone steps that lead through a pair of columns into an open entryway.  A slender footpath, covered with the same powdering of shells, works its way deeper into the jungle and affords a glimpse of some vegetation-choked buildings.  Two painted blue urns rest to either side of a carved sandstone bench under the shelter of a canopy of banana tree limbs.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Ruined Entry]
description: Broad stone steps, cracked and broken where wild jungle vines have pushed their way through the seams, lead down to a small clearing littered with crushed white seashells.  Rising on either side of the steps are alabaster columns that have long ago lost the roof they once supported.  Standing in the center of a broken arch is an embroidered silk screen facing an oak panel across rough stone slabs.  The entry continues to the north where a wide courtyard can be seen in the distance.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Ruined Entry]
description: Descending into a wide courtyard is a set of long steps, their sides adorned with golden-hued oak railings.  Crumbling walls painted with paneled mosaics line the old entryway only to fall away into ruined arches further to the south.  White censors strung from rod-iron poles give the air a strong musky scent as smoke pours from their shield-shaped openings.  The loud cawing of wild birds shatters the silence that hangs in the steamy, scent-laden air.

title: [Monastery Ruins, Courtyard]
description: A lush group of tropical trees encloses the clearing, their verdant leaves bowing gracefully to brush the tops of the ruined stone walls that litter the ground.  A small stream babbles through the mossy ground and feeds a placid pond that rests in the center, its surface glinting in the unwavering sunlight.  A carved stone bench sits in between tropical flowers that bloom in an array of hues, their blossoms a bright contrast to the blackened stone.  Some long stone steps lead out of the ruins, their surfaces worn smooth.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Monastery, Library]
description: Warm sunlight filters through a highly detailed, large stained glass window set into the west wall, casting shadows about the room.  Highlighting the mars and scratches along the opposite wall, a soft glow showers some weathered bookcases built into the rough stone and a maple writing desk resting beside them.  A set of ascending steps rests in shadows to one side.

Silvery starlight filters through a highly detailed, large stained glass window set into the west wall, casting shadows about the room.  Highlighting the mars and scratches along the opposite wall, a soft glow showers some weathered bookcases built into the rough stone and a maple writing desk resting beside them.  A set of ascending steps rests in shadows to one side.

title: [Monastery Grounds, Dining Room]
description: Three trestle tables, created from abandoned ship hulls, rest upon a broad cobblestone courtyard under the protection of a series of wide canvas sails that gleam brightly in the sunlight.  Two sets of iron tubs, used to illuminate and heat the dining area in the evenings, lay dormant to either side of the northern and southern pathways that lead in and out.  Some gently descending steps reside to one side.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry]
description: Murky shadows obscure the details of the room, though a sense of being watched is heavily prevalent.  A small halo of golden light, produced by the candlelight spilling under the oaken door, illuminates the edge of a set of wide stone stairs that leads downward into a dank darkness.

title: [Rogue Guild, Entry]
description: Damp runnels of water trickle over the moist surface of the curved wall, with the occasional drip echoing in the chamber as it plinks into the stagnant water on the floor.  Several spiders have made flimsy webs, anchoring them between the ceiling and the upper curves of the walls.  The majority of the webs cover the bulbous, rounded dead end to the south end of the sewer.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Stretching in either direction, the wide and tall tunnel echoes noisily with every rustle or movement.  Every surface seeps with water which pools shallowly on the ground.  The walls are featureless except for a subtle crescent on the northern wall.  A slightly raised spot on the southern wall reveals the tips of a ladder peaking out of it.

title: [Antechamber]
description: Both the reek of the sewers and the humidity of the air are attenuated here.  It feels almost to be a prosperous business lobby above ground.  Two doors are guarded by a scarred knotty oak desk with an elderly secretary behind it.  She sits primly, not obviously doing much outside of occasionally holding a handkerchief to her nose.  Nearer the ladder, a couple of middling-worn sofas and a dog-eared coffee table are provided for visitors.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Illuminated by the flicking flames trapped within bronze lanterns, the sewer passage is largely free of debris.  Steel, iron, and copper pipes descend from the ceiling in knotted tangles only to disappear into the western wall.  Rising four handspans high, a small water barrier made of burlap sacks filled with sand encircles a large hole in the floor with a blackened iron ladder poking out of it.

title: [Rogue Guild, Dining Chamber]
description: Built into an unused sewer nexus, the cobble walls of the dinning chamber are painted stark white.  Cushion-topped stools surround a circular driftwood bar beneath the warm glow of frosted orbs that are suspended from the azure ceiling.  Private alcoves occupy each of the north, east, west, and south-facing walls, while a blackened iron ladder resting in the northwest corner leads to the upper levels.

title: [The Colonnade, Lobby]
description: Bedecked in fine woven tapestries, the maroon silk-paneled walls surrounding this expansive room stretch upward to a domed ceiling.  To either side of the entrance, two small marble podiums stand opposite each other, each covered with a woven silk cloth.  Sweeping up toward the second level is a grand black-veined grey marble staircase, its railing carved with exotic flowers.  Set into an arched recess in the back wall, a set of double doors leads deeper into the theater.

title: [The Colonnade, Balcony]
description: Where the staircase ends, its beautiful carved railings spread to each side, dividing the balcony from the open space above the lobby with twisting marble wildflowers and twining ivy vines.  Velvet ropes define the areas open to the public and those which require tickets.  A rowan door embossed with a silver plaque rests in the wall at one end, while an oak door embossed with a gold plaque stands at the other.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Pools of prismatic sunlight spill through the open manhole that is recessed into the ceiling, its colorful illumination creating moving patterns upon the smooth, cobblestone walls.  Rising through the opening, a rusted ladder provides egress from the area and is surrounded by large flakes of rust and bits of discarded fabric.

title: [Bathing Annex, Catwalk]
description: Alternating teak and cedar boards rise upon the western edge of the very narrow room, while large stained glass windows form the eastern wall.  Curved walls lead away to the north and south, while a rusted ladder rises out of a large hole in the floor and leads to the sewers below.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Protected by a foot-high curving concrete barrier, an iron-bolted rusty ladder descends below the tunnel.  The sound of light metalwork filters up the shaft, echoing off the walls of the large tunnel and mingling with the ever present *plink* of dripping water.

title: [Rogue Guild, Workshop]
description: Smooth wooden panels give the small, circular room a finished look, while shelves make the space feel cramped and tiny.  Set beneath brass lanterns, a row of cluttered toolbenches provides several flat surfaces to work in.

title: [House Brigatta, Entry]
description: The entry to House Brigatta is panelled and floored in dark oak.  An ornately carved table sits to one side with a small crystal vase standing upon it beneath a brightly polished silver mirror.  On the west wall, a series of shelves and pegs hold various cloaks and garb for the outer world.  To the east, a stairway heads up to the second floor.

The entry to House Brigatta is panelled and floored in dark oak.  An ornately carved table sits to one side with a small crystal vase standing upon it beneath a brightly polished silver mirror.  Across the room, a series of shelves and pegs holds various cold weather cloaks and garb for the outer world as well as bits and pieces of battle stained armor.

The entry to House Brigatta is panelled and floored in dark oak.  An ornately carved table sits to one side with a small crystal vase standing upon it beneath a brightly polished silver mirror.  On the west wall, a series of shelves and pegs hold various cloaks and garb for the outer world.  To the east, a stairway lit with flickering sconces heads up to the second floor.

title: [House Brigatta, Upper Hallway]
description: Dark oak railings climb to and from the two-story stairway, leading to this long hallway carpeted with a cerulean blue runner.  Pale walls and a series of skylights keep the upper part of the house brightly illuminated with sunlight.  An illustrative copper panel bears stylized images of constellations mixed with magical sigils and leads out to an observatory perched on the roof, and a little further along, a pale haon door heralds the library.  At the far end is a dark mistwood door braced with hammered black iron fittings.

Dark oak railings climb the two-story stairway, leading to a long hallway carpeted with a cerulean blue runner.  Flickering oil-filled sconces mounted on the walls add a warmth of soft light to the upper part of the house.  An illustrative copper panel bears stylized images of constellations mixed with magical sigils and leads out to an observatory dome perched on the roof, and a little further along, a pale haon door heralds the library.  At the far end is a dark mistwood door braced with hammered black iron fittings.

title: [Sylvanfair, Rogal-Keli Hall]
description: The trunk of this enormous tree is hollow, providing the House with a huge hall of living wood.  Natural knotholes and other openings in the trunk allow light to enter the hall, while layers of carefully arranged branches and bright autumn-colored leaves keep out the weather.  Birdsong fills the air, giving the hall a cheerful atmosphere.  A staircase spirals up around the inside of the tree.

The trunk of this enormous tree is hollow, providing the House with a huge hall of living wood.  Natural knotholes and other openings in the trunk allow moonlight to enter the hall, while layers of carefully arranged branches and bright autumn-colored leaves keep out the weather.  Crickets and other night insects fill the air with their songs, giving the hall a cheerful atmosphere.  A staircase spirals up around the inside of the tree.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west, northwest, out

title: [House Sylvanfair, Treetop]
description: Branches intertwine to form several large benches here, covered with moss and soft pillows.  There's just enough of a breeze to be refreshing, and the songs of the birds and the chattering of the animals that live in the tree provide soft background noise.  One branch, larger than the rest, arches off to the east.  A spiral staircase leads back down into the trunk of the tree, curving around a cunningly carved tangle of branches.

There's just enough of a breeze to be refreshing, and the muted noises of the insects that live in the tree provide soft background noise.  One branch, larger than the rest, arches off to the east.  A spiral staircase leads back down into the trunk of the tree, curving around a cunningly carved tangle of branches.

title: [The Evening's Heiress, Barroom]
description: Brass lanterns line the stone walls casting a dim light through the barroom.  Stale cigar smoke lingers in the air, mixing with the scent of strong spirits.  A polished oak bar runs the length of the room, offering a few refreshments to weary travelers.  Behind the bar hangs a thick burgundy velvet curtain that covers the doorway to a backroom.

title: [The Evening's Heiress, Dressing]
description: Empty liquor bottles have been strewn across the plank floor, a few of which have rolled underneath a sturdy oak wardrobe.  Along one wall sits a long oak bench that is cluttered with kohl sticks, powder vials, and a few pieces of clothing.  Heady perfumes have permeated the paneling of the room creating a flowery smell throughout the dressing room.  The sound of clinking glasses drifts up a flight of wooden stairs from the barroom below.
