Along one wall a line of metal hooks have been secured above a long oak bench that is cluttered with kohl sticks, powder vials, and a few pieces of clothing.  Heady perfumes have permeated the paneling of the room creating a flowery smell throughout the dressing room.  The sound of clinking glasses drifts up a flight of wooden stairs from the barroom below.

title: [A Leg Up]
description: Hole-ridden and mud-stained carpeting spans from wall to wall, and the greyed floorboards beneath peek through the myriad of frayed openings.  The walls, likewise in a state of disrepair, must once have been a rich burgundy, but are now a washed-out hue that barely falls into the red family.  Here and there, scattered everywhere from the tabletops to the couch, are disembodied mannequin parts.  Eyeless heads stare out from the mantle, while limbless torsos rest propped in corners.

title: [A Leg Up]
description: The shabby staircase exits onto a long, narrow platform that is framed between a feeble, broken railing and mannequin foot-mounted wall.  Protruding into the walkway, the feet force travel to the far side of the hallway - the side which supplies a straight-down, stomach-dropping view over the railing of the lower floor of the shop.  Opposite the staircase, on the other end of the hall, is an archway leading further into the shop.

title: [Foot To The Floor, Front Room]
description: A rolling brass ladder is mounted on rails that the run the length of this long wagon, leading up to a trapdoor in the roof.  Boxes are stacked on the dusty floor nearly to the ceiling, alongside a large, dented metal bin.  An oak cabinet stands next to a threadbare green curtain leading further into the wagon.

title: [Foot To The Floor, Wagon Roof]
description: A trapdoor is propped open, revealing a brass ladder leading down into the wagon's front room, while the flat roof has been enclosed with painted oak rails, providing a view of the surrounding marshland.  A heavy metal chest is propped open in one corner next to a large wooden rack, and a cushioned bench is pushed against the railing, with several footstools scattered around the area.

title: [Stone Structure, Entry]
description: Jutting up from the ground, limestone foundations are topped with only the edges of what was once a thatched roof remain overhead.  Pieces of a broken table and shattered glass lie on the floor, scattered near the ladder leading down.  Arranged on a small ledge in the wall where several stones are missing are a wire brush, a comb, and a set of shears.  Blue and white-striped silks, brightly lit by a multitude of candles on the floor, are hung over the doorway in a festive manner.

Jutting up from the ground, limestone foundations in a state of disrepair reach toward the sky, and only the edges of what was once a thatched roof remain overhead.  Pieces of a broken table and shattered glass lie on the floor, scattered near the ladder leading down.  Arranged on a small ledge in the wall where several stones are missing are a wire brush, a comb, and a set of shears.  Blue and white-striped silks are hung over the doorway in a festive manner.

title: [Stone Structure, Underground]
description: The underground space is hollowed out for several feet in every direction from the centrally located wooden ladder.  Motes of moonlight drip down from above, several torches anchored into the ground providing extra light.  Next to a handful of broken shovels and bent pickaxes leaning against an area where the layers of limestone are especially visible, a collection of hair-related items and tools are heaped together in a chaotic pile on the ground.

The underground space is hollowed out for several feet in every direction from the centrally located wooden ladder.  Dim sunlight streams down from above, several torches anchored into the ground providing extra light.  Next to a handful of broken shovels and bent pickaxes leaning against an area where the layers of limestone are especially visible, a collection of hair-related items and tools are heaped together in a chaotic pile on the ground.

title: [Sticks and Stones]
description: The cleared dirt track leads behind the wagon, where a flaking gold-painted ladder leads up to the wagon's rooftop storage area.  Tall, dark, and spindly, branches from a brittle dead tree extend out toward the wagon and have been used as a makeshift display stand through the help of numerous hanging wooden boxes.

title: [Sticks and Stones, Wagon Roof]
description: A narrow, rickety railing runs along the perimeter of the wagon's roof, but judging by the state of disrepair it would be best to stick to the center.  Stacks of crates and boxes held down by leather straps make the roof difficult to traverse.  The top of the gold-painted ladder juts out from the back of the wagon, leading back down to the ground.

title: [The Keep, Entrance Hall North]
description: Alternating squares of onyx and white marble cover the floor.  Tapestries march along the gallery on both sides, ending at a grand staircase at the north end of the hall that leads to an upper floor.  To the west a set of double doors, adorned with gracefully shaped brass handles, mark the entrance to the library.  The low, soothing sound of meditation chimes drifts through the hall from the chamber to the east.

title: [Second Floor, Main Hall]
description: Two staircases cross here, one set of steps upwards and one down.  The cramped space smells faintly of food and sweat and the passing of many people.  A mural runs across what would otherwise be a featureless wall at the back of the landing.  A thick iron door leads into a salle, while through a large open arch rows of tables and benches are visible.

title: [Second Floor, Main Hall]
description: Two staircases cross here, one set of steps upwards and one down.  The cramped space smells faintly of food and sweat and the passing of many people.  A mural runs across what would otherwise be a featureless wall at the back of the landing.  A thick iron door leads into a salle, while through a large open arch rows of tables and benches are visible.

title: [Third Floor, Main Hall]
description: A fel balustrade keeps the unwary from falling over the edge of this balcony overlooking the grand entrance hall below.  A thick crimson carpet with gold fringe covers the hardwood floors.  Sitting opposite the balustrade is a small rosewood table flanked by a pair of cushioned chairs.

title: [Third Floor, Main Hall East]
description: Braided rugs cover the hardwood floor, although some signs of weathering can be seen where the wood remains uncovered.  A golden-framed painting shines from the crimson-papered wall beside a ladder that leads to a trapdoor in the roof.

title: [The Keep Rooftop, Northeast]
description: A sturdy wooden ladder emerges from the rock floor, allowing access back into the keep.  The tall parapet is reinforced here to ensure that access is not blocked by a lucky strike from a besieger's trebuchet, although the thick ramparts below make it unlikely that the precaution will ever be tested.  On the corner of the parapet, a thick pole holds aloft a black flag with a brilliant white shield emblazoned on it.

title: [DeArchon Home, Hallway]
description: A long, dimly lit passageway extends past a circular stairwell.  Along the hall are ornate-framed paintings, each one depicting a variety of ships at sea.  The hall ends at an arched glass-paneled door.

title: [DeArchon Home, Upstairs]
description: The stairwell leads up to a wide upstairs hall.  A window is set into the wall at the further end of the hallway, draped over by a heavy blue curtain.

title: [The Wellington Home, Entrance]
description: Each length of the room is coated in pale colors, ranging from yellow to green to blue and lavender.  Along the walls are wood-framed illustrations, each clearly painted by children.  Off the eastern wall, a wide stairway ascends to the second floor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, out

title: [The Wellington Home, Dormitory]
description: Stretching the width of the building, and painted in cool blue and green hues, the room is organized with several rows of neatly made bunk-beds.  Two trunks flank each bed for personal belongings, but otherwise the room is scarcely furnished.  A few chairs are scattered about, and a tall bookcase with a small selection of history books stands before the balustrade separating the stairway from the room.  A brightly painted door leads to a large washroom.

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Main Lobby]
description: A dark riverstone statue occupies the center of the expansive public space, its height drawing attention to a painted dome two stories overhead.  The pale stone floor and walls echo with the purposeful footsteps of citizens moving around the building, and with the brisk conversation of those who occupy the benches along the walls.  Two large windows flank the wide entryway, bathing the lobby in gentle golden light.

A dark riverstone statue occupies the center of the expansive public space, its height drawing attention to the dome that rises two stories overhead.  Silence hangs heavy on the night air, and the few citizens moving around the building do so with an air of dour resignation.  A few benches stand empty along the walls, which reflect the silvered moonlight that streams through the two entryside windows.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Clovertooth Hall, Upper Gallery]
description: Atop a white stone staircase, a circular gallery echoes the round shape of a frosted red and ice blue glass dome far overhead.  Suspended from the center is a rustic silver chandelier that fills the area with the amplified glow of refracted candlelight.  A small halfling child statue leans against a decorative railing at the top of the stairs, gazing downward with childlike wonder on her finely crafted face.

title: [House Phoenix, Kitchens]
description: Here in the kitchens, a large oven warms the room and fills it with the scent of baking bread.  An ancient iron cauldron bubbles over an open fire, as rich steam billows forth to carry the aroma of rolton stew into the air as well.  The walls of the room are filled with shelves and cupboards stacked high with dried and preserved foods of all sorts.  Piles of fresh vegetables and slabs of finely marbled meats wait for the deft hand of the chef to prepare them.

title: [House Phoenix, Wine Cellar]
description: This room is used for storage of the House beverage supply.  Large casks, kegs and bottles of all sizes are stacked along the walls or in bins and on shelves.  You recognize labels from places both near and far.  Many labels are old and brown from age but the bottles are sound though covered with dust and cobwebs.  You are tempted to draw a sample or two but decide to wait for a better opportunity.  Some of the best quality vintages are stored in a locked row of bins to keep them from 'evaporating'.

title: [House Phoenix, Library]
description: The library of the House is a largish room, with walls completely hidden by bookcases.  A wide selection of reading material can be seen from a cursory glance.  Treatises on science and history stand next to ancient volumes on forest lore and magic.  One rather extensive section seems devoted to arms and armor and the many subjects dealing with the arts of war.  Locked glass-fronted cabinets hold rare tomes and fragile scrolls and even the odd clay tablet.  Scattered around the room are several chairs.

title: [House Phoenix, Second Floor]
description: A series of paintings hung along the walls here celebrate the founding officers of the House.  Two doors, one painted red, the other gold, lead to guest bedrooms.  To the south is a brightly painted door and eastwards, a solid oak door bars entrance to the Planning Room.

title: [House Phoenix, Wine Cellar]
description: This room is used for storage of the House beverage supply.  Large casks, kegs and bottles of all sizes are stacked along the walls or in bins and on shelves.  You recognize labels from places both near and far.  Many labels are old and brown from age but the bottles are sound though covered with dust and cobwebs.  You are tempted to draw a sample or two but decide to wait for a better opportunity.  Some of the best quality vintages are stored in a locked row of bins to keep them from 'evaporating'.

title: [House Phoenix, Caverns]
description: The faint whisper of wings echoes through this dark, musty cavern.  A small natural pit holds a pile of debris and ashes.  The air is still and cool.

title: [House Phoenix, Alcove]
description: This alcove is plushly floored with thick carpeting that extends up the treads of a spiral stair to the next level.

title: [House Phoenix, Observatory]
description: Here on the highest level of the building, most of the walls and the roof seem to be formed of a clear glasslike crystal that allows an almost unrestricted view of the sky above and the surrounding townscape.  Various instruments of observation and study stand on a raised platform in the middle of the room.  To the south is a hallway.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Stone Ascent]
description: Four sides of smooth stone steps lead up to a wide platform, easily viewable from all areas of the inner keep.  All around, armored Taladorian knights stand guard.  Off to the side, a stone ladder leads up to an observation deck.

title: [Doggoroth, Observation Deck]
description: The deck is sturdy and very wide, allowing for comfortable standing room for hundreds of onlookers.  Rows of stone benches are also set about along the center of the deck.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Stone Ascent]
description: Four sides of smooth stone steps lead up to a wide platform, easily viewable from all areas of the inner keep.  All around, armored Taladorian knights stand guard.  Off to the side, a stone ladder leads up to an observation deck.

title: [Doggoroth Keep, Stone Dais]
description: The carved rock platform rises almost twenty feet off the ground, with wide stone steps descending around all four sides.  A stone arch stretches up even higher, with ancient dwarven sigils etched into its surface and an embroidered Talador banner hanging from its columns.

title: [The Bitter Bite]
description: An enormous stone hearth dominates an entire wall, where a roaring fire burns within, warming the entire area.  Above the hearth's mantle are ancient and battered shields, each one decorated in the symbols of every dwarven clan.  Tables and chairs are set up around the front room while uniformed barmaids meander about, refilling drinks or cleaning up empty plates.

title: [The Bitter Bite, Second Floor]
description: Dark wooden doors line both sides of the second floor hallway, each with rooms tucked away to provide comfort for guests.  The paneled walkway ends at a large bay window framed by blue velvet curtains.

title: [Caravan Consignments]
description: Natural pine encloses this compact space, from vaulted ceiling to rough polished floor.  A row of paned windows, set above a long brushed steel counter, makes up the full length of one wall.  Opposite the counter stands a small table, with two benches placed on either side affording a comfortable place to sit.  A narrow red door, flanked by a pair of tall cubbyholes, leads back to the world outside, while a golden oak arch on the other side of the room beckons customers to a small alcove in the back.

title: [Caravan Consignments, Loft]
description: Here, in the quiet space above the main room, the vaulted ceiling forms sloping walls that cradle the small loft in a comforting embrace.  A thick bedroll, with a pile of pillows shoved against a row of overturned crates that serves as a makeshift headboard on one end and a mass of rumpled blankets on the other, lies nestled in this cozy nook.  Running the length of the platform's outside edge, interrupted only by a gap for a sturdy steel-rung ladder, a low wooden railing protects against unwanted tumbles.

title: [Talador Mines, Narrow Ledge]
description: Sleek, glowing white worms slowly inch along the walls, like slow moving stars on the backdrop of night.  The ledge is narrow and jagged and one side opens up into a pit of blackness, leading across the way to another ledge, while an old metal ladder leads down into a tunnel.

title: [Talador Mines, Dwarven Den]
description: Thick wooden posts support the even thicker rock walls of the tunnel, each one covered in slimy glowing white maggots.  The ground is smooth and darkened from ancient blood stains.

title: [Helden Hall, Buttery]
description: Stacked casks of mead and ale take up most of the space in this huge room dedicated to storage.  From the amount of stored food, one can surmise that either a war is coming or the members of the Hall have huge appetites.  A half-windowed door to the south gives a picturesque view of the livestock pens of the Inner Bailey.

title: [Helden Hall, Underground Cavern]
description: A frigid blast of air sends a chill down your spine, and the hair on the nape of your neck stands on end from the energies flowing around the cavern.  Light is coming from numerous phosphorescent crystals protruding from the floor and ceiling, in a multitude of colors.  The crystals are connected to each other by strands of pure energy that seem to emanate somehow from an underground stream that flows through here.  Carved into one stone wall is a stone counter, and a few stone bar stools cluster around it.

A frigid blast of air sends a chill down your spine, and the hair on the nape of your neck stands on end from the energies flowing around the cavern.  Light is coming from numerous phosphorescent crystals protruding from the floor and ceiling, in a multitude of colors.  The crystals are connected to each other by strands of pure energy that seem to emanate somehow from an underground stream that flows through here.   Carved into one stone wall is a stone counter, and a few stone bar stools cluster around it.

title: [Bard Guild, Foyer]
description: Lush crimson carpeting spreads over the grey and gold flecked marble floor.  A pair of high-backed chairs sits to the side of a marble stairway leading up to the second floor, a wide banister landing visible from below.  Sounds of merriment drift from a high teak archway draped with rich velvet curtains, while a large flowering plant tumbles out of a stoneware pot and creeps into the long hallway that leads away from the foyer.

Lush crimson carpeting spreads over the grey and gold flecked marble floor.  A pair of high-backed chairs sits to the side of a wide staircase leading up to the second floor, a wide banister landing visible from below.  Sounds of merriment drift from a high teak archway draped with rich velvet curtains, while a large flowering plant tumbles out of a stoneware pot and creeps into the long hallway that leads away from the foyer.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: White spindled rails line the marble stairway and landing area, giving a view of the foyer below.  A teak bench is placed to one side, with a long ceramic planter to the other, full of flowering orchids and vines that hang down, reaching for the foyer below.  Covering the wall is a large handwoven tapestry reflecting vibrant colors.

title: [Methais's Home, Balcony]
description: The fresh air and moonlight on the rooftops of the city and the waters of Solhaven Bay to the west create a sense of serenity out here.  Twining ivy covers the wall, and climbing roses shroud the ivory railing.  Pale gardenias sit in the corners in elegant polished vases, their soft fragrance lingering in the night air, and maple leaves lie scattered on the balcony floor from a recent sea breeze.  A narrow set of steps descends from the north end of the balcony to a small garden on the house's north side.

title: [Methais's Home, Garden]
description: Shrouded in the shadow of the two story house on one side and the dense foliage of the boxwood hedge on the other three, the garden is lit only by the night sky.  Water gurgles from the top of the rounded mass that is the fountain at the garden's center, and ripples dimly break the jet surface of the basin's water that encircle its base.  A narrow set of steps climbs from the garden to the balcony, hugging the house's west wall.

title: [Paupers, Wide Hall]
description: This wide, carpeted hallway is quiet and peaceful.  At the end of the hallway are some wide double doors, above which is a rosette stained glass window.  Sunlight illuminates the glass, casting the hallway in bright colors.  An ornate winding staircase leads up, and a lapis-inlaid plaque hangs next to an ora-bound door.

title: [Paupers, Upstairs Hall]
description: Sunlight streams through a small dormer window, bathing the hallway in a soft, golden light.  An unlit brass lamp hangs above the winding stairs.  A small, ale-stained, sisal rug covers the floor.  The pleasant smell of ale and the sound of clinking glasses comes from the west.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Foyer]
description: Oriel windows, graced with recessed seats, are framed in azure draperies of soft Vornavian silk that pools in placid folds upon the polished floors.  Climbing up to an open landing, an elegant stairway fixed with a decorative spindled railing looks over a pair of cozy linden chairs with a matching table between.  Resting in the center of the floor is a plush emerald green rug richly designed with the image of a peacock, while a blue silk banner hangs above stained glass doors.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Upper Landing]
description: Resting between a pair of miniature orange trees, an elegant brocade silk divan is the perfect contrast to the terra cotta pots.  Hanging above, a large painting framed in linden shows a beautiful watercolor of the Cascade of Tears.  The polished floor is graced by a narrow, fringed runner and gleams in the light of a cut-crystal chandelier.  A sweeping staircase descends to the foyer below.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Hallway]
description: Framed in silvery mistwood, a beautiful painting of Solhaven covers one wall, the giant piece of art perfectly detailed.  An arched glass door leads out onto a balcony, its frosted panes etched with beautiful peacock feathers.  A pair of potted shrubs are placed to either side, their verdant hues a sharp contrast to the white silk walls of the hallway.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Attic Landing]
description: Spiraling up, the staircase leads from the hallway to a small attic room.   A thin layer of dust coats a large stack of boxes, chests and sacks stored against the wall.  Sunlight filters in through a small linden-framed window, tiny particles dancing in the air.  A series of footprints lead away from the area, their shapes and sizes indicate the variety of frequent visitors.

title: [Hall of Mages, Foyer]
description: The polished white marble floor is dusted with tiny motes of gold and leads up to a wide curving staircase with a smooth brass handrail.  Ascending along the wall beside the stairs are a number of gold-framed paintings, each depicting variations of Elanthia's magical spheres.

title: [Hall of Mages, Balcony]
description: A large marble balcony juts out over the foyer below, providing a clear view of the entrance.  From the polished railing of the indoor terrace hang woven tapestries depicting a golden hawk's head on a dark blue field.

title: [The Demon Draught]
description: Old, grey brick walls comprise the foundation of the spacious tavern, where oak tables and chairs are set up around the common area.  A plump boar is set near a large red brick fireplace, the roaring flames roasting the pig and warming the tavern.  From behind a brass-railed countertop, a scar-faced bartender pours drinks for the guests.

title: [Demon Draught, Second Floor]
description: The floor is scuffed and the walls are bland, lacking any real kind of decoration beyond a few small lit sconces to provide a dim light.  A few wooden doors run along both sides of the hall, some of them looking worse for wear.

title: [Demon Draught, Second Floor]
description: The floor is scuffed and the walls are bland, lacking any real kind of decoration beyond a few small lit sconces to provide a dim light.  A few wooden doors run along both sides of the hall, some of them looking worse for wear.

title: [Demon Draught, Rooftop]
description: To the west, the great Citadel of Barret's Gorge rises up like a giant black obelisk, its walls lined with soldiers and archers between parapets.  To the far south, the foreboding Demonwall stretches as far as the eye can see.  Down below, citizens move about their business, many keeping to themselves.

title: [Demon Draught, Feast Hall]
description: Long wooden tables and chairs run the length of the center of this hall, various spots still littered with old greasy plates and stains.  Stretched entirely across one whole wall is a faded tapestry depicting the image of two black towers on a field of dark green.  The sweet scent of cider wafts through from the kitchen in the back.

title: [Demon Draught, Wine Cellar]
description: Dark and cold, barrels and crates of wine suffocate most of the circular stone cellar.  Cobwebs hang high in the corners of the room, their silk webbing glistening from the orange glow of a sconce near the steps leading up to the main floor.

title: [Woods In the Woods]
description: The knotty pine-panelled room is nearly square.  The walls, however, are slightly crooked and canted, giving the space a ramshackle feel.  A narrow spiral staircase leads up through an opening in the ceiling.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Upstairs]
description: The second story of the shop is nearly identical to the bottom level, to which the staircase leads.  A rickety ladder has been propped through a hole the ceiling leading to the third floor.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Upstairs]
description: The second story of the shop is nearly identical to the bottom level, to which the staircase leads.  A rickety ladder has been propped through a hole the ceiling leading to the third floor.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Third Floor]
description: More knotty pine covers the skewed walls of this third-story room.  The ladder sticking out from the hole in the floor extends down to the second floor, and some uneven steps lead up to the topmost room of the shop.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Third Floor]
description: More knotty pine covers the skewed walls of this third-story room.  The ladder sticking out from the hole in the floor extends down to the second floor, and some uneven steps lead up to the topmost room of the shop.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Woods In the Woods, Attic]
description: While this room is virtually indistinguishable from those below it, only a peaked ceiling formed by haphazardly placed beams crowns the the pine walls.  The air is nearly stifling and smells of must and sawdust.  Some uneven steps lead down to the third floor.  A rough-hewn plank has been nailed to the front of a tall wooden wardrobe.

title: [Half-built Barn]
description: A rickety wooden ladder leads up onto the beginning stages of a loft.  Under its shadow, a small table holds an assortment of tarnished silver tools and white cloths.  The pale stench of decay drifts in from somewhere nearby, mingling with the wet, moldy stink that rises from the black muck and sprouts of verdant growth covering the ground.  Leaning against one wall is a small wood-framed mirror illuminated by several torches stuck in the ground.

A rickety wooden ladder leads up onto the beginning stages of a loft.  Under its shadow, a small table holds an assortment of tarnished silver tools and white cloths.  The pale stench of decay drifts in from somewhere nearby, mingling with the wet, moldy stink that rises from the black muck and sprouts of verdant growth covering the ground.  Leaning against one wall is a small wood-framed mirror.

title: [Half-built Barn, Loft]
description: Located on a handful of beams that are partially rotted through, the loft towers high over the unfinished barn, which glows with the light of candles and torches.  Moonlight glints off of the tendrils of spiderwebs, though much of the light is absorbed by the draping green moss that hangs all around.  From this vantage point, the loft has a sweeping view of the darkness surrounding the barn.

Located on a handful of beams that are partially rotted through, the loft towers high over the unfinished barn.  Daylight suffuses the bird's nests tucked into the higher areas of the foundations, and tendrils of spiderwebs mixed with draping green moss hang all around.  From this vantage point, the loft has a sweeping view of the immediate surrounding area before large clusters of banyans block further sight.

title: [Half-built Barn]
description: Heaps of mud-caked, rotting timber planks are piled into one corner, where a row of candles burn with flickering flames.  Two buckets lie on the ground, their contents displaying tarnished silver tools and a handful of dirt-smeared cloths.  The far wall, many of its planks entirely missing, is strewn with spiderwebs caught in the brambles and growth that seeps in from the outside.  In the far corner, a wooden ladder leads down into the dark.

The far wall, many of its planks entirely missing, is strewn with spiderwebs caught in the brambles and growth that seeps in from the outside.  In the far corner, a wooden ladder leads down into the dark.

title: [Half-built Barn, Underground]
description: A large cavern opens up in this area, though the limestone walls seem to have caved in in areas, blocking any passages that my have once existed here, save for one small opening.  Splinters of buckets, pieces of shovels, shards of pickaxes, and scraps of other mining tools are splayed across the area, some on the floor and others forcefully stuck into the walls and ceiling as if some powerful force blew them to bits.  Behind a wooden ladder is a gear-covered contraption and several torches set into the wall.

title: [White Haven, Founders Hall]
description: A highly polished marble floor dances with reflected light from the shimmering crystal chandelier overhead.  Next to a large open fireplace sits a white basket filled with wood and kindling.  Nearby, several plush chairs and a carved huntboard add comfort and warmth to the huge room.  Covering the north wall is an elegant mural of White Haven's founders.  A sweeping staircase of carved white modwir gently curves as it ascends to the tower's upper floors.

title: [White Haven, Stairway Landing]
description: A railing fashioned from crystal, relieved by golden flecks, binds the limits of the landing.  Prisms of light glint off the railing and bestow a colorful warmth to the carved modwir stairway.  Set in the corner is a water clock trimmed with polished metals that patiently marks the hours and minutes of each day.

title: [Highguard Keep, Landing]
description: Torches illuminate a row of suits of full plate armor that stand like sentinels along the landing.  To the west, a series of narrow mullioned bay windows that enclose a polished oak bench offer an expansive view of the remote trail that connects Wehnimer's Landing and Icemule Trace.  A few sheets of parchment and a scattering of mithril figures, arrayed for battle atop a painted map, rest upon a narrow table at one end of the landing.  A bookcase stands nearby, filled with leather-bound volumes and additional maps.
a.location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Highguard Keep, Great Hall]
description: Large enough to swallow a modest inn whole, the great hall is clearly the heart of the castle.  Braziers and a massive fieldstone hearth provide just enough light to reveal exposed ironwood beams high above the bearskin rugs and leather chairs scattered throughout the chamber.  Tapestries depicting scenes of battles and hunts add color to stone walls.  Pine boughs arranged on a T-shaped table that could seat a small army combine their fragrance with the pungent aromas of ale and roasted meats.  A grey granite throne inlaid with ironwood rises amidst a menagerie of trophy heads.
b.location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Li'aerion, Entrance Hall]
description: An immense circular room is enclosed with polished grey stone walls that rise up three floors to a dome-shaped ceiling of cut crystal.  Sunlight pours through the ceiling and breaks into shards of bright white light that shift lazily about the room, highlighting the central staircase and second floor landing.  The walls on either side of the staircase are covered with large, intricate tapestries hung from delicate bars of gold.  A sweet melody, faint but insistent, floats through the space without pause.

title: [Li'aerion, Upper Landing]
description: Sleek grey marble floors are covered at intervals with rugs in rich jewel tones.  Just to either side of the staircase, the spaces between intricately carved columns are draped with lengths of scarlet-swept ebon gossamer.  Recessed spaces on either side of the main corridor shelter a heavy grey velvet curtain and an onyx arch.  Enormous silver-dipped bone candelabrum hold blood-red candles that cast dancing lights over the floors and walls.

title: [Li'aerion, Solarium]
description: Elaborately carved columns reach up to support a seamless, perfectly domed glass ceiling.  Sunlight spills freely into the large space, illuminating several intimate seating areas of soft chairs and couches.  A pair of heavy red silk curtains hang from ebonwood hooks on the eastern wall.  The western wall is covered in a vivid mural, and the north end of the sunroom is a small grey marble staircase.

title: [Li'aerion, Upper Corridor]
description: The dark grey carpet of this hallway is soft underfoot.  The sleek grey marble walls are plain, save for elaborate rose gold sconces holding tiny candles.  A modest landing allows one to look down on the solarium below before the corridor continues around a slight curve.

title: [A Dark Cave, Upper Landing]
description: The upward slope of the cave evens out here to create a stable, if somewhat narrow, landing.  Light from a guttering torch affixed to the wall shows a dark tunnel leading out.  A pair of iron spikes secure the top loops of a thick rope ladder with leather ties, which leads back to the lower portion of the cave.

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: It is too dark inside this cave to see where the ceiling is, but it's somewhere very high up.  A faint glow highlights the sloping floor of the cave, which rises at first in a gentle incline and then sharply into a strange mound that seems to form the back of the cave.  Fastened to the mound is a thick rope ladder with leather ties.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Foyer]
description: Alabaster slabs thrust upward in the form of a lotus flower, presenting a series of concave walls and hidden conversation nooks.  Reaching twice the height of a pure elf, the tips of the carved stone petals intertwine to form a complex vaulted ceiling.  A despanal-veined pedestal casts a dull scarlet glow from the center of the room.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Lounge]
description: A low ceiling and an assortment of overstuffed chairs scattered throughout the room give the lounge an intimate ambiance.  An ornate Faendryl crest hangs above the massive black marble fireplace that dominates one end of the room.  Opposite the fireplace is a dart board fancifully painted with ravens and griffins.  A gleaming ebonwood bar accented with rhimar spans the length of the room, an open humidor left forgotten at one end.

title: [Ilynov Manor, Entrance Hall]
description: Two enormous bay windows, complete with cushioned seats, stand on either side of a pair of tall mahogany doors.  Cream wallpaper with thin, vertical crimson stripes is complemented by blonde oak wainscoting.  Two large, cut crystal chandeliers cast a warm glow over the flooring, which is of silver-veined onyx marble and centered with a pure white marble crest of House Vaalor.  Along the western wall, a winding staircase with a polished cherrywood banister curves upward toward the library, while a shadowed alcove along the eastern wall houses a set of carpeted steps leading downward.
a.location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Legion Hall]
description: This underground training area is framed by roughly hewn walls that have been carved out of the bedrock the fortress was built on.  One wall is covered with charts and maps, while another wall boasts a large sword display.  In the back of the room, a row of wooden training mannequins stands between a weapon storage rack and a pile of spare mannequin parts.  Several inches of clean, white sand cover a majority of the floor space.  A bamboo mat rests on the landing at the base of a set of carpeted steps that lead back up to the main floor.
b.location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Entrance Hall]
description: Two enormous bay windows, complete with cushioned seats, stand on either side of a pair of tall mahogany doors.  Cream wallpaper with thin, vertical crimson stripes is complemented by blonde oak wainscoting.  Two large, cut crystal chandeliers cast a warm glow over the flooring, which is of silver-veined onyx marble and centered with a pure white marble crest of House Vaalor.  Along the western wall, a winding staircase with a polished cherrywood banister curves upward toward the library, while a shadowed alcove along the eastern wall houses a set of carpeted steps leading downward.
a.location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Ilynov Manor, Library]
description: In one corner, two overstuffed chairs sit before a marble fireplace, a petite table nestled between them on a plush cream rug.  Moonlight pours through a large window along the back wall, casting shadows over a small writing desk.  A carved cherrywood railing serves as the southern wall, providing a view of the dim hall below, and is only broken by the head of a winding staircase.  The remainder of the wall space is floor-to-ceiling walnut bookshelves.  A darkened hallway to the east leads to a dark mahogany door.
b.location: Ilynov Manor, inside the elven fortress of Ta'Vaalor

title: [Beacon Hall Annex, Gallery]
description: With floor-to-ceiling windows and creamy ivory walls, this room is a showcase of statuary and exhibits.  Stretching across one side, a long glass case protects an array of important and delicate items.  In contrast, displays of battle memorabilia command attention throughout the rest of the room, plush benches scattered between.  A spiral staircase affixed with a sign leads upward, while a guard stationed near a graceful arch prevents casual visitors from further exploration.

title: [Beacon Hall Annex, Loft]
description: A chandelier provides sufficient visibility while the light plays off the vaulted ceiling.  An iron balustrade spans the wide balcony overlooking the gallery below.  Heavy cherrywood bookshelves span the full length of the wall opposing the balustrade, their repository of texts accessible by a rolling ladder.  The stucco walls are embedded with fragments of colorful sea glass and striated clam shells.  A pair of red velvet chairs, separated by a modest low table, are stowed away at the far corner.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Entry]
description: Placed to the side of the entrance, a suit of plate armor stands guard, while on the opposite side, a small gold plaque is affixed to the wall.  Hanging from bronze chains, a chandelier holds dozens of lit candles, their flickering lights illuminating the granite floor and the sandwich-board sign resting on it.  The room splits in two northerly directions, with short hallways that lead deeper into the structure, and between them a narrow flight of stairs heads up to the next floor.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Practice Room]
description: Rows of tackling dummies line the walls of the room.  Several wooden benches are placed in small clusters, providing a place to rest between exercises.  A rounded iron arch is set into the nearby wall, leading to a small office space which can be glimpsed through the opening.  Two small hallways lead away from this room, and a descending flight of stairs occupies the space between them.

title: [Bathhouse, Atrium]
description: Stepping down three stone steps, the jungle closes in, creating a garden walled in by verdant greenery growing about carved wooden columns.  A latticework of blossoming vines crisscrosses between, creating a fragrant ceiling for the walkway.  Sunlight streams through, patterning the ground below and illuminating a garden path leading deeper into the complex.

Stepping down three stone steps, the jungle closes in, creating a garden walled in by verdant greenery growing about carved wooden columns.  A latticework of blossoming vines crisscrosses between, creating a fragrant ceiling for the walkway.  Moonlight streams through, patterning the ground below and illuminating a garden path leading deeper into the complex.

title: [Tanglevine Hall, Northeast Lawn]
description: Overwhelmed by the surrounding jungle, a large teak building disappears into the greenery.  A grouping of amber and chime trees grows on either side of the path, their trunks surrounded by bushes and huge leafy ferns.  Standing off to the side is a monkey topiary that seems to be hopping on one leg.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Garden]
description: Secreted away amidst towering cedars and firs, this quaint garden has a simple, wild charm.  Decorative hedges line a moss-lined cobbled walk as it winds its way towards a short flight of steps that lead up to a white clapboard house.  On either side of the walkway, a quartet of evenly spaced raised planting beds teem with wildflowers.  Cutting through the grid of abundant color, a faint footpath leads to a side yard.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Porch]
description: Somewhat sheltered from the elements, the dark slate floor of this deep, covered porch runs the entire length of the humble abode.  Standing at the top of a short flight of steps leading down to the garden, a freshly painted crimson door invites guests inside.  Flanking the door, two pairs of scuffed utilitarian benches provide ample seating.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Parlor]
description: A bright crimson door opens into a large space with old, weathered wood plank floors that sprawl out beneath a low ceiling with rough, exposed beams.  Neat rows of lightweight, folding cots are pushed up against three of the room's bare walls, each with its own cleverly designed swinging tray stocked with ample bandages and tinctures.  The fourth wall breaks from the ceiling at a steep angle, revealing a narrow staircase.  Opposite the stairs, in a gap between two fresh cots, a whitewashed split door leads outside.

title: [Old Farmhouse, Attic]
description: Wall-to-wall bookshelves enclose this space, their contents carefully ordered.  Across the room from a narrow staircase leading down, a heavy oak desk sits next to a modest cream linen chaise.  Under a small window overlooking the side yard below, a collection of scalpels, bamboo needles, and other implements have been laid out on a low steel table where they await their next use.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Sewer Grate]
description: Dim light filters down from above a crooked ladder, reflecting off the wet slime that coats the stone walls of this dank, fetid passage.  An old tunnel sweeper stands in front of a rusty sewer grate.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Mark Alley]
description: Tall, dented poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which several pigeons roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is spattered with weeks' worth of bird droppings.

Tall, holly-spiralled poles hold iron lanterns at the alley's entrance, though the narrow passage is by far more shadow than light.  The building on the south side bears only one balcony, upon which tri-colored geese roost.  A pile of rubble beneath the balcony is covered in a fine dusting of snow.

title: [A Two-Story House, Entryway]
description: The muffled sounds of passersby trickle through the heavy metal-strapped door separating the entryway from the outside.  A thick bristly rug sits on the dark slate tile just inside the door as a token attempt to corral the mud and dirt from outside, and some polished brass coat hooks line one wall.  A wide crystal-paned door to the side leads into a dark-panelled room, and opposite it is a curving stairway.  Behind the stairway, the tantalizing smell of cooking wafts down a narrow hallway.

title: [Accessories Of Crime]
description: Plush velvet carpeting spreads from the top of the staircase throughout this cozy sitting room.  A long settee upholstered in pale ivory silk sits near the small curtained window with a sleek ebonwood case resting on its wide sill.  A massive ebonwood bookcase built into the far wall frames a small marble fireplace, and the cheerfully crackling fire within casts a warm flickering light over the contents of a velvet-lined basket set out on a small accessory table nearby.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: Warm breezes consistently sweep the area, bringing with them the faint scent of brine, and rustling the leaves of the nearby rosewood tree.  A woven rope hangs down from some unknown height and it sways gently with the slow, steady movement of the branches high above.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Dark bark encapsulates the trunk of the rosewood tree around which various platforms and ramps have been affixed to thicker branches.  Hanging liana vines add a touch of color to the otherwise green and brown landscape.  A strong, sweet smell lingers in the air here, a mixture of the liana blooms as well as the rosewood tree itself.  Mingled with the vines, a woven rope disappears below the platform, heading toward the ground far below.

title: [Aeia's Aromas]
description: The curving wagon walls have been painted a pale sage green, while overhead, dozens of tiny pastel candles flicker on a shelf along the soffit.  Next to the entrance, a quaint hand-written sign hangs over a small round table, and a stone wishing well stands in the center upon a daisy-shaped rug.  A knotted tree branch arches over the steps leading to the back garden.

title: [Aeia's Aromas, Garden]
description: Swaths of bright fabric drape from tall, evenly-spaced posts, weaving over and under one another to create a rainbow wall of cloth that encloses the circular space.  Colorful paper lanterns hang in the trees along the circumference of the garden, while a tall walnut tree stands sentry in the center, its branches a canopy over an ornate iron bench.  Dozens of small tealights flicker amidst the delectable offerings atop a long serving table covered with a floral muslin tablecloth.  Next to the steps that lead into the wagon, a verdigris seed bowl on a twisted iron stand offers a treat for winged visitors.

Colorful paper lanterns hang in the trees along the circumference of the garden, while a tall walnut tree stands sentry in the center, its branches a canopy over an ornate iron bench.  Dozens of flower petals have been scattered amidst the delectable offerings atop a long serving table covered with a floral muslin tablecloth.  Next to the steps that lead into the wagon, a verdigris seed bowl on a twisted iron stand offers a treat for winged visitors.

title: [Trulee's Trinkets]
description: Nestled into the large trunk of a hollow cedar tree, this small space is surprisingly cool and inviting.  Several iron-latticed lanterns hang from the smooth walls, casting a warm glow around the room.  Along the back wall are a row of wooden pegs and a shallow niche.  The floor is covered in a thick layer of cedar shavings, the slightest disturbance sending their heady scent into the air.  Several depressions have been carved into one side wall, creating a ladder which leads upward.

title: [Trulee's Loft]
description: Mounds of thick, spongy moss cover the ground in this cozy loft.  A large, octagonal lantern hangs from the slightly domed ceiling and sways slightly with the tree's movements.  Several depressions have been carved into one side wall, creating a ladder which leads downward.  The strong scent of cedar permeates the air.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Platforms at varying heights reside in the branches of the great banyan tree, their surfaces well worn with years of travel.  The branches continue upward toward the thick, leafy canopy, their leaves blocking out the moonlight.  A series of small glowing blue globes illuminate the area with an eerie light.  Several liana vines dangle down from the higher platforms, adding their sweet floral scents to the air.  Twin rope bridges extend in two directions, offering passage to the west and northwest.

Platforms at varying heights reside in the branches of the great banyan tree, their surfaces well worn with years of travel.  The branches continue upward toward the thick, leafy canopy, their leaves blocking out the sun.  A series of small glowing blue globes illuminate the area with an eerie light.  Several liana vines dangle down from the higher platforms, adding their sweet floral scents to the air.  Twin rope bridges extend in two directions, offering passage to the west and northwest.

title: [About Face]
description: Nestled in the sturdy boughs of a massive teak tree, this quaint boutique offers an assortment of fine accessories.  Tiny globes of colorful blown glass dangle from the canopy above, scattering rainbow light across wares.  A narrow wooden walkway leads further into the treetops, while a rope ladder allows access back down to the ground.

title: [Circle of Trees, Platform Level]
description: Wide branches of a beech tree support this sturdy wooden platform.  The only passage away from this area is a woven ladder of natural fibers that hangs down toward the ground far below and a single rope bridge that stretches to a platform to the southwest.  No bridge connects to the nearest platform to the north, though the span seems small enough to jump.  A small gourd attached to the tree collects rain water, and a steady dripping cadence is generated from the water that overflows.

title: [Circle of Trees, Ground Level]
description: A beech tree with wide branches reaches toward the thick green canopy above, adding its leaves to the tapestry of green.  A carpet of moss and flowers softens footsteps, and the steady cadence of gentle dripping adds percussion to the sounds of jungle birds in the branches high above.  A woven ladder of natural fibers dangles near the mighty tree, nearly camouflaged with the pale bark of its trunk.

title: [String It Up, Entrance]
description: Several frosted crystal orbs are suspended from wooden hooks that have been fixed into the walls.  The air is cool, an earthy scent filling the spacious area.  Soft carpets of woven moss cover the ground under a small white oak table.  A carved spiral staircase leads higher into the tree.

title: [String It Up, Showroom]
description: Built to fit the interior of the tree, the room is circular in shape, with the staircase leading back downstairs in the center.  Several shelves have been cut into the walls of the shop.  Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale light streams in from a small opening above.

Built to fit the interior of the tree, the room is circular in shape, with the staircase leading back downstairs in the center.  Several shelves have been cut into the walls of the shop.  Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale sunlight streams in from a small opening above.

title: [String It Up, Showroom]

Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale sunlight streams in from a small opening above.

title: [String It Up, Workroom]
description: Perched between a trio of thick canopy branches, a small platform surrounded by flowering vines creates an intimate gathering space.  Several pillow-like piles of moss serve as cushioned seats.  A small table piled with various tools stands off to one side.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Lounge]
description: A low ceiling and an assortment of overstuffed chairs scattered throughout the room give the lounge an intimate ambiance.  An ornate Faendryl crest hangs above the massive black marble fireplace that dominates one end of the room.  Opposite the fireplace is a dart board fancifully painted with ravens and griffins.  A gleaming ebonwood bar accented with rhimar spans the length of the room, an open humidor left forgotten at one end.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Training Hall]
description: Various weaponry and armor are arrayed on racks throughout a wide room with vaulted windows of colored glass.  Demon and humanoid-shaped practice dummies await attacks from novices and veterans alike.  While the rest of the room contains signs of regular use, the central onyx-bordered circle is free of any clutter.  Tapestries hung between the windows depict military scenes in muted hues.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Training Hall]
description: Various weaponry and armor are arrayed on racks throughout a wide room with vaulted windows of colored glass.  Demon and humanoid-shaped practice dummies await attacks from novices and veterans alike.  While the rest of the room contains signs of regular use, the central onyx-bordered circle is free of any clutter.  Tapestries hung between the windows depict military scenes in muted hues.

title: [Alabaster Spire, Solarium]
description: Curved, transparent sheets of crystal set at an angle into alabaster walls meet high overhead to enclose the top of the tower.  At the dome's apex, the crystal panes become a single lofty spire.  On one side of the crystalline chamber, a gilded arch opens onto a slender walkway that reaches into the sky without rails or supports.  Opposite the arch is a gold-chased telescope near a low table and scattered lounge chairs that invite stargazing.

title: [Necropolis, Narthex]
description: Six large stone sarcophagi form a rough circle around the circumference of the dais in the center of the room.  The life sized image of a knight in full armor has been painstakingly chiseled into the lid of each sarcophagus.  The tattered, moldy remains of six banners stand in the center of the circle, the faded cloth waving gently in the slightest breeze.  A crumbling stone stairwell climbs up and out of the narthex.

title: [Necropolis, Ascendant]
description: Torches mounted in iron sconces encompass the room, casting a dim light that barely reaches the hewn stone of the ceiling.  Two mummified corpses, clothed in tattered robes, have been tossed into an alcove set into the eastern wall.  To the north is an expansive stone door which appears closed.

title: [The Tonsorium, Rear Deck]
description: The short deck of lacquered floorboards is constrained by an ornate brass waist rail and, overhead, a red and white striped awning trimmed with golden piping along its scalloped edges.  Off to one side a brass ladder ascends the rear wall of the wagon to its rooftop.

title: [The Tonsorium, Rooftop]
description: A low brass rail ornaments the edges of the wagon's roof.  Polished to a glinting gleam and a mere six inches high, the rail's usefulness as a safety device is dubious.  From a pair of brass-trimmed vents drifts an aromatic air of barbershop smells: talc, oil of cloves, shaving soap.  The bracing scents are brief relief, soon corrupted by the noxious gases of the swamp.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, North Gallery]
description: Continuing from the southeast, the audience of demon-carved columns fills this portion of the hall facing the dais.  Although those recognizable as vathor and oculoth have been stretched and distorted in order to serve as support columns for the high-arched ceiling, other unnameable creatures have been carved in crouching poses with appendages folded double in order to fit into the same space.  Close against the west wall, a narrow set of marble stairs ascends the dais to the south.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, Dais]
description: Honey-colored flames dance above braziers at the four corners of the dais, illuminating the massive sandstone altar and the nine-rayed black marble starburst that form the dais' backdrop against the enormous chamber's west wall.  Beneath the high domed ceiling, and close alongside the dais, a narrow set of marble steps leads down to the south gallery.  A set of marble stairs hugging the west wall leads down to the north gallery, and a semicircle of golden steps descends east to the main hall.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, East]
description: Ornate balustrades define the hall's central aisle toward the east but end in the center of the room, where a double-arc of columns faces the dais that rests atop a semicircle of golden steps near the chamber's west wall.  Each column has been carved into a stylized species of demon that both supports the high ceiling and stands as a mute witness to whatever transpires at the stone altar atop the dais.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Sacrificial Hall, Dais]

Beneath the high domed ceiling, and close alongside the dais, a narrow set of marble steps leads down to the south gallery.  A set of marble stairs hugging the west wall leads down to the north gallery, and a semicircle of golden steps descends east to the main hall.

title: [Sacrificial Hall, South Gallery]
description: Continuing from the northeast, the audience of demon-carved columns fills this portion of the hall, facing the dais. Close against the west wall, a narrow set of marble steps ascends the dais to the north.
