title: [All Wrapped Up, Showroom]
description: The walls are almost completely covered trying to hide the decrepitness of the structure, but cracks in beams and holes in the wall can still be seen.  A variety of colors can be found in the stacks of bolts, from the bright greens to vivid reds and touching upon every shade in the rainbow.  Some crates sit in front of a large sales counter piled full of different clothing being offered up for sale.  Near piles of materials a wooden ladder sits in the corner extending upwards to the next floor.

title: [All Wrapped Up, Loft]
description: The loft provides a large working are with a rug covering most of the old timbers making up the floor.  Pillows are strewn about the room the room for seating, some alone, some in pairs, some tossed into piles.  In one uncovered corner a wooden ladder leading back down to the showroom area.

title: [Feywrot Caverns, Glowing Pool]
description: Glowing with a pale, luminescent light, a large pool practically gleams in the dark area.  Rock walls hug the vicinity, the ceiling low and dripping with tiny drops of greenish water.  Streaks of a bronze-colored mineral zigzag from a naturally formed arch to a length of rope hanging from a series of spikes set into the walls.  An oddly twisted door handle is nailed into the floor.

title: [Feywrot Caverns, Spiral Columns]
description: Torches set into the walls brightly light the wide space, which is littered with small pools of water spread between clusters of stalagmites.  Overhead, varied stalactites drip water, creating drip-drop sounds to the effect of a natural musical instrument.  Spiraling around a flat, open space, almost like a clearing in this underground forest, several limestone columns are covered in crude carvings.

title: [Small Clearing]
description: A carved-wood lodge stands here, hidden deep within this expansive forest.  The walkway leading to the lodge has been recently cleared of snow.  A cozy porch stretches around the lodge.

title: [Guild Lodge, Front Porch]
description: Drifts of snow rest against the perimeter of the lodge, and icicles hang from the roof.  The porch has been recently shoveled, keeping the wooden planks of the floor free of snow.  The shelter of the lodge blocks the cold wind, leaving the air still and crisp.

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Hallway]
description: Mismatched sconces erratically line the walls, their flickering candles cast oddly formed shadows toward the warped wood ceiling.  Muffled carousing voices carry themselves though the stuffy air from the various off-shoots of rooms lining the hall, and the smell of ale permeates the small space.  A few broken peanut shells litter the floor near the far end of the hall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Rumrunners' Tavern, Cellar]
description: Fruit in various stages of decay rests upon lopsided shelves.  An old, tarnished brass candelabrum hosts a plethora of flickering, tall pillar candles, brightly bathing the room with light.  The uneven floor slopes downward from south to north.  Kegs and casks are stacked in triangular formations at each corner of the room.

title: [Ranger Guild, Nexus]
description: Large and ringed with bay windows, this room leads to several others.  The walls are covered in dark felwood paneling, and sturdy wool tapestries depicting forest scenes cover the walls.  An arch in the west side of the room leads outside, with a coyote hide curtain in place to keep out the elements.  Large beeswax candles brightly light the room from their holders in the walls.  One of the tree's branches has penetrated the room and has been carved into stairs leading to the next floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest

title: [Ranger Guild, Nexus]
description: The spacious and airy chamber is carpeted in soft coyote hide, and oil lamps set between the doors on all four walls provide a gentle illumination.  Tapestries and large paintings cover the walls between the doors and windows.  Stairs carved from one of the tree's branches lead down, and a nearby ladder leads up.

title: [Ranger Guild, Nexus]
description: The spacious and airy chamber is carpeted in soft coyote hide, and oil lamps set between the doors on all four walls provide a gentle illumination.  Tapestries and large paintings cover the walls between the doors and windows.  Stairs carved from one of the tree's branches lead down, and a nearby ladder leads up.

title: [Ranger Guild, Lookout]
description: Bright sunlight fills the room.  A large dome of clear crystal encompasses the room, keeping the elements at bay while providing an excellent view of the surrounding forest.  The sea of green below is periodically broken by field or stream, and in the distance one can make out Solhaven Bay and the bustling port around it.

Silver moonlight flows into the room.  A large dome of clear crystal encompasses the room, keeping the chill night air at bay while providing a view of the inky night sky.  The forest below is lit by the moons above and the occasional spark of a firefly.  A small lamp rests near the ladder, and pillows are scattered about for relaxing stargazing.

title: [Ranger Guild, Oak Grove]
description: A cluster of ancient oaks forms a quiet glade, their heavy branches and foliage concealing anything above from view.  Several carved wooden benches are arranged on the mossy ground between the massive trees, set by the banks of a bubbling spring that emerges from a niche in the forest floor and flows between the roots.  A sturdy wooden pavilion opens to the south, half-covered by bushes and flowering vines, and a wide ladder leads up the gnarled trunk of the largest of the oaks.

title: [Ranger Guild, Treehouse]
description: The sturdy platform is constructed between the branches of the great oak, bounded by heavy moss-covered railings and covered by a network of carved beams that blend with the tree's branches above to protect from the elements.  A narrow rope bridge, almost invisible in the network of hanging vines that wind around it, leads west into the branches of another tree.

title: [Rone Academy, Alumni Hall West]
description: The room bustles with the day-to-day affairs of the Academy.  Clerics chant in somber tones to the west, nearly drowning out soft murmurings from the libary to the north.  An excited babble comes from the south, where a line of eager young applicants awaits admittance to the Academy.

title: [Rone Academy, Walkway]
description: This stone walkway links the two different buildings of Rone Academy, a heavily reinforced oak rail protecting each side.  Carved into the stone walkway are different images of wild beasts, some long extinct from the realm of man and some still present.  The walkway proves as an excellent view of the Landing, and a scattering of students pause briefly to admire it, then move on.

title: [Ranger Guild, Lodge]
description: The path winds up to the lodge, which is built wide and low beneath a copper roof.  Unstained oak walls have been planed to display the natural grain of the wood, and darker modwir frames the entrance.  A single apple tree by the stone steps provides welcome shade.

title: [Ranger Guild, Front Porch]
description: Plain cotton cushions cover the sanded maoral planks in lieu of chairs.  Wind chimes of wood and beaten brass turn in the breeze and add their gentle harmony to the atonal, yet tranquil music of nature.  To your south, the pavilion rises above the treetops, its banners brilliant against the cloudless sky.

title: [Ancient Keep, Foyer]
description: Circular in shape, the floor is completely made from square-cut sections of black marble.  Large, blackened marble pillars line the walls, ending with a domed glass ceiling high overhead.  A narrow gap on the far side of the room leads to a sweeping stairwell with a mithglin-plated door beneath it.

title: [Ancient Keep, Council Room]
description: A massive circular table fills the room with some large padded chairs next to it.  Hanging from the domed ceiling above is a golden chandelier, illuminating the room.  The walls of the room are painted with a mural depicting Icemule at night, with hundreds of small candles near each burrow.  Sequestered beneath a carved marble arch is a steep stairwell, leading back to the foyer.

title: [Rone Academy, Elanthian Library]
description: Ornately carved pillars punctuate each corner of this spacious library.  Students wander amongst the bookshelf-lined walls, their footsteps muffled by worn tapestry rugs covering the wood floor.  Moonlight filters in through a domed skylight in the ceiling, illuminating large antique tables.  Wrought iron railing borders a wide descending staircase in the center of the room.  On the north wall, an open doorway is flanked by an antique fel bookcase and a marble pedestal displaying a dark leather volume.

Ornately carved pillars punctuate each corner of this spacious library.  Students wander amongst the bookshelf-lined walls, their footsteps muffled by worn tapestry rugs covering the wood floor.  Sunlight filters in through a domed skylight in the ceiling, illuminating large antique tables.  Wrought iron railing borders a wide descending staircase in the center of the room.  On the north wall, an open doorway is flanked by an antique fel bookcase and a marble pedestal displaying a dark leather volume.

title: [Rone Academy, Professions Hall]
description: This circular room underground has arches that lead off to several different professional areas.  Much of an apprentice's study occurs in the profession rooms with the Elders.  There is a colored arch for each profession, marked clearly so that you won't lose your way.

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Entryway]
description: Rectangular panels of polished witchwood, set with several veil iron sconces, enclose three sides of the room, while the fourth is made entirely of glass.  An enormous window, with its wide bench, provides an unobstructed view of the majestic greens of Melgorehn's Reach and the multichromatic Lake Eonak.  Dark walnut flooring is softened by a thick silk rug, accompanied by several dark leather armchairs.  In a far corner, a set of straight ko'nag stairs lead downward, and through an open doorway a few bar stools against a countertop are visible.
a.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Bedroom]
description: Piles of sand lean against the base of the southern and western glass walls, which give a breathtaking view of Lake Eonak's sunlit surface.  The dark witchwood of the eastern wall is bisected diagonally by a set of straight ko'nag stairs.  A low, rectangular witchwood chest with square iron handles sits at the foot of a king-sized bed with a low, flat headboard, and is flanked by a nightstand that rests against the northern wall.  Joining the northern and eastern walls is a fireplace cut from ebon-veined brown marble.  A braided silk rug in muted tones stretches beneath a plush loveseat, positioned between the bed and a glass door that leads to a private beach.
b.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Deck]
description: Lacquered dark walnut flooring stretches out from the kitchen and across the neatly manicured grass of the hilltop.  The large deck is built to incorporate a narrow brook that runs down the hill to the beach and blends with the sparkling surf of Lake Eonak in the distance.  Thick, dark forests ring the lake, framing its pristine beauty against the backdrop of the Reach's majestic peak.  Several low teak chairs with elongated seats sit snug against the house.  A sliding glass door leads into the kitchen, while a narrow set of stone steps leads down the hill to the beach.
a.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Melgorehn's Retreat, Beach]
description: Smooth, pristine white sand gives way to a rippled, slightly darker counterpart as it stretches toward the water's edge.  The gentle lapping of Lake Eonak, along with the soft sounds of local wildlife, enhance the calming surroundings.  Brilliant sunlight glints off several glass windows of the house bordering the northern edge of the private beach.  A narrow set of stone steps hugs the hillside and leads to a deck.  Positioned a safe distance from the lake is a round firepit surrounded by blackened sand, and closeby is a cushioned loveseat suspended from weathered wooden beams by thick chains.
b.location: Melgorehn's Retreat, outside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Twilight Lodge, Clearing]
description: An ivy-covered riverstone lodge provides tranquil refuge in the darkness, light from its windows reflecting off the nearby towering silver lor tree and an eahnor-streaked waxing stone moon.  Across the clearing, a magnificent angel oak erupts from the ground, its many gnarled and twisted limbs embrace the glade, shielding it from the encroaching forest.  A braided hemp ladder hangs from the lor tree, and a glowbark dart board embellished with an astral rune is mounted on the oak.

An ivy-covered riverstone lodge basks in the sun alongside a towering silver lor tree and an eahnor-streaked waxing stone moon.  Across the clearing, a magnificent angel oak erupts from the ground, its many gnarled and twisted limbs embrace the glade, shielding it from the encroaching forest.  A braided hemp ladder hangs from the lor tree, and a glowbark dart board embellished with an astral rune is mounted on the oak.

title: [Twilight Lodge, Lor Treetop]
description: From a small platform high up in the lor tree, stars twinkle like countless pinpricks across an endless ebon sky, the view stretching from mountains to endless wooded plains.  A pair of great horned owls swoop through the trees, hunting for prey, their melodic hoots echoing throughout the forest at a hypnotic tempo.  Carved on the silver tree trunk are some ancient runes.  A tightly-woven hemp ladder hangs over the edge of the platform.

At the top of a tightly-woven hemp ladder, a small platform rises above the treeline, providing a spectacular view.  A pair of great horned owls tend to their young in a nest on a nearby branch.  Broken hatchling shells are scattered around the nest amongst fresh pellets and molted feathers.  Carved on the silver tree trunk are some ancient runes.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: The footing here turns treacherous, as the snow has hardened to slick ice.  Mercifully, the brush has pulled back somewhat, making the trek here merely hazardous, instead of hopeless.

title: [Frozen Bramble Patch]
description: Only those with myklian-tough skin could wander this path unscathed.  The surrounding brambles offer no apology for their attack, nor do they seem to tire.  The jagged points of the brush are nearly unavoidable in their quest for flesh.

title: [Black Wolves Manor, Lounge]
description: Warm and spacious, the lounge offers a cozy retreat with a rich mahogany floor and a high-vaulted ceiling framed by honey oak walls.  A grand fireplace stands against the western wall, and moonlight streams into the room through a pair of wide arched windows that flank its chimney.  A small basket of sticks sits by the fireplace.  Oversized couches and roomy chairs are casually scattered about the room, providing plenty of comfortable seats, and a curved mistwood bar stretches out beneath the loft.

title: [The Loft]
description: Subtle scents of spice and oils fill the air.  There is a sense of seclusion to the loft even though the lounge below is just a good shout away.  A few pillows are strewn along the overstuffed caramel suede corner couch, and a silky shag rug of ivory wool tipped with silver complements the rich mahogany floor.  Across from an arched window is an oil painting with a pair of spiraled mithglin sconces mounted on each side and a small claw-footed table that has been carefully arranged below it.

title: [Oak Tree, Large Branch]
description: A small platform with an opening cut in the center has been built on this hefty tree branch.  A twisted rope ladder leads down the opening, back to the meadow.  High above is a ragged hole in the tree with a gnarled rope hanging down.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: The gnarled rope has been knotted around a thick iron spike sticking out of a hole in the tree.  Little rays of moonlight that have managed to sneak past the thick green leaves that cover every branch spray down upon the tree, providing illumination to the hole.

title: [Red Forest, Abandoned Home]
description: The interior of the building is an eerie specter of what it once might have been.  The walls are splashed with age-old stains and almost every piece of furniture lies broken and in ruin.  The only furnishing of real consequence is a long wooden dining table that holds a tarnished silver tray with several smashed tea cups.  A rickety wooden stairway leads up to a second floor.

title: [Red Forest, Abandoned Home]
description: The hallway ends abruptly as half of the ceiling has collapsed on the eastern side, piles of rubble opening up a view of the mist-shrouded dark forest beyond.  One wall hosts a few old wooden frames, each one missing the original portrait inside.  In their place, small child-like sketches have been scratched into the wall within the empty frames.  At the end of the hall is an open doorway with rusty broken hinges.

title: [Crystalwood]
description: Dappled sunlight spills through the verdant leaves shading this quiet alcove, creating a kaleidoscope of shadow on the rough-hewn floor.  Tucked in between slender branches and gnarled knots, partially obscured by the pale blush pink blossoms of a climbing bougainvillea, several wooden shelves seem to almost grow out of the rosewood tree itself.  Near a rustic arched arbor laden with vividly colorful flora, a pair of woven palm frond baskets, one on either side of a simple rope ladder leading up to a raised platform, hangs from a sturdy limb and sways softly in a gentle breeze.

title: [Crystalwood, Canopy]
description: Nestled among the boughs of the ancient rosewood and extending out over the alcove below, this circular platform serves as a quiet workroom removed from common distractions.  A sturdy railing with a deep ledge, wound through with climbing vines heavy with fragrant flowers, surrounds the space, a small gap where a simple rope ladder hangs down the only break in the protection it affords.  Thin, woven grass mats line the plank floor, and a large dip in a branch stretching out from the tree's trunk forms a passably comfortable seat.

title: [Lost Outpost, Watchtower]
description: Sand pools in the corners of the tower's ground floor.  It seeps in through chinks in the ill-made walls of stone, but the real flood of it pours in through the wide open doorway, accompanied by searing wind and stinging sunlight.  Although the stairway ascending to the second story is wrought from blocks of solid stone, it manages to look exceedingly treacherous and unstable.

title: [Lost Outpost, Watchtower]
description: All along the watchtower's crenellated rooftop are signs that struggle, and not the desert, ended its dominance over this stretch of the Sea.  The shattered remains of a wine bottle glint, green as grass, from a pile of fine sand in one corner.  An arrowhead is lodged in between two blocks of stone, although its shaft has been devoured by the elements.  Over the whole scene, the wild wind howls, low and mournful.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Upper Hall]
description: Two tall Imperial soldiers stand on either side of a set of large wooden doors engraved with a simplified version of the crest of North Hendor.  A hallway leads westward, while the wide stairwell offers an avenue by which to return to the first floor.  Next to each guard is a banner, one showing the crest of the Earl of North Hendor and the other stitched with the name of the House Andrews.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Feast Hall]
description: A number of tables and chairs are set against the walls of the hall, waiting the next meal or well attended meeting.  At the end of the hallway is a wide stairwell with two Imperial soldiers standing sentry at its base.  Hendoran military banners decorate the stone walls along with flags of defeated enemies, a ragged Nalfein banner among them.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Upper Hall]
description: A narrow window offers a view of the inner courtyard below and in case of emergency, an archer's perch for the determined defenders of the outpost.  The hallway is divided by a thick brown bearskin rug that runs its length, separating two sets of doors.  A single Hendoran guard stands sentry beside the iron-bound wooden doorway.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Rooftop]
description: Stone ramparts line the entire perimeter of the rooftop, each section evenly spaced and fortified to allow equal protection and a staging ground for archers.  Rising from the center of the area is a crisp silver flag emblazoned with a silver phoenix and it flaps with the slightest of wind.  Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

Stone ramparts line the entire perimeter of the rooftop, each section evenly spaced and fortified to allow equal protection and a staging ground for archers.  Rising from the center of the area is a crisp silver flag emblazoned with a blue phoenix and it flaps with the slightest of wind.  Beyond the highest point of the outpost, the grasslands stretch out far to the south before they disappear into the forest, and the palisade walls and buildings of Wehnimer's Landing expand to the north.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, War Room]
description: This is a large and spacious room, well-lit by numerous spherical iron lanterns hanging from the walls.  Dominating the room is a round red mahogany table, its lustre catching the ambient light and reflecting it.  Matching chairs surround the table, and the walls are papered with maps of the local wilds.  A smooth teak ladder in the west corner of the room disappears through a dark trapdoor in the ceiling.

title: [Irregulars Barracks, Rooftop]
description: Abutted against the town wall, the roof of the barracks is at the perfect height to peer over the top of the palisade down to the western road and the forests beyond.  Faint sounds of waves emanate from the dark bay to the northwest, and the combined scents of salt and loam permeate the surrounding air.  A rough teak trapdoor leads back down into the barracks.

Abutted against the town wall, the roof of the barracks is at the perfect height to peer over the top of the palisade down to the western road and the forests beyond.  The sparkle of sunlight glints off the bay to the northwest, and the combined scents of salt and loam permeate the surrounding air.  A rough teak trapdoor leads back down into the barracks.

title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
description: Shaded slightly by walls to either side supporting the port and starboard gangways, the upper deck is shielded from all but the strongest natural breezes, but not from the constant gusting of wind deflected by the whir of the propellers holding the ship aloft.  A towering blade assembly dominates the area, the crimson and golden lacquer adorning it vivid compared to the ash-colored wood of the deck.

title: [The Firebird, Fo'c'sle]
description: Rising above the ship's upper deck, but not so high as the towering metal blade assemblies that propel the craft and hold it aloft, the forecastle is a swathe of space shaped like an arrowhead, tapering to a point at the bow.  The gilded and burled railing, all wrought of ash-colored fireleaf, joins with the carved bowsprit at the absolute fore of the vessel.  To the rear of the deck, broad wooden stairs proceed down toward the upper deck.

title: [The Firebird, Upper Deck]
description: Covered by an arced ceiling of transparent glaes, the sternmost portion of the upper deck is shielded from the elements.  Several chairs and tables laze underneath the faceted dome, forming a small enclave away from the bustle of the rest of the ship.  Some smooth wooden stairs form a wide path up to the smaller quarterdeck.

title: [The Firebird, Quarterdeck]
description: The quarterdeck is a raised expanse toward the rear of the ship that looks out over the recessed upper deck.  Carved from smooth fireleaf and embellished with avian silhouettes, an ornate rail bearing a coat of gilt and red brass leaf surrounds the quarterdeck.  Luxuriant crimson pennants, each bearing a firebird in yellow embroidery, are strung between the propeller assemblies and the railing.  One strand of them flutters in the breeze, dipping low over some old wooden steps leading up to the aftercastle.

title: [The Firebird, Quarterdeck]
description: The quarterdeck is a raised expanse toward the rear of the ship that looks out over the recessed upper deck.  Carved from smooth fireleaf and embellished with avian silhouettes, an ornate rail bearing a coat of gilt and red brass leaf surrounds the quarterdeck.  Luxuriant crimson pennants, each bearing a firebird in yellow embroidery, are strung between the propeller assemblies and the railing.  One strand of them flutters in the breeze, dipping low over some old wooden steps leading up to the aftercastle.

title: [The Firebird, Aftercastle]
description: Huge bronze cannons glare brightly from embrasures in the crennelated railing surrounding the sterncastle, guarding the rear of the ship like dogs on the watch.  A wheel embellished with gold and crimson lacquer stands at the center of the deck, carved of the same greyish fireleaf as most of the deck plankings, but polished to a glassy smoothness by the touch of many hands.  The raised deck provides an unobstructed view all the way to the bow of the ship.

title: [The Firebird, Main Deck]
description: Lit from either side by a pair of glimaerstone lamps, the passage is split by a heavy red brass ladder leading down to the orlop.  The sounds of the weather deck overhead are muted by solid wood, but not entirely inaudible.  Everywhere there is a faint thrumming, as if the walls themselves were suffused with the life and pulse of a great beast.

title: [The Firebird, Orlop Deck]
description: Most of the narrow passageway is blocked by a heavy red brass ladder that proceeds up toward the main deck.  Veniom wires are inlaid into the wooden planks of the hull, pulsing occasionally with waves of sky blue light.  The steady pulses illuminate coiled lines and crates of cargo slumbering in the shadows.

title: [Bard Guild, Winding Stairwell]
description: The curving stairwell widens at the foot of a window, its view partially obstructed by heavily carved wooden screens.  Beyond the screens lies a panoramic vista of quaint rooftops and minarets, and in the distance, the sparkle of moonlight on water.  An arched doorway is discretely set in a small alcove produced by the stairway's turn, and from inside, the clink of glass and delicious aromas extend an invitation to come within.

title: [Bard Guild, Office]
description: A flight of stairs opens into the office, a large, octagonal room occupying most of the building's third floor.  It has a high ceiling, rising into a dome painted with a representation of the sky.  Windows covered with wooden screens occupy most of the wall space.  Through the chinks in the intricately rendered patterns of the screens, truncated views of the town below can be seen.  A circular table sits in the chamber's center with high-backed chairs placed in a haphazard ring around its perimeter.

title: [Annatto Arch, Stairway]
description: This cramped space is hardly big enough to allow two elves to pass each other on their way to and from the small chamber to the southwest.  A layer of black mold has imbedded itself in the limestone blocks of the walls and ceiling, adding to the dimness of the space.

title: [Annatto Bridge Tunnel, Passage]
description: This cramped crawlspace slopes upward toward the southeast.  Pinpoints of light leak into the area, outlining the stones used to construct the bridge and this passageway within it.

title: [Annatto Bridge Tunnel, Ladder]
description: This small landing provides storage and a rallying point above the ladder shaft.  Dark and small, a tunnel leads off to the northwest.  A ladder, running down a narrow, rounded hole, descends into inky darkness.  Stacks of rag-wrapped torches, their heads dipped into tar, are stored in piles around the perimeter of the landing.

title: [Annatto Bridge Shaft, Ladder]
description: Damp and slightly slippery from the humidity of the air this close to the Mistydeep River, the ladder rungs descend into darkness, while dim pinpoints of light are still visible on the landing above, at the top of the ladder.  The tang of water and rust permeates the air.

title: [Annatto Bridge Shaft, Ladder]
description: Damp and slightly slippery from the humidity of the air this close to the Mistydeep River, the ladder rungs descend into darkness, while dim pinpoints of light are still visible on the landing above, at the top of the ladder.  The tang of water and rust permeates the air.

title: [Annatto Bridge Shaft, Ladder]
description: Faint blue luminescence reflects off the stone, emanating from a chamber just visible through an opening in the stone walls below.  The glow illuminates the iron rungs of the ladder, and shows the rust stains on the stone where the ladder is bolted into it.

title: [Fire Drake, Upper Level]
description: Rounded walls, obviously the interior of the drake's torso, enclose this space.  A sturdy platform that covers the majority of the chamber overlooks the room below.

title: [Orb Storage Room]
description: This room, occupying the base of the drake is built of heavy, rough-cut blocks of stone.  Overhead, a platform provides access to the mithril chamber.  The room is impeccably clean and illuminated with blue-tinged light cast by several small globes mounted to the walls.

title: [Yander's Farmhouse, Kitchen]
description: Cupboards line the eastern wall above a smooth granite counter that sparkles in the ambient light with flecks of mica.  Ebon and slate blue tiles create a checked pattern upon the floor, which is reflected in the glaesine globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Pushed against the opposite wall, and set beneath a tiny white oak-framed window, is a small cloth-covered table surrounded by wicker-seated chairs.  A pot-bellied, cast iron stove makes the room comfortably warm from its position near the open back door.

title: [Yander's Farmhouse, Loft]
description: Dyed a rich green hue, fleece pelts cover the floor from wall to wall and offer a soft, plush comfort beneath the steeply peaked roof.  Upon one side of the white-walled room is a luxurious feather bed covered with crisp white linens and a down comforter, while directly across stands a towering modwir armoire with painted doors.  At the foot of the bed rests a simple foot locker and several glowing glaesine globes dangle from the exposed rafters amid boughs of fresh and dried lavender.

title: [Bard Guild, Backstage Entry]
description: A narrow hall leads from the Bard Guild to the public Performance Hall, its passage a dogleg from east to north.  Sconces mounted to the walls throw a flickering gold light across the hall's dark grey walls.  The only other ornamentation is a carpet runner that follows the passageway's crook.  A small flight of stairs leads to the backstage area.

title: [Bard Guild, Green Room]
description: The walls of the green room are covered with likenesses of famous and not-so-famous performers, past and present, painted by a number of different artists.  Someone has constructed a makeshift makeup table against the back wall -- two crates and a plank are topped with little colored pots and a scattering of sequins, buttons, feathers, and other paraphernalia.  A long table sits in the center, surrounded by mismatched chairs.

title: [Bard Guild, Green Room]
description: The walls of the green room are covered with likenesses of famous and not-so-famous performers, past and present, painted by a number of different artists.  Someone has constructed a makeshift makeup table against the back wall -- two crates and a plank are topped with little colored pots and a scattering of sequins, buttons, feathers, and other paraphernalia.  A long table sits in the center, surrounded by mismatched chairs.

title: [Cholen's Temple, Costume Hall]
description: Clothing of every size, shape, color and fabric festoons the long, wide room.  Heaps of cloth are piled beside worktables and benches, and garments overflow the trunks and racks used to store them.  Cabinets and chests of drawers line the walls and bright lanterns of myriad shapes and sizes dangle from the ceiling to contribute to the room's brilliant illumination.  A narrow staircase in the west wall is partially obscured by a spill of costumes, but the doorway in the east wall remains clear.

title: [Anemone's Perch, Garden]
description: Casting long shadows across the garden, a spiraling wooden staircase leads to a bright white balcony that is wreathed in thick wisteria vines.  Terra cotta tiles create a patio in front of a pair of glass-paned doors that provides entry into the villa, while opposite, a slender shell-lined pathway ambles down the gently sloping lawn to a quiet beach.  Thick bushes of white and pink dog roses encircle the small garden and form a decorative barrier to the less domesticated plant life of the island.

title: [Anemone Villa, Balcony]
description: Crawling wisteria vines cling to the side of the villa and twine their way about the white banisters and railings that line the balcony.  Recessed into the verdant and violet foliage, a wooden bench is supported by wrought iron posts designed in the shape of enormous frogs, and is flanked by a pair of black iron filigree tables.  Glass-paned doors lead into the villa, while a spiraling wooden staircase leads into the garden below.

title: [Dawe's Home, Ground Floor]
description: The vast, glass-walled structure has an open layout with no real division of rooms, except for a study on the eastern side set off by frosted glass walls.  A waist-high, long black marble koi pond lines the west side, and the warm-hued tropical hardwood floor gives way on the east to a recessed square pit bordered with cushions, providing a seating area.

title: [Dawe's Home, Loft]
description: Moonlight streams into the room from the skylights cut in the coral stone ceiling, casting a silvery hue on the tropical hardwood floor.  The enormous space is sparsely but elegantly furnished, with a black marble platform bed and matching vanity as the most prominent features.  A narrow coral stone staircase leads up to a small landing with a door opening out onto the roof, while a wider white spiral staircase leads downstairs.

title: [Dawe's Home, Loft]
description: Moonlight streams into the room from the skylights cut in the coral stone ceiling, casting a silvery hue on the tropical hardwood floor.  The enormous space is sparsely but elegantly furnished, with a black marble platform bed and matching vanity as the most prominent features.  A narrow coral stone staircase leads up to a small landing with a door opening out onto the roof, while a wider white spiral staircase leads downstairs.

title: [Dawe's Home, Roof]
description: The noise out here from the two waterfalls is almost overwhelming, but this area is actually sheltered by a coral stone overhang that takes up almost the whole roof.  The smaller fall crashes directly into a marble basin set into the coral stone, the overflow splashing on towards a pool below.   From here, you can also see a glass tunnel of sorts that appears to lead away from the house under the larger fall, which is an opaque white wall of water.

title: [The Wave, Captain's Quarters]
description: An elaborately carved low maoral railing provides a view of the common area below the captain's loft.  A wooden plank stairway leads downwards, and pushed up against the hull of the ship is a brightly painted pink fel bunk bed, covered in an assortment of knitted quilts.  A pair of paintings covers the rear wall of the loft, framing a glass-paneled bright green door.  Glass-paneled lanterns hang from wrought bronze hooks in the beams overhead.

title: [The Wave, Common Room]
description: The hull of the ship is painted in a brilliant swirl of colors.  Blues and greens flow into pale whites as the designs on the hull rise upwards.  Numerous colorful pillows rest in a large pile at the center of the floor.  Along the side of the hull is a wooden plank stairway that leads to a small balconied loft above.

title: [Stone Manor, Atrium]
description: The manor opens up into a large circular chamber with a high glass dome ceiling.  A dark ironwood tree rises up from the center of the room, its branches bathed in moonlight from above.  Finely dressed servants bustle between a mahogany archway and a long hallway, while a wide stairwell ascends to the second floor.
a.location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Stone Manor, Upstairs Hallway]
description: A lavish navy blue carpet runs the span of the hallway, which ends at a pair of glass doors.  Various oil-painted portraits hang from each wall, broken up only by a dark mahogany double door.
b.location: Stone Manor, outside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Pemberley, Great Hall]
description: Polished villswood flooring stretches the length of this enormous room.  Soft golden teak paneling above pristine white wainscoting adds a warmth to the room.  Numerous paintings, depicting momentous events throughout history line the walls, lending their color to the grandeur of the hall.  A stately lor grandfather clock with beveled glass panels dominates the north wall next to a grand staircase that leads upwards towards a wide landing and the upper floors.

title: [Pemberley, Landing]
description: Flooding the area with moonlight, polished casement windows stretch from floor to ceiling along the northern wall.  A thick elven-crafted rug patterned in an intricate lor leaf design partially covers the villswood floor, while nicely complementing two window seats upholstered in a pale brocade, a delicate lor side table, and matching bookcase.  A carved lor archway leads east into the library, while a vaalin inlaid oak door leads west to the private living quarters.

title: [The Pie Shop, Backroom]
description: Stray rays of sunlight sneak in through two meager windows and splay through the room, creating pockets of luminescence in the otherwise dim surroundings.  Constructed of mismatched planking in a variety of hues, the floor's unfinished wood provides a distinct counterpoint to the bright yellow walls.  A large display counter takes up the majority of the room's space, nearly obfiscating a rickety stairway leading down.

title: [The Pie Shop, Basement]
description: Well-packed earth sends a loamy aroma floating through the chilly air and makes up the entirety of the capacious basement's walls and floor.  A small, disordered pile of crates and an exceedingly large mountain of crates are stacked near one another behind a rickety stairway.  Flickering lanterns hang from several hooks in the plank ceiling, casting three charcoal-hued couches, a dead root table, and a partially preserved cook's assistant corpse in a dappled mixture of light and shadow.

title: [Sebastian House, Sitting Room]
description: A roaring blaze crackles and snaps in a large stone fireplace, warming the large open room nicely.  An overstuffed horsehair settee and a few chairs provide a place to rest and socialize.  The curtain covering the entrance to the pantry holds in the heat, while opposite the hearth, a tall hoarbeam door leads outside.

title: [Sebastian House, Corridor]
description: The hallway is warm but austere in design.  Simple iron sconces on the wall provide enough light to distinguish between a white door with a griffin knocker and a black door with a polar bear knocker.  A set of carpeted stairs leads down to the sitting room.

title: [Journey's End, Patio]
description: The enclosed garden is ringed by pale granite pillars supporting the gently sloping slate roof.  Across the way, a pale beechwood door leads to another portion of the manor.  A narrow bed of white gravel surrounds a silvery grey stone fountain which centers the garden.  Mixed with shades from viridian to sage, dense layers of moss cover the ground leading to a massive willow.  A woven silk hammock is stretched between two ivory posts that are covered with climbing white roses.

A narrow bed of white gravel surrounds a silvery grey stone fountain which centers the garden.  Mixed with shades from viridian to sage, dense layers of moss cover the ground leading to a massive willow.  A woven silk hammock is stretched between two glowbark posts that are covered with climbing white roses.

title: [Journey's End, Willow]
description: Careful cultivation made this willow into a functional platform.  The trunk and its adjoining branches grow right into the wood plank edges.  Silk pillows have been scattered about the lofty retreat to add a touch of comfort.  Looking out across the landscape, Seethe Naedal rises high to the west, its domed observatory aglow in the sunlight.  To the east, a pair of bridges, one light and one dark, hover in the air above the city, creating visual markers that lead directly to the Sapphire Gate far below.

title: [Greystorm Manor, Gardens]
description: Rife with vibrant colored blooms, the garden has been designed and manicured with expert care.  Meandering paths weave between colorful flowerbeds and circle the trunks of flowering fruit trees.  Near the center of the garden, an ornately carved stone bench sits next to a small pond.  The surface of the pond is dotted with large water flowers, but occasional ripples reveal the presence of fish and other water-loving creatures.  A vine-covered carved stone stairway with flowering terraces leads to the moonlit rooftop.
a.location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Greystorm Manor, Terrace]
description: The rooftop terrace looks out over the luxurious gardens behind the manor and provides an expansive view of the town and the bay.  Large grey paving stones tile the terrace, which is dotted by beautifully groomed shrubs.  Carved stone benches are placed throughout the garden and around a large iron firepit.  A large arched trellis covered in green foliage and tiny purple flowers offers an inviting place to dance or relax under the stars.  In the far corner of the terrace sits a large brass-fitted telescope.
b.location: Greystorm Manor, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Gryhon Holding, Roof]
description: A battlemented walk wraps around the peaked, slate roof and gives an unobstructed view of the marsh stretching out in each direction.  Through a trapdoor in the northwest corner a wooden ladder leads to the chamber below.

title: [Gryphon Holding, Great Hall]
description: A light draft stirs the banners draped overhead, each measure of silk representing a knight of the Order.  Dominating the room is a massive oak table with a dozen tall chairs around it.  Three smaller tables are set up in an alcove off the eastern wall for more private gatherings.  Elaborate figurines of former members line the mantle of a huge fireplace set at the far end of the room.  Flanking the hearth, floor-to-ceiling shelves hold a wide selection of reading material and ancient tomes.

title: [Gryphon Holding, Great Hall]
description: A light draft stirs the banners draped overhead, each measure of silk representing a knight of the Order.  Dominating the room is a massive oak table with a dozen tall chairs around it.  Three smaller tables are set up in an alcove off the eastern wall for more private gatherings.  Elaborate figurines of former members line the mantle of a huge fireplace set at the far end of the room.  Flanking the hearth, floor-to-ceiling shelves hold a wide selection of reading material and ancient tomes.

title: [Gryphon Holding, First Floor]
description: Unadorned stone walls and narrow windows leave this room rather stark and austere.  A fireplace fills most of the north wall, and the large table and benches that stand in the center of the room appear to be polished and new.  Against the south wall, two rearing ivory gryphons hold between them an ebony and crimson dart board with silver numerals.

title: [Bloodforge, Workshop]
description: Encased in stacked slabs of ur-barath, this cold and damp chamber reeks of metallic-tinged aromas, as if it were a carnage-filled battleground in recent times.  Thin blades sharpened to a fine point jut out from the front of a crimson-tinged stone bloodforge, and droplets of what appears to be dried blood stain the floor surrounding the workspace.  Piles of crimson powder cover the floor beneath a large opening.  A dwarven blacksmith assistant stands in front of a narrow archway leading toward the smithy.  An unadorned staircase spirals toward the temple.

An undorned staircase spirals toward the temple.

title: [Underground Temple, Hall]
description: No more than two-feet high, a wide wooden board carved with straight lines and curved shapes encircles the room.  At each corner, a crystalline moon hangs from the ceiling and spins with abandon.  An unadorned staircase spirals downward into a chamber illuminated by a deep amber glow.  Sculpted from heavily crimson-laced slabs of ur-barath, a pulpit stands in solitude in the center of the room.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Kitchen]
description: The kitchen is a place of constant movement as the Hendoran cooks and staff continues a dance of constant clean up and preparation for the meals to feed their armed counterparts.  Rich and savory smells flow from various boiling pots and several spits of meat slowly being rotated by small cogs in wheels built next to the kitchen's fires.  Occasionally, an auxiliary disappears with a large plate of food and returns later balancing a number of wooden plates.

title: [Hendoran Outpost, Cellar]
description: Casks of wine and crates of food are stacked neatly in every corner of the large cellar, and more than a few old dirty footprints are scattered about the earthen ground.  A lit torch protrudes from a wall, throwing a cascade of light and shadows across the area.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Store Foyer]
description: Aside from tools, mechanical bits, and numerous stacks of dark wooden crates, the foyer of this building is largely empty.  Near the eastern wall, a stack of lids lies toppled over beside a broken barrel.  To the west, a salesroom is visible, and a set of uneven stairs heads up to the second floor.

title: [Reim Base Camp, Wares]
description: The ground floor of the store is visible through precariously wide gaps in the planks of the floor.  The strong scent of freshly cut lumber emanating from a thin layer of chunks and grains of sawdust covering the platform pervades the room.  Thick wooden pegs protrude from a sloping beam, and a set of uneven stairs heads down to the first floor.

title: [Darkness With Inn, Front Desk]
description: A blood-stained wooden desk sits to the side of the staircase and bears a placard carved into the likeness of a red-eyed lich, a crown of finger bones upon his head.  Moldering zombies stagger about the area, some wandering mindlessly up and down the staircase rising to the second floor.

title: [The Darkness With Inn, Hallway]
description: The second floor hall is nearly engulfed in darkness, shadows creeping along the walls and seemingly moving with a life of their own.  The carpet of the floor has been torn up in many spots, and stained with blood in others.  A number of doorways line the hall, their doors completely missing.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Forecastle]
description: Perched high above the main decking, the view offered from the polished brass railings of the forecastle stretches off many leagues toward the horizon.  A tall, cypress foremast dominates the space, while a long cylindrical bowsprit extends out over the choppy waters below.  To each side of the spacious decking, a set of coral-dusted stairs descends further into the vessel's depths.

title: [Damsel of the Deep, Passageway]
description: Though some light streams down an open stairwell from the forecastle above, brass lanterns provide most of the illumination in the enclosed companionway.  Staterooms for traveling merchants and other distinquished guests punctuate the illuminated passage, each highlighted on either side with a pair of softly glowing wall sconces.

title: [Caligos Island, Pier]
[Caligos Isle, Pier]
description: The sturdy pier stands ready to accomodate visitors arriving from, or embarking to, the mainland.  Resting on raised pillars anchored firmly in the substrate below, the terminal end stretches far enough off shore to reach deep water at low tide.  A small grey shanty with pristine white trim is affixed near the stairs, held fast with heavy linked chains.

title: [The Pleco, Dive Bar]
description: The prominent feature of this dim, compact space, is the short walnut bar lined with some squat bar stools bolted to the floor, providing beverages and respite along the far wall.  Behind it, shelves rise to the ceiling displaying an assortment of colored bottles in all shapes and sizes.  Rows of brass pipes run overhead and along the walls, punctuated by the odd knob or valve handle.  A half dozen ale kegs are strapped to the floor behind the bar, lashed together with thick leather belts.

title: [Caligos Isle, Bluff Head Trail]
description: Wisps of fog snake along the top of the plateau, sometimes obscuring the narrow path through short green bushes of salal and wax myrtle broken with patches of fragrant wild beach roses.  Small glass-encased lanterns light the way along crooked wooden stairs guided by a shaky rope handrail threaded through the eyes of iron posts.  Another layer of coastal marine mist wavers overhead, often hiding and revealing an indigo star-filled sky, mimicking the wave activity on the black sand beach below.

Lush green flora covers the top of the plateau, benefitting from the misty coastal fog that coalesces each day.  Short green bushes of salal and wax myrtle are broken with patches of bright pink wild beach roses basking in the sun, their delicate petals ruffled by a constant breeze.  A shaky rope handrail threaded through the eyes of iron posts assists along the crooked wooden stairs traversing to a black sand beach stretching as far as the eye can see.

Small glass-encased lanterns light the way along some crooked wooden stairs guided by a shaky rope handrail threaded through the eyes of iron posts.  Another layer of coastal marine mist wavers overhead, often hiding and revealing an indigo star-filled sky, mimicking the wave activity on the black sand beach below.

title: [Caligos Isle, Toe of Bluff]
description: At the base of the bluff, various heights of the soaring basalt columns that form the base of the plateau have broken off to create seatings providing a commanding view of the dark beach.  Even faint starlight causes a winking glimmer along the length of black sand.  Tall iron stands buried deep into the soil and filled with oil-soaked, rag-wrapped torches light the way just above the high water line.

At the base of the bluff, various heights of basalt columns cluster and soar to form a jagged plateau, many of their once sharp hexagonal edges near-rounded from exposure to high tides, crashing waves, and the elements for eons.  Broken off pieces mound in the sand like fallen logs, littering the immediate beach with seatings providing a commanding view of the beach.  Cold, empty iron stands mark the high water line, their accompanying torches removed during the day.

title: [Caligos Isle, Ravine's Heart]
description: Enormous wrought iron stakes are pounded into the smooth shale wall along the eastern edge of the ravine anchoring a rickety staircase of teak and steel that ascends into mist.  In contrast, the western wall is smooth and slick with water from an unseen force, it's unyielding face blotting out the moonlight.  Along this section of the ravine, the sound of rushing, swirling water collides with the howl of an unseen and unfelt wind.

title: [Caligos Peak, Twisting Inclines]
description: Rollicking mists, limned in silver moonlight, pour over granite shards that encircling the landing and pool in shadowed crevices that pockmark a gloom-filled landscape.  Wind howls through the area as it races past a rickety iron-bound staircase on its way to the inky black depths below.

Shards of blackened granite rise upon either side of an uneven landing, their glossy faces aiding the rollicking mist in shrouding a view of the world below.  Sunlight is stronger at this height, though the shadows run deeper as the golden light is unable to penetrate the various crevices of the pockmarked landscape.  Disappearing into the depths below is a rickety iron-bound staircase.

title: [Caligos Pawnshop]
description: Water-warped oak boards run from floor to ceiling, their wavy faces are pockmarked with rusty nails and the seams between are filled with fresh tar.  Dust swings lazily back and forth from the rafters as an exterior breeze invades the shop from the open teak door, while golden light pools upon the distorted floorboards from lanterns hung to either side of a few crooked stone steps that lead into the backroom.  A hollow manatee skull hangs over the counter and creates shadows upon the smooth surface.

title: [Caligos Pawnshop, Stockroom]
description: Brightly glowing lanterns frame a few crooked stone steps that lead up into the main shop and do little to dispel the general gloom in the corners of this somewhat tidy room.  Four tables displaying armor, weapons, arcane items, and miscellaneous treasures are arranged neatly, but these are the only things new about the space.  The heavy, musty odors of age, mildew, and water damage fill the air.

title: [Siren's Call Tavern, Bar]
description: A mild hint of wood varnish lingers in the air, mingled with the aroma of dark ale, spirits, and the twang of cigar smoke.  Centered on the back wall is a carved teak bar, and over it hangs a tremendous circular mirror behind glass shelves illuminated in wan jewel-toned hues.  Suede-cushioned stools sit beneath the edge of the counter, which is topped with clean-shaded lamps at intervals.  A narrow stairway leads up to the mezzanine.

title: [Siren's Call, Mezzanine]
description: Open to the tavern's interior on one side and the downward slope of the mountain on the other, the mezzanine is buffeted by cool, soft breaths of air stirred by waves breaking on the shore far below.  Half of the sheltering overhang is an outcropping of rock, while the rest is a retractable oilcloth canopy in a deep shade of blue.  Each of the canopy's supports are moored in sculpted stone planters carved out from the rocky floor.  A narrow stairway leads down to the bar.

title: [Wench Wear]
description: Bundles of dried flowers cover the peeling walls, overwhelming the small space with the scent of jasmine and lavender.  The only reprieve from the stifling odor is a small hole in the ceiling that allows fresh air and natural light to filter in.  A rope ladder falls through the small hole and dangles above a low-set clothing rack.  Two mannequins, one male and one female, have been posed on the only seat in the wagon, their arms tangled together in an awkward embrace.

title: [Wench Wear, Workroom]
description: Moonlight glints off of long sections of steel railing that encircle the roof of the wagon.  A cool breeze musters up a slight scent of jasmine and lavender that filters into the open area from a small hole in the floor.  Piles of pillows have been stacked up in each corner, offering a nice spot to rest and enjoy watching the stars.

Sunlight glints off of long sections of steel railing that encircle the roof of the wagon.  A cool breeze musters up a slight scent of jasmine and lavender that filters into the open area from a small hole in the floor.  Piles of pillows have been stacked up in each corner, offering a nice spot to rest and enjoy the warm sunshine.

title: [Caligos Isle, High Promontory]
description: In those rare moments when the fog lifts from the area, the view of the western sea is nothing short of spectacular from this promontory outcropping of basalt.  Peering down, however, is ill-advised for the faint of heart, as the drop-off is steep and the surface of the churning water is a long way down.  A long length of knotted hemp rope dissappears over the side of the cliff, and a plank and chain ladder vanishes upwards, all but lost in the thick, grey mist rolling down from the higher peaks.

title: [Caligos Isle, Junder's Base]
description: Dark boulders edging the coastline far below appear like fragments of smoldering coal, and wisps of white fog curl upward to a thick cloud just above the towering obelisk's midpoint.  A piercing whistle trails in the wake of gusts through the ladder rungs above, leaving a hypnotic melody lingering in the dense fog.

title: [Caligos Isle, Boneyard Garden]
description: A solid wall of etched stone surrounds this derelict clearing.  Malignant, low hanging fog creates a ceiling of dripping miasma that coats everything in a noisome mist.  Beneath a malformed cocobolo tree lie the shards of tiny, broken headstones, inscribed not with names, but with crude, childlike drawings of small animals.

title: [Caligos Isle, Mire]
description: A cloying fog laced with deep indigo tendrils hovers over the rough terrain.  Jagged, lichen-covered boulders block descent to the sea below but create a sufficient breaker for unrelenting waves that threaten to overwhelm the surrounding land.  A crystal clear pool has formed in the shadow of towering rock, and underfoot, slurping sounds of fleshy muck is suggestive that one should not linger.

title: [Caligos Isle, Cavern Split]
description: Various sounds amplify within the expansive chamber, the flap of unseen wings drowned out by the screech of grinding rock against rock.  Thin steam vents create a curtain of vapor that obscures the offshoots along the grey-cast cavern, each vent exploding into a crescendo of hissing.

title: [Caligos Isle, Dank Tidepools]
description: Black sands stretch across the cave floor, the soft grains incredibly fine and iridescent, while high above, the rough ceiling is covered in purple algae that is speckled with white.  Pacing between an iron-bound warped oak chest and a jagged-edged dark crevasse, a barefoot pale human child watches the ocean water that aggressively laps at the shore.  Dangling between torches set into the roughened wall, a knotted hemp rope provides access to the cavern above.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Hall]
description: The upward slope of the hall ends at the base of a set of curved stairs carved directly into the stone wall.  On the opposite wall is a recessed niche that stretches from the floor to a trefoil arch near the ceiling.  Within the depression, dark scenery emerges in earthy pigments blackened by time and moisture.  Wan light trickles down the stairs, along with the faint scent of sea brine and ale.

title: [Whip and Wight Inn, Landing]
description: The mouth of the stairway opens into a cavernous space hollowed out from the mountain, with deep crags and scars still visible in the stone.  Heavy iron sconces are bracketed to walls stained by soot and mildew, and the floor underfoot is a ridged span of age-darkened teak.  The chasmal void beyond is dimly lit by lanterns hung overhead, and the forms of stools and a bar sulk like lurking shadow beasts in the distance.

title: [Caligos Isle, Maze of Columns]
description: Unknown forms dart in and out of the haze-filled air, skittering across the eroded walls of the cavern and up the lopsided columns flanking the path beyond.  Frail strands of webbing lay smashed into the rocky floor creating glistening patterns that are highlighted by the torches perched at various intervals.

title: [Caligos Isle, Fish Pits]
description: Illuminated by torches that are set at even intervals, this section of cavern has an uneven floor that is pockmarked with rust-hued calcite deposits.  Perched upon a crate, a scrawny half-krolvin lad dangles one foot over the edge of a white stone-encircled pit that is filled with ocean water.  Behind him, an iron-bound warped oak chest sits with a large padlock on it, while just to his right is a knotted hemp rope that leads out of the cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Caligos Isle, Blind Man's Rail]
description: Twin railings stand at either side of the narrow pathway, the broken wood frames hanging precariously over the darkness of the cavern depths below.  The intermittent echo of rocks colliding down the walls of the chamber breaks up the otherwise monotonous silence of the area.

title: [Caligos Isle, Eel Beds]
description: Low ceilinged and cramped, the cavern has uneven floors and walls that are striated with purple algae and off-white calcite.  Iron-caged lanterns dangle from the ceiling to illuminate a strange tubular contraption, which resides over a banded oak-slatted bucket.  Pacing between an iron-bound warped oak chest and a dark glaes aquarium, a plump-faced gnome child watches over the area with a look that is a mixture of curiosity and amusement.  A knotted hemp rope provides an exit from the cavern and entry to the floor above.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Caligos Isle, Shadowed Grotto]
description: A ring of dying torches flickers through the grotto, the flames casting elongated shadows over the pale greenish waters.  A crumbling curved stairway cuts alongside the underground pool, the ramp briefly concealed as the torches threaten to be extinguished by the rivulets of liquid dripping from the ceiling.

title: [Caligos Isle, Narrow Chamber]
description: The scent of an extinguished torch permeates the humid chamber, the tilted walls crowding the available space along the fissure-covered ground.  The outline of a large hole dominates the center of the cramped area, one side clamped with a rust-flaked iron hook.

title: [Artificer Tower]
description: Steps mark the middle of the chamber, spiraling both upwards to a higher floor and downwards into darkness.  The round room itself is walled in stone, its floors covered in layered sapphire carpets and its entirety lit by glass globes suspended from filamentous silver chains.  An arched door leads outwards.

title: [Artificer Tower]
description: Benches sit flush against the walls, forming a rounded ring of seating.  In the center of the room, steps lead both up and down.  The stone floor is covered with a thickly plush silver carpet, worked with a design of linear sapphire peacocks.

title: [Artificer Tower]
description: Benches sit flush against the walls, forming a rounded ring of seating.  In the center of the room, steps lead both up and down.  The stone floor is covered with a thickly plush silver carpet, worked with a design of linear sapphire peacocks.

title: [Artificer Tower]
description: The topmost chamber of the tower benefits from the structure's domed roof, opening up the space to twice the height of the rooms below.  A ring of clerestory windows placed just beneath the cap of the dome itself let in a light tinged by their dark blue glass panes, a light which falls on the many banners and pennons hanging from the walls.  In the center of the chamber, a stairway spirals downward.

title: [Icemule Hall, Great Room]
description: A large stone fireplace dominates this wide room, its stacked chimney stretching beyond the vaulted ceilings.  Overstuffed chairs of all sizes surround the hearth, their backs draped in warm fur throws.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, northwest, out

title: [Icemule Hall, Loft]
description: Rows of bookshelves enclose this cozy hideaway, gleaming in the light of the brass torch sconces that are affixed to the walls.  Plush chairs sit off in one corner while cushions lie scattered about the floor, offering comfort to those wishing to thumb through the many tomes.  An arched bay window frames a plush padded window seat on the far wall, providing a bird's eye view of the snowy environs below.

title: [Journey's End, Foyer]
description: Covered with stone tiles, the floor of the entryway is a colorful mosaic depicting a rose pattern.  A mirrored coat rack stands next to a carved beechwood door, a reflection of the room echoed in the smooth glass.  Suspended from a silver chain, a large candelabra hangs above, illuminating the area.

title: [Journey's End, Lounge]
description: This expansive lounge feels vast, furnished with deep leather couches paired with mahogany side tables.  Tall curtained windows along the northern wall soften any light that spills in.  A long driftwood bar spans the space in front of the windows.  The eastern wall is claimed by a massive stone fireplace crowned by a thick mantle, while on the opposite wall a dark mahogany double door opens into an adjoining bedchamber.  Polished hardwood floors complement raised-panel wainscoting covering the walls.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Hushed Park]
description: Encircled by bright hedges, the small park is oddly tidy in comparison to other sections of the town.  Clean, bright red bricks form a patio of sorts where a large grey stone fountain quietly burbles amid greyish-pink water lilies and daisies.

title: [Haunt of the Silent Investors]
description: Large cobblestone blocks, grey and slippery from years of water damage, form the walls of this circular section of sewer, their smooth faces interrupted by the placement of pipes and drains.  A long marble staircase follows the curve of the wall, providing egress for denizens, beneath which are pendant lanterns crafted of glowing witch-balls that are filled with bright white lights.  Two tunnels lead away from the area, each with a small black pennant that prominently displays an ivory raven skull with a bound beak.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Tavern]
description: The air hangs thick with the smell of booze and sweat and mingles with the dull roar of rowdy patrons.  A long black oak bar stretches one wall that is covered in colorful glass bottles below a large emerald-studded serpent and the railing of a loft.  Several stained tables and chairs are clustered about the room before a low stage, while others appear to have been pulled into the darker corners for dicing or privacy.  Behind the bar, a small pair of swinging doors leads to the kitchen.

title: [The Viridian Coil, Loft]
description: A view of the tavern is visible though a rough oak branch railing that lines the edge of the loft, which has several tables and chairs set about the area for the patrons.  A battered dart board hangs from one wall, while flickering oil lanterns hang from pegs, providing some dim and dirty light to the area.

title: [Black Hand, Foyer]
description: The focal point of the expansive room is a swirled sanguine glaes chandelier, the dim candlelight illuminating the cavern.  Draped decoratively across the walls is tone-on-tone ivory bourde, the fabric framing a black willow sideboard.  Various tunnels allow further passage into the cave, and at each entrance, two large charcoal velvet armchairs sit opposite from each other.  Etched vaalin sconces line the winding slate stone steps as they continue downwards.

title: [Black Hand, Brewery]
description: The air is slightly damp, the silence of the rocky chamber broken by the quiet sound of water dripping far off in the distance.  A tremendous copper drum rises from the floor in the center of the room, tapering to a rounded peak near the ceiling to form a massive still.  Old, iron-banded vats line the walls, forming two rows of oak aisles among the space.  Off to the side, an ebonwood table holds some corked bottles of pale liquid, while a charcoal marble fireplace provides the only light in the space.

title: [Bloodriven Village, Exterior]
description: The cobblestones are crumbling on this stretch of the path.  Alongside the road, wagon wheel-sized ruts run deep in the dirt, and a broken wheel lays forgotten in the high weeds.

title: [Diskovery, Opening]
description: Excavated from the ground is a massive pit with no visible side supports to prevent a cave-in.  The surface is nearly fifteen feet above the bottom, and the only exit is back up the ladder.  Considering the absense of display tables, inventory containers, or seating accommodations, the floating objects do little to unclutter the confined cavity.

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Library]
description: The stairwell terminates at this hexagonal shaped room.  Walls of stone are interrupted by tall, multi-paned glaesine windows that stretch from the floor to the ceiling.  Between moonlit windows, ebonwood bookshelves line the walls.  The floor is grey-stained ash inlaid with an ivory border and covered by a polar bear hide rug at the center.  An ebonwood desk sits to one side before a pair of wingback black suede chairs.  Six sconces on the walls and a large wrought-iron chandelier are hung to illuminate the library.  An ebonwood ladder leads up to a hatch in the ceiling.
a.location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keep Aenatumgana, Cupola]
description: At the peak of the tower, the cupola boasts panoramic moonlit views of Icemule rooftops, the eastern slopes, and mountain peaks to the north.  Cold air and flurries of snow infiltrate wide windows on each of the six sides of the tower.  The only heat comes from candle votives suspended by chains from the mithril roof of the cupola.  Seated at the center of the platform is a large golden telescope trained on a mountain range to the north.  A ladder in the floor provides passage back inside.
b.location: Keep Aenatumgana, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Keg of the Bloody Asp, Storage]
description: Casks, barrels, and crates rise from the pine floorboards to the exposed rafter ceiling and occupy virtually every available space of the small store room.  Dim light spills through the door that leads into the tavern, while a bright glow spills on the uppermost steps of a rough pine staircase.  Several bundles of rushes bound together by wire are stacked in the center of the room.

Casks, barrels, and crates rise from the pine floorboards to the exposed rafter ceiling and occupy virtually every available space of the small store room.  Dim light spills through the door that leads into the tavern, while a bright glow spills on the bottommost steps of a rough pine staircase.  Several bundles of rushes bound together by wire are stacked in the center of the room.

title: [Lair of the Ophidian Cabal]
description: Three corners of the root cellar are fitted with yawning archways that lead deeper into the lair, while the fourth is filled with a rough pine staircase that disappears into the oak-raftered ceiling.  Caged torches are bolted to the nondescript walls and cast their flickering light upon a large round table in the heart of the room.  A gnarled ebonwood quarterstaff is mounted perpendicular to the floor and has a simple blue flag draping from its length.

title: [Glacial Cavern]
description: A great expanse of glacial rock and ice rises up, the naturally domed structure braced in curved, polished pine beams designed to embrace the frozen stalactites pitching down in crystalline brilliance.  Thin paper lanterns float from glaes-linked suspensions, glowing with pale lilac and blue hues of the phosphorescent orbs nestled within.

title: [Faire, Frozen Glade]
description: A jagged glacier looms over an open grassy knoll kissed with glistening frost and bordered by a dense coniferous forest capped in a thick layer of pure white snow.  The fresh scent of pine wafts on a chilled breeze as the surrounding trees sway, their snowy canopy bending to reveal a star-spangled sky.  Several makeshift log benches have been placed around a circular firepit, a crate of wood set into the snowy ground just beside it.

title: [Idip Udip Wedip]
description: Crammed into the confines of this small space is a pair of armless maroon-on-jade jacquard silk upholstered chairs with a small oak table between them.  A long lacquered pine counter stretches from near the glass-paned door to the back wall, ending beside a skinny ladder leading up to the house's loft.

Crammed into the confines of this small space is a pair of armless maroon-on-jade jacquard silk upholstered chairs with a small oak table between them.  A long lacquered pine counter stretches from the near the glass-paned door to the back wall, ending beside a skinny ladder leading up to the house's loft.

title: [Idip Udip Wedip, Loft]
description: Low ceilings and tight quarters create a cramped workspace.  Several plush caramel devore pillows litter the floor in a haphazard fashion, the only area kept clear near a skinny ladder.  Twin potted ferns flank a squat table of lacquered pine that sits against the loft's short railing.

title: [Warehouse, Receiving]
description: Positioned opposite an arched and curtained entry, a set of rickety stairs disappears into the ceiling above and is illuminated by the dusty glass lanterns that are anchored to the nearby rough maple wall.  Several pegs follow the slanting line of the stairs and house a variety of items over a long wooden bench that is cluttered with bric-a-brac.  An errant breeze, damp and heavy with the scent of decay, consistently tugs at the fabrics on display.

title: [Counting House, Hall]
description: Moonlight lends the dusty hallway a silver cast as it seeps through the greasy window that occupies a small space where the wall and roof meet.  Bookcases dominate the narrow causeway and are topped with oil lamps that flicker and sputter in the chilling draft that trickles down from some unseen fissure in the rafters.  A single staircase along the western wall provides access to the lower levels.

title: [Clovertooth, Kitchen]
description: A pair of swinging white oak doors separates the kitchen and dining room, sealing off some of the noise from the bustling staff at work.  A large fel cupboard occupies one corner, its doors ajar, revealing shelves stacked with fresh fruit and prepared desserts.  The white marble counter is laden with cutting boards and a variety of knives and utensils.  A red-faced halfling chef threatens his assistants with a rolling pin as they scurry about the kitchen preparing dishes for the guests in the dining room.

title: [Clovertooth, Wine Cellar]
description: Enclosed by stone walls, a cavernous room with arched ceilings opens at the foot of some extremely narrow spiral stairs leading up into the kitchen.  The cool, still air holds a faintly musty, earthen scent.  Wooden wine barrels sit in stacks, and built into the walls are latticed racks holding countless bottles of wine.  Iron chandeliers cast a twinkling glow over the bottles, setting their rich jewel tones alight, though the cellar is not without its shadowy corners.  Each footfall reverberates throughout the room, disturbing a light coat of dust.

title: [Top of the Stair]
description: A wide stairway of pale gold marble fills the hall, disappearing around the sharp curve of the wall as it descends.  Scrolled golden oak banisters on brass posts flank the top of the stair, and a long scarlet rug spills down its center.  Along the curved walls, long floral tapestries alternate with the bright glow of gaily flickering lanterns.

title: [Base of the Stair]
description: A wide stairway of pale gold marble fills the hall, curving sharply along the wall as it ascends.  Scrolled golden oak banisters on brass posts flank the stairway, and a long scarlet rug spills down its center to pool just before the arched doorway leading into the antechamber.  Along the curved walls, long floral tapestries alternate with the bright glow of gaily flickering lanterns.

title: [Saddle Me Up]
description: Dirt and dust hang in the air, visibly twirling about with every little movement.  Horse tack is strewn about the area, the vast majority of it broken and abused collections of reins, bridles, straps, stirrups, and saddles, none of which seem to be actual sales merchandise.  Somewhat hidden amongst the clutter, a small halfling mutters to herself, loudly smacking her gums and rolling her eyes as she lounges against a display rack and idly kicks at several unfinished saddle trees at her feet.

title: [Saddle Me Up, Showroom]
description: Built on a raised platform, this part of the saddlemaker's stall is entirely enclosed by white oak beams, save for a set of five steps leading out.  An intricate system of hooks jutting down from the ceiling suspends, at varied cants and angles, six Finnian style saddles.  Kannalan style saddles hang along a railing near one wall, opposite a long, horizontal post topped with a row of Minstrel's style saddles.  Scattered throughout the room, lanterns constantly spit tiny flames, their smoke mingling with the scents of white oak and leather.
