Scattered throughout the room, lanterns constantly spit tiny flames, their smoke mingling with the scents of white oak and leather.

title: [Midnight Heron, Main Hall]
description: Lanterns housing eldritch flames illuminate this coffee and spice scented hallway that connects various areas of the galleon below decks.  Heavy midnight carpeting and a large tapestry muffle any noise of passers-by.  Similarly carpeted, a stairwell with chrome handrails rises to the deckhouse above.  A reinforced door on one wall bears the crest of House Illistim.  A dark portal leads aft towards the cargo hold.

title: [Midnight Heron, Deckhouse]
description: Eldritch light from wall-mounted lanterns illuminates this cabin enclosed by thick dark blue velvet curtains that cover all possible sources of light from outside.  The walls are lined with bookcases filled with all manner of leather-bound volumes.  Covered with charts and maps, a large table surrounded by some cushioned chairs fills the center of the room.  Leading into the belly of the galleon is a darkened stairwell.

title: [Midnight Heron, Observation]
description: Plush midnight blue velvet encloses this comfortable observation gallery filled with some cushioned chairs facing a sizable viewing window.  The tiered floor steps upwards from the window allowing each row of seats an unobstructed view of the landscape outside.  Covering the opposite wall is a wide midnight and silver threaded tapestry.  Ascending to the deck above is a chrome-railed spiral staircase.

title: [Midnight Heron, Foredeck]
description: Square white sails fly high overhead along the thick mast at the center of this foredeck constructed of midnight blue oak with chrome finished hardware.  Taut white ropes secure the rigging above to chrome cleats, their loose ends laid into neat, flat spirals on the spotless deck.  Poised at the tip of the bow is a detailed figurehead depicting a young elven man with one hand outstretched towards the horizon.  Polished chrome handrails accompany a spiral staircase below.

title: [Town Barracks, Entryway]
description: The stone floor of the barracks entrance expands out in all directions, its smooth surface marred by numerous boot scuffs.  To the east, through an open archway, the glimmer of metal armor and weapons can be seen, while the clatter and chatter of the dining hall echoes in from the south.  A wide wooden stairwell dominates the western wall, rising up to reach the second floor.

title: [Town Barracks, Second Floor]
description: A wide wooden stairwell begins at the end of the second floor hall, an open banister overlooking the entranceway below.  To the south, a bookcase can be glimpsed through an archway, which stands opposite of a plain wooden door.  A narrow window provides an angled view of the city streets beyond.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Grand Gallery]
description: The high vaulted ceiling, with its inset panes of thick tinted glass, allows muted sunlight to stream into the room far below.  The floor is made of polished black granite with a wide red carpet stretching down the center of the entire room.  Gold sconces are mounted on the massive marble support columns.  Grand paintings and portraits, in keeping with the scale of the room, hang on the walls.  Twin flights of stairs rise to the east and west of a large equestrian portrait at the far end of the room.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, West Hallway]
description: A large mural is painted on one wall.  The marble stairway meets a deep red carpeted hallway, its length punctuated with gold sconces.  A carved fel door with a gold knob is set into the west wall.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, Grand Gallery]
description: The high vaulted ceiling, with its inset panes of thick tinted glass, allows muted sunlight to stream into the room far below.  The floor is made of polished black granite with a wide red carpet stretching down the center of the entire room.  Gold sconces are mounted on the massive marble support columns.  Grand paintings and portraits, in keeping with the scale of the room, hang on the walls.  Twin flights of stairs rise to the east and west of a large equestrian portrait at the far end of the room.

title: [Ta'Vaalor Hall, East Hallway]
description: A short flight of marble stairs ends in a long, wide hallway.  Painted on one wall is a large floor-to-ceiling mural.  The floor has been covered with thick gold carpet and a display counter runs the length of the entire corridor.  Mounted to either side of a door made from seasoned haon are elegant silver sconces.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Mirrored Hall]
description: Ornate gilt-framed mirrors line the ivory walls, reflecting back the neat arrangement of velvet-covered chairs and glass-topped tables around the room.  A mosaic of gold and silver moonstone tiles subtly outline a walkway in the center of the roseate marble floor, leading to the foot of a sweeping staircase.  Crystal candelabra cast a soft glow and each, by means of clever positioning, illuminates a discrete seating section.

title: [Ailanthus Manor, Landing]
description: A thick mulberry carpet runner traverses the full length of the landing, connecting the west wing to the east.  The roseate tones in the marble-tiled steps of the staircase extend to the surrounding walls and blush velvet curtains framing the tall windows at each end.  Facing a solid linden door, a trio of oil-on-canvas portraits hangs above a cherrywood sideboard on which sits a slender glass vase filled with cream roses in full bloom.

title: [Wizard Guild, Balcony]
description: Poised high above the city of Ta'Vaalor, this narrow balcony offers sweeping vistas northward up the Mistydeep River.  The fortress at Ravelin is clearly visible, the standard of Ta'Vaalor whipping in the breezes from its topmost point.  At the northern horizon, a faint mistiness marks the location of the Lake of Fear.  A narrow stone staircase spirals up the side of the tower to its top.

title: [Wizard Guild, Observatory]
description: A narrow stone staircase winds its way up the side of the tower into this small, domed observatory.  The room is dominated by a vaalorn and coraesine telescope poised at the center, its polished fittings gleaming brightly in the sunlight coming through a slit overhead.  To one side, a large wooden crank is connected to some complicated rope-and-pully contraption.

title: [Windfellow's Retreat, Greatroom]
description: The black stone walls in this space are joined by a similarly crafted staircase rising from the stones underneath in a rough circular trajectory hugging the internal walls of the tower.  At the center of this room is a massive sculpture depicting a trio of gargoyles artfully arranged in attack postures, their jaws open wide and wings flared.  Torches are placed around the base of the sculpture, providing both light for the room and dramatic shadows across the sculpture's surface.

title: [Windfellow Tower, First Floor]
description: The staircase flattens out here, winding almost completely around before climbing once more.  A large claw-footed brazier stands off to one side, though it is not lit.  The area is filled with ambient light whose source is unclear, and every noise echoes off the surrounding stone, reverberating around the area.

title: [Windfellow Tower, First Floor]
description: The staircase flattens out here, winding almost completely around before climbing once more.  A large claw-footed brazier stands off to one side, though it is not lit.  The area is filled with ambient light whose source is unclear, and every noise echoes off the surrounding stone, reverberating around the area.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Second Floor]
description: Once again, the staircase ceases its rise and forms another flat platform.  Doors of various shapes and sizes litter the walls, and the floor in this area is heavily scratched, in direct contrast to the relatively smooth surfaces of the rest of the visible stone.  A blood red orb is perched on a metal stand against one wall, glowing just brightly enough to bathe the area in a sanguine hue.

The colorful staircase once again ceases its rise and forms another flat platform, this one oddly full of stuffed animals.  Doors of various shapes and sizes are blocked by the cotton and suede zoo, the floor littered by buttons and goose down in every nook and cranny.   A blood red orb is perched on a metal stand against one wall, glowing just brightly enough to bathe the area in a sanguine hue.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Second Floor]
description: Once again, the staircase ceases its rise and forms another flat platform.  Doors of various shapes and sizes litter the walls, and the floor in this area is heavily scratched, in direct contrast to the relatively smooth surfaces of the rest of the visible stone.  A blood red orb is perched on a metal stand against one wall, glowing just brightly enough to bathe the area in a sanguine hue.

Doors of various shapes and sizes are blocked by the cotton and suede zoo, the floor littered by buttons and goose down in every nook and cranny.   A blood red orb is perched on a metal stand against one wall, glowing just brightly enough to bathe the area in a sanguine hue.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Third Floor]
description: The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, as a pair of the steps actually continue above the floor, creating an awkward step down.  Many signs of heavy impact can be seen on the protruding steps, as if someone or something had attempted to hammer them into place after they had been placed.  A staircase formed of the same stones found in the rest of the tower stretches upwards, though these particular stones are polished to a high sheen.

The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, evidenced by the uneven pool of tiny wooden toy gargoyles gathered in the corner of a lower step.  Colorfully painted arrows indicate that the tower stretches upward in a spiral of streamers and dried beetles.

title: [Windfellow Tower, Third Floor]
description: The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, as a pair of the steps actually continue above the floor, creating an awkward step down.  Many signs of heavy impact can be seen on the protruding steps, as if someone or something had attempted to hammer them into place after they had been placed.  A staircase formed of the same stones found in the rest of the tower stretches upwards, though these particular stones are polished to a high sheen.

The staircase on this level is not quite even with the floor, evidenced by the uneven pool of tiny wooden toy gargoyles gathered in the corner of a lower step.  Colorfully painted arrows indicate that the tower stretches upward in a spiral of streamers and dried beetles.

title: [Dread Lord's Suite, Entrance]
description: The staircase terminates in a small alcove recessed into the tower wall which contains a pair of sturdy iron doors.  Various sigils have been etched into the metal though they are of inconsistent quality, with some being very precise and deep and others appearing ragged and haphazard.  A rope is suspended from the ceiling to the right, and a small rug lies on the floor before the doors.

The confetti-strewn staircase terminates in an alcove recessed into the tower wall, the streamer-strung pair of sturdy iron doors poorly etched with a smiling gargoyle face and several arrows pointing inward.  A duo of stuffed straw gargoyles lay against the colorful walls, their hands attached to garishly painted maypoles that droop slightly at the entrance.  Hanging from the ceiling is a spindly human-shaped lantern, casting distorted rays of light through the various puncture wounds riddling its body.

title: [Stonefinger's Secrets, Nook]
description: This is a very large, partially flooded, stone room.  The uneven floor provides a mostly dry walkway to help visitors circumnavigates pools of stagnant water.  Primitive torches lining the walls provide nothing more than unhospitable light and menacing shadows.  Some signs are posted at intervals between ancient, empty wine racks.

title: [Stonefinger's Secrets, Cellar]
description: Though several feet below the main cellar, this sub-cellar has somehow managed to escape the flooding.  Dark and musty, this small, windowless room is disconcertingly tomblike.  A single oil lamp, atop a large battered desk, provides a meager light source.  Absent any air currents, the twin scents of sulfur and smoke linger.

title: [Grifty Shades of Fae, Backroom]
description: Noticeably cooler than the area above, this area seems to be more recessed below the ground.  A bowl made of a large resin-encased leaf and a carved wooden tray stand side by side on a natural rock ledge from which a large strip of bark is hung.  Sitting on the ground, a hollowed out log is nestled close to the mass of roots that leads upwards.  In darkened corner, you can just make out the image of a braided vine ladder which leads through a narrow hole in the ground.

title: [Grifty Shades of Fae, Playroom]
description: Ambient light flickers through this subterranean alcove from a few scattered candles, illuminating a smooth stone table ringed by some soft piles of heather.  Barely noticeable, a braided vine ladder reaches up from the shadows through a hole in the ceiling.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Foyer]
description: A beam of light streams through a crooked lunette carved into a slanted modwir door, creating a large half-moon shape on the grey floor tiles.  The walls mimic the tilt of the entryway, creating the discomforting sensation of falling.  A silvery glow extends up from the stone stairs that lead down and further into the temple.

title: [Zelia's Temple, Descent]
description: Stone stairs start out wide and even, then become more erratic and twisting back upon themselves in hairpin turns, traversing this passageway.  Each landing created by the snaking steps features a small wooden bench, and yet walls lit with bright oil torches are devoid of any art or tapestries.  A tiny cluster of silver bells is suspended from a small hook set into one of the bench arms.

title: [Chapel of the Twins, Entry]
description: Embraced by the mirror-image ascents of two curved stairways, the antechamber is a relic of good taste tarnished by the cruelties of time and abandonment.  The floor is a checkerboard of white and black tiles, though age has riddled both hues with impurities and the stones with spidering cracks.  A tiered golden corona lies, bent and warped, in the shadow of the upper balcony.  Light filtering through mud-caked windows breathes prismatic life into shards of crystal scattered over the tiles.

title: [Chapel of the Twins, Overlook]
description: The passage of time has eaten away at the finish of a pair of scarred double doors, revealing silvery, splintered wood beneath.  Framed by the curve of a wrought iron banister, the balcony is bare of adornments, but echoes of rich hue and make in the carpeting allude to past finery.  The balcony overlooks an antechamber with a checkerboard floor of black and white marble that is in comparable disrepair.  Each descending stairway is crumbling and caked in dust.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: Five glaes statues stand in alcoves that have been carved into the walls.  Four of the statues are crafted into the likeness of creatures formed from each of the elementals, while the fifth represents a large and powerful demon.  A large silver symbol is inlaid on the floor, the key points reaching the base of each statue.  Directly opposite the main stairs is a smaller staircase leading upwards through the ceiling.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Rooftop]
description: A thunderstorm rages disconcertingly close to this rooftop perch.  Peering through the battlements, the Sentoph mountains are visible, clouds obscuring the tops of their peaks.  Looking westward, you can make out the shape of a large castle set into a far mountainside, waiting at the end of a long trail.  A wide path winds between the battlements and a tall obsidian wall that follows the circle of the tower's curvature.  An enruned rolaren door serves as the only entrance into the high inner wall.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: Cracks snake up and down the tunnel walls, darkness creeping along them like veins of shadows.  The tunnel comes to an end at an uneven slab of rock and stone, the occasional loose dirt falling to the ground.  A stained steel ladder is set into the wall, leading up.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point, the moonlight gently illuminating the interior of the tower.

A rough angled ceiling of thin iron plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of iron that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark metal walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Passage]
description: Dimly lit by tallows placed in wrought iron sconces, the small passage has rough wooden walls and a packed dirt floor.  Rickety wooden stairs ascend to the floor above along the western edge, while white-washed oak planks form a descending staircase that disappears below.  A faded curtain outlined in light is the only other means of exiting the space.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Basement]
description: Heavy and damp, the air is rife with the scent of packed dirt, herbs, and smoke.  Spidery white tendrils, the roots of some unseen plant, dangle from the ceiling between the thick oak beams.  Footsteps dully echo from above as patrons and denizens move through the passage above, the tremors setting the wrought iron basket of coals that hangs in the center of the room to swaying.  A rough wooden table rests against one earthy wall, its contents largely in shadow.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Passage]
description: Dimly lit by tallows placed in wrought iron sconces, the small passage has rough wooden walls and a packed dirt floor.  Rickety wooden stairs ascend to the floor above along the western edge, while white-washed oak planks form a descending staircase that disappears below.  A faded curtain outlined in light is the only other means of exiting the space.

title: [The Sable Quietus, Landing]
description: Rough oak floorboards form a small, squarish landing that encircles a rickety set of wooden stairs that descends to the level below.  Whitewashed walls, newly painted and clean, lend a sterile and austere air to the small space that is only enhanced by the scent of medicinals in the air.  Wrought iron hooks flank a closed white door, their curved edges supporting various overcoats and smocks.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Lobby]
description: The lobby is lit by a massive copper fixture, suspended by chains from the vaulted wood beam ceiling and set with hundreds of burning candles.  Central and opposite the entry doors is a sweeping wood-and-stone staircase, flanked on the ground floor by some copper-framed glass panels and a pointed mahogany arch.  Elegant and rustic elements of design mesh gracefully in the large chamber, where walls with squared hunter green panels meet with a polished birchwood floor.

title: [Williwaw Resort, Upper Landing]
description: A sleek railing of polished pine with swirling electrum inlay encircles the upper landing, from which the entire lobby is visible.  Rich burgundy carpet is soft underfoot, stretching though the long hallways which lead away from the landing in three directions.  A leather chaise lounge upholstered in ivory suede sits near the railing, a perfect spot for watching the comings and goings below.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Mantle's Landing]
description: Encased by a small railing, the curving road affords an unobstructed view of the sea and sky.  Rough stone stairs descend to the local beach, their smooth faces carved right into the bedrock of the cliff-face and flanked by a looped rope railing anchored with driftwood.  Bright glaesine lanterns flicker with green and blue lights upon their wrought iron pedestals as they create circles of illumination on an elegantly appointed bar.

Stained glass-paned lanterns flicker with green and blue lights upon their wrought iron pedestals as they create circles of illumination on an elegantly appointed bar.

Bright glaesine lanterns rest dormant upon their wrought iron pedestals as their reflected light creates rainbow patterns on an elegantly appointed bar.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Beach]
description: Ebbing and flowing, the lapping waves darken the glistening sands as they soak the edges of a beach illuminated by bamboo torches.  Rough stone stairs rise to the northwest providing access to the road above, each smooth stone step cut directly into the cliff face, which gradually descends into dunes to the southeast.  Set back from the water, an enormous circular pedestal supports a large dolphin statue, the back of which is illuminated from light that spills out of a stone-lined angular archway built into the bluff.

Ebbing and flowing, the lapping waves darken the glistening sands as they soak the edges of a beach dotted with bamboo torches.  Rough stone stairs rise to the northwest providing access to the road above, each smooth stone step cut directly into the cliff face, which gradually descends into dunes to the southeast.  Set back from the water, an enormous circular pedestal supports a large dolphin statue that casts its shadow upon a stone-lined angular archway built into the bluff.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Built against the rough stockade fence that encircles the colony, a set of stone reinforced stairs climbs to a parapet built along the top of the wall.  Water sluiced through gutters along the roof of a fortified tower spills upon the ground, creating a muddy mess that the locals avoid by making walkways of rough oak planks.  A large blackened fist painted within a canary yellow sun decorates the lowest floor of the tower.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west

title: [Logging Colony, Parapet]
description: Surrounded by logs hewn to a point, the parapet stretches from the nearby tower to the top of the colony's gates in the west.  Bamboo torches fitfully burn from their perch along the southern railings that overlook muddy tracks below, while small barrels filled with arrows and bolts rest beneath.  A fortified door provides entry to a tower that casts shadows upon the stockade fence.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Thick oak planks stretch to the west, the smooth boards creating a walking space that traverse viscous mud that dominates that area of the colony.  Rough-cut railings, fashioned of smaller trees stripped of their bark, form a protective barrier along the edge of the cliff, terminating against the stockade fence to the north and a variety of logging machinery to the south.  A set of stairs descends to a small plateau in the cliff face, a large oak sign offering caution for descent.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Penitent Pass]
description: Carved directly into the cliff facing, long tunnels lead away from the railing-encircled, rough stony ledge.  Black-eyed yellow daisies peek out from a wall of bracken that prolifically grows around oak posts at the cliff's edge.  A set of stairs, narrow and cut directly into the bedrock, ascends to a logging colony surrounded by palisades.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Entry]
description: A colorfully-painted carved ship's figurehead styled as a happy sea hag welcomes one and all into this rustic yet upscale inn and tavern.  Woven ropes of fresh-cut flowers decorate the salvaged figurehead and fill the entry with the pleasant scent of hibiscus and ivy, mingling with ocean salt.  A polite murmur of carousing wafts in from the other side of some double doors to the west.

title: [The Sea Hag's Roost, Landing]
description: A large brass sea hag figurine, handsomely tarnished by time and the ocean air, sits atop the banister as if to greet guests on their way to their rooms.  A smattering of sand has collected between the planks of this landing's otherwise tidy bare wood floors.  Clinking tankards, merry voices, and other muffled sounds of life drift in from downstairs.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Lower Platform]
description: High above, the open ceiling of the converted airship depot has been retrofitted with glass panes, each of which is set into a curving framework of verdigrised copper and coffered tiles.  The lower hall, with its branching chambers, sits largely open to a view of the windows, as well as to glimpses of the railings that line the elevated second story galleries.  Three steps lead downwards towards the glassed end of the building, and a half-moon shaped chamber set against it.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Ticketing]
description: One wall of the building is entirely glass, each pane placed into a framework of oxidized copper.  The doorway set into the wall is wide and slightly arched, part of a triad of equally spaced openings hung beneath a giant verdigris medallion.  Beyond the half-moon shaped chamber, a flight of three steps leads into the open expanse of the museum.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Foyer]
description: Heavy beams of dark timber, likely salvaged from the hulls of wrecked ships, stretch at a steep pitch to the near-darkness that lurks in the open space beneath the thatched roof.  Old fishing nets span the vacancy, artfully strung with branches of dried coral and a variety of shells, and candle-lit lanterns are scattered amongst them, contentiously placed to avoid the threat of fire.  A set of uneven steps lead down into the lobby, and a deep ocean green carpet runner follows in faded increments.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Lobby]
description: A deep ocean green carpet runner bisects the lobby, cutting an even divide between the check-in counter that sits to one side and an arch-inset wall on the other.  The end of the counter rounds to a gated entrance just short of the far wall, and a recessed staircase sits just beyond, leading to the second floor of the inn.  On the facing wall is a pastoral mural that spans from end to end in muted shades of grey and blue softened further by the diffuse light cast from the candle-lit lanterns overhead.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Lobby]
description: A deep ocean green carpet runner bisects the lobby, cutting an even divide between the check-in counter that sits to one side and an arch-inset wall on the other.  The end of the counter rounds to a gated entrance just short of the far wall, and a recessed staircase sits just beyond, leading to the second floor of the inn.  On the facing wall is a pastoral mural that spans from end to end in muted shades of grey and blue softened further by the diffuse light cast from the candle-lit lanterns overhead.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Hallway]
description: The hallway stretches out, long and dark, with walls covered in aged grey silk in a hue like that of an angry deep sea tempest.  A stenciled border trails near the ceiling and the floor, a repeating line of stylized waves in dark blue, and underfoot, a worn carpet runner in the same color cushions the wooden floor beneath.  Beside each door is a single candle-lit lamp, its scalloped shade made of age-discolored tin atop a sooted glass orb.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Lounge]
description: Massive ship wheel chandeliers hang from the sea salt-stained ceiling overhead, the wood of both dark with use and age, but glossy with a thick coat of lacquer.  The entire far wall of the lounge is occupied by a reclaimed wood bar, while half a dozen or so tables are arranged around a central mast erected at the center of the space.  A rope ladder leads up the mast to a crow's nest.

title: [Kelpie Beds, Crow's Nest]
description: From the high perch of the crow's nest, the entire lounge and bar below are visible, and the din of voices and glass clinking is muted.  A large, lumpy pillow covered in patched fabrics is smooshed against the curve of the railing as an impromptu seat, and atop the banister across from it sits an age-darkened spyglass on a bronze stand.  A dark bronze masthead lantern hangs from the mast at the center of the platform above a rope ladder leading down.

title: [The Captain's Cup, Entry]
description: The shallow entryway unfolds into a plush sitting area that seems more elegant state room than pub.  Floors and walls of varnished mahogany gleam darkly beneath the flickering candles set within a pair of lofty chandeliers, and the air is filled with the scent of high-priced cigars and vintage spirits.  A sepia-toned globe guards a set of upward steps at the far end of the bar, and across the way, a curved brass handrail follows a stairway upward into the darkness.

title: [The Captain's Cup, Top Shelf]
description: Pendulum lamps with jewel-toned stained glass shades hang above the bar, illuminating the cherry wood and highlighting clusters of drink accoutrements, such as embossed coasters, napkins, and extra garnishes.  Swags of wine-hued velvet drape the ceiling and upper walls, subduing sound as well as the light from the candelabra scattered about.  The effect is close and intimate, with a pair of suede-covered couches and several upholstered chairs arranged around a modest fireplace with a stone hearth.

title: [The Captain's Cup, Entry]
description: The shallow entryway unfolds into a plush sitting area that seems more elegant state room than pub.  Floors and walls of varnished mahogany gleam darkly beneath the flickering candles set within a pair of lofty chandeliers, and the air is filled with the scent of high-priced cigars and vintage spirits.  A sepia-toned globe guards a set of upward steps at the far end of the bar, and across the way, a curved brass handrail follows a stairway upward into the darkness.

title: [The Captain's Cup, Lounge]
description: Carved mahogany frames the ceiling above, with an elaborate maritime mural spanning the entirety of the space within.  Wine-hued velvet hangs in scallops at the upper edges of the walls, while cherry wood wainscoting trims the lower half in a subtle, but stylish contrast to the mahogany walls.  A half-circle counter at the head of the room boasts a display showcasing a variety of glasses, and dark leather-cushioned chairs and side tables are spread throughout the lounge.

title: [Boarding House, Foyer]
description: Exposed oak framework lends the entry a rustic look, while bright white stucco walls help to brighten the space.  Following the line of the eastern wall, an ascending staircase leads to the loft-like second story and has a small welcome mat placed before its bottommost step.  A polished copper mirror is affixed to the western wall, which leads to a small kitchen, where a half-circle wooden table filled with cleaning supplies rests.

title: [Boarding House, Loft]
description: Built into the attic and surrounded by exposed roof beams on either side, the long loft is filled with narrow cots covered in white sheets, woolen blankets, and knitted throws.  Footlockers rest at the foot of each, their edges perched upon a braided rug of black, brick red, and slate blue.  A single window allows the sunlight to filter into the space, while a descending staircase along the eastern wall leads to the floor below.

title: [Sunfist Tower, Office]
description: Utilitarian and sparse, the room smells strongly of cedar and pipe tobacco.  Maps are pinned to the rough oak walls, covering the space between a dark green chalkboard and a bulletin board filled with parchments.  A small desk and chair in the northeastern corner sit at an angle to take full advantage of the room's two windows.

title: [Sunfist Tower, Bunk Room]
description: Devoid of windows, the room is small and austere.  Hooded lanterns rest over a small writing desk in one cramped corner, while a large clothes press mounted in opposition sits partially ajar.  Bunk beds covered with lusterless grey wool blankets clutter the remainder of the space.

title: [Brewmaster's Tap, Pub Room]
description: The air in this grubby run-down pub is thick with the scent of old ale, and the floor is sticky with it too.  The tables are little more than old beer kegs, and the seats merely smaller casks dropped next to them, but it matters little to the rough and hearty crowd.  A surly matron mans the many taps behind a rickety old bar, while a young boy excitedly dashes between her and the tables to take and fill patrons' orders.

title: [Brewmaster's Tap, Cellar]
description: While floor-to-ceiling beer kegs betray this space as a storage area, puddles of fresh ale show it's still a popular drinking spot in this bar.  Upright kegs and smaller casks serve as makeshift tables and seats, all illuminated by the unsteady flickering candlelight of an overhead cast-iron chandelier.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Portico]
description: Thin rivulets run down the spiralled flutings of columns framing the vestibule's entry, the water flowing into seaglass-filled channels carved into marble floors leading toward a driftwood arch.  Petrified coral sconces with flickering cerulean candles accent a mosaic crafted from broken shells spanning rockface walls.  Cut into these same walls is an opening leading to a small nook.

Thin rivulets run down the spiralled flutings of columns framing the vestibule's entry, the water flowing into seaglass-filled channels carved into marble floors leading toward a driftwood arch.  Petrified coral sconces with flickering cerulean candles accent a mosaic crafted from broken shells spanning rockface walls.

title: [The Peaceful Porpoise, Passage]
description: Scant light, cast from a single bronze torch thrust into a broken iron sconce, casts dim shadows against the passage's craggy walls.  Along with the sound of rustling fabric, footsteps from an unseen source echo up some shale steps.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Blue, grey, and white flagstones form a checkered pattern upon the western wall, the worked stones smooth and unblemished by dust or cobwebs.  Uniformly grey cobblestones form the floor of the building, while polished warm red mahogany decorates the ceiling.  A single lantern decorates the railing of a pair of ascending stairs, its brightly glowing interior providing a blaze of light that reaches to the sill of a nearby window.

title: [Converted Weather Station, Hall]
description: Knotty pine rafters are evenly spaced down the long hall, causing the ceiling to resemble the inverted ribs of a ship.  Starlight illuminates the panes of nearby windows, while lanterns crafted to look like tiny houses spill warm candlelight onto the mahogany floorboards.  Curving along the exterior wall, a set of descending stairs stands opposite a set of wide golden oak doors in the wide landing.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Lower Platform]
description: A marble staircase cuts a diagonal across the back side of the building, leading upwards to the second story.  On one side of the staircase is a copper railing and on the other, an unobstructed view through the glass wall to the city outside.  Several arches lead off from the main platform floor, each one leading into a more contained chamber.

title: [Museum Alerreth, Upper Platform]
description: Copper railings line the inner edge of the high platform, providing a slatted view down onto the main floor of the museum below.  The exhibit space between the railings and the building's exterior wall is largely open, and identical to its mate across the platform -- the floors are basket weave patterned wood and the cases clear glass atop copper pedestals.  A walkway stretches between the two elevated halves of the building.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Rotted Cabin]
description: Tangled vines of kelp descend from the cracked ceiling, the rotting vegetation filling the dank cabin with an unhealthy stench.  Haloed by an eerie green light, a fissure in the wall provides a means of escape, as does a brass-tacked ladder.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Rotted Cabin]
description: Shattered ceiling boards lay scattered across the soggy rug amid tangled kelp, coral colonies, and the bones of long dead aquatic creatures.  Eerie green light filters into the room, its source somewhere beyond the furthest rung of a brass-tacked ladder.  Moldy and mildewed piles of broken furniture are pushed against the slick walls, creating a path that leads to a fissure in the eastern wall.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Coral Alcove]
description: Terminating in an alcove of splintered and rotted wood, the hallway sports coral structures and moldy velvet.  Two paintings depicting faded scenes in the jungle, one of a ruined temple and the other a raging waterfall, hang at tilted angles along the wall.

title: [Warped Wavedancer, Hallway]
description: Piled against the end of the hallway is the splintered remains of something that vaguely resembles a wooden table.  Mounted to the water-slicked wall is a verdigris mirror filled with shards of semi-reflective glass.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Lighthouse Pub]
description: Crescent-shaped tables and some curving birchwood benches fill the grand circular room at the base of the lighthouse.  Winding stairs climb the structure in a spiral to the top, while torch-bright sconces ring the space with cheerful light, supplemented by a brick-faced fireplace placed behind a lacquered walnut and mahogany bar.  Squeezed onto a small side stage, a disparate band of musicians circulates in and out of the pub, playing a boundless profusion of merry, foot-tapping music.

title: [Briarmoon Cove, Lantern Room]
description: The cylindrical glassed-in structure is supported by vertical bars of gleaming vultite and crowned with an intricate cupola roof.  Dominating the majority of the space, an immense adamantine-framed crystalline lens is brightly illumined by a flock of glowing white gold lanterns.  Tucked into a narrow outer corridor, a rainbow glaes-paned door sits next to some winding stairs that descend back to the pub below.

title: [Over Yander, Goods]
description: The sides of the covered wagon have been folded down, providing a sturdy shelf on which goods are displayed.  Several crates, barrels, and tubs have been placed near the rear of the wain, and hold a variety of products for sale.  Twin brass braziers flank a series of wooden steps leading to the interior of the schooner, providing both light and heat for patrons.

title: [Over Yander, Interior]
description: Tawny canvas, stretched taut over metal ribs, keeps the interior of this covered wagon dry and comfortable.   A weapon rack and an armor stand dominate the cramped space, leaving little room for browsing.  A small wooden seat has been built into the far end of the schooner, providing a rough resting place for patrons.

title: [Tower of Knowledge]
description: Smooth, pale stone walls encircle the spacious area, and evenly dispersed windows provide plenty of light.  A large portrait hangs next to a pale stone arch, and above the arch is an elegant sign.  Tucked into an alcove are some rough stone steps flanked by a gold-bound plaque and a highly polished gold sconce.  Rising through the center of the ceiling is a wrought-iron spiral staircase.  Accessible through an archway to the east is a rope and plank bridge.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Observatory]
description: Rising through a perfect circle centered in the smooth, pale limestone floor is a wrought-iron spiral staircase.  Five tall arches support a colorful stained glass dome overhead.  Sunlight streaming through the multicolored shards creates a slowly moving collage on the stone below.  A tarnished brass telescope sits on the balcony that encircles the structure.

title: [Tower of Knowledge]
description: Smooth, pale stone walls encircle the spacious area, and evenly dispersed windows provide plenty of light.  A large portrait hangs next to a pale stone arch, and above the arch is an elegant sign.  Tucked into an alcove are some rough stone steps flanked by a gold-bound plaque and a highly polished gold sconce.  Rising through the center of the ceiling is a wrought-iron spiral staircase.  Accessible through an archway to the east is a rope and plank bridge.

title: [Tower of Knowledge, Instruction]
description: A large chandelier hangs from the ceiling, its multicolored droplets casting colorful patterns on a pile of training cauldrons that are stacked in a corner.  A pair of potted ferns sit at the base of some rough stone steps.  A refreshment cart provides a focal point for idle staff and guests.

title: [On the Other Hand]
description: The oaken floorboards of the airship's decks slope sharply, making navigation difficult.  Most of the furniture is in a pile at the hull, except for a few trunks and chests that remain lashed to the bulkheads on either side of a narrow ladder leading below deck.  A large cabinet lies on its side, the doors smashed open, revealing a small cache of weapons inside.

title: [On the Other Hand, Below Deck]
description: Cramped and lit only by one small lantern with dingy glaes panes, the storage area is stacked with crates, boxes, and overturned casks.  Rope hammocks swing from the overhead, no longer beds for the crew, but filled with a variety of arms.  A row of ports on the starboard side are filled with dirt rather than sky due to the angle of the sunken airship.

title: [Cold River, Outskirts]
description: A rickety watch tower looks out over the northern curve of the palisade wall as it disappears into the surrounding woodlands.  Built of old wood and possessed of a decided lean, the construction looks to have seen better days.  With feet firmly dug into the hardpack, a rough-hewn spruce ladder ascends to the nest at the top of the guard post.

title: [Cold River, Watch Post]
description: At the top of a rough-hewn spruce ladder, the nest of the watch post looks out over a sea of white-capped trees.  The timbers of the foundation creak and groan, and the makeshift building sways in the breeze.

title: [Angargreft, Greatchamber]
description: The entrance stands, framed by a pair of colossal red stone pillars, at the apogee of a crescent-shaped walk that curves along the interior of the fane.  Towering gigas statues, male and female, stand with battleaxes in hand in alcoves along either wall.  Their faces are unwelcoming and their postures unmistakably aggressive.  Ruddy stone steps breach the wall to the north, heading precipitously downward into stygian shadow.

title: [Angargreft, Descent]
description: Huge, ruddy stone steps descend into unleavened darkness, framed on either side by high walls of the same rust-colored rock.  Dim light from the fane's entrance illuminates primitive paintings on the distant ceiling, revealing rudimentary scenes of battle and conquest.  The steps are slightly damp and tacky.

title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
description: Pits and pocks mar the sloping face of the fane.  The caustic corrosion has undermined the stability of the snowy garden terrace above, causing a portion to collapse into an unsteady pile of rubble that impedes the pathway's progress to the north.  Cemented by frost, the fallen stones look like they could be climbed, but the way is treacherous.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Compromised by corrosion and great age, the easternmost verge of the tomb's terrace has given way.  The resulting pile of rubble is a treacherous mess of ruddy stone and snowfall, a terrifying jangle of sharp edges and false handholds that has spilled across the niveous grove below.  Wind claws ruthlessly at the remaining intact stone, as if desperate to tear it down as well.

title: [Angargreft, Hanging Gardens]
description: Framed by a pair of majestic runestones heavily inlaid with still-bright copper, some cracked red stone stairs ascend unevenly toward the zenith of the mausoleum.  The steps are each as tall as a man and are spiderwebbed with cracks, as if the center of the stairway was impacted with great force.  Save where they have been washed away with corrosion or erosion, the composite stones are heavily decorated with strange writing.

title: [Angargreft, Berserker's End]
description: Sized for an immense stride, some cracked red stone stairs ascend to the highest reaches of the gargantuan fane, proceeding beneath a series of crumbling arches that are a deeper and more intense red than the rest of the edifice.  Chunks of stairway are missing in places, leaving a teetering array of steps at the very top.  Beyond the stairs spreads a crescent-shaped plaza dotted with banks of fresh-fallen snow.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: Atop a set of vast stone steps, the walkway curves toward the northwest, the path guided by long-spent torches in brackets of rusted iron.  One has been wrenched free from its setting, with a gaping hole in the stone left behind.  Cold gusts of air whistle along the sepulchral halls like a chorus of mourning cries.

title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
description: The western wall is partly consumed by a curtain of stringy goop and much of the stone is pocked and porous.  Its source appears to be a crack in the ceiling.  The rocked edges look to have been devoured by some caustic substance.   Some of the translucent threads cling to the westward edge of vast stone steps climbing toward the edifice's terraced second story.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, The Galley]
description: The back of the galley is dominated by an enormous red brick oven, its center set with a long oily grate above a glowing fire.  A high shelf almost droops beneath the weight of bags of flour, iron pots and pans, and nearly a hundred corked bottles of rum.  A wide worktable is suspended from the ceiling by heavy ropes and its surface is scattered with various meat cleavers, jars of spices, and old stains.  Several crates and iron-banded barrels occupy every corner of the kitchen.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, The Bilge]
description: The deepest pit of the tavern is heavily cramped, with large rocks stacked about that once kept a measure of buoyancy for the ship when it was once at sea.  There is little room for anything else, save for a narrow walkway crossing from the back of the room to the ladder leading up.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Main Deck]
description: The main deck of the tavern looks to be untouched by the elements, but its wooden plank flooring is marred by countless scuff marks.  Guests linger and speak in hushed tones along the wooden railings, while the murmur of voices carries down from the quarterdeck above.  A thick rope ladder hangs on the side of the huge wooden mainmast as lights flicker in the breeze from several tiny lanterns dangling from the ship's netting above.  Two wide wooden stairs frame a tall iron-bound door.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Crow's Nest]
description: The top of the main mast reaches its peak at the crow's nest, which has been crafted to resemble a huge wooden barrel held together by bands of sturdy iron.  From this vantage point more than half of Wehnimer's Landing can be seen, as well as far out onto the waters of Darkstone Bay.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Main Deck]
description: The main deck of the tavern looks to be untouched by the elements, but its wooden plank flooring is marred by countless scuff marks.  Guests linger and speak in hushed tones along the wooden railings, while the murmur of voices carries down from the quarterdeck above.  A thick rope ladder hangs on the side of the huge wooden mainmast as lights flicker in the breeze from several tiny lanterns dangling from the ship's netting above.  Two wide wooden stairs frame a tall iron-bound door.

title: [Rusty Cutlass, Quarterdeck]
description: Two wooden stairs lead up to the expansive quarterdeck that provides a wide view of the deck and forecastle beyond.  A notched ship's wheel juts up from the center, while far behind it several tables and chairs for guests have been positioned about with each wooden leg nailed into the deck.  Several blued steel lanterns hang from a long wooden railing.

title: [Caligae of the Colossus, Deck]
description: Rising from the icy slope of the wood decking, a curving staircase ascends to the forecastle where railings topped with holly-adorned copper lanterns.  High railings, each nearly a solid wall that is designed to prevent falls into the frozen waters beyond, are dotted with round shields protected by thick furs.  Pennants of madder red, gorse yellow, and lapis blue drape from the low roof created by the forecastle deck, the fabric strung between icicles formed across the hempen rope strung from wall to wall.

title: [Forecastle Deck]
description: Stylized flames of burnished teak are inlaid into the decking of the forecastle, the walls covered in layers of fur to shield from the winter winds.  Spindled railings are fitted with copper lanterns, the bright red windows within reflecting the ambient light.  Providing an excellent viewing point from which to admire the length of the boat, the forecastle's view is unobstructed as the sky blue sails of both the fore and aftmast are fully furled.

title: [Courtyard]
description: A series of freestanding arches looms over a wide path of tightly interlocked stones.  The path runs straight and true from the polished silver gates to the north to a stairway that drops off to the south.  Outside the arches crushed red brick covers the ground inside the white limestone walls.  Cacti of different shapes and sizes reside in large earthenware pots, and here and there small stone rabbits sit rigidly still.  A brightly blazing torch extends from the side of each arch.

The path runs straight and true from the polished silver gates to the north to a stairway that drops off to the south.  Outside the arches crushed red brick covers the ground inside the white limestone walls.  Cacti of different shapes and sizes reside in large earthenware pots, and here and there small stone rabbits sit rigidly still.  An unlit torch extends from the side of each arch.

title: [Hub]
description: A placid dark lake extends to the south.  A sheltered island sits in the center of the lake, and a bridge arches over the lake's waters to reach the island.  Well-maintained paths of white stone wind through a stark landscape of crushed volcanic rock and strategically placed volcanic boulders.  Tiny grey lizards peek out from under some of the boulders while others scamper over the rocks in search of an insect meal.  A stairway rises to the north, and a stone building resides to the east.

A placid, crystal blue lake extends to the south.  A sheltered island sits in the center of the lake, and a bridge arches over the lake's waters to reach the island.  Well-maintained paths of white stone wind through a stark landscape of crushed volcanic rock and strategically placed volcanic boulders.  Tiny grey lizards sun themselves on some of the boulders while others scamper over the rocks in search of an insect meal.  A stairway rises to the north, and a stone building resides to the east.

title: [Kraken's Fall, Logging Colony]
description: Built kitty-corner between a sun-crested stockade fence and a railing-guarded cliff, a two-story whitewashed shop sits within a field of shaggy grass.  Large windows of stained glass, comically depicting a colorful halfling baker, rest in the face of the white-washed structure, as does a bright red door that has been left partially open.  Just to the right of the building, a sturdy knotty pine staircase leads to the second story.

title: [Two-Story Shop, Landing]
description: Light reflects off of the polished copper underbelly of the roof's awning, which stretches protectively over the knotty pine landing.  Heading in a straight line to the grassy yard below, a sturdy knotty pine staircase is flanked by brightly illuminated lanterns fitted with bright cobalt blue windows.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Landing]
description: Circular in shape, close-fitting brick forms the walls of the room creating the foundation of the lighthouse proper.  Light from a warped, stained-glass window bathes the space in beams of bright colors.  Set back from the entrance is a polished mahogany desk with bits of shell inlaid along the edges.  A spiraling staircase leads up into the tall building.

title: [Kraken's Fall Hall, Corridor]
description: Wooden panels generously covered in whitewash line the walls of the curved hallway.  Protecting the corridor is a railing of thick cast iron chain links that thread through carved oak supports.  A smooth driftwood door carved with a leaping dolphin is set into the wall near a spiral ascending staircase.  Imbedded with bits of sea glass, a stone archway leads into a shadowed chamber.

title: [Landing Hall, Main Lobby]
description: Footsteps and hushed whispers echo off of the polished black-veined white marble floor, resounding throughout the room and amplified by the massive golden dome overhead.  A huge, polished gold chandelier dangles from the top of the dome from a thick mithril chain, dozens of candles providing ample light.  The sunlight streaming through the fanciful stained glass makes colored patterns upon the floor and the sweeping staircase that leads to the second floor.

title: [Landing Hall, Second Floor]
description: This landing offers a bird's-eye view of the main lobby, a polished gold railing keeping the unwary spectator from plummeting down.  Soft music can be heard from some fancifully-carved grand oak double doors, mixing with the echoes that float up from the lobby.  The walls and floors are bathed in multicolored light, the effects of the stained glass in the dome much more apparent from this vantage.

title: [Solhaven Hall, Larder]
description: Marble counters stretch along two walls, copper cooking utensils littering their surfaces.  Beneath the counters a large circular shelf slowly turns, hiding then revealing an assortment of spice-filled jars, bags of food staples, and canned preserves.  Just above a large basin, rosewood cupboards with etched glass panels display various styles of dinnerware.

title: [Solhaven Hall, The Stumble Inn]
description: Looking more like a lounge than the typical pub, the room is furnished with low divans and thickly cushioned chairs assembled around tables in vague groupings.  Behind a scuffed bar, a mirror reflects the oddly shaped liquor bottles lining the shelves.  Dimly lit by scattered pillar candles, a long mural fills the wall nearest a tiled arch.

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Bed Chamber]
description: Aligned directly across from an invar-framed picture window, an enormous four-poster feather bed is grazed with hints of moonlight that drift in through the wide glass panes.  Suspended from the ceiling, a six-tiered rainbow glaes chandelier casts kaleidoscopic colors across the fiery crimson damask bedding that is piled with satin cushions and thick furs.  Obscured on a far wall, a set of obsidian-inlaid stairs is fixed next to a roll-top carved mahogany desk.

a.location: Emberglaes Hearth, inside the isle town of Kharam-Dzu

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Observatory]
description: Abruptly, the obsidian-inlaid stairs open to a wide-ranging room that has an austere design but is richly outfitted with finely wrought finishings.  Protected on an exceptionally well-lit side, a lustrous smoked glass worktable sits in front of some towering acacia koa bookshelves that are brimming with leather-bound books and study materials.  A gilded staircase leads up to a raised platform, haloed by a sheer, glass-domed cupola that is supported by thin beams of veil iron.

title: [Ranger's Guild, Entrance]
description: Huge and hollow, the inside of the tree is also almost entirely empty.  A simple small table constructed from an old tree stump sits in the center of the trunk.  Spiraling around the inside of the trunk, a narrow staircase leads upwards further than the dim light reaches.

title: [Ranger's Guild, Entryway]
description: Round and spacious, the wide spiral staircase ends at a large wooden landing high inside the tree.  Below, the faint glow of a lantern can be seen only as a small point of light.  Roughly cut openings to the northwest and southwest lead to rope bridges and further into the guild.

title: [Ranger Guild, Library]
description: Numerous small cubbies are carved into the thick walls of the tree.  Scrolls, books, and various other archival records are neatly tucked away, each organized by a general category.  A tall teak bookshelf stands in the center of the room with a variety of artifacts displayed upon it.  A dozen padded chairs are arranged to provide comfortable reading spots.  Opposite a series of small teak desks stands a large iron door.

title: [Ranger Guild, Den]
description: Massive cedar planks stretch wall to wall, covered in places by various tanned hides.  Portals cut into the tree walls, some perhaps old knots, allow light to filter in from outside.  A basalt fireplace and chimney rest in the center of one wall.  A large metal grate rests horizontally across the fireplace, forming a grill for some impromptu cooking.

title: [Bard Guild, Quartz Walk]
description: Aged bronze statues line the quartz-flecked walkway on one side, while towering, glowing toadstools run along the other.  The clamor from the tavern is softened by the embroidered crimson runners and velvet banners that cover some of the stone.

title: [Bard Guild, Hall of Inspiration]
description: Small alcoves run along the golden limestone walls of the hall, each containing replicas of cherished artifacts from bardic history.  A slow, deep hum resonates through the area, originating from beyond a carved granite archway to the south.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Pantry]
description: Crates of supplies are stacked neatly against the back of the pantry.  Several shelves filled with jars, bags and packets hang from the walls.  Sacks of dry goods are neatly arranged on the floor their contents carefully labeled.

title: [Cairnfang Manor, Basement]
description: Numerous crates and barrels of non-perishables are stacked uniformly around the dimly lit basement.  A hard, cooled stone surface lies underfoot, causing any notable sound to reverberate fiercely.  Two sconces adorning the far wall are the lone light sources, flickering in shades of blue and green.  Frequent streams of air waft into the area from the kitchen above, causing the flames to shift and dance as they distribute their magical light.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Entry]
description: Curving down and to the west, marble steps cut through the travertine planters that line the pathway that trails away from Pentas Avenue.  Concentric bands of gold-veined tiles form overlapping knotwork patterns upon the broad expanse, as twinkling lights spill out of blown glass orbs that reside at various places amid succulent plants and white ground-covering pebbles.  Dappling the ground with mottled shadows, starlight filters through nearby cypress trees cooling the area.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Promenade]
description: Travertine pavers, surrounded by brightly colored, elfin creeping thyme, decorate the promenade, which hugs the cliff side and gently slopes downward away from some curved marble steps that lead to the avenue above.  Cypress trees dot the edges amid railings that offer a view of the ocean, while several shops stand opposite one another with open and inviting doorways.  A carved marble bench provides a quiet place for respite.

Cypress trees dot the edges amid railings that offer a view of the ocean, while two shops stand opposite with open and inviting doorways.  A carved marble bench provides a quiet place for respite.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Promenade]
description: Forming crisscrossing patterns in the thick creeping thyme, travertine pavers sinuously wend their away through the promenade and terminate at some curved white marble steps that lead to the tower above.  Splashes of white pink, rose, and lilac blossoms cling to the woolly groundcover, providing colorful interest from cliff face to guardrail before disappearing over the eastern edge.  Severe and utilitarian, a pillar-framed postal exchange house crafted of marble is flanked by a pair of brightly burning lanterns, while window-dotted storefronts dapple the lane.

title: [Isle of Ornath, Agora Entry]
description: Curving down and to the east, marble steps cut through the travertine planters that line the pathway trailing away from Pentas Avenue. title: [Arboreal Afterlife, Storage]
description: Shelves line the right side of the room from floor to ceiling; some are lined with half-opened cards, while others have some sculpted glass vases upon them that hold an assortment of quills and styli.  The wall straight ahead has a mural of colored tiles resembling a waterfall and has been framed with stacks of colored paper and parchments.  A set of stairs that leads to the floor above is against the left corner of the room, while the remaining wall has bouquets of various flowers hanging upside down to dry.

title: [Arboreal Afterlife, Upstairs]
description: The smell of ink and perfumed parchment radiates throughout the area, while a kaleidoscope of various shapes, sizes, and colors of cards is a vivid splash of hues against the otherwise plain and pallid surroundings.  Silken streamers dangle from the ceiling and droop down enough to have cards hang on them at their crease.  Built into the far-right wall is an old oak apothecary cabinet that's been refurbished, its drawers labeled with tiny golden plaques.

title: [Little Things, Storefront]
description: Golden knotwork runners trim the top of the yellow sandstone walls, interspersed with glowing frosted orbs that light up the interior.  Pewter creepers, crafted to resemble olive vines, outline a pair of ivory-handled teak doors, flowing down to the floor and decorating the walls with a variety of jade and onyx olives.  To one side, a set of smooth shelves carved into the yellow sandstone provide a stark contrast to a glass-paned polished oak cabinet pushed up against the far wall.  At the rear of the shop, an iron-wrought spiral staircase ascends to the floor above.

title: [Little Things, Studio]
description: Gold latticework lined with silver rope rings the sandstone walls of the small studio.  Opposite an iron-wrought spiral staircase, a small window opens out over the courtyard letting the salted exterior air mix with the scent of mulberry and jasmine incense.  To the side, a juniper display case with a polished teak counter stands below a small white marble shelf.  A large oil painting, flanked by two brass lanterns, occupies the otherwise barren wall across from the workstation.

title: [House Aspis, Foyer]
description: Panelled in dark, aromatic hardwoods, this arched hallway conveys so well the authority and strength of Wehnimer's most ancient House.  Its marble floor is inlaid with tiles reflecting all the professions and races of Elanthia.  Muted candelabra lend an air of soft stateliness, and twin staircases spiral upwards to the next floor.  In the center of the room, a marble fountain effervesces with the gentle music of dancing water, and beyond it reposes an impressive oil painting of Aspis' founding members.

title: [House Aspis, 2nd Floor Balcony]
description: This balcony overlooks the main entry hall of the house.  It runs along two sides of the building and several doors open off of it.  Twin stairways descend to the main floor and a smaller staircase leads up to the next landing

title: [House Aspis, 2nd Floor Balcony]
description: This balcony overlooks the main entry hall of the house.  It runs along two sides of the building and several doors open off of it.  Twin stairways descend to the main floor and a smaller staircase leads up to the next landing

title: [House Aspis, 3rd Floor Landing]
description: This floor holds the rooms of the House Officers and other senior members.  It is richly panelled in fine woods, and thick woven rugs cover the floor.  A staircase leads down to the lower floors.  A row of multi-paned windows gives light during the day, and a small table holds brass oil lamps and candles for use at night.

title: [House Aspis, Roundhouse]
description: The most striking object in this circular room is the solid glaes column that rises from the center of the room to the ceiling.  It is apparent that this supports some great weight.  Floor-to-ceiling windows allow the light to stream in on the pool that surrounds the column.  Small benches and chairs line the tiled flooring, and a service bar circles the great column.

Floor-to-ceiling windows are awash from the shadowy reflections off the pool that surrounds the column.  Small benches and chairs line the tiled flooring, and a service bar circles the great column.

title: [House Aspis, Observatory]
description: The ceiling of this mystical chamber is a huge open dome of paneled glass.  The walls, also of glass, are covered in leafy vines of climbing ivy.  Centered in the room is a magnificent silver dragon, head held high, with eyes containing unimaginable knowledge.  A closer look shows the beast actually to be a large telescope, aimed directly into the sky.  Nearby is an old wooden table, heaped with astrological charts, scrolls, and other instruments of discovery.
