title: [House Aspis, Pool]
description: Around the glaes column, the cool, refreshing water is deep enough for swimming.  A benched area for the poolside bar rests near the tiled steps for lounging or exiting.

title: [Asylum, Dining Room]
description: The vaulted stone ceiling is decorated with hanging iron chandeliers that cast a soft glow across the room.  A massive dining table covered with a dark cloth dominates the heart of the room with seemingly countless chairs surrounding it.  Uniformed workers come and go from a winding metal staircase that leads down to the kitchen.

title: [Asylum, Kitchen]
description: The large room seems to be in some sort of organized chaos.  Disheveled cooks with dirty aprons bustle about, some putting and some taking things off the wooden island counter in the center of the room.  A service table designated for ready-to-go trays of food sits next to a winding metal staircase that leads upstairs.

title: [Sew Bustled, Dressing Room]
description: Gold-leafed dressers line the east and west walls and carry upon them rose-gold trays filled with morsels to snack upon.  Teardrop crystals dangle from stringed pearls that are draped across the walls, while a large round mirror is placed above the line of gemmed streamers.  A honey-colored teak ladder breaks up the space between rooms, opening to a loft above.

title: [Sew Bustled, Loft]
description: Swathes of fabric are strewn across the room, creating a dizzying meld of colors and patterns.  Tightly wound bolts line the wall behind a worktable and a worn leather armchair.  Short, silk-covered settees are pressed against the chiffon tapestry-covered walls of this workspace, while mannequins representing the sizes of various races are dressed in half-stitched garments on the other side.  There is a square opening in the floor with a honey-colored teak ladder set against it.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Sitting Room]
description: Overhead, a skylight floods the entire room in clear, natural light, illuminating a large wooden table surrounded by a series of mismatched comfortable-looking chairs that runs the gamut of bright colors.  In one corner is a wide rhimar chest, and across the room from it is a large flagstone fireplace.  A low, wide sofa festooned with multicolored pillows is situated in front of the fireplace.

title: [Sunset Cabin, Rooftop]
description: Somewhat shielded from the elements on three sides by the roof of the cabin, this cleverly constructed perch looks out across an expanse of undisturbed snow.  The night sky is brilliantly lit with an innumerable number of bright stars, and a pair of padded wooden chairs are situated to allow both comfortable relaxation and easy access to a small rhimar chest strategically placed between them.

title: [Garden Sanctuary, Reception]
description: Precisely pruned trees of varying heights give a secluded feeling to the otherwise open expanse of short, pale emerald grass.  A simplistic stairway forms a fanning crescent down the side of a modest hill, adjacent to a sculptural stonework buffet and a bronze patina pedestal.  Warm, twinkling lights float amongst the limbs of back-set red maples that provide a fiery accent to the understated landscape.

title: [Garden Sanctuary, Conservatory]
description: A set of curving stairs trails off at a statuesque pavilion with a peaked crown covered in slate shingling.  Three dewy glass walls seclude a silk-cushioned trestle seat, while still allowing a sweeping view of the profuse irises and fruit trees.  Sunken into the ground, a silvery stone water basin faintly glimmers under shifting beams of sunlight.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Petrel Parlor]
description: Open and airy, the large chamber is brightly lit by refracted light from a chandelier above, though faint starlight can be glimpsed through high windows.  An immense carved marble fireplace dominates one pale wall, while the rest are adorned in paintings and tapestries.  Scattered chairs and settees are arranged in small clusters around low tables, while a lacquered tanik sideboard rests discreetly below a curving staircase leading upward.

title: [Illithien Aerie, Conservatory]
description: Warm, moisture-laden air fills this large conservatory.  Countless panes of copper-hued glass framed with white metal arch high overhead, warding off the alpine night.  Night birds silently flit to and fro after prey.  Marble tile pathways lead between raised planter beds, each filled with lush flora and dotted with blooms in gradient hues.  A densely canopied dwarf haon is the focal point, its translucent leaves casting a luminescent halo magnified by a reflection pool beneath its elliptical foliage.

title: [Hailscatter Atelier, Workroom]
description: The spacious work chamber is lit by a number of candles in festive colors, each encompassed by a faceted crystal globe.  The dancing light gleams off of the edges of hay-lined crates full of various materials and pools on the surfaces of silky cushions scattered in a rough semicircle across the floor.  Bright tapestries soften the cold stone of the walls, featuring artistic cavalry scenes and forested splendor.

title: [Shivergale, Landing]
description: Climbing out of the shop below, the airy steel of a spiraling staircase rises to the second story of the structure.  It opens onto a spacious landing shielded from the frigid wind by a sheltering wall that holds boxes of hardy iceblossoms and beds of wintersbite.  Standing guard before an arched double door of darkly stained Ossian pine is an ice crystal statue painstakingly carved to resemble a wide-bodied dog frozen in a vigilant posture.
b.location: Shivergale, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

title: [Solhaven, Dungeon]
description: Throughout the length of the corridor, mold and mildew encrust the granite stone walls of each cell.  Dim torchlight offers little visibility to the area.  The air is cold and damp providing little comfort to the denizens of these cells nor any other in this forsaken place.

title: [Solhaven, Death Row]
description: In this deepest portion of the dungeon, the air is stale and barely breathable.  Huge iron doors of steel lined with krodera bars are set solidly in the stone to prevent any chance of escape from the final confinement.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Gathering]
description: Several leather-covered chairs are placed around a thick, woven reed carpet that is centered in front of a large grey stone fireplace.  Rich, spicy aromas from cooking food drift about the tavern, mixing with the scent of fresh ale.  Dark walls of lacquered wood glisten as the light from several black iron chandeliers illuminate the tavern.  A row of padded stools are lined up in front of a polished driftwood and glaes counter.  A narrow wooden staircase in the back leads up to an open hallway above.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Hallway]
description: Dark wooden paneling lines the walls of the small hallway.  Intricately carved molding lines the ceiling, while the floor is cushioned with a thick, crimson wool carpet that travels from a narrow wooden staircase to a tall oval window.  A small bronze lantern is hung on either side of each door, the pale glow softly illuminating the narrow space.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Gathering]
description: Several leather-covered chairs are placed around a thick, woven reed carpet that is centered in front of a large grey stone fireplace.  Rich, spicy aromas from cooking food drift about the tavern, mixing with the scent of fresh ale.  Dark walls of lacquered wood glisten as the light from several black iron chandeliers illuminate the tavern.  A row of padded stools are lined up in front of a polished driftwood and glaes counter.  A narrow wooden staircase in the back leads up to an open hallway above.

title: [Airmen's Rest, Cellar]
description: Large stands, filled with barrels and casks, line the walls of the clean basement.  Each wooden lid is marked as ale, beer, mead, whiskey, and other types of alcohol.  A smaller rack rests against another wall, its shelves filled with bottles of all shapes, sizes, and colors.  Bins of glassware, and metal and wooden tankards are stacked in the far corner.  A single glaes lantern hangs from a copper hook in the ceiling, its pale light illuminating the cramped, dark area.

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Observatory]
description: A circular table carved from gilt-veined marble dominates the mahogany-planked room, its surface covered with a small scale model of Elanthia and its waterways.  Iron-framed windows flank an antiqued gold telescope, leaving a pair of tall leather-backed chairs to hold back the heavy curtains fashioned of faded pirate flags.  A collection of weaponry is displayed above an unadorned slate fireplace, the mantle stacked with nautical charts and volumes.
a.location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Cormorant's Roost, Chamber]
description: The mosaic-tiled floor of the room creates a map of the western waterways, the various seaports highlighted in metallic ink and scrimshaw ivory, whilst nautical routes are traced in blue-green imflass.  Vellum-sailed boats are scattered across the ground, a few strategically lined to flank a merchant ship far from port, the fleet surrounding the tall mahogany bed that dominates the far wall.  A gilt-framed velvet armchair sits by a ceiling-high window, the seat draped in layers of plush fur.
b.location: Cormorant's Roost, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [The Retreat, Lounge]
description: The ceiling in this room is pitched at a high angle, with the exposed rafters forming the barest framework of a conventional space.  Nestled amongst the shadowy eaves are a series of chandeliers, each one providing enough ambient light by which to see, but not enough to completely dispel the dimness.  The hardwood floors have been polished to a glossy finish, and a massive overstuffed leather chair sits in front of a stacked stone fireplace.
a.location: The Retreat, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [The Retreat, Workroom]
description: A single stone slab forms the floor of this room, though it bears many telltale signs of heavy wear.  An oversized worktable stands against the far wall, scattered with debris of various sorts, and etched into the floor is a nearly perfect circle with faded runes painted around its edges.  Some wide shelves sit off to one side, the wood visibly pitted and charred but held together by large iron braces.
b.location: The Retreat, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Hallway]
description: Carved of alabaster and onyx, a pair of elegant statues flanks a flight of broad mahogany stairs, their arms raised above their head as they hold frosted orbs aloft.  Ochre fleur-de-lis patterns decorate the burgundy rug that covered the floorboards, while matching velvet swatches cover the walls.  Standing opposite the stairs are a set of polished double doors.

title: [Gavelsdown Hall, Entry]
description: Brightly illuminated by polished brass sconces that are evenly spaced upon the crimson and ebon bourde walls, the entry is carpeted with a deep burgundy rug that muffles all sound.  Flanked on the eastern wall by a lacquered ebonwood archway and the western by glass-paned doors, a flight of broad mahogany stairs ascends to the second floor and is decorated with carved balusters.

title: [Quinton Manse, Vestibule]
description: Suspended from a golden chain, an enormous crystal and votive-filled chandelier hangs over a central hug and table, providing ample illumination for the circular vestibule.  Golden linden planks mix with ebonwood to create a striped paneling along the lower half of the surrounding walls, while the tops are covered in painted silk to create a colorful mural.  A flight of mahogany stairs leads to the level above, while a heavy golden linden door is open in the eastern wall and a narrow hallway provides access to a sprawling kitchen.

title: [Quinton Manse, Study]
description: Occupying the entire upper level of the manse, the study is both expansively lit by candles and surrounded in scarf-wrapped polished glass windows that offer ample natural lighting.  Ebonwood bookcases line every bit of the walls that aren't occupied by a window, while dark walnut tables are arranged in the center and surrounded by oiled leather armchairs.  Smaller, more private nooks can be seen to the east and west of a flight of mahogany stairs that lead to the lower level.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Entry]
description: Gilded leaf and vine motifs engulf vivid emerald-colored walls, highlighting the tome-filled cases of lacquered lasimor framing the curved archway from floor to ceiling.  A myriad of framed portraits cover the remaining spaces, briefly illuminated by the blackened iron sconces flickering foxfire green flames before a set of elegant glass doors, the sparks scattering into the air.  An ebony velvet runner leads upward from the jet marble floor toward a set of wide stairs, the railing of metal arabesques flanked by a duo of onyx wrens.

title: [Second Floor, Landing]
description: A wrought iron chandelier hangs from the ceiling above, the half-melted tapers surrounded by a variety of metal cages enclosing stuffed birds glancing down through glass eyes.  Sculptures of chiseled green marble are displayed across from the blackened railing adorned in faenor roses, each decoration veiled in a thin layer of greyish dust.  A square-framed mahogany door stands a short distance from a set of wide stairs, decorated with a burnt velvet runner fringed in silken tassels.

title: [Constabulary, Entry]
description: Large cobbled stones plastered with stucco form the walls of this windowless room, while thick iron bars create a barrier between the common area and that of the detention area.  Rough wooden benches form a loose waiting area in front of a baluster-surrounded counter where moldy and dust-covered papers are stacked in orderly piles.  Stretching along the eastern wall, a set of stairs rises to towards the second floor but sharply turns towards the north as it disappears around a corner.

title: [Constabulary, Upstairs]
description: Folded back to emit the twilight-hued light of the sky beyond, grey shutters are swung away from wide windows and anchored to walls on all four sides of the well-kept room.  Resting upon a tangerine and slate grey braided rug at the center of the room is a broad oak desk.  A cushioned high-back chair rests behind it, while a smoky lantern sits in one corner.

title: [Second Floor, Ascent]
description: A gold-framed painting adorns the top of a decorative golden linden entry, the cityscape painted in muted tones and obscured by thin cobwebs draped along the ceiling and railings of blackened iron like macabre lacework.  To the right of the entry stands a suit of wren-engraved armor forged from pale steel, its arm held aloft, longsword angled at a set of wide stairs covered in dark velvet.  Heavy gouges litter the geometrical floor, the scuff marks distinguished by curls of steel and scorched wood.

title: [Wrencrest Rookery, Landing]
description: Tall shelves are adorned in preserved blooms of rich burgundy flora, the ribbon-tied bouquets interspersed with small trinkets and knickknacks covered in a pale coat of dust.  A myriad of leaf-framed animals and aquatic life are depicted across a pair of carved double doors, the fauna covered in lacerations extending from floor to ceiling, stained with splatters of an unknown black substance.  Twin newels of iron twist to form spherical cages on either side of the wide stairs, each pillar entrapping a glass-eyed wren.

title: [Fate's Holding, Barrow Summit]
description: Providing a view of the spiraled pathway that encircles the barrow, a hillock top has a steep trail leading down its side to the distant gates of the neighborhood.  Clanking chimes decorate the tops of crooked sticks that rest within short barrier walls that connect shallow cairns to one another across the flat plain.  Disappearing into darkness, a spindled copper-bound ladder offers access to the interior of the barrow where the faint flicker of torchlight is visible.

title: [Fate's Barrow]
description: Dank and dark, the cavern smells of loam, dirt, and something unidentifiable but sweet.  Root tendrils dangle from above, their spidery fingers casting shadows on the ground due to the flickering of the three torches positioned around a spindled copper-bound ladder.  Framed in ebonwood, widowwood, and driftwood, an ancient story wall displays colorful painted panels of a time gone by.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Hallway]
description: A ticking longcase clock sits between a pair of closed doors in the middle of a short corridor leading northeast to a grand staircase.  Opposite the doors, a bronze-framed oil painting hangs above a heavy mahogany desk, a thick leather-bound tome lying open on it.  A rolling cart supplied with fresh towels and folded blankets is parked to one side of the hallway, while a maidservant pauses to dust a marble gargoyle sculpture.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Basement]
description: At the bottom of a steep staircase, wall-mounted lanterns cast shadows onto floor-to-ceiling shelves overflowing with unclaimed luggage, the moldering leather cases spilling their contents onto hard packed dirt underfoot.  The dark corners of the substructure are piled with a menagerie of forgotten possessions, a saddle trimmed with tarnished silver on top of one heap.  A path has been cleared through the jumbled maze, but only wide enough to sidle through.

title: [Third Floor, West]
description: Rope-strung mirrors lay in graduated lengths on either side of the curving archway, casting distorted images by the faint glow of an avian-shaped iron lantern, its flame-lit eyes flickering in the ambient breeze.  A silk-woven partition partially conceals a narrow wooden door and ladder, the screen hung with a variety of household tools left in disarray.  Small wire-formed cages encircle the spiraled wrought iron staircase, the enclosures piled with dusty feathers that spill across the rug-covered floor.

title: [Gable of the Finch]
description: The slanted ceiling of the chamber is covered with a variety of drawings, the image of a wren transcribed over and over in different mediums and styles, its diminutive body violently slashed by a sharp object.  An unadorned desk and matching bed sit untouched by the wrought iron staircase, both surfaces covered in sheets of parchment with the same wren, obscured by dust and grime.  A coil of frayed rope lays beneath a wobbly wooden chair, the ends entangled between the marred legs.

title: [Third Floor, West]
description: Rope-strung mirrors lay in graduated lengths on either side of the curving archway, casting distorted images by the faint glow of an avian-shaped iron lantern, its flame-lit eyes flickering in the ambient breeze.  A silk-woven partition partially conceals a narrow wooden door and ladder, the screen hung with a variety of household tools left in disarray.  Small wire-formed cages encircle the spiraled wrought iron staircase, the enclosures piled with dusty feathers that spill across the rug-covered floor.

title: [Gable of the Grackle]
description: A dark-painted plague of grackles covers the slanted ceiling of the narrow room, their shadowed bodies illuminated by a small caged lantern hanging above a simple blanket-adorned bed.  The weathered floor boards are partially concealed by scattered pieces of clothing, the tattered shreds slipping beneath the loose planks like an open maw, its edges stained rust red.  A cotton-stuffed grackle sits perched above a wrought iron ladder, appearing to gaze over the bed with its glass eyes.

title: [Third Floor, East]
description: The emerald-colored walls peel across the scratch marks on either side of a pine-framed curving archway, the haphazard slashes continuing along the narrow wooden door blending into the lasimor framework of the enclosure.  Stone-hewn nests adorn the railings of the wrought iron staircase, the marble cradles filled with ivoried bones fused with dark cloisonne.  A spiral wrought iron ladder leans across a parchment-filled wall, the anatomical sketchings highlighted in vivid scarlet ink.

title: [Gable of the Rook]
description: Tiny origami rooks seemingly float across the low ceiling of the room, their onyx paper wings pierced by thin iron hooks hung on brittle wire, and the paper avians are linked by cobwebs and dust.  An ebonwood-framed bed sits beside a wrought iron ladder, the bare mattress devoid of sheets and ornamentation and the narrow headboard snapped in half.  Flush against the high side wall is a marred writing desk, its surface penetrated by tapered blades bent at unnatural angles.

title: [Third Floor, East]
description: The emerald-colored walls peel across the scratch marks on either side of a pine-framed curving archway, the haphazard slashes continuing along the narrow wooden door blending into the lasimor framework of the enclosure.  Stone-hewn nests adorn the railings of the wrought iron staircase, the marble cradles filled with ivoried bones fused with dark cloisonne.  A spiral wrought iron ladder leans across a parchment-filled wall, the anatomical sketchings highlighted in vivid scarlet ink.

title: [Gable of the Wren]
description: Gilt-foiled wrens soar across the shredded emerald-colored ceiling, their diminutive bodies visible between the dozens of wind chimes strung from the iron staircase to the back wall, with the hollow tones of metal and wood echoing in the small chamber.  A pillow-covered bed sits nestled below a long ebonwood shelf, the ledge perched with a single hollow-eyed doll, its arms broken off and sitting upon the woolen blanket.  A faint glow of crimson emanates from beneath the wooden bed, pulsating slightly.

title: [Town Hall, Entry]
description: Surrounded by tarnished silver, oval, rectangular, and square mirrors dominate the faded green-on-silver wallpaper that lines the walls of the entry.  Wooden benches arranged upon the inner walls wobble at random intervals, as if something is sitting or rising from them though no one is present.  To either side of the entry, wrought iron hooks house cloaks and capes in various colors, though the number seems to shift and change without warning.

To either side of the entry, wrought iron hooks house cloaks and capes in various colors, though the number seems to shift and change without warning.

title: [Town Hall, Hallway]
description: Shadows pool upon the landing, causing the eastern and western passages to be shrouded in darkness.  Doorways fashioned of clotted spiderwebs make it impossible to progress further in any direction that isn't down a balustered ebonwood staircase.

title: [Goblin King Dolls, Foyer]
description: Chipped, pale pink, raised panels enclose this entrance hall with sliding doors closing off the two side rooms to the east and west.  Sideboards have been pressed up against the mold-coated walls around a round center table, each surface holding various dolls.  A wide set of stairs leads up to a small landing where a single door sits.  Broken, unadorned dolls hang from miniature nooses from the railings.

title: [Goblin King Dolls, Landing]
description: Shattered porcelain litters the floor, and the wood frame, walls, and flooring around the door are blackened with a mix of soot and mold.  The layout of this upstairs landing has been mostly walled off.  There are no windows, hallways, or other doors here.  Shelves staggered, hung across the eastern wall, are home to more dolls.

title: [Masqued Intentions, Entry]
description: Pallets made of wood are arranged in an orderly fashion against an opposite wall, illuminated by the dim light coming in through a window that has been fogged over.  Barren walls and broken furniture show signs of wear and neglect, with several pieces in multiple stages of disrepair.  Several porcelain masks are strung from some luxurious black silk ribbon affixed to an oak beam erected into the ceiling, while a small stone stairwell leads down to a basement below.

title: [Masqued Intentions, Basement]
description: Blackened stone walls slick with moisture line the area, while a precariously hung lantern casts shadows throughout.  Broken bits of furniture and decorations lay strewn like obstacles as water drips steadily in one corner of the room.  A thick onyx table stands near the back wall with a silver-handled obsidian dagger resting on it while a single post of scorched ironwood stands upright alongside it.

title: [The Other Daughter, Ingress]
description: Candles lit with flickering light overwhelm the majority of the floor space and sit in sconces and niches set along the wall, often with nary a scrap of space between each taper.  The flames regularly splutter out, victims of an ever-present chilly draft, but quickly spring back to life, as if the mausoleum's four stately coffins are unable to bear lingering for too long in darkness.  Barely visible in the warm illumination, hints of a violet glow suffuse thin fissures along the walls.

title: [The Other Daughter, Entry Vault]
description: Dark stone walls are infested along multitudinous cracks with a bright violet luminescence, its glow so vibrant as to faintly illuminate the majority of the dank, damp space.  Dripping down from the decrepit ceiling and oozing across the floor, viscous fluids and goo intermingle with scattered, nondescript bones, broken glass, and, in one corner, a collection of oversized rat's nests.  In the midst of it all, four candle-topped coffins offer a neatly laid out selection of curious oddities.

title: [The Other Daughter, Entry Vault]
description: Dark stone walls are infested along multitudinous cracks with a bright violet luminescence, its glow so vibrant as to faintly illuminate the majority of the dank, damp space.  Dripping down from the decrepit ceiling and oozing across the floor, viscous fluids and goo intermingle with scattered, nondescript bones, broken glass, and, in one corner, a collection of oversized rat's nests.  In the midst of it all, four candle-topped coffins offer a neatly laid out selection of curious oddities.

title: [The Other Daughter, East Crypt]
description: The air is moist, its scent so strongly laden with loam and decay that it practically tastes of it.  Formed from the halves of two broken altars, four stone benches are angled in toward each other to face a rocking chair that sits at the dead center of the octagonal chamber.  Beneath it, the makings of a ritual circle and its associated runes sprawl outward in imperfect symmetry before abruptly terminating just shy of the violet phosphorescence-riddled walls, each of which houses a tomb in its earthen embrace.

title: [Ironmonger's Smithy, Salon]
[Ironmonger's Smith, Salon]
description: Walnut bookshelves fill every wall making this narrow shop with a low ceiling a bit claustrophobic.  Though carpeted, the floor creaks and groans with every step.  Between two of the bookcases, a side door opens out to an open-air scrapyard.  A little more exploration reveals an almost hidden set of stairs that leads up to another space above.  A large casement window offers a view of the street outside next to the salon's threshold.

title: [Ironmonger's Smithy, Office]
[Ironmonger's Smith, Office]
description: This windowless office is cloaked in shadow except for a bright candle on a chest-high desk in the center of the room.  Illuminated by the golden flame, a nearby stand lays bare the interior of a thick tome.  Barely discernible cabinets stand around the desk, their presence hinted at by the flicker of the candle's flame.  A shadow of the desk wavers on the carpeted floor from the dancing candlelight.  Almost invisible in the darkness, a set of stairs offers a way down.

title: [Fiendish Phantomes, Athenaeum]
description: Massive open space has been hollowed out into the core of this tree, creating an interior pavilion with multiple arched outlets that peer deeper, through the tree's branches.  Carved into the oak walls of this dome are floor-to-ceiling bookshelves trimmed with faenor metalwork, each one depicting different vegetation.  The worn floor is covered in omnifarious parchments and half-torn books that are blanketed with dust and webbing.

title: [Fiendish Phantomes, Study]
description: Stacks of thick books tower thirteen feet up and surround an armless, high back wing chair that has been placed perfectly centered within a blood-drawn pentagram.  High above, draped across the tome peaks, are tattered flyrsilk curtains that envelop the area in sheer waves of fabric.

title: [A. B. Witching, Tinkering]
description: Though subterranean, the chamber has been decorated to conceal that fact, with two walls lined with floor-to-ceiling witchwood bookcases, while the others are covered with a deep forest green wallpaper lined with thin stripes of metallic bronze.  Sconces are mounted meticulously at regular intervals between the lines, set with ivory candles that glow with viridian-sparked golden flames.  A narrow glass-shelved rack, with a witchwood humidor on the top shelf, stands beside a set of steep stairs leading downward.

title: [A. B. Witching, Workshop]
description: An immense crescent worktable sits centered on the back wall, with a swiveling cushioned barstool nestled in its cradle, allowing access to the full span of the work surface.  Almost an entire wall is covered by a large parchment illustration of a variety of plants, herbs, and fruits.  Hand-scribbled notes line its surface, some faded with age, others so fresh that the wet ink glimmers in the lamp light.  A few wine red damask-cushioned wingback chairs are arranged about in the remaining space.

title: [Pierced Veil, First Floor]
description: Acicular crystal formations pierce through the mahogany planks of the repurposed house, their facets glinting from the pulsing glow emanating from a dusty, orb-capped chandelier.  A barbed wrought iron stand casts spiked shadows softened by the gentle, rhythmic illumination.  Barely concealing a narrow staircase, devore velvet curtains patterned in monochromatic florals echo the profusion of black star calla lilies framing the glass display case set to one side.

title: [Pierced Veil, Second Floor]
description: The stairs lead up to a spacious room with a pair of splintered doors on the western wall.  Tattered shreds of gossamer drape from the edges of the ceiling, brokenly veiling tilted paintings and a full-length mirror tucked into one corner.  In the center of the room, open manacles hang from the armrests and footrest of a reclined leather chair.  Scattered around a mahogany console table, piles of dusty velvet cushions provide an alternative to the questionable seating.

title: [The Minaret, Ground Floor]
description: The ground floor of the minaret is packed earth, nearly frozen solid even within the thick walls.  A dusty cushion sits half askew at the base of a stone spiral staircase, the steep curve of which disappears upwards into a distant darkness.  Someone has left a bulky ceramic jug and a few lumpy pottery cups to lie in a dusty pile.

title: [The Minaret, Up the Spire]
description: Only a bit of light seeps in from above and below to illuminate the sharp curve of the spiral staircase.  It wends its way upwards and downwards in the minaret, its risers and treads carved from the tower's stone itself.  There is no handrail.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Hidden Room]
description: Thick cobwebs with a cache of moths, flies, and beetles wrapped in their silky strands stretch across a tightly spiraled staircase.  At the foot of the stairs, a curtain has been pulled partway across a darkly stained mahogany panel, its edges illuminated with warm, glowing light from behind.  A spider dangles from a wax-covered candelabra set atop a high-wrought walnut newel post.

title: [Evermore Hotel, Widow's Walk]
description: A spiraled staircase is visible beneath a trapdoor that opens onto a wooden rooftop platform enclosed by a black iron balustrade.  Offering a bird's-eye view of the grounds below, the lookout surrounds a massive stone chimney, a line of sand-filled buckets, and scum-topped rain barrels nearby.  A sleek ebony raven perches on a railing-mounted brass telescope.

title: [Armaments of the Destroyer]
description: Cold radiates from the stone floor, leaving the air of the keep damp and uninviting.  Spiraling stairs hug the outer wall, offering passage to the floor above, while a pair of heavy wooden double doors provides egress to the street beyond.  Several armor stands are arranged along the curve of the room, faded pennants and tapestries hanging above them and fluttering in an unfelt breeze.

title: [Armaments, Second Floor]
description: Arrow-slit windows allow the twilight colors of the sky to paint the southern stones in shades of amber, violet, and cerulean, while a large cobblestone fireplace brands the room in orange, red, and yellow hues.  Despite the warmth of the fire, the air is still damp and laced with a pervading chill.  Positioned between the spiraling stairs and a copper and oak ladder, several armaments are arranged upon statuesque stands, each depicting warriors in combat poses.

title: [Armaments, Second Floor]
description: Arrow-slit windows allow the twilight colors of the sky to paint the southern stones in shades of amber, violet, and cerulean, while a large cobblestone fireplace brands the room in orange, red, and yellow hues.  Despite the warmth of the fire, the air is still damp and laced with a pervading chill.  Positioned between the spiraling stairs and a copper and oak ladder, several armaments are arranged upon statuesque stands, each depicting warriors in combat poses.

title: [Armaments, Third Floor]
description: Overlapping square rugs of durable, if utilitarian, wool cover most of the wooden floor, while ensconced torches dominate the walls and stain the ceiling with soot.  Thick iron hooks, sturdy wooden pegs, and heavy wrought iron racks rest beneath the light sources, each laden with armor and armaments.  Descending to the floor below, a copper and oak ladder disappears through a small hatch along the western wall.

title: [Deserted Farmhouse, Entry]
description: The cramped interior of the farmhouse is made less navigable by an overturned table blocking the way into a ransacked kitchen.  Despite the cold, the smells of spoilage and rot commingle into a revolting melange that hangs on the air like a rancid oil slick.  Some rickety wooden stairs climb past the wreckage, guarded by an unwieldy looking bannister as they ascend to the house's second story.

title: [Deserted Farmhouse, Upstairs]
description: Smashed pottery litters the upstairs landing of the small farmhouse, the low ceiling of which leaves the raw timber eaves crowding down upon the passage.  What remains of a rug cushions the hardwood floor in places, but exposure to the elements has left it a threadbare ruin.  The air is cold, and occasional breezes solicit rusty creaks from a rounded wooden door at the end of the hall.

title: [The Snowcat's Den, Common Room]
description: Guarded by a long counter of dark-stained pine, the common room's bar boasts an impressive array of spirits in pristine bottles that come in all of the colors of the rainbow.  Several leather-upholstered stools sit along the counter's outer edge.  A half wall behind the bar provides a glimpse of the inn's kitchen and its hearths, above which game birds and other meats roast on wooden spits.  Nearby, a carved white pine stairway ascends to the second story.

title: [The Snowcat's Den, Landing]
description: Looking down upon the common room of the inn, the landing is framed by a raw pine bannister scored with stylized claw marks.  Mounted on the walls are trophies of past hunts, ranging from an elk head to the scaled blue wings of a reptilian beast, each as wide as a man is tall.  Two doors, one of spruce and one of honey oak, break the trophy wall.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Passage]
description: The smoky, torchlit passage splits to either side of a grand staircase of grey stone and deep crimson bloodwood that ascends grandiosely to the second story of the keep.  There, upper banisters fly banners in scarlet and grey.  A framed archway to the northwest reveals glimpses of long shelves crowded with old tomes, while a mirroring path to the northeast dovetails into a spectacular gallery hung with a dazzling selection of artworks.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Upper Hallway]
description: A stone and bloodwood staircase climbs to the second story of the keep, the natural beauty of its ruddy wooden inlay complemented by the grey-trimmed scarlet runners at its center.  Beeswax candles stand in arched nooks along the tenebrous stone walls, illuminating a trio of hallways leading to the castle's living spaces.  The shortest path, to the north, is softened by a dark red carpet with bright golden tassels.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Pantry]
description: Little separates the pantry from the kitchens beyond a stone half-wall that is lined with containers of dried spices and burlap bags full of salt and flour.  Wheels of cheese, the size of a small child, sit atop blocky tables, and cured legs of meat swing from the arched ceiling.  Several barrels of mead and wine sit in one corner, but they are dusty with disuse.  Behind one barrel, a stairwell descends into the floor.

title: [Moonsedge Castle, Larder]
description: Intense cold embitters the air of the expansive larder, a basement dug into the earth beneath the castle and surrounded by imposing walls of black rock.  The carcasses hanging from the low ceiling are still but untouched by rot, the subterranean frigidity helping keep decay at bay.  One corpse looks to have been bipedal.  Several barrels of brined fish in one corner lend a salty aroma that keeps the air sharply fresh.

title: [Consortium, Exchange Hall]
description: Dark wooden posts support the high ceiling of the exchange hall, which houses several wooden tables and chairs, many arranged in circles to offer plenty of space to allow conversations and trade to occur.  Heavy brocade curtains are pulled back along each wall to provide just enough light to seep in through a collection of large glass windows.  The wooden floor has lost its polish and is now marred by countless scuff marks from boots.

title: [Consortium, Envoy Post]
description: Ornamental monir pillars line the room on each side, framing a spacious carved stone table surrounded by wrought iron chairs.  Partitioned from the main meeting space, nooks of opulent ivory leather booths face an immense pane of glass that looks out on the exchange hall below.  Tall ferns and potted greenery loom over blue cushioned couches, their foliage providing a secluded place to relax.  Positioned against a statement wall of brushed muted copper is a tessellated mistwood credenza.

title: [Consortium, West Hall]
description: Dark-paneled walls encompass the length of this hallway, with its floor a stretch of burnished grey wood.  Modwir-framed portraits are staggered along one wall, each one depicting the face of several founders.  A polished statue of a red marble lion is perched at the side of a wide staircase leading up.

title: [Consortium, Founder's Hall]
description: Wide-paneled windows provide an expansive view of West Ring Road and the palisade walls of Wehnimer's Landing, with the trees of the Dragonsclaw forest rising in the distance.  Plush deep blue carpet runs the length of the floor and ends before a small step that leads to a tall modwir door.

title: [Consortium, East Hall]
description: Dark-paneled walls rise up along a smooth floor of burnished grey wood.  Light from the atrium shines in through a row of high arched windows, which cast a warm glow along several fel-framed paintings along one wall.  A polished statue of a red marble lion stands to the side of a wide staircase leading up.

title: [Consortium, Silver Gallery]
description: Plush deep blue carpet runs along the floor of the hallway, and several potted plants rest along the width.  Ornate silver sconces are set into the dark-paneled walls, their light mixed with the sunlight from wide window and brightening the area.  An oversized painting of Darkstone Bay hangs near a wide mahogany archway, from which the sound of revelry and clanking glasses echoes.

title: [Guardian Keep, Grand Audience]
description: Blazing on high, a domed ceiling of stained glass is imbued with swirls of golden and crimson that form the lithe musculature of a spread-winged wyvern staring down upon the audience chamber.  Marble pillars, limned in fiery shades by the creature's span, foist vibrant scarlet banners bordered in washes of golden brocade.  Below, a vanguard of armored statues stands to either side of a thick red velvet carpet scaling the mass of a golden stair.

title: [The Jolly Chimera, Deck]
description: A large chimera statue stands sentinel over the houseboat, its cheerfully painted figure brightening the entire polished teak deck.  A twining leaf-painted door leads into the deck-level cabin, while a brushed steel ladder leads deeper into the interior.  Ocean droplets on leaves and petals glint in the sunlight washing over the numerous healing herbs and potted plants that ring the deck and cabin, and several different arkati icons are carved into the outer rail's posts.

A large chimera statue stands sentinel over the houseboat, its cheerfully painted figure looming over the night-shadowed deck.  A twining leaf-painted door leads into the deck-level cabin, while a brushed steel ladder leads deeper into the interior.  Ocean droplets on leaves and petals glint in the starlight shining upon the numerous healing herbs and potted plants that ring the deck and cabin, and several different arkati icons are carved into the outer rail's posts.

title: [The Jolly Chimera, Cleric]
description: Several cots line the room beneath detailed murals of various ship battles with body-strewn decks.  Each mural depicts a dwarven cleric walking cheerfully through the carnage.  The floors are scuffed and splattered with crimson stains, which are only partially obscured by various potted herbs.  A dusty cabinet is filled with chrism gems, white flasks, and obscure paraphernalia.

title: [Oteska's Den, Entry]
description: Wood made from repurposed ships' hulls lines the floors and walls of this small entryway, all polished to a rich sheen.  The variety of woods and hues is broken by an iron-worked rich maoral door leading back to the shop, and a spiral staircase winding up.  Hanging between a pair of crossed cutlasses is a brass plaque, and an unusually neat pile of netted glass floats is carefully arranged in one corner, each globe dimly lit from the inside to illuminate the area.
a.location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Oteska's Den, Main Cabin]
description: Cozy and with a theme best described as pirate meets eccentric, the walls of the main living area are covered with a collection of maps and charts with a dart board positioned carefully between them and above a cupboard.  Several leather chairs arranged in a loose semi-circle around the fireplace rest on a rug woven to resemble a treasure map.  Sunlight streams through a large, bullseye window over a curtain-covered arch, brightening the area and bathing a spiral staircase in its warm rays.
b.location: Oteska's Den, inside the island town of River's Rest

title: [Vornavis, Gate of the Tradesmen]
description: Known colloquially as the Tradesmen's Gates, a wide stone structure juts out from the copper-faced doors that interrupt the tall Vornavis-Solhaven wall.  Cobbled stairs to the south and north ascend to the bustling warehouse district of the imperial city, where refracted light bounces off of lanterns that are strung up on the avenue below.  Fuchsia-footed wandering sailor, a local ivy, climbs the walls, finding purchase in the ancient mortar between the stacked stone blocks.

Known colloquially as the Tradesmen's Gates, a wide stone structure juts out from the copper-faced doors that interrupt the tall Vornavis-Solhaven wall.  Cobbled stairs to the south and north ascend to the bustling warehouse district of the imperial city, where pinpoints of lantern light glow from where they are strung up on the avenue below.  Fuchsia-footed wandering sailor, a local ivy, climbs the walls, finding purchase in the ancient mortar between the stacked stone blocks.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Arcing to follow the curve of the Vornavian cliffs, the granite wall becomes shorter as the distance between the two cities expands due to the natural formations.  Short terraces dot the cliff face, each incredibly narrow and overflowing with vibrant apple blossom clematis, the dark leaves and vines of which dangle down to touch the cobblestone lane.  Northward, the storehouses and customs buildings give way to a wide road and smaller buildings surrounded by paddocks.

title: [Vornavis, Vestibule]
description: Large and circular, the grand vestibule has a domed ceiling and an enormous crystal chandelier anchored to three points in the sandstone walls.  Wall-hugging stairs form an arch over a pair of large fel doors, a banded brown wicket discreetly tucked in the shadows of the eastern staircase, while a double-wide green feldspar archway on the northern wall offers a view of an enormous dining hall.  Emerald green and ivory tiles form a decorative tile mosaic in the circular floor.

title: [Vornavis, Gallery]
description: Surrounded by tapestry covered walls, the gallery's landing is comprised of a clean, polished wood floor and sparse furnishings.  Emerald green runners line the way, each spreading from the wall-hugging stairs and disappearing into the wings in the northeast and southeast.  An aerial view of the vestibule is beyond a set of fel railings, while ornate pillars and a short wall provide a stone-framed view of the Great Hall below.

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: Just beyond the end of a towering blue stone arch, the stone and dirt path dead-ends into a blood-red stone wall.  Though the surface of the rocky rise is replete with crags, so too is it slicked with the downpour and the foliage of exotic plants that sprout from the multitudinous crannies.

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: A precarious ledge juts out from the middle of the rock wall, lending access to deep niches carved out of the stone.  Winks of gold and other metallic hues flash from the darkness of several of the holds.  A single such recess might be the work of nature, but the even procession of them suggests that they must be the work of skilled beings.  Above, the rock wall is smoother and lends little purchase for climbing.  In some places it appears smooth as blown glass.

title: [Safe Harbor, Bunks]
description: A quartet of simple beds are set up along the walls of the sleeping area, each bed neatly made with green blankets and a single pillow.  A woven low-slung hammock hangs between a discolored wooden wardrobe and a large overhead beam.  Along the back of the room a pair of clothing racks frame an elaborate gold and brass mirror mounted on the wall.  A rusted iron rung ladder leads to a hatch in the roof.

title: [Safe Harbor, Rooftop Sanctuary]
description: The rooftop of the building is lined with a series of barrel planters, each sprouting a vibrant pink display of seaside daisies.  Residing under a waxed sailcloth awning is a mosaic glass Niima statue, her eyes looking out over Solhaven Bay.  A polished brass ship's lantern rests on the driftwood plinth beneath the statue, its surface polished and smoothed by the touch of countless hands.  A battered driftwood hatch leads back inside the building.

title: [Hall of Justice, Hallway]
description: Ivory-weighted banners of pavonated silk are suspended high above the silver-gilt staircase, the muted fabric embroidered in peahens framed by arabesque-beaded plumage.  A duo of heavy-handled doors stand below the curved ascent, each haon-crafted panel flanked by an armored member of the Sapphire Guard standing still above the cool stone floor.  The sounds of footsteps echo throughout the hall, followed by the muffled sounds of whispers from behind the chamber beyond.

title: [Observation Room]
description: Haon-framed chairs of burnt plum velvet are arranged before the silver-washed railing, their brush-shaped legs resting against the marbled ivory floor.  Heavy curtains are draped across the ceiling-high windows, obscuring the light through layers of lilac-on-aubergine brocade, the fabric pooling below a lacquered heartwood table affixed in the far corner.  A spherical silver lantern emanates a soft glow across the table's surface, providing a faint modicum of light.

title: [Vornavis, Inner Garden]
description: Incongruously, the eastern section of the garden is dappled in a thin layer of snow that allows blossoms to grow despite the subtropical climate.  Creating the illusion of a forest glade, pale yellow mosses reside beneath towering silver fir trees that elegantly hide the militaristic nature of the castle walls, while geometric hedges descend along the southern slope.  A narrow set of stairs ascends to the protective walls, while a small banded door leads into the keep and keeps company with a row of narrow whorled-glass windows.

title: [Vornavis, Castle Wall]
description: Protecting the inner courtyards of the baron's castle, the wall is crafted of sandstone and slate blocks.  Below the crenellations, a paved yard stretches to an outer wall, while to the inside lies a well-manicured garden subdivided by a snowblossom-bordered walkway.  A narrow set of stairs descends from the top of the wall to the garden, where a small door provides entry to the castle.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Landing]
description: Surrounded by shaggy broom sedge and feathery nassella grass, a yawning portal cuts into the very bedrock of the cliff face and is surrounded by cultivated black basket wythe.  Several wide, grey stone slabs form steps that lead to the deep, turquoise-blue waters of a crescent-shaped beach of pristine white sands, while the sun-bleached planks of narrow boardwalks stretch east and west through the sheltering grass.  A copper-banded barrel is tucked against a sheer stone wall, with a sign reading "Keep Our Neighborhood Clean" tacked to it.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Set to a backdrop of blue-green grass with feathery beige tops, the white-sand beach is serene.  Starlight reflects off the flecks of mica within the fine white sands, causing it to sparkle and shimmer as gentle tidal breezes cool the air and carry the tang of salt to the area.  Flanked by thin trails and sandy paths that slip through the encircling dunes, a pair of stone slab steps departs from the beach and connects with a flat stone landing with a wythe-encircled entrance in the distant cliff face.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Sharing Garden]
description: Encircled by a picket fence, the public garden is arranged in steppes that are irrigated by fresh water pumped into the area by a complicated bamboo system that disappears up the incline to the higher steps.  Box planters are teeming with vegetation upon each of the grassy layers and are surrounded by seagrass baskets of harvested fruit, free for the taking.  A series of stone slab steps descends to the beach through a break in the fencing.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Sheltered from the rollicking surf by the curve of the land, the small inlet is bisected by a freshwater riverlet that slips out of the surrounding dunes on its voyage toward the ocean.  The soft sands of the shallows are pockmarked with tiny holes where hidden clams rest, the gently lapping waters filling them in with each passage.  A series of stone slab steps provides access to a public plateau garden that grows upon the flat surface of a small outcropping.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, West Bonfire]
description: Resembling a manicured lawn, the outcropping is sheltered by the cliffs of Kraken's Fall on the west and encircled by a white picket fence on the north and east.  An octagonal picnic table and a driftwood bench are scattered about the area, while an open-air kitchen is built directly against the cliff face.  A large blazing bonfire surrounded by stones and sand is the focal point of the plain, while a rickety sun-faded staircase leads to the beach below.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Beach]
description: Small and large tidepools decorate the western edge of the beach, where a rickety sun-faded staircase attaches to the cliff face and leads to a grassy plain.  Soft sands are covered with shallow water, the small inlet protected from the encroaching surf by large boulders that jut out of the turquoise waters.  To the east, the surf carries bits of seaweed and empty mermaid's purses across the mica-flecked sands, while a twisted grass-flanked pathway heads to a distant boardwalk.

title: [House Aspis, Lower Storeroom]
description: Well-stocked racks and shelves fill this room.  It is cool and dry, the perfect environment for supplies destined to last a long time.  Inventory lists dating back several decades hang from the walls, and a narrow stair leads down in one corner.

title: [House Aspis, Wine Cellar]
description: This is a long narrow space under the foundations of the house.  It is cooler than the rooms above and rather a bit damper.  Long rows of dust covered bottles sit on wooden racks along one wall.  Casks of ale, mead, brandy and other liquid delights squat along the other wall awaiting their call to duty in the lounges and rooms abovestairs. Beads of moisture collect along fissures in the walls and an occasional drip echoes faintly through the still air.

title: [The Onyx-Petaled Taerethil]
description: Ceiling-high windows are draped in a fall of onyx-petaled taerethil, the blooms arcing over the curved lattices framing the faenor-chained chandelier at the center of the shop.  A gilded cabinet of ebony stands behind an elongated glass-paneled counter, the surface encasing rows of pastries labeled with vellum placards and placed upon leaf-framed platters.  Nestled in the back corner is a nacre velvet curtain, partially concealing a spiraled flora-wrought staircase entwined with thin vines.

title: [Onyx-Petaled Taerethil, Rooftop]
description: Trellises of latticed ebony provide the framework for a series of domed enclosures scattered across the pebbled garden, the stones creating a pale walkway through the lawn.  Lacquered lengths of rope suspend vivid faerthiel interspersed by sailor's knots, the tiny lanterns dancing like fireflies along with the ambient breezes off the nearby waters.  The faint echoes of music reverberate throughout the area, the instruments occasionally accompanied by a passing choir of impromptu performers.

title: [Zul Logoth, Switchbacks]
description: The cavern ends here at a glistening rocky wall.  Carved into the dark stone, a series of wide switchback steps winds upwards, wet from water that trickles down from above.  Small patches of deep red algae can be seen on the surface of some of the surrounding rocks, but they do not quite thrive in the cool, mineral scented air.  Darkness obscures what lies to the north.

title: [Zul Logoth, Cavern Entry]
description: This cave is small, with air that is slightly musty.  Lichen clings to the walls to the southwest, a hint of what lies further in that direction.  Tiny streams flow north out of the cave and down a series of steps just outside an opening in the north wall.  Dark and quiet, save for the sound of the streams and the occasional drip of water, it smells of earth, mold, and slate.

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a herringbone woven bamboo mat edged by a plaited band of natural sea grass rush.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a copious amount of bamboo barstools featuring plush rattan-backed seats flanked by a thatch-roofed tropical bamboo bar surrounded by a plethora of vibrant flora.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, a modest cocobolo writing desk and cocobolo bench rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the open door.

title: [Bungalow, Loft]
description: Stretching from one end of the space to the other, exposed rafters support the peaked ceiling and are strung with several luminescent crystalline orbs dangling from opalescent vaalin wire.  A white-washed wooden canopy bed draped with pristine netting rests against the flat northern wall where a decorative carving hangs over its headboard and a large wooden footlocker rests against its footboard.  Spindled balusters support a small railing that overlooks the room below, a nearby ladder providing egress.

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a simple throw rug.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a wide couch flanked by a sturdy end table.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, an exquisite fly-tying workbench and a soft dog bed rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the open door.
a.location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Loft]
description: Stretching from one end of the space to the other, exposed rafters support the peaked ceiling and are strung with dried herbs and flowers.  A carved wooden bed rests against the flat northern wall where a diminutive handcarved elf-owl nesting box hangs over its headboard and a large wooden footlocker rests against its footboard.  Spindled balusters support a small railing that overlooks the room below, a nearby ladder providing egress.
b.location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a simple throw rug.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a golden teakwood sofa covered in marshmallow-hued pillows flanked by a sturdy end table.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, a plain oak desk and wooden chair rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the open door.
a.location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Loft]
description: Stretching from one end of the space to the other, exposed rafters support the peaked ceiling and are strung with dried herbs and flowers.  A carved wooden bed rests against the flat northern wall where a decorative carving hangs over its headboard and a large wooden footlocker rests against its footboard.  Spindled balusters support a small railing that overlooks the room below, a nearby ladder providing egress.
b.location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Giant's Ridge, Juncture]
description: Impeding further travel to the east is a wall of tremendous boulders, a barricade to the immense summit that imposes a foreboding shadow over an already darkened trail.  Freshly cut limbs and branches rest in an orderly pile beneath a covered stand filled with a variety of pruning tools and other miscellaneous items.  Just beyond a wide crevice in the ground, a rock-spattered ledge clings to the mountain face and wends back and forth toward a moderate clearing set back from the trail's sharp edge.

title: [Giant's Ridge, Rocky Ledge]
description: With barely enough space to take a deep breath, this thin ledge, which continues across the mountain face and hangs on the precipice of tragedy, supports travelers as they precariously shuffle from one side to the other.  An up close and personal view of the mountain face shows unnoticed or perhaps forgotten details about the aged granite.  The trail appears safely reachable with a fairly effortless leap, but the trek to the south appears a bit more grueling, especially given the weather conditions.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Krag Tunnel]
description: While somewhat protected from the harsh conditions outside, this tunnel has dangers of its own that necessitate heedfulness.  Resting at the base of an arduous rise is a pile of aged bones, a collective grave that remains largely untouched save the addition of recent casualties.

title: [Thunder Plateau, Vista]
description: Imposing crags and rock faces dominate the western segment of the plateau, but are far less treacherous than the perpetual lightning strikes that befall the higher elevations.  Extending nearly ten feet from the eastern edge is a narrow rocky shelf that stretches over a gaping cavity of the plateau.  Blending with the current sounds of wind, rain, and thunder is the unmistakable roar of a waterfall from somewhere far below.  A sharp descent leads into a smoky tunnel.

title: [Titan's Crown, Rocky Ascent]
description: At the top of a steep scree declivity, unstable rock gives way to immovable stone.  What was a steep climb now becomes a vertical one.  Mercifully, disguised within the shadow of a tall outcropping, some crude steps have been carved into the mountain.  They zig and zag as they lead the way up, moving closer to falls as they rise, until finally reaching the east bank of the waterfall's crest.

title: [Titan's Deluge, East Bank]
description: Stretching over the water from the fall's west bank, a massive stone bridge seamlessly connects to a narrow strip of craggy rocks that broadens into a wider patch of land further down the lake shore.  Almost entirely unnoticeable, a series of crude steps carved into the mountain's face has been cleverly hidden behind a rough outcropping of stone near where the water spills over the edge and plummets below.

title: [Cuddfan Hollow, Yard]
description: Potted plants create an organic fence that almost completely hides the various tents and wagons of the surrounding caravansary, though the prolific growth is arranged to keep the back side of a gaily painted bright yellow wagon and nearby dark alley visible at all times.  Long picnic tables rest along the northeastern section of the yard, their wide oak benches covered in thick cushions, while a large blazing bonfire surrounded by a large stone slab sits in the center.  Off to one side, a mesh-covered rain barrel sits beside a wrought iron rack filled with tinder and kindling.
a.location: Cuddfan Hollow, inside the Northern Caravansary on the outskirts of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Cuddfan Hollow, Rooftop]
description: Guarded by a low, copper pole railing, the platform perches upon the top of the wagon and has a panoramic view of the entire caravansary.  Large, water-resistant cushions are clustered along the western end, supported by a low wall of decorative white birch, while the eastern edge has a polished copper ladder leading to the yard below.  A small painted table shares space at the center of the rooftop with a wrought iron and brass telescope.
b.location: Cuddfan Hollow, inside the Northern Caravansary on the outskirts of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Oleander House, Entry]
description: Smooth sage green walls encircle the small entry, which is illuminated by frosted orbs hung in the four corners.  Rows of scrollwork wrought iron hooks hang about six feet off the ground, providing storage space for outerwear garments, while below them is a small painted wooden chest designed to house shoes.  A coarse mat of bristles and river reeds rests upon the slate tiles and is positioned before a solid modwir door, while a wall-hugging staircase leads to the second floor.
a.location: Oleander House, inside the city of Vornavis Proper

title: [Oleander House, Hallway]
description: Occupying a large section of the hallway, a cherrywood curio with glass doors displays various pieces of collected bric-a-brac and keeps them safe from prying fingers.  Standing opposite one another, a painted blue door leads to the guest room, while the double-wide doors lead to the master bedroom.  An ocean-themed, circular rug dominates the landing, its glossy mahogany planks easily transitioning into a wall-hugging maoral staircase that leads to the floor below.
b.location: Oleander House, inside the city of Vornavis Proper

title: [Strings And Things, Showroom]
description: Several frosted crystal orbs are suspended from wooden hooks that have been fixed into the walls.  A small copper-bound chest is placed on one side of the opening, while a woven frond basket rests on the other.  The air is cool, with an earthy scent filling the spacious area.  Soft carpets of woven moss cover the ground under a small white oak table.  A carved spiral staircase leads higher into the tree.

title: [Strings And Things, Showroom]
description: Built to fit the interior of the tree, the room is circular in shape, with the staircase leading back downstairs in the center.  Several shelves have been cut into the walls of the shop.  Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale light streams in from a small opening above.

title: [Strings And Things, Showroom]
description: Built to fit the interior of the tree, the room is circular in shape, with the staircase leading back downstairs in the center.  Several shelves have been cut into the walls of the shop.  Soft, verdant moss grows on the floor, giving the feel of rich carpeting.  Pale light streams in from a small opening above.

title: [Strings And Things, Workroom]
description: Perched between a trio of thick canopy branches, a small platform surrounded by flowering vines creates an intimate gathering space.  Several pillow-like piles of moss serve as cushioned seats.  A small table piled with various tools stands off to one side.

title: [Titan's Triumph, Hall of Glory]
description: Brilliantly lit by torches hung in sconces along the walls, the hallway has a vaulting ceiling painted with aged frescos of victorious combat.  It proceeds toward a great portcullis of ironwood reinforced with black and gold vultite.  From beyond, the roar of the arena calls.  Alcoves spaced along the walls hold suits of polished armor, though one arched opening in the western wall houses a broad flight of marble steps ascending to the stands.

title: [Titan's Triumph, Stands]
description: Stands comprising tiered seats and steps of carved stone encircle the colosseum floor, providing an excellent view of the battles down below.  Bold banners, black and scarlet with a golden tower wreathed in flames on each, are held aloft by poles along the uppermost tier.  Marble steps descend back down to the lower reaches of the colosseum.

title: [The Fang, Antechamber]
description: Emerald flames spit and hiss from a cavernous hearth that takes the form of a serpent with its maw open.  The snake's sickle-like fangs are black silhouettes against the inferno within, which heats the antechamber to an uncomfortable degree.  Scintillating green cinders drift on the air currents, pirouetting past banners and an aged tapestry portraying a man with a scaled face and a serpentine shadow.  A winding green stone staircase coils sinuously toward the upper story of the temple.

title: [The Fang, Sinuous Hall]
description: Atop a winding green stone staircase stretches a long hallway that proceeds past the staring eyes of countless snakes carved onto the dark walls in bas-relief.  The serpents span a variety of shapes and sorts, but each has eyes of emerald that seem to glint with viridian flames from within.  Undulating to the left and right as it winds southward, the walkway passes by the statue of a scaled man clad in luxuriant robes.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Foyer]
description: A crystal chandelier hangs over the foyer of the manse, casting shards of light over a silver seal set into the pale marble floor.  The leaping mule etched into the metal is repeated in relief on the front doors, which are framed with windows that look out onto a snowy walk.  Opposite the entry, a grand staircase with banisters twined in fir garlands sweeps up to the second story.  Hallways branch to the west and east, proceeding beneath trefoil arches accented with ornately carved maplewood.

title: [Dabbings Manor, Upper Hall]
description: A dark pine staircase spirals up toward the upper story of the manse, its banisters twined with fir garlands that perfume the air.  A long runner patterned with prancing mules in blue and white proceeds down the main hall of the manse's upper story, which branches off into lesser hallways leading to family and servant quarters.  The bordering railing offers a view of a spectacular chandelier fashioned in the shapes of hundreds of icicles, glittering and glowing with the light of dozens of votive candles.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Foyer]
description: A branch-pierced dome of murky glass shadows the fur and dust-covered floor of the spacious foyer, the ceiling's design obscured by caked leaves, the contorted wires framing the split staircase leading up into the mansion.  Broken ivory busts are set on rotting mahogany pedestals, the artwork displayed along the walls that open to the hallway, the elongated passageway bisecting the stairs above.  Set into the marble are scraps of twisted metal, the pieces extending out towards the various pathways.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Upstairs]
description: Tall, mold-riddled columns encircle the vast second floor, the mahogany pillars separating the numerous hallways and doors radiating from the cloth-covered object at the center of the carpeted floor. Oilcloth covers the rectangular frames affixed to the peeling walls, the pieces covered in overgrown weeds. A detritus-scattered pile of metal is nestled along a far corner, propped against a broken bench beside the iron-railed staircase.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Hallway]
description: A dull carpet of frayed wool and silk covers the expanse of the open hallway, the cobweb-ridden walls interspersed with cloth-covered portraits and unlit brass sconces.  Set against the periphery are narrow wooden tables cluttered with piles of paper and knickknacks coated in mottled layers of dirt, the surfaces placed between the arch and door at the end of the elongated room.  Draped along walls are heavy velvet curtains, the silken ropes left in tangles slithering across the floor.

title: [Tanglemist Mansion, Workroom]
description: Half-finished automatons frame the dusty corners of the workshop, their hulking frames suspended by thick, twisted lengths of rope.  Scrawled notes engulf the parchments covering the brocaded walls, the scrolls unfurling down onto the tool-filled workbench, the clutter threatening to tip over the glass lanterns nestled near the edge.  Hooked curtains of oil-stained cloth obscures the stairway, the length bound by iron chains, the same metal forged into a short gate leading towards the twisting hallway.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Canopied Walk]
description: Multiple pieces of stitched-together linens cover the area and drape down to the boardwalk's edges, forming a dim tunnel of planks, pillars, and cloth.  Through a few pinned-back sections of this linen canopy, the night sky is visible.  Small, rug-covered squares line the tunnel, offering additional space for market stalls.  This tunnel gives way to an open boardwalk with a wooden fountain at its center, surrounded by several cloth pillows and a series of lanterns.

Multiple pieces of colorful, stitched-together linen cover the area and drape down to the boardwalk's edges, which paints this area in a soft, multihued glow during the day.  Small, rug-covered squares mark the path forward and offer additional space for market stalls.  These stalls give way to an open boardwalk with a wooden fountain at its center, surrounded by several cloth pillows and a series of lanterns.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Aside the Walk]
description: The sand alongside the boardwalk is cool and flecked with bits of washed ashore seaweed and organic material.  Many pieces of colorful, stitched-together linens drape down over the boardwalk's edges and reach nearly to the sand.  These linens billow in the breeze and are backlit by lights from above.  Fronting these vibrant pieces of cloth and lit by stout candles, a long and battered driftwood table has been placed.

title: [The White Wyrm, Main Deck]
description: Toward the fore of the ship, the main deck widens.  Crates and supplies are stacked along the bulkheads, secured to them by hooks and sturdy hempen ropes, save around the base of a pale metal ladder that leads to the upper deck.  They leave sufficient space to access crew quarters through a narrow archway in the eastern wall.  Heavily reinforced with golvern, a riveted imflass hatch leads toward the ship's bridge.

title: [The White Wyrm, Upper Deck]
description: Vast propeller assemblies sprout from the upper deck, crafted from the same pale golvern as its rails and plated hull.  Interspersed between them are a series of cannons wrought from the same metal.  Shot racks lining the decks are laden with solid iron cannonballs.  The racks, like the hoarbeam deck underfoot, are heavily etched with dimly glowing runes.  A pale metal ladder leads to the lower deck.

title: [Lighthouse, Ground Floor]
description: A small fetish of scrimshawed bones and shark teeth hangs from the lintel of the lighthouse's entry arch.  Relentless ocean winds whistle through gaps between the rounded stones making up the edifice's walls.  Though sparsely furnished, the antechamber is occupied by a winding stone stairway that curves toward the upper story.

title: [Lighthouse, Upper Floor]
description: Icy winds whip through the upper chamber of the lighthouse, making the flame burning at its center dance drunkenly.  The smoky glass panes of the windows encircling the chamber permit a dazzling view of the landscape in every direction, from the dark waters of the Frostmain to the rugged landscape further inland.  Fingers of frost glisten from the windows' edges.

title: [The Trove, Buyouts]
description: Short steps separate the intimate chamber from the looming majesty of the adjoining hall.  A dazzling collection of moldering relics and strangely glowing magical items occupies a series of reinforced ebony cases along the far wall, neatly catalogued and evenly spaced.  Specimens marked for immediate sale occupy velvet-clad tables spaced in a semicircle.   Between the cases, an archway houses a winding basalt staircase that winds up to a small outdoor patio atop the building.

title: [The Trove, Patio]
description: Frigid wind scours the rooftop patio, shivering the branches of a pair of dwarf pines clad in spiraling strands of fine silver chain.  The low wall surrounding the space offers a panoramic view of Fortune Plaza's sprawl below, with its brightly colored tents, stalls, and wagons.  Near the northeastern corner of the patio, a winding basalt staircase descends into the auction house.

title: [The Crimson House, Clerk]
description: A stately bloodwood and ebony desk bars further passage into the manse, its surface a study in organized chaos.  Scrolls and ledgers form ordered piles, some so high that they look as if they must totter, and inkwells full of crimson fluid sit in precise rows along one edge.  The desk is positioned to watch the arched doors of a nearby office, over which a single stylized droplet is etched into the lintel.  Stairs ascend to a raised hallway overlooking the lower story.

title: [The Crimson House, Hall]
description: Dark red banners sway overhead, the velvet fabric gleaming faintly in the light of torches lining the huge hallway.  A high, vaulted ceiling of raw black timbers lends a cavernous quality to the space, turning the whispers and footsteps of passing guild members into distant echoes.  A crimson runner travels past dark copper statues of robed krolvin holding spheres, tomes, and daggers aloft.  Stairs descend to the lower story.

title: [Nereid's Cradle, Aside the Walk]
description: Moving away from the boardwalk is a series of dark and crisscrossing sand-blown trails snaking between slick boulders and large pieces of weathered driftwood.  Amid this collection of debris, a gnarled and weather-stripped tree with twisting branches towers over the multitude of thin trails.  Before the gnarled tree, on a dark patch of cleared dirt, rests both a wide wooden bench and a metal lantern atop a driftwood pillar.  In the distance, the calls of birds and other wildlife mingle with the sound of waves.

title: [Salty's Services, Exterior]
description: A promenade off of some wide sand-stuck stairs leads up from the distant beach and opens on a metal-patched driftwood warehouse.  Before the warehouse is a boardwalk-style through-way that is mostly empty.  Occasional fishers, gaudily dressed merchants, or townsfolk pass.  Adjacent to the warehouse, a small and seaweed-lined shack is built and lit by torches lining its walls.  pposite and across the promenade from the shack, a distressed hovel leans against the warehouse.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Docks]
description: Steps carved from white travertine create a transitional space between the sprawling dock system and the rocky shoreline.  A weathered wooden sign directs visitors to the harbor master's shed nearby.  The shed itself is a quaint structure with a red-tiled roof and an ornate iron lantern hanging by the door.  Nearby, a small crate filled with fishing nets and tools is arranged as if the pieces have been placed out to dry.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Docks]
description: Flanked by stark white travertine pillars, charcoal grey planks form a walkway along the shoreline as they connect a sprawling pier system to the mainland.  Tide pools filled with colorful sea anemones and small fish dot the area, providing a glimpse into the vibrant underwater world.  Crowning nearby cliffs, a pageantry of verdant greenery sways in the seaside breeze.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Sanctuary]
description: Creating a haze of silver, starlight filters through the open ceiling above, painting the sanctuary in a dim glow that causes the unornamented marble walls to seem ethereal.  Heady fragrances fill the air at the heart of the space, their source the large, flower-filled urns placed around an alabaster altar that sits upon a raised dais.  Enormous ironwood doors painted in a wash of moss green flank the exit, each piece carved with a silver scythe.

title: [Tholos of Silence, Crypt]
description: Despite the lack of airflow, the underground chamber is humid but much cooler than the rooms above.  Marble walls and floors are polished to a high, reflective sheen, allowing the scant handful of shielded lanterns to keep the space in a twilight-like glow.  Hundreds of niches decorate the walls, each filled with large and small urns surrounded by simple offerings of dried flowers, candles, or incense.  A long white bench rests at the center of the chamber, and a set of wall-hugging stone steps provide egress.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, White Beach]
description: White sands curve gracefully along the grotto's edge, where rough oak steps lead down to clusters of oyster beds and shimmering tidal pools that mirror turquoise waters.
