In these shallow pools, tiny marine life flits among patches of seaweed, while a long driftwood table nearby displays assorted wares designed to house pearls.

title: [Wavesong Grotto, Oyster Pools]
description: Rough oak steps lead upward from glistening kidney-shaped tidal pools to a stretch of white sand, their surfaces weathered by salt and time.  Amid the pools and dunes, a copper-bound rough oak barrel stands beside a shucking oyster harvester, its form worn yet unmistakably functional.  Shallow waters mirror the sky, capturing fleeting images of drifting marine life along the rugged shore.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Tier 2]
description: Curving around the atrium, the second floor frames the grand circulation desk below, its presence marked by a tile mosaic in teal, white, and canary yellow.  Towering bookcases stretch toward the vaulted ceiling, their warm wood tones complementing white wrought iron railings.  Lanterns perch atop the posts, casting dappled light across the floor.  Above, staircases spiral toward the next level, their curves forming a clover arch over a quiet reading alcove nestled beneath its embrace.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Tier 3]
description: Rising to teal-painted walls and a white stucco dome, this floor curves beneath a vast skylight, its iron framework supporting beveled glass panes that flood the space with sunlight.  Clover-shaped arches frame the upper level, their carved edges accentuating the graceful design while providing reading nooks amid the towering bookcases.  Railings trace the perimeter in intricate, ivy-like patterns, while twin staircases of dark-burled camphor descend in sweeping curves, leading to the level below.

title: [Mercy's Reprieve, Great Room]
description: Most of the space in the room's center is taken up by numerous long tables, each of which is furnished with wooden benches.  A massive grated fireplace runs along the southern wall on one side of the room.  Nearby a small pile of wood sits neatly stacked, ready to be used with several bins lined up alongside each other.  The exterior wall is lined with several enormous, stained-glass windows, which contrasts against the cream-colored walls, while a heavy wooden door rests under a wooden stairway leading upstairs.

title: [Mercy's Reprieve, Bedroom]
description: The bedroom is lined with multiple bunk beds, each of which is separated by a large window that only has one pane.  Under each window, a small end table sits, adorned with various mementos.  At the opposite end of the room, next to the door that leads into the washroom, there is a large mirror propped up on the floor.  A small iron-banded chest and a wooden chair are placed at the foot of each bed.  A long, faded blue carpet runs the room's length.

title: [The Contempt, Orlop Deck]
description: In the orlop deck's dim undercroft, coils of salt-crusted line lie heaped in silent disorder along planks stained with sludge.  They tangle about the bases of a collection of crates and tuns of spirits sealed with old, dry wax.  The air of the hold is close and smells sweetly of rot.  Sounds of splashing water and groans of distressed wood climb a ladder leading down to the hold.

title: [The Contempt, Hold]
description: Far from the open air and the activity of the other decks, the hold is dark and echoes with a symphony of creaking timbers and dripping water.  Though a skim of water lingers over the swollen planks of the deck, most of the cargo, a collection of crates, barrels, and foot lockers in a variety of makes, remains dry and secured by lengths of line.  A single sea lamp swings from a rusted iron chain overhead, throwing fitful light over the cavernous space.

title: [The Contempt, Main Deck]
description: Beneath the main mast, a disintegrating hatch of iron with edges swollen by rust yawns into the hold below.  The deck before it is worn smooth by the passage of many feet over countless years.  Its greying planks and the steps leading down to the hold are weakened in places by splotches of black rot.  Air from below wafts up in cold gusts, laden with the perfume of lamp oil and a less pleasant sweetness of old decay.

title: [The Contempt, Crow's Nest]
description: Atop the main mast, a circular wooden crow's nest sways in the ocean breeze, its timbers held together by the feeble efforts of rusting nails and splintered planks.  Frayed lines dangle from the masthead, their fibers stiff and tacky from decades of disuse.  They sway in the wind like ragged pennants, but are overshadowed by the ship's flag, which is embroidered with a scarlet siren on faded black cloth.

title: [The Contempt, Aft]
description: Beneath the thundering canvas of the mizzenmast, the quarterdeck rises imperiously toward the ship's blunt stern.  Mirrored sets of stairs ascend to the raised deck, leaving space for a black wooden hatch heavily reinforced with dark steel allowing entry to the cabin beneath.  Several barrels sit nearby in various states of disrepair, the golden frame of a compass atop one standing out against the dark wood.

title: [The Contempt, Quarterdeck]
description: High above the cluttered expanse of the main deck, the quarterdeck unfolds beneath the ragged sails of the mizzenmast.  The ship's wheel is black and timeworn, metal banding around its spokes more verdigris than bronze.  Nearby, a binnacle stands slightly askew, its compass face clouded and unreadable.  Patches of rust and peeling paint mar every surface, lending the once-proud post a tatterdemalion cast.

title: [Singing Crags, Base]
description: The last verges of the jungle yield to cragged stone as the path approaches a wall of severe blood-black stone that rises toward the high hills at the island's heart.  Vines snake thickly over the rugged surfaces of the rocks, dotted with little white blossoms that are far less numerous than the barbed black thorns spiraling down their lengths.  Moss shelters in the depths of cracks and crevices, seeking solace from scouring winds that awaken a subtle, melodic hum from the rock face.

title: [Singing Crags, Rocky Ascent]
description: Jagged rocks descend sharply toward a green path a staggering drop below, their surfaces etched into strange patterns by wind and driving rain.  Sparse vegetation struggles between cracks, manifesting as spiky grasses sprouting from a shallow crevice or hardy shrubs along the cliff's edge.  The roots of the latter protrude defiantly from the rock face, gripping tenuously to stony hollows.  Soft breezes whisper through narrow fissures in the rock, filling the air with strange, moaning music.

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: The jungle's swaying banyans and strangler figs stand away from the base of a towering pinnacle as if in deference.  Black and foreboding, the spire of rock stretches skyward like a crooked talon, its tip lost in swirling mists.  Though the stone wall at its base is replete with crags to serve as handholds and footholds, it is slicked with mist and rain, and the exotic vines clinging to it are as likely to snap treacherously as to provide purchase.

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: A precarious ledge juts out from the middle of the stone wall just over an arm's breadth away from deep niches in the black stone.  Winks of gold and other precious metals flash from the darkness of several of the crevices.  A single such recess might be the work of nature, but the even procession of them suggests the use of tools.  Above, the cliff face is smooth, offering little purchase for climbing beyond a few slick handholds.  In some places it appears smooth as volcanic glass.

title: [Talon Isle, Rock Wall]
description: A precarious ledge juts out from the middle of the stone wall just over an arm's breadth away from deep niches in the black stone.  Winks of gold and other precious metals flash from the darkness of several of the crevices.  A single such recess might be the work of nature, but the even procession of them suggests the use of tools.  Above, the cliff face is smooth, offering little purchase for climbing beyond a few slick handholds.  In some places it appears smooth as volcanic glass.

title: [Talon Isle, The Sea's Bargain]
description: Winds scream about the peak of the rock talon that gives the island its name, tossing the stubborn grasses crowning the summit's small plateau.  An ornate seaglass altar stands forgotten, its base tangled with flowering vines, and atop it, held aloft by a twist of seaglass, is a clear glass orb that pulses with stormglow.  Ragged veils of swirling mist whirl around the summit, snagging on black crags and tracing patterns over the greenery.  They occlude all but the vaguest view of the island and the sea beyond.

title: [Spicers' Sea, Penumbra]
description: The path ends at the base of a colossal disc of peculiar blue stone that looms overhead as a great black shadow.  Within its darkness, the air is cruelly cold and smells faintly of burning ozone.  The monument's stony construction is pocked from years beneath the wave where it is not crowded by an overgrowth of coral in a chaotic rainbow of colors.  Along unsullied surfaces, there are hints of ancient carvings that bleed a pale glow that brings to mind a sky tossed by storms.

title: [Seat of Storms, Base]
description: Seawater cascades down from the huge disc on all sides, feeding an overgrowth of multicolored coral that scales the base of the structure.  Along the immense supporting column of blue stone, there are places where dying coral has fallen away, revealing stone undamaged by the gnawing of the sea.  Carvings taller than a giant depict figures overlooking seas churned by storms, and they bleed sickly greenish stormglow that casts the surroundings in a sallow pall.

title: [Seat of Storms, Base]
description: Seawater cascades down from the huge disc on all sides, feeding an overgrowth of multicolored coral that scales the base of the structure.  Along the immense supporting column of blue stone, there are places where dying coral has fallen away, revealing stone undamaged by the gnawing of the sea.  Carvings taller than a giant depict figures overlooking seas churned by storms, and they bleed sickly greenish stormglow that casts the surroundings in a sallow pall.

title: [Seat of Storms, Base]
description: Worn away by the powerful rush of draining seawater, a yawning sinkhole in the stone lets cold starlight glimmer across the damp surface of the girthy support column beneath the sprawling disc of variegated blue stone.  Its rugged edges offer purchases necessary to scale the distance to the surface of the disc.  Bordered by towering barriers of fathomless ocean held back by invisible forces, the perch offers improbable glimpses of sealife surging and darting through the depths.

Worn away by the powerful rush of draining seawater, a yawning sinkhole in the stone sends harsh sunlight skittering down the damp surface of the girthy support column beneath the sprawling disc of variegated blue stone.  Its rugged edges offer purchases necessary to scale the distance to the surface of the disc.  Bordered by towering barriers of fathomless ocean held back by invisible forces, the perch offers improbable glimpses of sealife surging and darting through the depths.

title: [Seawind Haven, Promenade]
description: Curving gently around the side of a turquoise villa, a cobblestone walkway disappears behind the building.  Clusters of hibiscus and bougainvillea bloom along the edges, their striking colors spilling over low hedges.  A papaya tree rises above a sturdy knotty pine staircase leading up to an elevated cottage, its tall trunk laden with ripe fruit.  Ferns and broad-leafed palms line a crushed seashell path as it weaves through the tropical foliage.

title: [Sunlit Sanctuary, Landing]
description: Light reflects off of the polished copper underbelly of the roof's awning, that stretches protectively over a planked walnut door on the knotty pine landing.  Heading in a straight line to the grassy yard below, a sturdy knotty pine staircase is flanked by brightly illuminated lanterns fitted with radiant cobalt blue windows.
b.location: Sunlit Sanctuary, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Epilogue, Chamber]
description: Wood-framed maps, their once vibrant ink aged beneath the panes of glass, hang between paintings of local flora and wildlife that dot the stone-stacked walls of the stone cottage.  Two half-circles of worn leather couches enclose an intaglio-carved table in the center of the room, the seating opening up to a trophy-adorned fireplace rising to the ceiling.  Crystalline decanters and glasses rest upon a wheeled steel cart nestled in a back corner.
a.location: Epilogue, inside the dwarven caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Epilogue, Bedroom]
description: The domed ceiling of the room has been painted with an expansive map of Elanthia, the cities inlaid with burnished eahnor, while the bodies of water reflect their shards of vivid sapphire.  A circular bed of lacquered mahogany lays beneath the cartographic design, illuminated by a pierced golden lantern casting scattered patterns of light across the wood-planked floor.  Haphazard piles of books lay stacked upon leather-bound trunks nestled to either side of a carved stone staircase.
b.location: Epilogue, inside the dwarven caverns of Zul Logoth

title: [Dragonfly Den, Retreat]
description: Surprisingly roomy for being inside a hollowed-out tree trunk, a swaying rope bridge leading from the retreat to the limestone cliff at the far opposite of the spiraling stairway lets in a soft breeze.  An over-stuffed sofa and complementing chair with ottoman are placed around a highly polished tanik table sitting low and holding some refreshments.  Resting on a square of dark terra cotta tile, a small black iron brazier glows steadily, the bright coals sending out a welcome warmth.  Decorations are minimal, allowing the patterns of the sapwood grain to stand out.
a.location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Canopy Deck]
description: Almost at the top of the canopy and breaking past the reach of most surrounding trees, much of the vast skyline opens up and affords glimpses over the surrounding montane.  A smooth handcarved bench outfitted with a thick seat cushion and several small pillows provide a comfortable setting to sit and gaze.  Winking glints of light flash as viewing angles capture sight of obscured lakes or meandering rivers through the forest.
b.location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Chamber]
description: A wide, open-ended sleeping niche has been carved out of the limestone cliff, providing an expansive view just below the canopy of trees, as the uppermost reaches begin to thin out.  More sunlight is present here, adding both warmth and light.  In addition to an oak bed with an over-stuffed mattress piled with a thick zaffre blue quilt and matching fat pillows, an oak side table and dresser set off to one side complete the furnishings.  Steel doors suspended on rails are etched with flitting dragonflies filled with bright enamel in jewel-tone hues.
a.location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Dragonfly Den, Rainfall]
description: Redwood planks with slight gaps form a solid deck over the limestone ledge, atop which sits an outdoor relaxation bath.  A heavy chain attached to a metal pipe jutting out from the cave wall hovers over a holding tank leading to a punched steel disk suspended at one end of the bathing vessel.  Giant tanik trees surround the outdoor setting, creating a privacy screen, admitting beams of moonlight.  The scented air of the forest and rushing waterfall nearby contribute a relaxing vibration while one reclines neck-deep in hot water.
b.location: Dragonfly Den, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [New Heights]
description: Inside this small ger, several mannequins are scattered haphazardly about amongst a littered floor covered by dead leaves, nut husks, and shriveled berries of various sorts.  Criss-crossed lattices of birch, pine, and rowan make up the khana, which is covered by a thick layer of felting and held in place by large bands of leather.  A wide loft, accessible via a narrow ladder, hangs above the mannequin's heads, blocking their view of the roof ring.

title: [New Heights, Loft]
description: Situated within a human's height of the roof ring, this platform is all but empty.  A hammock swings gently overhead, hanging from the rafters to just within a halfling's reach.  The only other decoration is a small lantern that sits near the ladder.

title: [Halan Lea, Well of the Elders]
description: Perched atop a small hillock, an expansive bright white felt ger girded in bright blue and red bands rests on an elevated wooden platform that forms a wide patio encircling the fabric-wrapped structure.  Beneath the platform, shale and shard rock spread in uneven patches where limestone saxifrage grows in dense clusters, its pale blooms and glossy leaves creating a living carpet across the stones.  Extending outward from the large domicile, a line of colorful pennants trails down the slope, each cloth snapping lightly in the breeze, while at the edges of the hillock is a cluster of smooth stones.

title: [Shore of Khesta 'Dahl]
description: Riverstones in shades of grey, cream, and muted rose blanket the shoreline of Khesta 'Dahl, their rounded shapes glimmering as the water laps over them.  Tufts of lake sedge and cattails that cluster near the shallows, their narrow blades rising in loose fans where the ground dips toward the waves.  To the east, the dark forest presses close to the waterline, while a small hillock that rises to the south is traversable by a set of alternating larch and birch steps.  Mist from the lake drifts inland in thin, cooling sheets.

title: [Chalet Cairnfang, Lounge]
description: Great beams of darkened fel rise high averhead toward a vaulted ceiling, the dusky wood contrasting against pale plaster walls, many of which are lined in bookshelves, curios, and a single, inconspicuous door.  Within the lounge's heart, several stuffed leather chairs are arranged in a semi-circle near a wide limestone fireplace, with a low carved linden table resting between them.  Warm sunlight streams in through a wide bay window, illuminating the cozy room while offering a striking view of the valley.

title: [Chalet Cairnfang, Wine Cellar]
description: A chill in the air belies the chamber's depth beneath the chalet.  Surrounded by gently sloping granite walls, each carved with a relief giving the impression of stacked stone blocks, the wine cellar bears several vibrant cherrywood wine shelves set nearly floor to ceiling.  Soft golden light from a trio of pewter lanterns overhead illuminates a long rosewood counter resting against the far wall, where a locker rests on the polished surface beneath a carved golden linden mirror.

title: [House Arcane, Foyer]
description: This small vestibule is the terminus to the rest of the House.  The spiral staircase is made of the same darkly finished hardwood with which the room is panelled; the steps themselves are covered by a soft, forest green carpet which cushions your steps as you pass through the room.  Paintings lining the walls treat your eyes to colorful renditions of ancient heroes and their quests while smells of whiskey, spices and wood mingle in your nostrils.

title: [House Arcane, Landing]
description: Standing at the top of the spiral staircase, you can look down the long hallway leading to the members' rooms.  The unfinished plaster of the walls is divided at intervals by strips of dark wood that begin at the ceiling and intersect with the paneling two-thirds of the way down the wall.  Cast iron oil lamps extend from the strips, giving the corridor a dusky yellow tint.

title: [House Arcane, Bar]
description: The house taproom is finished to rustic perfection with cherrywood-panelled walls, a stone floor covered by a huge bearskin rug, and a cherrywood bar fronted by a round table and several chairs.  The flickering light of hand-crafted oil lamps glints off the bottles, prompting an undeniably parched and thirsty feeling in your throat.  In the far corner, a set of steep stairs leads down to the basement.

title: [House Arcane, Billiard Parlor]
description: The House gameroom is a slightly shabby room lit by stained-glass lanterns that dangle from the ceiling.  Varicolored light from them falls upon the rugs that cover the walls.  An assortment of scuffmarks and stains mar the otherwise interesting pattern of various squares of hardwoods that makes up the flooring here.  A billiard table occupies the center of the room, alabaster and marble balls racked on its surface.  Leather couches line two of the walls, along with a pair of coffee tables.

title: [House Arcane, Hall's End]
description: The hallway ends here with a set of steep, wooden stairs which ascend to the third floor.

title: [House Arcane, Landing]
description: Here, at the top of the steep, wooden staircase, you look down a corridor whose white plaster walls have been covered with maps of distant lands and lacquered with a thin, smooth glaze.  Farther down the hallway, a number of doors guard the private rooms of House members.

title: [House Arcane, Deck]
description: The sky is set with twinkling stars and the moons shed their soft glow upon the area.  Lounge chairs placed on the unfinished boards of the deck offer comfort for stargazers or for a group of friends to gather.  Grapevines cover the house's exterior around the door and the railing that surrounds the deck.  Over the rail, you can make out the Bay, and the sound of small waves crashing on the sandy beach reaches your ears from below.

title: [House Arcane, Pier]
description: Situated on the tidal-flow area of the river, this simple, sturdy pier is built from heavy yew planks fastened with iron nails to massive pilings sunk deep into the river bed.  Simple lanterns spaced evenly along the solid wood railings provide soft warm light against the night.  At the end of the pier, a small fish-shaped blackboard hangs from one of the pilings.  Two comfortable wood chairs and a pair of benches provide seating for fishermen or nature lovers.

title: [Garden Getaway, Kitchen]
description: Cupboards line the eastern wall above a smooth granite counter that sparkles in the sunlight with flecks of mica.  Ebon and slate blue tiles create a checked pattern upon the floor, which is reflected in the glaesine globes that dangle from the ceiling.  Pushed against the opposite wall, and set beneath a tiny white oak-framed window, is a small cloth-covered table surrounded by wicker-seated chairs.  A pot-bellied, cast iron stove makes the room comfortably warm from its position near the open back door.

title: [Garden Getaway, Loft]
description: Dyed a rich green hue, fleece pelts cover the floor from wall to wall and offer a soft, plush comfort beneath the steeply peaked roof.  Upon one side of the white-walled room is a luxurious feather bed covered with crisp white linens and a down comforter, while directly across stands a towering modwir armoire with painted doors.  At the foot of the bed rests a simple foot locker and several glowing glaesine globes dangle from the exposed rafters amid boughs of fresh and dried lavender.

title: [Emberstone Hall, Courtyard]
description: Lanes of trimmed lush grass stretch across both sides of the courtyard, and tall rose bushes line each wall.  Polished riverstone fountains rise up on each side of a white pebblestone walkway that snakes from a high rolaren gate to a pair of dark mahogany doors.  Burnished wooden benches form half-circles around each fountain.
a.location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Workshop]
description: Basalt steps rise toward a passage at one end of this half-subterranean chamber, its walls hewn from the island's dark volcanic stone.  Invar brackets and fittings lend the space a distinctly dwarven character, their red-speckled black surfaces complementing the surrounding rock.  A invar-fitted workbench dominates one wall, flanked by a grinder and polisher, while several sketches of hammer and blade designs have been tacked above it.  A heavy invar-banded door stands opposite the steps.
b.location: Emberstone Hall (Forge), inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Atrium]
description: The manor opens up into a large circular chamber with a high glass dome ceiling.  A dark ironwood tree rises up from the center of the room, its branches bathed in sunlight from above.  Finely dressed servants bustle between a mahogany archway and a long hallway, while a wide stairwell ascends to the second floor.
a.location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Emberstone Hall, Upstairs Hall]
description: A lavish navy blue carpet runs the span of the hallway, which ends at a pair of glass doors.  Various oil-painted portraits hang from each wall, broken up only by a dark mahogany double door.
b.location: Emberstone Hall, inside the island town of Mist Harbor

title: [Bungalow, Living Space]
description: Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a simple throw rug.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a wide couch flanked by a sturdy end table.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, a plain oak desk and wooden chair rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the closed door.

Spacious and tidy, the floor of the living space is fashioned of polished oak and covered with a simple throw rug.  Colorful artwork decorates one beadboard wall, the pieces hanging above a wide couch flanked by a sturdy end table.  Near the open archway to the kitchen, a plain oak desk and wooden chair rest beneath a copper lantern, while in the opposite corner a ladder leads to the second floor near the open door.
a.location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Bungalow, Loft]
description: Stretching from one end of the space to the other, exposed rafters support the peaked ceiling and are strung with dried herbs and flowers.  A carved wooden bed rests against the flat northern wall where a decorative carving hangs over its headboard and a large wooden footlocker rests against its footboard.  Spindled balusters support a small railing that overlooks the room below, a nearby ladder providing egress.
b.location: Bungalow at Nereid's Cradle, inside the pirate paradise of Kraken's Fall

title: [Dungeon, Antechamber]
description: Along the northern wall, a large mithril gate stands between an iron-banded door and a steel-banded door, while a pile of wooden crates line the western wall.  Fresh blood splatter drips down the stone walls, forming dark red pools upon the ground.  Within the center of the room, a granite staircase leads further underground.

title: [Undercroft, Approach]
description: Limestone walls enclose the undercroft's entry, with a single torch barely giving enough light.  An eerie fog fills the room, its presence clearly unnatural.  Vaulted ceilings give the entry a very spacious feel, however, a pile of rubble blocks any further passageways that would lead deeper within.  Along the northern wall, a granite archway stands before a limestone sarcophagus, while on the southern wall, a granite staircase leads up.

title: [Hearth's Desire, Lookout]
description: Icicles dangle precariously along the sharply slanted roof of the lookout, the transparent ice encrusted along the reinforced ropes stretching down towards a northern post.  An iron-hinged telescope sits buried beneath thick layers of warg fur, the snow-dusted pile set beside the upside down crates.  A pair of spherical glass lanterns hang above, swaying in the ambient breeze before the sybil-shaped dart board and rack nailed to the rope-bound posts.

title: [Hearth's Desire]
description: A glinting blanket of snow covers the tall ironwood trunks along the periphery of the encampment, the rope-secured barricades spaced with iron-caged braziers forged into vertical tusks.  Frost-covered barrels sit clustered across the straw-strewn dirt, the makeshift seating encircling the pole-framed bonfire contained between the weathered rocks set in a wide circle.  Steady light radiates from the flag-adorned structures at the back of the encampment as a steady stream of cooking smoke rises above.

title: [Militia Keep, Meeting Hall]
description: Beyond the arched stone doors to the south, the meeting hall has been carefully arranged to accommodate an audience of nearly any number.  Long tables neatly form up the center of the room, each chair turned to face the modwir podium at the main wall, above which looms a massive golden tapestry bearing the Militia's crest.  Several smaller tables and booths surround the area beneath arches of stone, offering more private seating away from the center of activity.

title: [Militia Keep, Barracks]
description: Plenty of torches line the walls of the barracks, illuminating the area sharply.  Four thick stone pillars are scattered across the room to support the ceiling, each displaying the Militia's coat-of-arms upon golden tapestries.  Several tables and chairs are bunched up in the center of the room, offering plenty of seating while simple cots and cotton hammocks line the walls for those who need rest.  Pushed up against the eastern wall is an iron and modwir credenza.

title: [Militia Keep, Barracks]
description: Plenty of torches line the walls of the barracks, illuminating the area sharply.  Four thick stone pillars are scattered across the room to support the ceiling, each displaying the Militia's coat-of-arms upon golden tapestries.  Several tables and chairs are bunched up in the center of the room, offering plenty of seating while simple cots and cotton hammocks line the walls for those who need rest.  Pushed up against the eastern wall is an iron and modwir credenza.

title: [Militia Keep, Cellar]
description: While the cellar is quite large, crates and boxes cover most of the eastern stone wall.  Set standing in the center of the room are two modwir racks, separated by a gleaming suit of full plate armor, which looms in guardianship over the proceedings.  An elaborate sigil has been etched into the stone of the southern wall, marked between two brocade tapestries that display the Militia's coat-of-arms.  A reinforced steel and iron door sits on the western wall abutting an upwards-leading set of steps.

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Studio]
description: Cramped yet tidy, the studio has a solid mahogany floor and slate walls.  Honeycomb cubbies are built between the floor and underside of an ascending spiral staircase, the octagonal compartments filled with all manner of supplies, half-finished projects, cups, bowls, and other bric-a-brac associated with the art of creation.  A long paint-marred table provides ample room for new creations and has a tall metal-fortified stool set before it.

title: [Shadowlight Gallery, Attic]
description: Spartan at best, the second story fills the entirety of the residence's floor space and is built between the eves of the roof.  Tiny glass jars filled with fireflies illuminate the space and hang in profusion from the exposed rafters.  Pressed against the north and west wall, a thick blanket-laden sleeping pallet has a battered old oak footlocker at one end of it, while a mirror-topped antique wash stand rests next to a descending spiral staircase.

title: [Albatross, Gambler's Rest]
description: The casino floor begins here and branches off in all directions.  Rosewood and mahogany doors are barely visible along the tapestry-covered walls, which are lined with some dark leather couches and serving trays.  In the center of the room is an elaborately carved mistwood staircase that climbs up to the next level of the riverboat, and a silver-inlaid mahogany archway leads toward the bar, ballroom, and buffet.  A short flight of steps lead down to the cashier.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Albatross, Patrons' Hallway]
description: Elegant beeswax candles hang from the ceiling in hunter green glass holders, their light dappling the richly carpeted hallway and casting shadows along the rosewood walls.  Solid gold and silver filigree frame the entryways leading to the various shops on this level of the riverboat.  An ivory-inset mahogany archway and a gold-trimmed rosewood door rest on the western wall, which is lined with colorful tapestries.  Several chairs and serving trays are set out throughout the hallway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, northwest

title: [Albatross, Patrons' Hallway]
description: Cheerfully festooned gold railings enclose the open-air hallway, and a large portion of the surrounding area is visible from this vantage point.  Daylight reflects off the waters far below, and the expanse of the deck is visible.

title: [Albatross, Upper Hallway]
description: Dark chestnut marble veined with alabaster and gold stretches the length of the hallway, and dark mahogany walls are elaborately carved in relief with aristocratic scenes of gambling, drinking, and hunting.

title: [Keep, Dressing Room]
description: A stone basin rests in the middle of a long, low stone table, beset by a silver pitcher and a rectangular silver tray filled with assorted hairpins.  Torn carpets, now stiff and wiry with mildew, in hues of yellow made darker by time and wear, cover the floor.   A narrow staircase leads up.

title: [Keep, Sleeping Quarters]
description: The stone here has been limed and whitewashed, though it is now dingy with age and soot.  Piles of white bedclothes, stained with blood and black smudges, are strewn about.  There is no sign of any furnishing, save for a large stained glass-fronted wardrobe still standing against the far wall.  A narrow staircase leads down.

title: [Keep, Glowing Passage]
description: Except for a narrow ledge, there is an abrupt drop-off here on three sides.  The walls are coated with a slight phosphor that sheds dim light.  A natural cave-in has left the ledge littered with rubble.  Some of the rubble has been cleared away, revealing a stairwell that spirals downward.  You also see a small opening.

title: [Dungeon, Landing]
description: This room is fairly large.  The wide base of a tall spiral staircase takes up a fair portion of it, looking grand and massive.  The grey stone walls are slick with cool moisture and you can hear the faint dripping sounds of water all around you.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
description: The floor of the tower is filled with rubble and debris, leaving barely any room to squeeze through the chunks of stone and fallen timber.  Mounds of dirt and sand make it almost impossible to reach the remains of a black marble spiral stair that ascends to the lookout point above.

title: [Black Swan Castle, Tower]
description: This is the lookout floor of the tower.  A spiral black marble stair winds its way down in the center, while a granite platform carved into the walls allows access to the north and east doors, and the south and west windows, for watches and emergencies.

title: [Dungeon, Landing]
description: A dark haze obscures a large opening in the wall near the bottom of a spiral stairwell, preventing you from seeing through it clearly.  The whole room is dimly lit and unadorned save for a tattered and faded grey banner that hangs forlornly on the wall.

title: [Dungeon, Stairwell]
description: A bright sconce illuminates the top of a spiral stairwell, gently lighting the glistening stone steps that lead down into the darkness below.  The steps look easy enough to traverse, but are slick with moisture and there are no railings to aid someone in case of an unfortunate slip.  A small oaken door off to the side adorned with a heavy iron clacker is the only other method of egress from this small chamber.

title: [Lirafyr Cottage, Library]
description: Entering into the base of the large sequoia tree, the air has a strong, albeit pleasant, scent of fresh cut lumber.  Stairs jut outwards from the timber giant, spiraling upwards into the darkness above, while the remaining spaces have been carved into built-in shelves filled with books.  Completing the cozy room is a large riverstone fireplace imbedded into the northern wall with a dark velvet loveseat settled nearby.

title: [Lirafyr Cottage, Bedchamber]
description: The twisting staircase comes to a rest at a platform surrounded by waist-high railing, its posts resembling scaled wings of dragonflies.  Large circular windows encased within the timbered walls of this abode are placed at the north and south, offering views of the surrounding landscape down below.  Situated amongst this floating terrace is a flyrsilk-draped four-poster bed with a red oak armoire standing nearby and a suede divan resting against the southernmost window.

title: [Dessert Vibes, Confectionary]
description: The walls are predominantly two-toned and depict a desert landscape, with emerald green sands painted beneath a pale violet sky.  At the horizon where the colors change, silver clouds with black-painted winking expressions further decorate the walls.  In the room's middle, a series of tangerine-hued driftwood crates and a series of silver-hued driftwood boxes are arranged to display wares.  A glaesine orb serves as a lantern for the shop, hung in the room's middle and casting a flickering light.

title: [Dessert Vibes, The Drop]
description: Small and flat-bottomed, the room is a small hole that looks like it was roughly dug out, with uneven walls and small piles of clay-rich dirt off to the sides.  Stuck into the walls at the ceiling are several long bamboo poles which dangle large hard candy sculptures.  Haphazardly arrayed across the dirt floor are a series of red and white candy-striped burlap pillows.  A broad driftwood sign hands askew on the wall, loosely nailed into the dirt.  Several votives placed along the room's edges light the hole.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Fifth Floor]
description: At rest, a dusty suit of platemail stands balanced against the greatsword it holds point-down before it, its surface kept clean and free of dust.  Across from the armor, a faint chill lingers around an open door, cool air slipping quietly into the space.  Nearby, a spiraling stone staircase winds both upward and downward, continuing toward the sixth level while fading into shadow below.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Conical Summit]
description: Exposed rafters support a conical roof of fresh thatch, its structure rising overhead and lending the space a warm, rustic scent.  Wide windows stand open to the surrounding grounds, letting in clean air and unbroken views of the grounds beyond the tower.  At center, a hot-bellied cast iron stove rests upon a stone pad, its curved chimney snaking upward along the wall before disappearing through the roof.  Nearby, a spiraling stone staircase descends only, its curve dropping away into the levels below.

title: [Brayern Isle, Jungle Path]
description: Carved-out hollows line a path along a sheer cliff that divides jungle plateaus along the volcanic mountain.  Massive, onyx-hued boulders punctuate the lush treescape below, remaining where they have landed since dislodging from higher altitudes.  A strung rope and a small sign next to the edge separate travelers from a high dive.  A series of stone lanterns are suspended along the cliff face.  A rope ladder anchored to the rock face leads to a narrow platform above.

title: [Brayern Isle, Cliffside Watch]
description: A stone wall and a plank-reinforced stone floor define the edges of this canopy-covered hollow erected in a small cliffside pocket.  A narrow path toward a vine-twisted opening offers access, as does a rope ladder along the cliff face.  Built on river rock slabs is a small bonfire, with several chairs set around it.  A metal viewing glass wrapped in vines is propped against the stone wall, offering a view of the jungle below or of the churning mana storm that surrounds the island.  The area is lit by several lanterns attached to the cliff face.

title: [Brayern Isle, Fort Brayern]
description: Silver-striated white stone bricks line the floor of this fortress.  Above, a wide leather tarp pulled tight with thick ropes protects from harsh weather.  Ingress is granted via a metal portcullis built into the blue-green wooden fortress walls, which are hung with weathered violet-hued banners and lanterns.  The area's centerpiece is a small pool surrounding a blazing bonfire built on a raised white stone platform.  Some plush pillows surround both.  Wide white stone stairs with a prominent sign adjacent lead up and onward.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest

title: [Brayern Island, Portal Dais]
description: Scratches mar the ground, evidence of objects being dragged along toward the stone stairs and down into the fortress.  The jungle cliffs outside the fortress are visible over the blue-green wooden walls, with twining vines plunging down sheer rock faces and out of sight.  To the north, a tall white stone arch containing opaque, wavering energies stands out against the mana storm's electric blue highlights.  Ahead of it, a checkpoint wooden kiosk with a wide sign attached to its front stands in the way.

title: [Nyessem, Ring Loop Entrance]
description: Meticulously carved from pearlescent white stone, the walls here suggest the area was hollowed and then detailed to accent the stone's innate glow.  Shapes of jewel-studded flowers, animals, and geometric patterns have all been artistically etched into the walls.  In particular, a wide gem and stone relief of two individuals holding orbs stands out, dominating a prominent section opposite a tall sapphire-lined tunnel.  Beneath the relief and from alongside the installation, a marble fountain flows liberally into a shallow marble pool.  In the room's middle, a wood and stone sign covered in metal letters offers instructions.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: Built above the Ring Loop and accessed via the stairs from below, this walking path is similarly wide but twice as tall, formed from the same pearlescent white stone walls found throughout Nyessem.  Instead of a ceiling, a pale blue mist hovers in the air, mimicking a clouded sky.  Next to the stairs is a stone cart with refreshments and a small sign.  Pillows are intermittently spaced for taking one's ease.

title: [Nyessem, Orb Approach]
description: The walls here are colored a dark, matte black.  A pale silver spotlight emitting its beam straight from the ceiling focuses on a glittering gem-studded arch.  Flanking the arch on all sides are some dark crimson banners trimmed with bright violet threads.  Above the top banner running perpendicular to the arch is a gem-cut crest for the Maivaldius family.  At the crest's center is a large rune-etched diamond.  Opposite the arch are some wide stairs.

title: [Nyessem, Promenade]
description: This walkway is wide and extends off into the distance in multiple directions.  The way down, through the stairs at one end, is shrouded in shadow with occasional pearlescent flickers.  The contrast between this near-darkness and the blue mist above lends the area a surreal duality.  In the middle of the walkway is a four-tiered white stone fountain surrounded by thickly piled silk pillows.

title: [Zrenigotham House, Sitting Room]
description: Moonlight filters through a large mahogany-framed window with built-in seating, casting a silver glow across the sitting room.  Lamps latticed with thin silver metalwork are placed about, joined by a small stone fireplace as a source of ambience in the cozy area. A padded pale ivory silk settee and two armchairs invite rest, while a glass-topped sidetable awaits nearby.  Bookcases line the walls, brimming with literary gems, and fresh flowers add subtle color.  A winding staircase offers access to the upper level and a set of glass-paneled doors open up to an arched hallway.
a.location: Zrenigotham House, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Zrenigotham House, Master]
description: A winding staircase leads to the master chamber, where tall windows offer a moonlit view of the orchard, its trees silvered under the night sky.  Soft shadows stretch across the room, cast by the pale glow drifting over a great carved modwir bed upon an expansive rug of lush miniver, its outline gentle in the dim light.  Modwir nightstands stand quiet gaurd, each bearing an elegant glass lamp.  A brass sidetable holding a white porcelain basin rests near mahogany-framed mirror.
b.location: Zrenigotham House, inside the frontier town of Wehnimer's Landing

title: [Salty's Services, Foyer]
description: Opening off of a wide driftwood arch, the area is cavernous and spare, with high ceilings and a plain wooden floor scattered with loose sand.  Varied multihued banners line the wooden walls, each adorned with the sewn-on image of a stylized kraken.  Above, a metal brazier hangs from the ceiling, casting a dim light across the warehouse entry.  A narrow winding stairway disappears upward into the warehouse's second floor, while a broad kelp-lined curtain opposite the arch leads further inward.

title: [Salty's Services, Landing]
description: A tangle of ropes and netting hangs over a wide room off a narrow winding stairway.  Caught within the amalgamation are varied larger containers, lengths of wood, fishing poles, and tattered bits of clothing.  The room is relatively unadorned, except for triangle-shaped series of votive-topped barrels at its center.  Amidst the barrels, Administrator Salty stands, leaning on a propped-up driftwood sign atop one of the barrels, facing the stairway.

title: [The Jocular Oculist, Main Deck]
description: Swaying to and fro, near-white canvas sails flap noisily in the breeze, adding a calming distraction from the vessel's rushed crew members.  Red pine planking, laden with puddles from a recent washing, stretches across the deck in eye-catching patterns of mixed horizontal and vertical arrangements.  Thick braided ropes hang from brass hooks along the main mast which casts shadows across a wooden grate in the center of the main deck.  Adjacent to a red pine gangplank, some stairs lead down to the lower level.

title: [Optimistic Views, Cabin]
description: Rose-colored silks drape decoratively across red pine rafters that frame a wooden grate in the ceiling.  Neatly arranged on a glass counter are velvet-lined boxes filled with a variety of wares, and a small brass tree displays some of the shop's more sophisticated offerings.  Placed prominently on the wall between some stairs and a wooden door carved with sea creatures is a brass plaque.

title: [The Kraken's Dispatch, Deck]
description: Polished from stem to stern, the ship has pristine sails painted with the flotilla's signature ebon kraken floating in a crimson pool on a field of emerald green.  Large crates are stacked everywhere, each stamped with various ports of call and the phrase, "Mail for the Flotilla if you can find it."  A spacious staircase leads down, with a neatly lettered sign right next to it.

title: [The Kraken's Dispatch, Delivery]
description: Behind a polished mahogany counter, shelves and cubbies line the walls, filled to overflowing with packages, parcels, envelopes, and letters.  Mail accoutrements for purchase are neatly displayed along the walls closest to the spacious staircase leading up to the main deck.

title: [Derelict Queen, Main Deck]
description: Ivory canvas sails stretch above the oak and teak floor, the tall masts casting shadows across the incarnadine ramp framed by knotted hemp ropes.  A rope-entwined ironwood staircase leads upwards to a velvet-curtained archway flanked by iron-forged windows, the sea glass geometry highlighted by slivers of nacreous shells, each cluster of glass forming images of sealife.  Affixed across the masts are weblike lengths of ebony netting, the ladders anchored to curved eahnor hooks set at various intervals.

title: [Kyncera's Cabin]
description: Hook-gathered lengths of velvet and brocade are draped across the wood-planked walls, the rich, ocean-colored tones partially obscured by the various flags displayed in states of disarray.  A cushion-covered bed spans the back of the cabin, curtained off in silver and gilt-beaded silks, the arabesques spilling down across the raised platform.  Nestled in the corner is a worn leather chair encircled by a pair of round tables, the surface covered by several bottles and blown-glass instruments.

title: [Wehnimer's, Stormarm St.]
description: This intersection links the bazaar routes with those bisecting and encircling the Landing.  A few ruddyfaced sailors, loudmouthed dockworkers, and off-duty soldiers linger along the wall of a tavern, which is set back from the side of the road up a slight incline.  A shaky wooden stairway, the bane of many an overimbiber's existence, leads up to the tavern door.

title: [Helga's Tavern, Barroom]
description: The blended odors of ale, sweat, leather, perfume and hearty stew fill the stifling air of the tavern.  Disheveled regulars and road-weary travelers rub elbows at the wooden bar, which looks recently varnished but already bears a variety of stains and grime.  Helga, the ancient, obese proprietor, moves behind the bar, wiping glasses with a dirty towel as she keeps a beady eye on the patrons.  A small fireplace in one corner burns feebly, adding little light or warmth to the room.

title: [Wehnimer's, Exterior]
description: You are standing on the western shore of the Locksmehr river.  From here you can see the southern water entrance to the town of Wehnimer's Landing.  It is through this entrance that the boats returning from their upstream sojourns to the south have access to the town.  A rough trail descends a rocky slope toward a stand of willow trees.

title: [Willow Grove]
description: A rough trail winds down a rocky slope from the bridge above, passing through a stand of willows.  The trees' lacy fronds move slowly at the prompting of a light breeze off the river.  They stand together, growing more dense the closer one gets to the bank.  The path meanders between the trunks, running at an angle from the swift current of the water with its constant susurrus and sparkling reflections of sunlight.

A rough trail winds down a rocky slope from the bridge above, passing through a stand of willows.  The trees' lacy fronds move slowly at the prompting of a light breeze off the river.  They stand together, growing more dense the closer one gets to the bank.  The path meanders between the trunks, running at an angle from the swift current of the water with its constant susurrus and twinkling reflections of moonlight.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Grasslands]
description: You are wandering through the grasslands of Lower Dragonsclaw.  This area is hilly, but not enough to justify the mountain which juts out from the ground to the east.

title: [Above Elanthia, On the Web]
description: A vast spidersilk web sprawls out as far as the eye can see.  Millions of tiny spiders strengthen their craft, allowing the surface to be durable enough to walk on.  The bright sunlight is nearly unbearable from all the way up here.  Below, the only thing recognizable is Mount Aenatumgana's peak.  There is a thick rope of spidersilk leading toward Elanthia off one of the web's edges.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Wet Ravine]
description: Moss and fungus coat the rocks at either side of this deep, wet ravine.  The ground is slippery with mud and leaves.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Cemetery]
description: The strange song of the Sirenflower is more distinct and more eerie here.  Tree branches, heavy with the old growth and dripping with vines, seem to bend over in mourning.

title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: The farmhouses and fields are closer together here as the road nears the village of Sylvarraend.  One of the farmers has left a plow nearby, apparently in preparation to till one of the fields for a new crop.

title: [Above Elanthia, On the Web]
description: A vast spidersilk web sprawls out as far as the eye can see.  Millions of tiny spiders strengthen their craft, allowing the surface to be durable enough to walk on.  The bright sunlight is nearly unbearable from all the way up here.  Below, the only thing recognizable is Mount Aenatumgana's peak.  There is a thick rope of spidersilk leading toward Elanthia off one of the web's edges.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Modwir pines rustle in the wind, and bluejays swoop back and forth among them, belittling you and each other in rough, raucous voices.  The main trail curves to the west and southeast, while a rougher trail heads up the side of the hill to the north.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Great blocks of stone thrust out of the earth all about you as you pick your way across the jagged landscape.  Here and there, a patch of crinkly lichen clings to the pale gray stone, but other than that, this area is devoid of plant life.  You hear a faint skittering in the distance, and think of claws on rock.  You glance around nervously, wondering what lives here.

title: [Solhaven, Eastbridge End]
description: Standing out because of its crisp, but darker lines, as well as its location, the high wall surrounding the estate at the southern corner of the intersection is constructed entirely of grey brick.  Wrought iron arabesques and spikes adorn the top of the wall and the felwood gates at the compound's entrance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, west

title: [Huge Tower, Nexus]
description: Wooden planks reinforced with bands of steel form a circular platform high into the sky.  A tall ladder is bolted to the side of the tower, leading down toward the ground far below.  An arched roof overhead provides shelter from the elements, and the tower branches off into four main sections from this point.  The surrounding landscape is visible for miles, the horizon blurring into a blend of land and sky.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: Glimmering droplets of moisture coat the moss-covered trees and rocks, occasionally dripping to the sodden ground with a soft *plunk*.  A pile of massive boulders blocks the view to the east, the encroaching mist slamming harmlessly against the stone.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The trail wends its way up a steep hillside dotted with small trees which, at some point in their long-ago lives, found purchase in the rocky soil.  A pile of boulders blocks progress westward.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The trail moves along the edge of the ridgeline, skirting the bases of the massive trees dotting the cliffside.  Large granite boulders, many covered in glowing lichen, jut raggedly from the ground.

title: [Wraithenmist, Winding Trail]
description: The dead trees thin somewhat, the rocky ground having made it difficult for them to colonize more ground in their days of life.  A pile of large rocks blocks the trail.

title: [Depths of V'Tull, Crawlway]
description: You see a sharply descending cylindrical crawlway leading down into the depths of the volcano.  The air here is so hot it's painful to breathe.  This passageway is cramped, and the lava-scorched glassine walls seem somewhat unstable as they squeeze in from either side.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Inner Circle]
description: This small alcove provides a little protection from the hot air and steam that constantly plague the area below.  Beads of sweat roll down your face and hands as you try and decide if you want to again venture downward back into the chaos.

title: [Commerce Burrow, Trader Way]
[Commerce Burrow, Trader's Way]
description: A brisk wind blows down the street, shivering the branches of evergreens along the roadside.  The road comes to a sharp corner in front of a marvelous two-story bakery.  Countless small windows with white shutters peek out of the brick facade of the shop, and a polished silver plaque is affixed next to the door.  Woodsmoke billows gently from the stone chimney, though its bite is sweetened by the aroma of baked goods.

Trader's Way comes to a sharp corner here, in front of a marvelously grand bakery.  Painted bright pink, the front of the shop is decorated with numerous tiny windows outlined with white shutters.  A polished silver plaque hangs next to the door.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin ironwood plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of ironwood that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point despite the icicles growing here and there.

title: [Altar of the Elder]
description: The ledge is more generous than it appeared from the lower stone platform, which now looks extremely narrow and far below.  The view from here of the monumental ice sculpture reveals its top to be as superbly detailed as its other aspects.   Incongruously, a pool of clear, sapphire-colored water lies between the ledge and an immense statue of a sleeping drake, its recumbent body curled around a large throne on the pool's northern edge.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: To the northwest, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  Above the course of steps, a dais is visible below a ridge.  Strange flickers of reflected light bounce off the icy walls above and around the dais, as if the low light were rebounding off water.  To the south, the huge, sculpted mountain of ice exudes a constant wave of brutal cold, as if it was exhaling the wilderness of rime encasing the ancient edifice.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: The ice coating the platform flows unbroken into the nave's huge iceberg, a seamless sweep of graceful spirals that eventually merge with a monumental figure towering above.  There, a dragon plummets from the sky, its wings trailing behind it like tattered streamers.  Icy shafts protrude from the drake's neck and body and rivulets of ice seep from the wounds.  The form hovers moments before impact, its features a study of agony and at the same time, resignation to the finality of its endless fall.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [Platform of Ice]
description: To the northeast, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  This platform is totally encased in a frozen sheet that muffles sound and reflects light in a glistening shimmer.  Above the treacherous ascent, a ledge is visible - and towering above that, a monstrous, serpentine figure reclines, its head and tail forming a protective curve around the ice-sheathed dais.

title: [Stairs of Ice]
description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.

title: [East Stair, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs curve up toward the west, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  The stone of the outside walls is heavily carved in bas-relief.  Overhead, the ceiling is a distant, shadowy pool of darkness, but the intricate detail of the carved walls can be glimpsed reaching past the point of sight in a rich landscape of embellishment.

title: [Domed Entry Hall, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs culminate in an entry hall, little more than a glorified landing replete with sculpted stone.  Stairwells curving down to the southeast and southwest converge at a double column surmounted by capitals carved in high relief.  Opposite the trumeau, two arches, crafted of alternating dark and reddish-toned granite blocks, open to the northeast and northwest.  Over every surface, the relentless sheath of ice gives a reflective coating that is as lovely as it is precarious.

title: [West Stair, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs curve up toward the east, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  Along the outside wall, friezes follow the ascent, providing a rich panorama of dense detail that adds to the menace of the ice, adding the temptation of studying the carved stone instead of the ice-covered steps.

title: [Domed Entry Hall, Hill of Ice]
description: The stairs culminate in an entry hall, little more than a glorified landing replete with sculpted stone.  Stairwells curving down to the southeast and southwest converge at a double column surmounted by capitals carved in high relief.  Opposite the trumeau, two arches, crafted of alternating dark and reddish-toned granite blocks, open to the northeast and northwest.  Over every surface, the relentless sheath of ice gives a reflective coating that is as lovely as it is precarious.

title: [Top of the World, Aenatumgana]
description: The biting wind howls incessantly over a sharp precipice, whipping jagged pieces of ice around brutally. Deep indentations have been etched into the surface ice covering the precipice from the ferocity of the wind.  High overhead, several large icicles look dangerously close to falling from a small outcropping.

title: [Above Elanthia, On the Web]
description: A vast spidersilk web sprawls out as far as the eye can see.  Millions of tiny spiders strengthen their craft, allowing the surface to be durable enough to walk on.  The bright sunlight is nearly unbearable from all the way up here.  Below, the only thing recognizable is Mount Aenatumgana's peak.  There is a thick rope of spidersilk leading toward Elanthia off one of the web's edges.

title: [Southern Slopes, Narrow Shelf]
description: Above, the granite canopy has broken, leaving a narrow vertical crevice in the pinkish rock.  Through it, the sharp pinnacle of the eastern peak can be seen set against the sky.  Large boulders crouch beneath the crevice.  Over the cliff to the south, a frozen lake sits far below.

title: [Foothills, Frozen Lake]
description: The trail ends at the shore of a frozen lake that sits in a low basin here.  Waterfowl slip and slide across the opaque ice, like children at play.  The northern shore of the lake is formed by the sheer cliff stretching upwards towards a craggy mountain peak.  The other shorelines are comparatively flat, and heavily wooded.  Perched high upon the boughs of an edge-water pine is a thatched stick birds nest.

The trail ends at the shore of a frozen lake that sits in a low basin here.  The northern shore of the lake is formed by the sheer cliff stretching upwards towards a craggy mountain peak.  The other shorelines are comparatively flat, and heavily wooded.  Perched high upon the boughs of an edge-water pine is a thatched stick birds nest.

title: [Arctic Tundra, High Plain]
description: Passage to the east is blocked by an enormous landslide.  Rocks and ice long ago melded together to form a slick, seemingly unclimbable barrier.

title: [A Winding Path]
[Abbey Approach, Winding Path]
description: An enormous landslide chokes the pathway, yet it is not as impenetrable as it first appeared.  Beneath the rubble, traces of a wider, stone pathway emerge and continue upwards and around the base of a broad mountain.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield, Trench]
description: The wind howls with menace above, but finds itself unable to gain entrance to the deep battlement.  The stone-reinforced walls are covered with slick ice, and what might have granted sanctuary long ago seems nothing more than an icy prison now.

title: [A Frozen Battlefield]
description: Deep pits fortified with large stones and boulders still remain as quiet momentos of the war that ravaged this plain.  Dented greaves and smashed helms lie crushed between two huge boulders, implying the violence of previous battles.  Wind screeches through the gaps in the low rock walls, bringing a terrifying, ominous song to the area.

title: [Temple Burrow, Icy Pool]
description: Penguins churn the frigid pool.  They swim through the limpid waters, diving and splashing with a comedic flair that provokes uproarious laughter from onlookers on the banks.  The water is freezing cold, but the birds do not seem to mind in the slightest.  To the side, an icy ledge offers a way out of the gelid drink.

The water is alive with penguins.  They swim all about the pool, diving and splashing so comically that you cannot help but laugh.  The water is freezing cold, making your teeth chatter and turning your lips blue, but the birds don't seem to mind in the slightest.  To the side you spy an icy ledge that you believe you could climb to get out of the drink.

title: [Temple Burrow, Penguin Hill]
description: Cold and crystal clear, a small lake has formed at the peak of the hill, providing a popular spot for local wildlife to congregate.  A huge colony of penguins flourishes on the shores of the lake.  They waddle comically around the edge, preen themselves and one another, and dive after little silvery fish darting through the frigid waters.  A smooth runnel in the bank makes an ideal slide for the creatures and, it appears, some of the younger townsfolk.

A small lake has formed here, making this a popular spot for the local wildlife.  A huge grouping of penguins lives on the shore of the lake, waddling comically around the edge, preening or catching the cold water fish.  A smooth area on the bank makes an ideal slide for the creatures and, looking more closely, it seems you could join in the fun.

title: [Tavern Burrow, Honeybeer Road]
description: At the busy intersection of Stout Street and Honeybeer Road, the smell of roasting meats drifts from the west on a cold breeze.  The whistling of a traveling merchant rises over the moaning of the wind as her mule-drawn cart clatters down the road.  Sounds of town guards drilling filter over the high wall of an armory to the north.

You find yourself at the busy intersection of Stout Street and Honeybeer Road.  The smells of roasting meats entice you to move west, yet there seems to be some activity to the north which might be worth investigating.  Pausing briefly, you whistle a quick tune and make your way down the road.

title: [Tower]
description: A rough angled ceiling of thin ironwood plates arcs overhead, supported by thick poles of ironwood that continue down to the ground that is far below.  Planks of wood make up the sturdy albeit rough floor, and a few small notches are cut into the dark walls.  The countryside expands out beneath you, its terrain easily visible from this high vantage point despite the icicles growing here and there.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: The dim flicker of torchlight casts shadows that flit across the uneven stone walls in a macabre dance that evokes images of death and demons.  A heavy, iron door hangs from rusted hinges.  A crude, iron ladder leads up to a sturdy-looking trapdoor.  The trapdoor has a strong-looking spring mechanism across its underside.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Deep brown wood panels this room, making it look even darker and smaller than it actually is.  A solid-looking trapdoor with heavy hinges is set into one corner of the floor, surrounded by tightly fitted grey stone.  A burned-out torch lies discarded in the corner near the trapdoor, which looks blackened and singed in places, but is still as solid as ever.

title: [Thanatoph, Narrow Ledge]
description: Sheer stone walls rising hundreds of feet above your head blot out the sky, making any further upward movement impossible.  You turn to look out over the ledge, but your perch is precipitous and you quickly decide that the view from here is not worth the possible, and highly likely, fall.

title: [Thanatoph, Eastern Peak]
description: The peak levels off slightly here, and movement becomes easier.  Leading off to the northwest, the tracks of a large animal follow alongside a path of burrowed earth.

title: [Warehouse, Nexus]
description: The air is filled with shouts and bellowed orders as warehouse workers, wagons, and tradesmen barely avoid each other in their rush to get to their appointed locations at their appointed times.  A large wooden platform sits in the center of this whirling pool of chaos, a calm eye in the center of the howling storm of commerce.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, west, northwest

title: [Warehouse, Platform]
description: The solid oak platform sits in the middle of the warehouse floor, an island in the middle of a swirling sea of activity.  From here you have a wonderful view of all of the activity going on in the warehouse.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: A steep path twists up the slope of the hill to the north and disappears as it plunges through a thick patch of berry bushes.  Clinging to the intimidating thorns of these bushes are a few strips of shiny metal and some decaying bits of now unrecognizable flesh.

title: [Cave, Entrance]
description: A large opening in the rock face of the north wall of this cliffside has been covered with a few scraps of roughly cured leather.  Apparently this leather was meant to serve as a crude door to the obvious cave behind it.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Debtors Vault]
description: The smell of death and decay almost overcomes you and you gasp for air, but your lungs refuse it.  Although you have smelled death before, you have never experienced the revulsion you feel entering this area.  You wonder if you should advance any further as the nausea drains your strength.

title: [Hall of the Dead, Common Crypt]
description: As the light of the room flickers something is different, the wall carvings have become very shallow.  They are so shallow that bodies have been turned on their side to save work in carving the holes.  In fact, most are held to the wall pockets by simple restraining straps, some of which have rotted, allowing the bodies to tumble from their resting place.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Corrie]
description: The rock face rising out of the snow at your feet is completely featureless.  A thick rope, crusted in ice and apparently secured above, turns slowly in the ever-present wind.

title: [Griffin's Keen, Corrie]
description: After a final steep scramble, the trail widens out to a path that slopes to an end at a sheer drop off.  About twenty feet below, the snowy valley floor is cut in half by the black stripe of a cold, rushing stream.  Heavy pegs, pounded into the old ice, look like they have been there for generations.  From the pegs, a knotted rope disappears over the side of the cliff.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Coastal Woods]
description: The path turns sharply to the southwest and southeast here, looping around a small, marshy area to the south.  Stepping off the path to the south here means sinking to the ankle in mud.  A small spring could be the source of the wetland.

title: [Warrens]
description: The cramped tunnel begins to squeeze in on all sides and travel in this passage is reduced to an uncomfortable crawl.  While the earthy aroma of the area is not unpleasant, the thick and heavy air is making it quite difficult to breath.  Muffled sounds can be heard coming from either direction, although it is difficult to tell just how far off they might be.

The cramped tunnel begins to squeeze in on all sides and travel in this passage is reduced to an uncomfortable crawl.  While the earthy aroma of the area is not unpleasant, the thick and heavy air is making it quite difficult to breathe.  Muffled sounds can be heard coming from either direction, although it is difficult to tell just how far off they might be.

title: [Manor House, Kitchen]
description: As dirty and damp as this room is, with patches of yellow mold and cobwebs in the corners, the steel spit spanning the large fireplace and the butcher block counter make the original purpose of the room quite plain.  A rusted basin rests on a table between a boarded up window and a stairway set against the east wall that climbs to the second floor.  Beneath the stairway, stone steps descend to the manor's cellar.  A haon door stands just south of the fireplace in the kitchen's west wall.

title: [Manor House, Servants' Stairs]
description: Along the east wall a stairway descends to the ground floor of the house, while another stairway along the south wall leads up to the manor's attic.  Both sets of stairs look weak, and a few of the steps are actually missing.

title: [Warrens]
description: Large gnarled roots run along the walls and roof of this tunnelway, likely the only support for the soft earth forming this passage.  Dim light peeking through a jagged hole overhead is managing to provide a bit of illumination for this otherwise darkened lair.  Curious grunts echo from all about, the sound magnified by the claustrophobic terrain.

title: [Vornavian Coast, Foggy Valley]
description: Rocks about the size of pumpkins litter the path here, which appears to have once been a stream bed.  The rocks, unseen beneath the fog, make walking painful and treacherous.  The swirling fog pours downward into a large hole in the ground.

title: [Krag Slopes]
description: Poised on the very edge of a canyon wall, you look upon the brink of a seemingly bottomless pit, your feet threatening to slip out from beneath you and plunge you into the dark depths below.  The distance across the chasm is not too great, and you ponder the wisdom of trying to cross it.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rocky Pass]
description: Jagged outcrops of craggy rocks split the valley into twin canyons.  Small rocks skitter down the steep walls of the canyon and form small wisps of dust that look like rising steam.  Cold air flows steadily north out of both canyons as the night cools the rock faces to near freezing temperatures.  Very faint chattering sounds can be heard coming from large cracks in the rock outcrop to the south.

Jagged outcrops of craggy rocks split the valley into twin canyons.  Small rocks skitter down the steep walls of the canyon creating small wisps of dust that look like rising steam while the cool rock of the canyon floor creates a stream of cool air that flows steadily north out of both canyons.  Very faint chattering sounds can be heard coming from large cracks in the rock outcrop to the south.

title: [Hidden Plateau]
description: A dull stone fountain rests near the base of the chipped marble staircase that leads into the palace ruins.  Scattered cobblestones circle around the fountain and head away to the west, hinting at a long overgrown road.

title: [Hidden Plateau, Ruins]
description: Dilapidated metal fire pits flank the massive, broken doors that form the entryway into the building.  Grime-covered shards of blue, white, and yellow stone form a detailed mosaic of the sun rising over some mountain peaks on the ceiling above.  Smooth marble floors stretch down the halls to the east, marred and scratched violently at random intervals.

title: [Labyrinth, Promontory]
description: A small stone promontory stretches outward slightly from the mountainside, overlooking the ground far below.  A gentle breeze swirls about playfully, carrying with it the strong scent of pine.  Stone benches travel around the walled edge of the circular platform, turned to face the handsome statue of a warrior-king.  A steep trail leads away from the simple sanctuary, down and across the cliffs of the plateau.

title: [Plateau's Edge, Steep Path]
description: Slick and frozen terrain prevents passage back up the cliff.  The path continues sharply down the edge of the plateau, ending abruptly several feet above the ground of the frozen slopes below.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Overlook]
description: This small clearing reveals a view overlooking the moonlit reflections from Lake Eonak far below.  A few steps away, a narrow set of stairs lead up toward an imposing grey tower.  A broad path is barely visible at the end of the clearing.

This small clearing reveals a spectacular view of Lake Eonak and Wehnimer's Landing far below.  A few steps away, a narrow set of stairs lead up toward an imposing grey tower.  A large mountain blocks the sunlight and casts darkness along a broad path pushing down into a grassy valley.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Tower]
description: Looming before you stands a tall grey tower shrouded in a misty fog.  A courtyard surrounds the tower and is protected by a massive portcullis.  A thin blanket of mist flows toward a narrow set of stairs leading down.

Looming before you stands a tall grey tower silhouetted by a dark mountain.  A courtyard surrounds the tower and is protected by a massive portcullis.  A few steps away lie a narrow set of stairs leading down.

title: [Gorge, North Rim]
description: The gorge ends in a sheer cliff face here, but looking at it you notice that the phenomenon is clearly not natural.  The cliff wall is blackened and fused together such that it forms a near glasslike face.  The path that follows along the gorge leads directly up the cliff as though it once continued onward, and the floor of the gorge only contains a mere trickle of water where a raging river once flowed.

title: [Gorge, Rock Ledge]
description: You stand in awe on a large rock shelf which protrudes out over the canyon as if by magic.  Gazing northeast, you turn your attention to the sheer cliff that blocks further passage in that direction.  You can find no way to scale the wall from this side.

title: [Graveyard, Burial Mound]
description: Your eyes adjust to the semi-darkness as a pale shaft of light filters through the tiny natural chimney in the domed roof of the curved chamber.  You see no signs of life yet low, unearthly murmurings, vague rustlings and flickers of faint lights swirl about you.  The only reality you are sure of is the dull thud of your footsteps on the earthern floor, echoing off the packed dirt walls.

title: [Graveyard, Top of Mound]
description: From the lofty perch atop the burial mound, you look out over the lowlands and marshes to the south and west and the desolate plateau to the north.  Facing southeast are the ominous graveyard, unquiet crypt, and the gates and cemetary walls beyond.  The ridge is narrow and uneven, with little room to maneuver.  Startled by the cawing of a nesting gorcrow, you realize that any distraction from keeping your balance would be courting to disaster.

title: [Shadow Valley]
