description: Steep rocky walls rise high above, squelching any thoughts of climbing out.  A cold biting wind blows across your face, stinging your eyes and lips.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest

title: [Shadow Valley, Dark Pasture]
description: Drab grey clouds twist overhead in muted anguish, casting writhing shadows over this secluded pasture.  The pasture spreads out dully to the southeast, broken only by the occasional misshapen tree or rotted trunk.  An ancient trail, overgrown from countless years of disuse, weaves its way from the rising valley walls into the desolation.

title: [Underground, A Deep Pit]
description: You are in a deep pit.  The walls are smooth for the most part but enough roots have grown through to make some good hand and toe holds.  Above you, the trapdoor taunts you with visions of freedom.

title: [Underground Ruin, Entrance Hall]
description: This is the southern most end of the entrance hall.  The walls are bare except for a few burnt out torches.  Flattened against the south wall is the mummified corpse of a guard.

title: [House of Paupers, Crystal Room]
[Paupers, Crystal Room]
description: An abundance of overgrown hanging plants and excessive humidity encourage you to shed your inhibitions along with your clothing to participate in the water sports played in this enormous area covered by a translucent crystal dome.  In one corner you see a steaming hot tub surrounded by rocks and lush greenery.  The plants release aromatic vapors which relax your senses.  An expansive swimming pool sparkles as it reflects the moonlight.

An abundance of overgrown hanging plants and excessive humidity encourage you to shed your inhibitions along with your clothing to participate in the water sports played in this enormous area covered by a translucent crystal dome.  In one corner you see a steaming hot tub surrounded by rocks and lush greenery.  The plants release aromatic vapors which relax your senses.  An expansive swimming pool sparkles as it reflects the light from the sun.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Sunlight glints brightly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Moonlight glistens softly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Pass]
description: A bluish-grey mountain spire dominates the terrain.  The top of the spire is hidden by clinging clouds.  Around the base of the mountain pillar are strewn rocks of a variety of shapes and sizes.

title: [Luinne Bheinn, Crag]
description: A grey and moist sea of mist envelops the crag, making it quite impossible to see more than an arm's length or two.  The moist air makes the small, granite mountain top slick and treacherous, but also adds a vibrancy to the blue-grey hued rock.  Occasional icy blasts of wind make the mist swirl hypnotically.

title: [Observation Tower]
description: The stone walls are bare, save for a raised mural on the north facing wall, which depicts in great detail the surroundings of Wehnimer's Landing.  Resting on a dais mid-center of the tower, a hand-carved obsidian chair captures the eye.  Deep gouges mar the surface of one of the steps which leads up to the surface of the platform.

title: [Observation Platform]
description: The rotating chair swivels easily around, showing great views of the surrounding area through vertical-slitted windows that traverse the walls.  All manner of gadgets presents themselves for manipulation.  A crystal eyepiece mounted on a spring arm can be raised and lowered on a whim by use of a horizontal and vertical cranks and a lever made of invar.

title: [Bard Guild, Theater Lobby]
description: The chamber is shaped like a crescent moon, and within the curve of the arms, cascading tiers of steps lead down to arches opening into the auditorium beyond.  Heavy velvet drapes and thick rugs, all a rich shade of dark crimson, give the room a hushed ambiance, rendering footsteps almost soundless and conversation into a muted buzz.

title: [Bard Guild, Performance Hall]
description: The auditorium is cavernous, and every inch of the curved ceiling appears to be covered in vividly colored frescos.  The walls are a combination of polished mahogany and painted panels that equal the ceiling in decoration.  Tiers of seats descend toward a stage at the hall's far end, their ranks upholstered in crimson velvet that matches red carpet runners traversing the aisles between them.  A row of small lanterns illuminates the front of the stage.

title: [Wehnimer's, Constabulary]
description: The front room of the local constabulary contains the desk of the town constable.  The oaken floor is scuffed by countless feet dragged across it, obviously most reluctantly.  Behind the desk is a weapon rack.  A strong, ironbound door with a narrow, barred grate leads east.

title: [Catacombs, Dank Cellar]
description: A few brown sewer rats dart across the floor and scurry north, in the direction of the odor of spoiled food and ancient cooking grease.  In a far bleak corner stands a filthy cot, a heap of dirty laundry piled high at its foot.  Anchored into the southern wall is a ladder, which disappears into the total darkness that obscures the vaulted ceiling.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Sunlight glints brightly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

The tall, rickety wooden ladder sways slightly under your weight.  The rungs show the wear of many sweaty hands.  Moonlight glistens softly off the water in the pool below.  The pool looks rather small from this height.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The very tall, very rickety wooden ladder sways considerably under your weight.  Below you the pool looks very, very small.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower]
description: The very tall, very rickety wooden ladder sways considerably under your weight.  Below you the pool looks very, very small.

title: [Paupers, Diving Tower Platform]
description: The narrow platform sways wildly under your weight.  Far below the pool seems nothing more than a bright, insignificant speck.  A short distance above you is the dome of the crystal ceiling.

title: [River Tower East, Roof]
description: A small, roofed structure provides some weather protection on the open top level of the guard tower.  The view north across the bay affords a valuable vantage point, looking out towards the island of Glaoveln, home port of the warlike Ice Krolvin.  To the west and south, the blue rivers and rocky slopes of the Lower Trollfang region provide a breathtaking vista.

title: [Observation Platform]
description: All manner of gadgets presents themselves for manipulation.  A crystal eyepiece mounted on a spring arm can be raised and lowered on a whim by use of a horizontal and vertical cranks and a lever made of invar.  The rotating chair swivels easily around, showing great views of the surrounding area through vertical-slit windows that traverse the walls.

title: [Northern Caravansary, SW Corner]
description: Stacked beneath and about a merchant wagon are scores of barrels and hogsheads, all tightly sealed and bound together with ropes.  A crudely fashioned sign depicting a pile of animals with 'X's' for eyes hangs above the door that the steps lead up to.

title: [Pets No More]
description: Taking up less than a quarter of the length of the wagon, this small room contains only a short, butcher block counter with Mettys Rundig standing behind it.  A curtained doorway to the left of the counter leads further into the wagon.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: Numerous tarps, stretched from the side of the merchant wagon and pegged to the turf, make this look less like a wagon and more like a tent grown wild.  Stairs emerge from beneath a low, canvas awning.

title: [Finders-Sellers Pawnshop]
description: Wooden bins are lined up along the canvas partition behind Brenteera Zule's counter.  Silvers paid out come from a small chest resting in her lap, and each item pawned gets tossed into the appropriate bin without her eyes leaving the counter in front of her.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: Two large wagons parked side-by-side dominate this area, with oversized hoops that stretch the crimson canvas into a common roof for both.  The sound of laughter, loud voices and the clink of glass on glass coming from within make a sign unnecessary.  The stairs leading up to the wagon's door look wider and sturdier than those of the neighboring wagons.

title: [Killin's Thirsty Work Tavern]
description: Light filtering through the red canvas of the roof and red-lensed nomad lanterns wash everything with a lurid glow.  The polished fel bar, resting on stacked casks, runs along the east wall, and bottles of every shape and color line the two shelves behind it.  Pedestal tables of various heights and ledges along the wagon sides provide rests for tankards and mugs, but with such cramped quarters there's no sign of anything to sit on.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: An oversized, boiled leather cuirass hangs on a post-and-crossbeam here, close alongside the steps leading up to this merchant wagon.  The dun canvas of the wagon's roof bears the armorers' guild symbol, a grey cuirass on a circle of blue.

title: [You Bet Your Life Armory]
description: Narrow tables laden with an assortment of armors, all obviously used, run along both sides of the wagon.  Runtahk Schen stands behind the hinged, fold-down counter, smiling pleasantly.  A pair of straw-filled dummies stand to either side of the entrance, one sans armor and quite severely hacked up, the other sporting badly cut and dented armor, but appearing otherwise intact.

title: [Northern Caravansary, Wagon Row]
description: A merchant wagon has been parked almost in the corner of the caravansary, its grey canvas roof bearing the sword-and-anvil symbol of the weaponcrafters guild.  Worn steps lead up to the rear of the wagon where a wooden sword has been bolted alongside the door.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest

title: [Weapons With a History]
description: Sword hilts and weapon hafts sprout from open barrels that line the walls in this small room.  A board laid across two barrels serves as a counter for the transaction of business.  A narrow, curtained doorway to the right of the counter leads further into the wagon.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Rancid Pool]
description: You are in a murky, rancid pool.  Putrid fumes from the pool make your eyes tear and your skin burn.  Although the pool is not deep, it is difficult to gain a sure footing on the slippery bottom.

title: [Czeroth Caverns, Great Cavern]
description: Along the edge of the murky pool, beaded helictite looks like thousands of pearls.  A large outcrop of gypsum flowers grows at the pool's edge.  If not for the rancid odors, this would be a magnificent cavern.

title: [Cysaegir, Copse]
description: Larkspurs, violets, alyssums, and bluebells thrive here by a gurgling brook.  Offering shades of yellow, blue, pink, and purple, their raceme clusters face the sun, and seem to quiver in excitement whenever a soft breeze sweeps across the ground.  Some spiraling stairs twine around a bole and lead to a shop built mid-level on the massive tree.  An exceptionally over-sized branch droops low offering shade and relaxation beside a whitewashed cottage.  Securely strung up between the trees are well-made hammocks, constructed from woven vines.

Larkspurs, violets, alyssums, and bluebells thrive here by a gurgling brook.  In the pale light of the evening, all of the flowers take on the same ghostly hue and seem to quiver in excitement whenever a soft breeze sweeps across the ground.  Some spiraling stairs twine around a bole and lead up to a shop built mid-level on the massive tree.  An exceptionally over-sized branch droops low, offering shade and relaxation beside a whitewashed cottage.  Securely strung up between the trees are well-made hammocks constructed from woven vines.

title: [Piaere's Boutique, Main Room]
description: A sprawling azure canopy, painted like the sky it obscures, shades this open-air platform enclosed by sturdy fel railing.  The massive trunk of a linden tree rises through the heart of this cozy boutique, and several of its thick branches have been converted into makeshift clothing racks.  A florid orange tree nearby scents the air with a heady fragrance, drawing iridescent hummingbirds to flit through the shop in search of sweet nectar.

title: [Emerald Forest, Pool]
description: Tiny fish dart past your legs and gusts of spray from the waterfall wash over your face as you bob in this chilly pool.  Something glints in the crevice of a rock at the very bottom, but the swirling current obscures the details.

title: [Emerald Forest, Stream]
description: A gentle, rushing roar announces the presence of a waterfall leaping over a ledge of rock on the hillside above your head.  The pool which forms at the bottom is small, but still deep enough to preserve a blue-green radiance.  From his perch atop a hummock of moss, a glistening toad serenades the forest.

title: [River's Rest, Creek]
description: An eddy has formed in a curve of the creek a short distance before it joins the wide Tempest River.  The bottom of the creek, visible through the clear water, consists of small pebbles that have been washed downstream by the current.  The creek bank, a half moon of brown, blue and green pebbles, is surrounded by tall cattails and reeds.  A small wooden footbridge crosses the creek to the north.  In the middle of the creek is an old pier piling.

title: [River's Rest, Creek Bank]
description: The pebbled path leads you to a grassy hillock overlooking the creek.  The creek bank here is rather steep.  At the water's edge is a small half moon of pebbles...blue, green and brown...flanked by reeds and cattails.  To the north you can see a small footbridge crossing the creek.  Tied to a limb of a tall oak tree is a length of hempen rope.

title: [River's Rest, River Beach]
description: A mixture of sand, pebbles and small rocks underfoot is still warm from the earlier sun of the day, counteracting a stiff, cool breeze from the Bay.  The beach runs to the river, the bank to the north having slowly disappeared leaving small eddying pools at the waters edge.  Across the widening river, a large rocky field is visible, ending at a high cliff far to the north.

A mixture of sand, pebbles and small rocks underfoot is heated by the sun, counteracting a stiff, cool breeze from the Bay.  The beach runs to the river, the bank to the north having slowly disappeared leaving small eddying pools at the waters edge.  Across the widening river, a large rocky field is visible, ending at a high cliff far to the north.

title: [The Stone Eye, Foyer]
description: Large slabs of granite, sitting snugly into solid oak crossbeams, make up the four walls, floor and ceiling.  Tiny gargoyles leer at you from a ledge affixed slightly below ceiling height.  Each gargoyle appears to have been hand carved with its own personality.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold, Casks]
description: You find yourself precariously balanced atop a stack of several large casks, but well within reach of the cargo grate above you.

title: [Krol Ship, Main Deck Amidships]
description: This is the center of the ship, where the Krolvin load their cargo and move on and off the ship via the gangplank.  To the north, towards the stern, you can see the massive base of the mainmast.  Further aft is the quarterdeck.  Forward from here are the foremast trunk and the forecastle.

title: [Krol Ship, Forecastle]
description: The deck here is elevated from the main deck to provide a tactical advantage to the sailors during boardings.  From here most of the river can be viewed, as well as most of the cove to the south.

title: [Krol Ship, Bowsprit]
description: Tenuously you cling to the large spar here which extends out from the bow of the ship.  Below you the water from a small river flows past the anchor chain and into the cove with a constant gurgle.  It looks as though the only way to go is back down the bowsprit, but you may be able to climb down the anchor chain with care.

title: [Krol Ship, Bowsprit]
description: Tenuously you cling to the large spar here which extends out from the bow of the ship.  Below you the water from a small river flows past the anchor chain and into the cove with a constant gurgle.  It looks as though the only way to go is back down the bowsprit, but you may be able to climb down the anchor chain with care.

title: [Krol Ship, Anchor Chain]
description: You are holding on to the wet anchor chain with the greatest of care, fully aware of the water swirling under the ship, below you.  Although the bowsprit is not high above you, trying to climb up to it would be suicide.  A few feet above you, the chain disappears into the ship's hull through the hawse hole.  You may be able to squeeze through it.

title: [Alchemist, Ruined Balcony]
description: Only a narrow ledge still remains of the former balcony.  This vantage provides an excellent view of the overgrown courtyard and the decrepit buildings beyond the crumbling perimeter walls.  Twenty feet below the ledge, slate tiles and shattered pots record the rest of the balcony's demise.  With some care, it might be possible to climb down the wall, but a heap of jaggedly splintered support beams awaits anyone with more confidence than skill.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: By night, the dominant hues of the courtyard are the delicate silver of reflected moonlight and the greenish-black of shadowy leaves.  Crumbling walls border the courtyard, demarcating the line between an untended interior and an equally wild exterior.  Broken slate tiles and shattered pots litter the ground around the remains of a fallen balcony.  A single shaft of moonlight pierces a jagged crack in the building's wall, but darkness dominates whatever lies beyond.

Crumbling walls border the courtyard, demarcating the line between an untended interior and an equally wild exterior.  Broken slate tiles and shattered pots litter the ground around the remains of a fallen balcony.  Part of the building's interior may be glimpsed through a jagged crack in the wall, seeming shadowy and dim by contrast with the brilliant orchids and verdant leaves that fill the overgrown garden.

title: [Citadel, Walkway]
description: Miniature flaming violets grow from the arch overhead.  Oddly, the flames don't seem to consume the violets or the arch itself.  The air, however, is very hot and the myriad charred avian bones show what happened to the few birds who got too close to the burning violets.

title: [Cavern]
description: The boulders which comprise the floor of this irregular cavern have been worn smooth by repeated floodings.  The air is very damp and you can hear the trickle of water farther down the passage.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: To the east a series of wide stone steps lead up the side of a pyramid.  A palatial building awaits at the top of the stairs, towering above the ruins of the surrounding city.  In the river to the west, partially submerged in the water, can be seen a carved obsidian statue fashioned in the image of a massive warrior.  The tip of a thick obsidian spear rests among the bulrush growing along the edge of the river bank.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the west of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

Positioned above all the single story buildings of the city, it is possible to see the damage that time has wrought.  Several blocks to the northwest a tall, dark tower pokes its tip above the cracked and crumbling walls of the surrounding structures.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A wide aisle runs between the pyramid and tiers of stone benches arranged in an oval pattern around an open space to the east.  Here and there, a small sapling has broken through the paved surface between the benches, like potted plants perched on a sitting room shelf.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Amphitheater]
description: Grass grows in rich abundance across this open field, spreading out in every direction in rippled waves of gold and green.  A series of terraced benches rises to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A series of stone benches circles out and around a large oval space to the east.  A section of the tiered seats is toppled over at the northern end of the oval, breaking the perfect symmetry of the structure and forming a wall along the edge of the river.

title: [Basilica Platform, Second Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the east of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.  Another set of steps lead up to the third level of the pyramid.

From this lofty height it is possible to see the dense forest to the east of the city walls.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the third level of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, Third Level]
description: A building constructed of gleaming white marble is enthroned upon the pinnacle of the pyramid.  No vegetation climbs the pristine heights of the exterior walls. No dirt or signs of erosion mar the ornate carvings that surround the arched entrance leading into its massive hall. It is as if time has come to halt atop this lofty tower.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: A set of descending stairs leads to the northwest, toward the center of the ruins.  Two marble pillars, seemingly in good condition, support the ceiling and form an archway in the southern wall.  The strong smell of the sea is carried in by a breeze that swirls, almost violently, through a window along the eastern wall.

title: [Ruined Temple, Second Floor]
description: Aside from the water that has flooded the area, the room is plain.  A single iron sconce remains attached to the wall, and the remains of another rests below the surface of the water.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Entrance]
description: The eldest of the yews here have grown into a great canopy, almost blotting out the sky.  Great shadows play through their branches, dancing over the tower steps.  The dim lights on the rough exterior walls give a very somber tone to the entrance here.  A small path parts the wall of foliage, carrying the faint sound of trickling water.

title: [Temple of Jastev, Nave]
description: The somber entranceway is poorly lit, leaving large shadows to consume the room corners.  A far wall is lined with boots and sandals, probably left by worshippers paying proper respect to the temple.  Small pegs are provided for visitors to leave their cloaks at the door.  You snatch a quick glimpse of a monk in a dark gray robe scurrying into the main temple.

title: [Tropics Trail, Exit]
description: A shadowy archway in the rock wall reveals a narrow stairway that has been cut through the rock, spiraling down towards the entrance of the aviary.  Clusters of pale lavender spider lilies, their angular petals edged in a vivid amethyst, grow at the base of the archway.  Lacy networks of vines drape across the face of the rock, displaying showy white and yellow striped morning glories.

title: [Aviaries, Entrance]
description: A long stone ramp leads down into a glass-domed enclosure, the stacked slate walls rising to support the clear, curving roof.  Bird tracks of various sizes and shapes are inlaid into the floor, wandering along a path that leads deeper into the structure.  A squat, tilted bronze-faced sign is placed near a set of wide double doors that lead out.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Kitchen]
description: Open on two sides, the kitchen is supported by wooden posts and sports a polished oak floor.  Large and small river stones form the other two walls, one of which is fitted with enormous baking ovens and a large hearth.  An enormous dining table, surrounded by a motley assortment of oak benches, stands at the center of the room beneath a candelabrum of frosted sea glass globes.  Near the rear of the room is a single oak door that is flanked by glass-front cabinets, while at the front is a set of steps.

title: [Gypsy Compound, Pond]
description: High grasses wave gently in the light breeze that travels through the area, their slender tips dipping to touch the riverstone path that leads away from the pond's edge.  Enormous lily pads speckle the pond, which is teeming with a variety of fish that can be glimpsed beneath the clear waters.  A pair of benches is set to the right of the shore and frame a pair of steps leading into an open front kitchen, while a low clothesline rests opposite them airing various articles of clothing.

title: [Museum Member's Suite]
[Museum, Member Lounge]
description: This reception area is restricted to use by members, patrons, donors and the elite of Wehnimer's Landing, to gather and entertain like-minded culture mavens.  The marble floors and walls are highly polished, reflecting the limpid light that filters through the stained glass skylight overhead.

In the middle of the ceiling, a large crystal chandelier descends to illuminate the inlaid wooden dance floor in the center of the room.  Various stained glass skylights dot the ceiling in an artfully haphazard fashion, each one a different scene of upper class society.  Along the northern wood-paneled wall, a long cloth-covered table is laden with refreshments.  Against the opposite wall, several plush velvet settees rest on the green marbled flooring that runs the edge of the room, offset from an intricately patterned silk curtain in the corner.

title: [Hall of Knowledge, Library]
description: Bookshelves encompass all the remaining wall space that is not taken up by doors, and a plush pale gold rug covers the floor.  Wooden tables, flickering oil lanterns set on their surfaces, and cushioned chairs offer areas to spread out and read or study.  Scents of parchment, glue, and dust permeate the room.  The well-manicured librarian stands behind a low wooden checkout desk, its surface littered with folios, quills, and jars of ink.

title: [Wehnimer's, East Jetty End]
description: The jetty ends here in jagged steps leading up to the tarnished brass tower, its doors hanging ajar on torn and twisted hinges.  At the tip of the breakwater, the spray of the waves and the salt breeze wash away the dirt and commotion of the town.

title: [Brass Tower, Entrance]
description: Cold and damp, the tower interior is smaller than expected though roomy enough to feel comfortable even in a large group.  The smell of the sea is still strong here, providing a musty flavor to the air.  A circular stairway leads to a landing above you, but the upper portion of it is scorched and twisted.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Rooftop]
description: The view from the rooftop extends all the way to the walls of Wehnimer's Landing and beyond.  Exposed to the elements, this wind blown edifice juts up into the sky opposite the observatory tower on the eastern side of the museum.  Protected from errant footfalls by metal rims, various stained glass skylights are set into the rough stone floor.  An unobtrusive drainpipe is attached to the side of the building, leading rainwater away from the roof.

title: [Wehnimer's, Wisraith Lane]
description: Interspersed among the small shops along the cobbled road are a few modwir-shingled private houses.  They are gaily decorated, competing for individuality with one another by means of daubs of colorful paint, skillfully carved doors and shutters, and window boxes bursting with ornamental flowers and fresh herbs.  A bright yellow awning lit by a glowing lamp marks the entrance to the florist, whose windows are brimming with fresh blossoms.

Interspersed among the small businesses and shops along the cobbled road are a few modwir-shingled private houses.  They are gaily decorated, competing for individuality with one another by means of daubs of colorful paint, skillfully carved doors and shutters, and window boxes bursting with ornamental flowers and fresh herbs.  A bright yellow awning marks the entrance to the florist, whose windows are brimming with fresh blossoms.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Ledges]
description: The ledge winds around a niche in the cliffs, the shacks set among the rocks somewhat sheltered from the constant wind by the curve of the land.  Weathered trees line the edge of the cliff above, their branches swept back over the merchant road.  A steep trail leads down the cliffside.

title: [Coastal Cliffs, Rocky Slope]
description: A niche in the cliffs shelters a sloping field of scattered rocks and dry brush.  Grasses rustle in the constant wind sweeping in from the bay, and seabirds soar overhead, their plaintive cries echoing from the cliffs.  A steep trail winds up the cliffside between the rocks.

title: [Daingneach Onoir, Entrance]
description: Massive walls of pure white granite bear numerous scars from both recent and long past assaults.  Towers stand sentinel to either side of an open modwir gate and raised portcullis, providing a suitable post for any guard.  Four flaming sconces frame the imposing entrance, and an intricate gem-inlaid crest is mounted proudly above it.  A narrow alcove near the northern tower reveals a granite staircase leading under the fortification.

Massive walls of pure white granite bear numerous scars from both recent and long past assaults.  Towers stand sentinel to either side of an open modwir gate and raised portcullis, providing a suitable post for any guard.  Four unlit sconces frame the imposing entrance, and an intricate gem-inlaid crest is mounted proudly above it.  A narrow alcove near the northern tower reveals a granite staircase leading under the fortification.

title: [Onoir, Granite Cavern]
description: Simple torches cast light upon the roughly hewn white granite walls, revealing numerous scorch marks and a patch of soot that stands out in one corner, oddly resembling a large, humanoid silhouette.  Ash has collected in the deeper depressions of the floor and lies in small piles on a set of granite steps leading up to the garden.  Clear of all dust and debris, a large wooden bucket rests idly beneath a crack in the wall.

title: [Beacon Hall, Dock]
description: A well-built stone pier juts out into the bay at the foot of a long stairway carved from the face of the cliff.

title: [Beacon Hall, Rock Room]
description: This room appears to be unfinished.  Although it is encompassed on all four sides by stone walls, it lacks a ceiling, and sunlight streams in unhindered.  The floor is made up entirely of small rocks and pebbles, which crunch loudly underfoot.

title: [Manor House, Attic]
description: Cobwebs fill every corner of this attic, and dust, mold and bat droppings cover the floor.  Several holes in the roof allow moonlight into this part of the attic near the stairway leading up from the manor's second floor.

Cobwebs fill every corner of this attic, and dust, mold and bat droppings cover the floor.  Several holes in the roof allow sunlight into this part of the attic near the stairway leading up from the manor's second floor.

title: [Manor House, Servants' Stairs]
description: Along the east wall a stairway descends to the ground floor of the house, while another stairway along the south wall leads up to the manor's attic.  Both sets of stairs look weak, and a few of the steps are actually missing.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entry Courtyard]
description: A small, crystalline pool edged with profuse ferns and seasonal wildflowers offers a spot of serenity in the otherwise busy entrance to the guild proper.  Impressive in size and architectural detail, the fortress looms just ahead, while the manicured courtyard and outdoor areas beyond rest placidly in its grand shadow.  A slate walkway and well-defined paths meander further into the grounds.

title: [Illistim Warrior Guild, Foyer]
description: A grand, double staircase leads up to the administrative offices of the Warrior Guild of Ta'Illistim.  Mica-flecked blue granite floors lead to fine, maoral-paneled walls, each bedecked with a suit of armor.  To the east, the guild's distinctive task offices are plainly visible through a wide marble arch and easily accesible to all guild members.

title: [Isle Dyes, Courtyard]
description: Walled with heavy white canvas that plummets down in straight lines from the supporting poles, the dyeing area is large, wide, and airy.  The roof overhead is also made of canvas, though it is raised several feet higher than the walls on separate poles to allow sunlight to filter in.  Billowing in the passing breeze, light drapes, of a sheer white variety that is a lovely contraposition to the blue tile flooring, serve as dividers between the courtyard and the individual dyeing stalls.

title: [Isle Dyes, Foyer]
description: Reddish tiling spreads across the floor in pleasant contrast to the white stucco walls.  A trio of curving arches to the west open up into the showroom, while a simple arch to the north leads out into an open-air courtyard.  Just adjacent, a large bamboo desk has been commandeered by a massive collection of papers and half-full dye bottles.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Nearly a cavern unto itself, the tunnel widens considerably into a large chamber illuminated by four torches set along its length.  Two alcoves have been cut into either side of the tunnel, one with stone steps leading upwards, and another with a ladder disappearing into the ceiling.  Somewhere in the darkness, crickets chirp contently.

title: [Targon's Tavern, Backroom]
description: The room is small by human standards, but the perfect size for a dwarf patron or barkeep.  Stacks of crates line one wall and rows of barrels line the other.  A light sprinkling of sand covers the floor on the far side of the room and trails off in the direction of the door leading back towards the bustling sounds of the tap room.  A stuffed rolton head hangs from one wall, an expression of shock and surprise eternally captured on its face.

title: [Smuggler's Tunnels, Wide Tunnel]
description: Nearly a cavern unto itself, the tunnel widens considerably into a large chamber illuminated by four torches set along its length.  Two alcoves have been cut into either side of the tunnel, one with stone steps leading upwards, and another with a ladder disappearing into the ceiling.  Somewhere in the darkness, crickets chirp contently.

title: [Timor's, House Annex Hallway]
description: The hallway floor is warped and uneven.  Ceramic oil lamps hang from the ceiling, bathing the hallway in a flickering light.

title: [Dark Tunnel]
description: Heavy footsteps can be heard overhead, along with deep, gruff voices.  Several empty crates have been stacked in the corner beside odd bits of metal.

title: [J.M. and Descendants, Foyer]
description: A small, entry room forms a T-shaped intersection with larger shops to the north and south.  Occasionally the sound of metal grinding on metal comes from either direction, and sometimes from both directions simultaneously.  Overhead, a large, tightly woven metal mesh cage houses a goodly number of fireflies, and their winking on and off illuminates the room with a soft strobe effect.  A metal sign affixed to the west wall offers a directory of services, and a heavy black door provides an exit.

title: [Rogue Guild, Roof]
description: A low wall encircles the roof affording a measure of privacy from anyone who happens to glance up.  Weeds and wildflowers growing in the cracks ruffle slightly in the breeze.

title: [Solhaven, Wentletrap Lane]
description: The buildings along this stretch of Wentletrap Lane are ornamented with a variety of sawtoothing, panelling and moldings, creating variety in a fairly conservative style.  A large, verdigrised brass quill hangs above the doorway of a small shop that occupies the northeast corner of the Scriveners' Hall.

title: [Rogue Guild, Hallway]
description: The tiled floor is partly covered with simple rugs.  The flickering light from the ornate brass oil lamps reflects off a brightly polished tower shield which hangs on the wall.

title: [Narrow Tunnel]
description: The entrance to this carefully engineered tunnel is marked with an arched oak crossbeam supported by stout oak bracing columns.  A gourd-shaped ceramic oil lamp hangs from the crossbeam, illuminating the tunnel with a strange, shimmering light.

title: [Wizard Guild, Steps]
description: The narrow channel feels as enclosed as a chimney and is almost as sooty.  The rock walls around you are uncomfortably warm to the touch, and the widely spaced torches shed little light on the seemingly never-ending steps.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Cliff Top]
description: You are on a narrow ledge heading west.  The east side stops at a cliff which drops about 50 feet before the trail continues west again.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Staircase]
description: The trail up the mountain ends here at the base of a sheer, 50-foot cliff face.  In front of this is a series of four stone pillars that seems to be some sort of unusual staircase.  There are also some strange markings on the mountain wall.

title: [Channel]
description: The passage slowly curves and leads to a rusted iron ladder that leads back up.  Something heavy must have fallen from above, as the cobblestones at the base of the ladder are cracked badly.

title: [Inn]
description: Quite a contrast from the squalor of the tunnels below, this comfortable common room looks well-furnished.  Several tables and chairs allow folks a comfortable place to sit and chat.  Large portraits adorn the walls, most depicting the more famous buildings of Ta'Vaalor.

title: [South Crossing, Riverbank]
description: The river swells as it strikes a massive boulder in midstream, forming eddies along each bank.  A deep pool is created as a result of the conflicting flows cutting into the streambed.  Despite the depth, the gravel and mosses at the bottom of the pool are clearly visible.  Nourished over the centuries by the river it grows next to, a gnarled old oak towers above.  Dangling from one of its limbs is a knotted rope.

title: [Crossing, In the River]
description: The swirling waters of the river have created a deep swimming hole here, lined on the banks with small wildflowers and carpeted with waving green water plants.  Fish swim about your legs, darting away at the slightest move towards them.  The water is briskly chilly, giving you prickly goosebumps all over.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Workshop]
description: Various chutes, pipes, and conduits open out into this room, conveying an occasional load of rubbish.  The floor is cleverly constructed of tightly spaced wood lattice, allowing the smaller bits to fall into the fetid bilgewater below while keeping the larger detritus available for sorting.  A frayed rope ladder dangles down from some unseen vantage overhead.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Landing]
description: You break your long journey upward at a small landing, hardly more than a few planks wide.  Great stacks of lumber surround you, the sweet smell of the freshly sawn boards a refreshing change from the dank sewer below.  A small breeze comes from somewhere nearby, though the source seems hidden.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Landing]
description: You break your long journey upward at a small landing, hardly more than a few planks wide.  Great stacks of lumber surround you, the sweet smell of the freshly sawn boards a refreshing change from the dank sewer below.  A small breeze comes from somewhere nearby, though the source seems hidden.

title: [A Stick in Your Eye, Entry]
description: The low space between the decks is here completely filled with piles of fresh-sawn lumber.  All manner of woods are here, neatly stacked and bound: mundane woods, like pale boxwood and black ebony, as well as rare magical woods, from grey hoarbeam to russet-toned ruic.

title: [Rogue Guild, Wine Cellar]
description: The dim light from a torch casts a flickering light over the murky room causing dancing shadows to play over a rack of dusty wine bottles sitting against one wall.  Two large wine casks on the opposite wall nearly fill the rest of the room.  Sitting in the center of the bare floor is a small table.

title: [Rogue Guild, Pantry]
description: A large set of shelves covers one wall, filled with cobwebs and dust-covered table settings.  An ornate wrought iron lantern broods over the room, casting a sickly glow through grimy glass panes.  The floor is curiously scratched in a pattern before the shelves.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sandy Peninsula]
description: Golden sunlight warms the air, which is heavy and balmy from the rise and fall of the surf that separates the glittering sands of the beach from the roped-off swimming area.  Umbrellas dot the coast, their vibrant silken expanses offering shade to the blankets set beneath them.  Beach grass-riddled dunes create a barrier between the sprawling streets of the shopping district and the beach, while a sandy pathway accommodates the foot traffic.

Cool and misty, the air is dominated by the sound of the surf as it pounds against the sandy beach beneath the silvery light of the moons.  Passing clouds occasionally cast shadows upon the landscape and paint the various umbrellas lining the coast in caliginous hues.  Beach grass-riddled dunes create a barrier between the sprawling streets of the shopping district and the beach, while a sandy pathway accommodates the foot traffic.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Dolphin Lane]
description: Nestled within verdant dog rose bushes, a series of white benches fashioned of wooden slats lines the cobblestone streets amid pillars fitted with frosted globes.  Occupying a space along one of the sidewalks, a young freckled merchant offers treats from her umbrella-covered wooden cart, while to the east, a series of dunes topped with high, green beach grasses provides easy access to the beach.

Nestled within verdant dog rose bushes, a series of white benches fashioned of wooden slats lines the cobblestone streets amid pillars fitted with glowing frosted globes that cheerfully dispel the dark.  Occupying a space along one of the sidewalks, a young freckled merchant offers treats from her umbrella-covered wooden cart, while to the east, a series of dunes topped with high, green beach grasses provides easy access to the beach.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Temple]
description: Pale periwinkle wisteria vines drape across the smooth white marble of an aged temple as it rises suddenly across the pathway and blocks further progress to the north.  Painted windows shimmer as they reflect golden sunlight into the pools that ring the temple's base, their waters speckled with anemones and water lilies and bisected by a pair of smooth marble steps etched with the image of frolicking sea otters playing with dolphins.

Pale periwinkle wisteria vines drape across the smooth white marble of an aged temple as it rises suddenly across the pathway and blocks further progress to the north.  Painted windows shimmer as they reflect silvery moonlight into the pools that ring the temple's base, their waters speckled with anemones and water lilies and bisected by a pair of smooth marble steps etched with the image of frolicking sea otters playing with dolphins.

title: [Ceiluir Glade, Niima's Temple]
description: Painted into the domed ceiling is a mosaic of the oceans and mists that surround the island, while below, a wall of aquariums is filled with a plethora of the local aquatic life.  Colored sunlight tickles the smooth diamond-shaped tiles that cover the floor, their source the wide windows that flank the steps leading out.

Candles perched in high niches are shielded with blue sea glass globes that reflect the light in watery hues across the domed ceiling and mimic the rolling of waves as they flicker.  Below, a wall of aquariums is filled with a plethora of aquatic life local to the island.  Colored moonlight tickles the smooth diamond-shaped tiles that cover the floor, their source the wide windows that flank the steps leading out.

title: [Groom's Waiting Room]
description: Silver and ebon-veined marble tiles spread across the floor towards walls that are painted with scenes of the wild hunt.  Standing before a wide open window is a full-length mirror, while a glass-covered wrought iron table nearby houses a set of playing tiles.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a set of polished linden stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble fauna-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Great Hall, Ebon Chapel]
description: Golden tiles mix with ebon as they stretch across the floor to meet with the linden walls that are accented with ebonwood columns that spiral upward to a sanguine dome ceiling.  Wrought iron wall sconces ring the upper reaches of each carved support and are fitted with dark green, white, and pale yellow tallows, which spread golden illumination through the area.  An enormous stained glass window is the focal point beyond the ebon marble altar and is framed by twin alcoves, one lined in gold and the other lined in silver.

title: [Bride's Waiting Room]
description: White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the light seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows that they frame and is accompanied by the spill of golden sunlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

White gossamer drapes flutter lazily in the cool seaside breeze that drifts through the open birch windows and is accompanied by a spill of silvery moonlight.  A full-length mirror stands beside a glass-covered wrought iron table that is covered with roses in nearly every hue of the rainbow and still has ample room for storage.  Standing at opposite sides of the room, a series of silvery ash stairs leads down into the ebon chapel, while a marble ivy-patterned staircase leads into the white chapel.

title: [Great Hall, White Chapel]
description: Deep cobalt blue tiles stretch across the floor, their glossy expanses decorated with white trilliums that provide a delicate accent to the white walls and high ceiling.  Twin alcoves flank the altar, one trimmed in carved wildlife and the other in verdant ivy bands.  An enormous stained glass window in the shape of an inverted diamond occupies the back wall, its image that of a young couple gazing up at the sun as they kneel in prayer.

title: [Cholgar's Cavern]
description: The walls glisten as water slowly drips down, creating a musty aroma to the shadowy cavern.  Corroded black lanterns provide a soft diffused glow, faintly illuminating a cracked crystal fountain resting between a stack of old crates and a waterlogged bookcase.  A broken chain snakes around a cluster of tarnished bins which are positioned next to a pile of rubble.

title: [Theatre, Backstage]
description: The area behind the stage is in disarray, with wooden props scattered about the floor while fanciful costumes are overflowing from iron-bound chests.  Bins of old paint rest near a few discolored wooden sets, their transformation still incomplete.  A few stools rest before a row of vanities, and a dim passageway leads back to the theatre's auditorium.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Basement]
description: Lined on both sides by flickering torches, this room is part of a tunnel beneath the museum.  A set of stone steps leads upward toward a brighter light, while the enclosed passage stretches on to the east and west, its rough walls crafted from timber braces and mortared stone.

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Foyer]
[Wehnimer's Museum, Grand Lobby]
description: White marble columns, set halfway into the walls, serve as both decoration and structural support for the high ceiling.  Set between them are some colorful velvet settees that offer respite for weary patrons.  The cool marble floor is interrupted by a pale gold carpet that leads up an expansive staircase.  In the center of the western wall is a green marble arch, while the eastern wall sports a white marble arch.  Across the room from a gold marble arch, a large platinum plaque and a rectangular white sign are displayed beside the oaken double doors that lead outside.

You are in the grand entry hall of the Wehnimer's Museum.  This building houses much ancient and historical lore, artifacts and antiquities.  The museum complex consists of galleries bedecked in fine works of art, wings devoted to historical artifacts, a library of rare manuscripts, a wing devoted to the natural history of Elanthia, and a Hall of Magic and Technology.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, out

title: [Wehnimer's Museum, Planetarium]
description: The black walls are circular, creating a dark cylindrical space.  Domed, the ceiling is riddled with tiny holes and lit from behind.  The light shining through the holes mimics the starlight on a cloudless night.  All the constellations well-known to the local area can be seen among the stars.  A narrow stone staircase leading up and a set of spiral stone stairs leading down rest against one curved wall, while four constellation tapestries hang an equidistance from each other on the rounded walls, their contents illuminated by the starlight from above.

title: [Hall of Knowledge, Laboratory]
description: The room is dim, a faint luminescence emanating from a single shelf mounted on the wall that houses several glowing potions under a glass case.  There are small plaques on the shelf in front of each potion, their metal surfaces gleaming in the half-light of the room.  Centrally located, a simmering cast iron cauldron over a magical blue flame sits adjacent to a mortar and pestle that rest on a small pedestal.  A gnarled ebonwood arch leads to the northwest, while an onyx arch leads southwest.

title: [Wrought From Rot, Ledge]
description: Humidity soaks you in a bath of sticky air at the top of the hollowed out cypress.  Mold grows in dense clusters on the ceiling and wars silently with a moss-covered wall for territory in the corners.  The scent of mildew is protrusive.

Humidity saturates the air at the top of the hollowed out cypress and mold grows in dense clusters on the ceiling, warring silently with a moss-covered wall for territory in the corners.  The scent of mildew is protrusive.

title: [Wrought From Rot]
description: Heat and humidity saturate the air, and a single torch is mounted on a long length of rattan to better illuminate the interior of the tree.  Crooked wooden stands are nonchalantly placed against walls covered in moss and spiderwebs.  The floor is a soft, squishy combination of trampled swamp grasses and mud.

title: [Dollhouse, Entry]
description: The varnished mahogany walls enclosing the area are accentuated by the elegant ebonwood chairs set about the wagon.  A single chandelier casts illumination upon the center, highlighting the soft lamb's wool area rug occupying the floor.  A claw-footed table of mahogany rests on the rug, a tall-backed upholstered chair on either side.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Long tendrils of grey-green moss drape gracefully from the overhead branches of an ancient cedar.  An artistic touch has been rendered with the twisting of red silk ribbons into the tendrils, like a grey-haired matriarch with beribboned braids.  Beneath the living curtain, chiseled-stone statues stand sentinel at the corners of a raised wooden platform.

title: [A Pocket Full]
description: The scent of leather pervades this room, mixed with lantern oil, and a faint flowery scent.  A darkly stained oak crate crammed with goods rests on the floor near the front, while a small cherry oak dresser with open drawers stands against the wall to one side, below an etched metal sign.  The area is lit with several flickering lanterns set along the rustic log walls, between two of which, a row of hooks displays more wares to be sold.  At the back of the wagon, a small archway affords further entrance, while opposite, an open doorway housing a set of steps leads back outside.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: A proliferation of fiddlehead ferns flourishes here, each nestled snuggly against its neighbor.  Near the pathway most are small, their curling tops barely reaching ankle height of those making their way through the growth.  To each side, ferns of greater maturity are fully unfurled, reaching heights that would tower above the average gnome.

Near the pathway most are small, their curling tops barely reaching ankle height of those making their way through the growth.  To each side, ferns of greater maturity are fully unfurled, reaching heights that would tower above the average gnome.

title: [Close Yer Robe, Porch]
description: The wood plank flooring has rotten through in several places, leaving large holes in the surface and making walking here treacherous.  A dilapidated porch swing hangs from the listing tin roof that is so laden with rusty holes that it does not protect from the elements at all.  The paint on the railing has peeled almost completely, leaving the bare wood showing from beneath.  A layer of mold and grime coats every surface, including a trio of steps that leads down, and the frame of the open doorway that offers entrance.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Highland]
description: The decayed skeleton of a large cat rests half in and half out of a small brackish pool beside the main path.  Its jaw is frozen in a silent scream, and bits of leathered skin cling tenuously to its bones.  An odd growth of fungi clutters the surrounding area.

The decayed skeleton of a large canine rests half in and half out of a small brackish pool beside the main path.  Its jaw is frozen in a silent scream, and bits of leathered skin cling tenuously to its bones.  An odd growth of fungi clutters the surrounding area.

title: [Erythro Island, Forest Ring]
description: A chorus of mournful wails eerily fill the forest, their cries sounding forlorn and distant.  Birds take to the sky, dark silhouettes against the ruddy sky.

title: [Erythro Island, Blood Tunnel]
description: The walls of the tunnel are unnaturally smooth and their surfaces covered in dark blood.  Small radiant red orbs hover throughout the underground passageway, their scarlet light bathing the area in a crimson glow.

title: [Stone Keep, Courtyard]
description: Stone rubble from the wall above lays in scattered chunks around the courtyard, the rocks layered with a solid coat of ice.  A frayed rope leads back up to the keep's perimeter.

title: [Stone Keep, Outer Wall]
description: The stone wall has completely collapsed here making any further travel around the keep impossible.  A fraying rope hangs down the side of the wall and lowers into the open courtyard below.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: The fractured remnants of an animal's skull lie amidst a pile of dusty bones in a corner of the tunnel, where it opens into a wide turn.  Nearby, a crude wooden ladder leads up to a hinged trapdoor.

title: [Lower Dragonsclaw, Forest]
description: The evidence of a lightning strike is more pronounced here, and even massive trees have been felled and charred.  One impressive ruin is the huge trunk of a fallen modwir, which lies upon the ground.  Just barely the height of a man, a hole in the trunk shows it to be hollow.

title: [Begetting Besiegers, Basement]
description: Narrow wooden steps lead down from the trapdoor in the ceiling, ending in a wide underground chamber.  Old rusty sconces cast a dim glow along the earthen walls, creating thick pockets of shadows that partially conceal a flimsy wooden door.

title: [Begetting Besiegers, Backroom]
description: Windowless and dim, it's a wonder how the artisan gets any detailed work done.  A small leather-padded stool rests between two paint-stained tables, easily affording the craftsman an ample amount of space.  Short shelves and stands hold an assortment of half-finished miniatures, many still colorless or missing limbs.  Tart crumbs are scattered about the floor.

title: [Wehnimer's, Burrow Way]
description: While most of the tunnel is shrouded in darkness, this section is aglow from the orange light of several torches set into the earthen walls.  The passageway is warm from the burning torches, and half a dozen troll skeletons litter the ground.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: Fragrant evergreens cover the side of the ridge here.  Years of battling the elements have stunted and twisted their growth as they cling to the rocks and rubble that clutter the side of the hill.

title: [Burga Hall, Courtyard]
description: A cobbled path, leading from the black gate to the porch steps, breaks the monotony of the white-encrusted landscape.  The path's stones are a multi-hued mosaic that repeats a colorful abstract pattern along its length.  The walkway is free from ice and snow, proof of a groundskeeper who keeps it clear.  Iceblossoms and frostflowers add their pale colors to the flower beds that hug the wall of the low, wide building.  Branching from the main path, a long snow-packed trail leads into the trees at the side of the hall.

title: [Burga Hall, Porch]
description: Long and rectangular, this room encompasses about half of the front facade of the building.  The hardwood floor is kept free from debris and snow by an absorbent rug resting by the door leading out.  With stone bricks comprising the bottom half of the walls and wood planks making up the top, the room has a rustic feel, amplified by the wrought iron lanterns that illuminate the area from their perch in niches along the walls.  Near the entry, a white wooden table holds a variety of glittering objects.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Passage]
description: A single, unwavering torch illuminates a long, roughly hewn stone hallway.  Flecks of ore and crystal glimmer out from the natural rock walls, and coarse rockdust litters the floor, causing footfalls to crunch softly.  Dark passages lead off to the south and the west, and some rough stairs lead up into yet more gloom.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Foyer]
description: Black obsidian walls, polished to a sheen that nearly matches that of the tall silver mirror that stands at the west end of the foyer, rise to the vaulted ceiling thirty feet above.  A gracefully curved staircase of black marble winds along the walls, leading upwards into the higher reaches of the tower.  Dark banners emblazoned with symbols of the Dhe'nari castes hang high on the walls, and a set of double doors carved of black ora opens to the south.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: The winding, lattice-work pattern of the bark makes for easy climbing, providing several nooks comfortable for sitting.  Twisted tree-roots hang down from the branches above, creating a skeletal canopy.  A light mist swirls down from the thick, leafy roof.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Banyan]
description: Deep lacerations in the tree and tufts of dark fur caught in the uneven bark mark the area as a resting place of some large cat.  Several liana hang down from the branches above, swaying slightly back and forth.  A fresh scent fills the air, a distinct change after the decay below.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Stepped Valley]
description: Though as verdant and overwhelmed by the growth of grasses and ferns as the rest of the valley, a raised plateau to the north does provide some means of visually pinpointing location.  A few large boulders litter the ground, perhaps washed down from the sloping sides of the tableland during harsh weather.

title: [Monsoon Jungle, Highlands]
description: Raised above the level of the rest of the valley, the plateau is a haven for huge ferns and even a few of the larger jungle trees.  From this vantage point, a section of coastal cliff is plainly visible in the distance.  One fallen tree trunk forms a bridge of sorts to a small ridge in those cliffs.  To the south the sloping sides of the tableland provide a natural descent to the floor of the cirque below.

Raised above the level of the rest of the valley, the plateau is a haven for huge ferns and even a few of the larger jungle trees.  From this vantage point, a section of coastal cliff is plainly visible in the distance.  One fallen tree trunk forms a bridge of sorts to a small ridge in those cliffs.  To the south, the sloping sides of the tableland provide a natural descent to the floor of the cirque below.

title: [Earthen Cave, Undertree]
description: A rough stone ladder descends from above near the very edge of the room.  The cave's chamber is walled with hard-packed soil, held in by a network of roots that crisscross the walls like the threads of a spider's web, two of which flank a narrow earthen passage.  A large bundle of roots descends from the center of the ceiling in a writhing tangle, some tips curled around glowing crimson globes, creating a macabre chandelier.  Set beneath the roots is a fire pit, while in the background, set into the wall, is a niche containing an ornamented skeleton.

title: [Shadowed Clearing]
description: Dense canopy surrounds this small clearing encasing it in cool dark shadow.  Thin white mist enshrouds a stained stone slab that is surrounded by tiny black gravel in the center of the clearing.  No living thing disturbs the silent grip that stillness holds on this secret, hidden glen.  Over the slab, three small orbs slowly hover, spinning around each other and casting a faint silvery light that mutes nearby colors into varied shades of pale whites, cool grays, and pitch blacks.  Between two trees is an arch of tangled boughs.

title: [Rogue Guild, Access Points]
description: Narrowing quickly, the huge tunnel deadends in a thick metal grate that completely covers one end.  Bits of paper and various other waste cling to the cross bars of the grate indicating that, at times, there is considerably more water here than now.  A rusty iron ladder leads up to a manhole above.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Crane Lane]
description: White picket fences, their thick and thin slats entangled with vines laden with niveous violet-striped clematis and red-throated saffron hibiscus, encircle the yards of the houses that line the cobbled street.  Shell-lined pathways wind their way through the verdant lawns that the fences encircle and allow easy passage from the street to the cottages beyond, some of which have signs proclaiming them to be shops.  Lamps, their glass windows glinting in the sunlight, dangle from wrought iron shepherd's crooks that line the streets.

White picket fences, their thick and thin slats entangled with vines laden with niveous violet-striped clematis and red-throated saffron hibiscus, encircle the yards of the houses that line the cobbled street.  Shell-lined pathways wind their way through the verdant lawns that the fences encircle and allow easy passage from the street to the cottages beyond, some of which have signs proclaiming them to be shops.  Lamps dangle from wrought iron shepherd's crooks that line the streets and create circles of illumination.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Rounded cobblestones are stacked with precision to create the smooth walls, which gently curve upward to create a domed ceiling.  Piles of debris are clustered along the southern wall, the faint scent of decay and mildew rising from them, though the northern wall appears to be largely clear where a sewer-capped ladder disappears into the ceiling.  Oddly deep, several claw marks mar the lower area of the rounded walls.

title: [Eastern Harbor, Sea Turtle Lane]
description: Surrounded by flowering trees, the teak and cedar villa sprawls across a petal-strewn lawn along the northern edge of the street.  Glassless windows provide a view of the cobalt blue walls of the interior, while the exterior is marked by an elegant painted sign and an arched entry that exudes a welcoming atmosphere.  Golden sunlight illuminates the tangled clusters of the surrounding foliage, which provides a pleasant contrast to the bright white of the cobblestoned street.

Surrounded by flowering trees, the teak and cedar villa sprawls across a petal-strewn lawn along the northern edge of the street.  Wide open windows, illuminated from within, provide a view of the cobalt blue walls of the interior, while the exterior is marked by an elegant painted sign and an arched entry that exudes a welcoming atmosphere.  Circles of lamplight pool upon the cobblestones and cast shadows in the surrounding foliage that partially obscure a vast marble castle.

title: [Bard Guild, Courtyard]
description: Offering an excellent view of the harbor, the stone-lined walkway opens up into a large cobblestone courtyard.  Beds of bright flowers are planted about, splashing color over the pale grey stones leading up to an elegant whitewashed manor.  A pair of bright ceramic urns flank the staircase, each one filled with beautiful island blossoms.  Several varieties of orchid and fern trees surround the area, creating a colorful canopy.

title: [Bard Guild, Foyer]
description: Lush crimson carpeting spreads over the grey and gold flecked marble floor.  A pair of high-backed chairs sits to the side of a marble stairway leading up to the second floor, a wide banister landing visible from below.  Sounds of merriment drift from a high teak archway draped with rich velvet curtains, while a large flowering plant tumbles out of a stoneware pot and creeps into the long hallway that leads away from the foyer.

Lush crimson carpeting spreads over the grey and gold flecked marble floor.  A pair of high-backed chairs sits to the side of a wide staircase leading up to the second floor, a wide banister landing visible from below.  Sounds of merriment drift from a high teak archway draped with rich velvet curtains, while a large flowering plant tumbles out of a stoneware pot and creeps into the long hallway that leads away from the foyer.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Much of the water flowing into the area cascades through the gates in the floor in a frothy rush, leaving the available footing covered with spray and as slippery as metal.   Recessed into the wall, a ladder pushes up toward a trapdoor.

title: [A Dark Warehouse]
description: Cramped and crowded, the small room appears to be a warehouse with brick walls and a knotty oak floor.  Stacks of boxes and containers are piled to the ceiling in many places and create a labyrinthine maze of packed goods.  Incredibly faint light leaks out from behind one particular short stack of wooden crates, while light from the alley also filters in through the open doorway.

title: [Sewers, Beneath the Slaughter]
description: Smelling heavily of carnage, the dank passage is illuminated by a single torch resting in a bracket beside a blackened wrought iron ladder that leads upwards towards the oak ceiling.  Sanguine stains darken the walls and packed dirt floor.

title: [The Slaughterhouse]
description: Cracked and peeling paint decorate the walls of the small shop, their curled ends littering the rough floor amid a layer of scattered sawdust.  One long counter stretches across the room, easily dividing the shopping space from the work area.  Implements of the butchering trade, such as razor strops, black iron rib cutters, and knives, dangle from black iron hooks, which stand over sanguine filled buckets.

title: [Rogue Guild, Sewers]
description: Scents of garlic and herbs mingle with those of rotten food.  The water flows slowly past piles of food wastes in various states of decay.  A soft click-click in the darkness suggests that the piles are feasts for some.  Rising from a pile of fresh slop, a slippery ladder leads upward to the apparent source.

title: [Monkey Fist, Storage Closet]
description: Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

Roughly the size of a broom closet, the small room is illuminated by what light spills in from beyond the a doorway to the Monkey Fist kitchen.  A well-used refuse chute sits beneath various storage shelves at the back of the room, and is surrounded by carrot, fruit, and cucumber peels.

title: [Rogue Guild, Training Nexus]
description: Several iron-grated drains are recessed into the uneven cobblestone of the floor and surround a raised platform that is covered in steel sheets.  Large alcoves lined in white and black stones are arranged around the north, west, and southern walls, their depths illuminated by candles from within.  Surrounding the eastern passage into the sewers is an old iron ladder, that leads up, and a rough oak table that is heavily scarred with jagged gashes.

title: [Warehouse, Tanner's Haven]
description: Thick and cloying, the air in this section of the warehouse is heavy with the acrid scent of chemicals despite the wide open window located in its eastern wall.  Curing frames hang from the exposed rafters above vats filled with viscous liquids, while a long counter stretching across the opposite wall provides ample workspace for the various apprentices that move through the room completing obscure tasks.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Locks]
description: Flickering light from the north spills into this section of the tunnel, though its licking fingers do not invade the deep shadows to the south.  Rising along the eastern wall, and bolted into place by large iron brackets, is a blackened ladder that leads from the cobblestone floor and disappears into the wooden ceiling.

title: [Locks and More, Workshop]
description: The ceiling slants downward from a peak overhead, mimicking the shape of the roof above.  Hooks have been placed on the lower part of the ceiling towards one side of the room, various tools used in the art of locksmithing and repairing lockpicks hanging from them.  Beneath them is a worn oak table that looks as though it might once have been a fine piece.  Windows up near the peak of the ceiling on either side of the room provide the only light, the lamps overhead unlit.

The ceiling slants downward from a peak overhead, mimicking the shape of the roof above.  Hooks have been placed on the lower part of the ceiling towards one side of the room, various tools used in the art of locksmithing and repairing lockpicks hanging from them.  Beneath them is a worn oak table that looks as though it might once have been a fine piece.  Moonlight filters through the windows up near the peak of the ceiling, the lamps overhead lit to provide more light.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Gems]
description: Bright light spills into this short passage from the south, its brilliance illuminating every stone, corner, and crevice in the area.  A single ladder rises from the stone floor and disappears into the wooden rafters of the ceiling.

title: [Etaenia's Jewels]
description: Blue, green, and purple striped rugs are scattered about on the floor, like small islands, while an oak counter partially spans one side of the room.  A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, the curtains drawn back allowing daylight to enter.

A jeweler's loupe rests upon the counter at one end, and jewels in the process of being cut, cleaned, and polished sit at the other, in front of a padded stool.  Curtains matching the rugs hang upon the windows that adorn the walls, and crystal lamps are hung between the windows, providing additional lighting.

title: [Sewers, The Underside of Health]
description: Glass globes housed in copper cages are suspended from the ceiling and provide ample illumination for this section of the tunnel.  Painted bright white, the walls, ceiling, and floor are all uniformly the same and a narrow cot appears to be the only furnishing.  A blackened iron ladder leads upward through a small trapdoor.

title: [Healer's House]
description: Filmy blue chiffon curtains blow gently in the breeze from the open windows, while a small calico cat snoozes beneath them in a patch of light on the floor.  Drying herbs hang from hooks upon the wall, waiting to be used in various medicines.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

Filmy blue chiffon curtains blow gently in the breeze from the open windows, while a small calico cat bats lazily at them from a big blue cushion on the floor.  A large quantity of lamps hanging overhead keep the room well lit.  A small table covered with bandages and medicines sits next to a padded table covered with a sheet.  Next to an embroidered curtain rests a large basket filled with dried lilacs, giving the room a pleasant scent.

title: [Sewers, Under Lock and Key]
description: Roughly carved out of dirt, the terminus is surrounded on four sides by walls and has a small tunnel that leads towards a central nexus.  Spidery white roots decorate the smooth walls and the floor is pitted with oddly shaped rocks.  Four thick support posts mark the corners of the area, while a blackened iron ladder rises towards the knotty oak ceiling where a small trap door stands closed.  A waxed parchment is tacked near the ladder.

title: [Mist Harbor Lockup, Cell]
description: Bitter and bleak, the air hardly moves in here except for a single vent in the center of the ceiling.  A thin shaft of moonlight is the only access to the outside through a vertical crack in the outside wall.  A small metal table is bolted to the floor as is a sturdy metal cot next to it.

A large fallen log rests underneath the shade of several of its companion trees, its roughened jagged-edged body covered in an array of vines and insects.  Butterflies flutter in and out of small patches of wildflowers flourishing near the edge of the jungle, their jewel-toned wings creating a subtle, yet distinctive, buzz in the humid air.  The presence of an occasional breeze, wafting in from the nearby river, alleviates the discomfort of the sauna-like surroundings.
